json.title: Yardman/Picker/Sorter

content.jobHook: The Waste Resource Recovery and Waste Management Sector is a Rain/ Hail and Shine Business
content.unEditedContent:
Chilli bins Leading Waste Management is seeking a hard working and honest Yardman/Picker/Sorter to join our team at our Chilli Recycle Facility located in Caboolture.

The role involves working in an indoor/outdoor environment completing general picking in construction and demolition waste resource recovery facility.

When not Picking you will assist the team with routine plant and yard maintenance tasks such as greasing and general cleaning duties as well as driving the site sweeper (on site training will be provided.

This is a recycling entry level position the requires you to be physically fit and have a positive can do attitude with strong work ethics. The ideal candidate must be prepared to wear appropriate safety equipment during the shift, including hardhat, safety glasses, masks, hearing protection, gloves ,long sleeved high visibility clothing.

Future career development opportunities exist including leadership roles, Truck Driving, Loader or Excavator roles are available to those that display initiative and the right attitudE.

Must have own transport be reliable trustworthy and able to pass drug and alcohol testing.

json.title: Retail and Customer Service Assistant

bulletPoints: Join an award winning Australian footwear brand that customers genuinely love
Hands on, varied role across retail, online customer service and admin
Footwear perks and the opportunity to grow with a growing brand
content.jobHook: Join our growing footwear brand! Help customers find supportive, comfy shoes in store & online, plus admin and dispatch support when needed.
content.unEditedContent:
About us

she wear is a Brisbane based Australian footwear brand designing supportive footwear for women at work and play. From safety boots to lifestyle and walking shoes, we focus on one thing .. footwear that actually works in the real world (and yes .. we are slightly obsessed with comfortable shoes).

We are committed to offering an exceptional brand experience, and have a great reputation for a quality, innovative product and genuine customer service and support.


About the role

We are looking for a friendly and experienced part time Retail and Customer Service Assistant to join our Hamilton store.

Customers come to us because they need footwear that actually works in the real world .. whether that's safety boots for work, supportive shoes for long days on their feet, or comfortable everyday shoes.

So this isn't just a "stand behind the counter" retail role. It's about chatting with customers, understanding what they need, and helping them find the right pair of shoes .. whether that's in store or online.

You'll need to feel confident recommending products and guiding customers towards the right choice, including upselling where appropriate .. always in a helpful, genuine way rather than being pushy.

You'll also support our online customers through emails, live chat and virtual fittings. That means answering questions, helping with sizing, solving problems and making sure every customer feels confident in their purchase.

Because we're a small, growing team, this role is genuinely varied. Alongside customer service, you'll work on admin tasks and projects from the Founder or Customer Service Lead. And when we get busy (think wholesale orders or when the warehouse team is on leave), you'll jump in and help with dispatch and warehouse tasks too.

If you love talking to people, enjoy problem solving, and are happy to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in wherever you're needed .. you'll fit right in.

This role will commence part time (2 days per week), with the opportunity for additional hours over time. Saturday availability is essential.


Duties

  • Deliver exceptional in store customer service, helping customers find the right style, size and fit

  • Build rapport with customers and create a welcoming, helpful store environment

  • Respond to customer enquiries across multiple channels including phone, email, live chat, social media and virtual fittings

  • Confidently recommend products and guide customers towards the right purchase, including appropriate upselling

  • Develop strong product knowledge and become a fit expert, assisting customers with specialised fit enquiries and concerns

  • Maintain high store presentation standards including merchandising, restocking and general housekeeping

  • Complete admin tasks and projects from the Founder or Customer Service Lead

  • Support other areas of the business when required, including dispatch, returns, warehouse and marketing activities (particularly during busy periods or when team members are on leave)

  • Participate in a rotating after hours roster responding to social media and live chat enquiries


You will ..

  • Have a genuine passion for customer service and retail sales, and enjoy talking with customers and helping them find the right solution

  • Have at least 2 years experience in retail, customer service or online customer support (experience in footwear, fashion or E-commerce is highly regarded)

  • Have excellent communication skills, both in person and in written correspondence

  • Be comfortable assisting customers across multiple channels including in store, phone, email, live chat and social media

  • Be a pro active problem solver who can make decisions and recommendations with minimal supervision

  • Be able to handle customer concerns or challenging situations calmly and professionally

  • Be confident working solo in store .. opening, closing, serving customers, handling problems and managing your own workload independently

  • Be happy to roll up your sleeves and help wherever needed, including jumping into dispatch or warehouse tasks when the business gets busy

  • Be responsible, reliable and take pride in doing a great job

  • Be highly organised with strong time management skills and attention to detail

  • Have a positive, motivated attitude and enjoy working in a small team environment

  • Have strong computer skills and be comfortable learning new systems

  • Experience with Shopify, Gorgias or inventory systems will be highly regarded


Why join us

Free shoes .. do we need to say any more? ;) But seriously ..

You'll be joining an award winning, growing Australian footwear brand where our purpose, values and culture genuinely matter .. and where you'll work with a product you can be proud of.

We're a small, close knit team that takes pride in what we do. We work hard, support each other and enjoy having a bit of fun along the way.

Because we're a growing business, no two days are exactly the same. We're looking for people who are happy to roll up their sleeves, get stuck in and contribute wherever needed.

Our recently renovated retail store is based in Hamilton, with easy access to cafes, parking and public transport.


Please note: Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. We love AI and use it in our business (so being comfortable with it is a plus!) .. but please don't use it to write your cover letter or CV. We can spot it a mile off, and we'd much rather read something genuine in your own voice. Tell us a bit about yourself, why you think you're a good fit, and what you'd bring to this role and the team.

json.title: Medical Receptionist Casual

content.jobHook: Join a respected practice offering full training, a supportive team environment, and a genuine long-term career opportunity.
content.unEditedContent:
We are looking to recruit a a friendly, organised Receptionists to join our team on a casual basis.

This is a great working environment with a small and close-knit team who love supporting each other and working together

This is a front-facing role. You will be the first point of contact managing appointments, keeping the day running smoothly for our team and families.

Previous medical reception experience preferred.

Casual

Requirements/Job Description

  • Handling appointment bookings and patient enquiries with care and professionalism

  • Ensuring billing is completed accurately and in a timely manner

  • Familiarisation with Medicare billing procedures

  • General administrative duties, including processing payments (EFTPOS) and managing correspondence.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with doctors, staff and patients

  • Provide administrative support to Doctors and management.

  • Ensure the medical practice is clean and tidy at all times.

  • Own transport essential.

  • Excellent presentation and phone manner.

  • Ability to multi task.

  • Reliable and punctual.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Experience with medical practice software (Best Practice, Genie, or similar) preferred but not essential.

  • Understanding of Medicare billing procedures is advantageous.

Applications

  • Please submit your resume and cover letter through Seek, Clearly stating hours and days you are available. Any applications without this will not be considered.

content.jobHook: Join That Sales Company in Sydney. Full training, no weekends, strong earning potential, career growth, and a supportive team culture.
content.unEditedContent:
Full-Time Availability | Immediate Start | $35–$40 per hour + Commissions

Looking for a fresh start away from hospitality?

If you’re ready for more stability, better work-life balance, and genuine career progression, this could be the opportunity for you. Whether you’ve worked as a barista, bartender, waiter, or in cafes and restaurants, your people skills are highly valuable in sales.

At That Sales Company, we help individuals transition from hospitality into fast-paced, rewarding sales careers with full training and ongoing support provided.

About Us

That Sales Company is a rapidly growing Sales & Marketing company based in Sydney. We represent leading Australian brands through face-to-face promotions, B2B campaigns, events, and customer acquisition campaigns.

Our team culture is energetic, supportive, and performance-focused. We invest heavily in training and development to help people build confidence, communication skills, and long-term career opportunities.

If you enjoy working with people, want to challenge yourself, and are looking for more than just another hospitality shift, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Join That Sales Company?

Career Progression

We promote based on performance, not time served. Leadership and management opportunities are available for high performers.

Transferable Skills

Build valuable skills in communication, sales, leadership, and customer service that can benefit you long term.

Travel Opportunities

Paid travel opportunities available across NSW and interstate for campaigns and networking events.

Consistent Full-Time Work

Monday–Friday schedule with no late nights or weekend shifts.

Strong Earning Potential

Competitive hourly rate plus uncapped commissions, bonuses, and incentives.

Full Training Provided

No sales experience required — we train you from day one.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Representing leading brands through face-to-face campaigns
• Building rapport and speaking with new customers daily
• Working towards achievable performance goals and KPIs
• Attending ongoing sales training and development sessions
• Learning practical sales and communication skills in the field

What We’re Looking For

• Positive attitude and strong work ethic
• Great communication and people skills
• Full-time availability
• Ability to commute into Sydney CBD
• Must be 18 years or older

Hospitality, retail, customer service, and sports backgrounds are highly transferable.

What You’ll Earn

• $35–$45 per hour + uncapped commissions
• Weekly bonuses and incentives
• Superannuation included
• Progression opportunities into leadership roles

Check Out Our Socials

👉 Instagram: @thatsalescompany

Ready for a Change?

If you’re looking to step away from hospitality and into a role where your effort is recognised and rewarded, apply today.

Successful applicants will be contacted by our HR team within 1–3 business days.

Our focus is providing small to medium size business exceptional IT support and solutions. We are customer focused and pride ourselves on being friendly, conscientious and jargon free.

Opportunity

We are seeking a IT Support Technician to support our growing customer needs, in a role that has long term potential and an exciting chance to develop with the company.

Responsibilities

  • Provide friendly and effective IT Support to SME clients by phone, email, remote access and onsite visits.

  • Support predominantly Microsoft Windows Operating Systems but also Apple Mac, popular mobile devices and tablets, such as iPhone, iPad and Android based devices.

  • Support various versions of Microsoft Office and related applications.

  • Assist in supporting client Core Business Systems.

  • Administrate, maintain and support Windows Server, Active Directory and Hyper-V.

  • Administrate, configure and support Microsoft 365 for business.

  • Support and setup servers, desktops, laptops, mobile phones, tablets, networking devices, such as Internet routers and Wireless Access Points.

  • Configure and support Veeam backup solutions.

  • Configure and support a suite of security solutions.

  • Configure and support 3CX phone system.

  • Update, improve and develop internal systems and documentation.

  • These tasks are not exhaustive and the role requires flexibility to adapt to the jobs at hand.

  • Motivated, self-starter with a strong work ethic.

  • Customer focused approach.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting.

  • Highly organized and able to multi-task.

  • Enthusiastic learner, keen to develop their knowledge and career.

  • Professional, conscientious and well presented.

  • Passionate about technology.

  • Diploma, degree or industry recognised qualifications in computer science, information technology or equivalent.

bulletPoints: Permanent 0.8 FTE part-time role

Perth CBD office supporting lithium operations restart
content.jobHook: Experienced AP professional wanted to support Core Lithium during an exciting operational growth phase.
content.unEditedContent:
Accounts Payable Officer

Perth-Based | CBD Office | Permanent Part-Time Opportunity

 

Core Lithium has reached Final Investment Decision (FID) and is entering an exciting new phase of operational growth with the restart and ramp up of the Finniss Lithium Operation in the Northern Territory.

 

As operational activity increases across the business, we are seeking an experienced Accounts Payable professional to support the growing transaction volume, supplier coordination and purchasing workflows associated with a large-scale operational restart.

 

About the Opportunity

Based in our Perth corporate office on St Georges Terrace and reporting to the Financial Controller, this is a standalone Accounts Payable role suited to someone who enjoys working autonomously, taking ownership of their function and contributing within a collaborative finance team.

This opportunity will suit a proactive and highly organised Accounts Payable professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys being part of a business during a significant growth.

The role is offered on a 0.8 FTE basis (32 hours per week), with flexibility to work these hours as 4 full days per week, or reduced hours across 5 days.

Key Responsibilities

  • Managing the end-to-end Accounts Payable function
  • Supporting Accounts Payable and purchasing workflows within Pronto
  • Managing increasing transaction volumes as operations ramp up
  • Supporting transactional processing during ramp up into operations
  • Liaising with internal stakeholders to support AP and purchasing processes
  • Working autonomously within a standalone Accounts Payable role
  • Assisting with operational and transactional change management activities associated with the business restart
  • Supporting continuity and knowledge transfer during the handover period with the current incumbent

About You

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and comfortable operating autonomously within a busy operational environment.

You will ideally bring:

  • 4–5+ years’ Accounts Payable experience
  • Strong end-to-end AP capability
  • Extensive Pronto experience (essential)
  • Experience working within medium to large operational businesses
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Ability to manage changing priorities and increasing transaction volumes
  • Mining/resources industry exposure preferred but not essential

Due to the immediate nature of this requirement, we are seeking applicants currently based in Perth, Western Australia with unrestricted Australian working rights.

Why Join Core Lithium

Core Lithium is restarting operations at the Finniss Lithium Operation in the Northern Territory, with significant operational growth expected over the coming 6–12 months.

 

This is an opportunity to join a growing team during an exciting operational transition and contribute to building efficient finance processes as the business scales.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, with an immediate start preferred to allow for a structured handover period with the current incumbent.

For more information, visit corelithium.com.au
For career enquiries, contact careers@corelithium.com.au

json.title: Warehouse Co-ordinator

bulletPoints: Award winning Australian footwear brand that customers genuinely love
Part time role with the opportunity to grow into full time
Close knit team, hands on work and great shoe perks
content.jobHook: Hands on part time Warehouse Co-ordinator role with a growing Australian footwear brand. Pick & pack, dispatch, stock transfers and warehouse admin.
content.unEditedContent:
About us

she wear is a Brisbane based Australian footwear brand designing supportive footwear for women at work and play. From safety boots to lifestyle and walking shoes, we focus on one thing .. footwear that actually works in the real world (and yes .. we are slightly obsessed with comfortable shoes).

We are committed to offering an exceptional brand experience, and have a great reputation for a quality, innovative product and genuine customer service and support.


About the role

We are looking for a reliable and hands on Warehouse Co-ordinator to join our team at our Northgate HQ.

You'll be picking, packing and dispatching orders, managing stock transfers between our warehouse and retail store, supporting stocktakes, helping unload inbound containers, keeping the warehouse tidy and orderly, and generally keeping things running smoothly day-to-day.

You'll work closely with the Founder and Brand Co-ordinator, and because we're a small team, the role is genuinely varied. You'll also help out with general admin tasks and projects when needed.

If you take pride in doing a job properly, like a tidy warehouse and don't need someone looking over your shoulder to get on with things .. you'll fit right in.

More than anything, we're looking for someone with a "just get it done" attitude and genuinely strong attention to detail. These two things matter to us more than any specific experience.

This role will commence part time (3-4 days per week, approx 20-25 hours), with the opportunity to grow into full time over time.


Duties

  • Pick, pack and dispatch orders for direct to consumer, corporate and wholesale customers

  • Quality check every pair of shoes before dispatch, checking for defects, mismatched sizes, marks or damage .. our reputation depends on it

  • Work with our customer support team on order and delivery enquiries when required

  • Manage stock transfers between our Northgate warehouse and Hamilton retail store, both via system processes and physically moving stock

  • Follow established warehouse processes and IMS workflows, flagging issues or improvement ideas to the Founder

  • Take responsibility for inventory accuracy .. processing regular stocktakes and cycle counts, investigating discrepancies, and making sure what's in our IMS always matches what's on the shelves

  • Help co-ordinate inbound shipments and stock, including unloading containers and receipting

  • Keep the warehouse clean, organised and safe

  • Complete general warehouse admin and operational tasks as required

  • Help with admin tasks and projects from the Founder when needed


You will ..

  • Have at least 1-2 years experience in a warehouse, dispatch or fulfilment role

  • Be confident working in inventory systems and understand that accurate inventory is critical .. you take ownership of keeping the system and shelves in sync. IMS experience preferred, Cin7 a bonus

  • Have the kind of attitude that just gets stuck in .. you see what needs doing and do it, you don't need to be chased, and you finish what you start

  • Have genuinely strong attention to detail .. you notice the small stuff, double check your work, and care about getting it right the first time

  • Be reliable and consistent .. you do what you say you'll do, when you say you'll do it

  • Be comfortable being part of a small team and following established processes and taking direction

  • Be happy working hands on in a warehouse environment, physically fit and able to lift boxes up to 25kg

  • Have excellent computer skills and be comfortable learning new software

  • Be calm, practical and solutions focused when things don't go to plan

  • Be comfortable working autonomously and managing your own workload without supervision

  • Hold a current driver's licence. A forklift licence is a bonus but not essential

  • Be the kind of person who gets things done and takes pride in doing them properly

  • Be an all round good human!


What you'll get ..

  • A hands on role where your work genuinely makes a difference day-to-day

  • A down to earth, supportive team (no corporate fluff here)

  • The opportunity to grow into a full time role over time

  • Shoe perks for you or your loved ones .. obviously!


We love to have a bit of fun and are proud of our team culture, so a positive "can do" attitude is just as important to us. We are a small, close team and help each other out when required.

Our HQ is in a great location with easy access to cafes, parking and public transport.

Please note: Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. We love AI and use it in our business (so being comfortable with it is a plus!) .. but please don't use it to write your cover letter or CV. We can spot it a mile off, and we'd much rather read something genuine in your own voice. Tell us a bit about yourself, why you think you're a good fit, and what you'd bring to this role and the team.

content.jobHook: Join a growing organisation, have a positive impact on the lives of people with a disability, and work to ensure everyone is seen and heard.
content.unEditedContent:
Does this sound like you?

  • Passionate about empowering all people.

  • A belief that great things are achieved through collaboration and mutual respect.

  • An understanding that honesty, integrity, and willingness to learn provide the foundation for the highest level of person-centred care.

If it does, this could be the ideal role for you!

We are currently seeking support workers to work with our expanding community.


Vis-Ability Support Services Pty Ltd is a completely mobile service that works with clients in their homes or in the community. At Vis-Ability Support Services we believe that everyone deserves to be seen and heard. With this belief our goal is to provide services that break down barriers people with a disability may face and assist them to live their lives to the fullest. We aim to provide services that empower people living with a disability to state their goals and then work collaboratively with them to achieve these goals. We believe this is possible through our person-centred and holistic approach to support.


We are moving into a phase of growth with a goal of growing whilst ensuring the quality of support provided to our clients is not impacted. As such, we are looking for motivated and proactive support workers who embody our values of respect, honesty, and empowerment to join our team. 


We primarily service areas around Sydney’s CBD, East, Inner West, South, and South-East.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Work with clients to provide them:

  • Person-centred care to assist them in achieving their goals

  • Support to engage meaningfully in the community

  • Transport and accompaniment to attend appointments

  • Domestic assistance to help them maintain their homes

  • Assistance with meal preparation

How a day may look like:

  • Starting with a client who requires support with their morning routine of having breakfast, a reminder to have their medications, and tidying their home.

  • Heading to the next client who requires transport and accompaniment to attend an appointment (legal, medical, or health). 

  • End the day with a client who wishes to have some social support whilst in a café. 

This role can entail a significant amount of driving. As such, we aim to always schedule the clients who you will be working with in a day to be at most a 30 minute drive from one another, and ensure you are reimbursed for the travel time, parking fees, and KMs travelled. 

To be successful in this role you may have:

  • Certificate/Diploma in Disability and/or Mental Health, or other related disciplines. 

AND/OR

  • Previous experience working with people with a psychosocial disability. 

Essential Requirements:

  • Passionate and motivated to support people with a disability

  • An ability to work independently with integrity

  • Confident and proactive with strong interpersonal skills to establish relationships with clients and other stakeholders

  • National Police Check

  • Working With Children's Check (if applicable)

  • NDIS Worker Check

  • Current First Aid CPR

  • 2 Doses of Covid-19 Vaccination or Medical Exemption Form 

  • A current Australian Driver’s License and access to a reliable car (every shift)

  • Happy to work Short & Long Shifts

Skills & Experience:

  • Domestic assistance and meal preparation.

  • Assistance with daily life (may include personal care)

  • Community access and transport (with the use of your own vehicle).

  • Ability to always remain composed and respectful. 

  • Documenting and progress note keeping.

How to apply:

Please apply directly through this advertisement and we will be in touch with you.


If you'd like to have a confidential conversation to further discuss this opportunity, email jaala.b@vis-abilityss.com.au.

json.title: Male Mentor (Support Worker)

content.jobHook: Ditch the 'support worker' label and become the Mentor who helps young men with disabilities 13-25 bridge the gap between isolation and independence.
content.unEditedContent:
Are you a down-to-earth and purpose-driven man ready to lead by example?

Dynamic Support WA is looking for active and engaged Mentors to join our team. We go further than just "providing support"; we empower young men with disabilities (aged 13–25) to crush their goals, build independence, and find their place in the community.

If you’re a natural communicator who can turn a community activity, a gym session, or even a conversation about gaming into a growth opportunity, we want to hear from you.

About Us

At Dynamic Support WA, we specialise in the transition to adulthood. Our culture is built on meaningful value and support for young men. We help our participants navigate employment, social connection, and daily life through tailored one-on-one sessions and high-energy group programs.

The Role: What You’ll Do

As a Mentor, you are a coach, a guide, and a role model. You will be trained in our GROW model (Guide, Rehearse, Observe, Win) to create real-world outcomes for our participants:

  • Social Confidence: Bridge the gap between isolation and community through shared interests, whether that is sports, fitness, gaming, or anime.

  • Lead Outings: Take initiative in planning routines and leading community outings that build genuine connection.

  • Life Skills: Teach the basics of independence, including budgeting, navigating the city, and managing a schedule.

  • Employment Coaching: Assist participants with building resumes or practicing for interviews as they prepare for the workforce.

  • Reporting: Maintain brief, high-quality progress notes and keep up with scheduled check-ins regarding your shifts.

Who We’re Looking For

This role is perfect for early-career professionals, university students, or those looking to change careers and enter the disability sector. We are seeking candidates who are:

  • Natural Leaders: You lead with empathy, integrity, and respect.

  • Relatable: You can connect with a young man over common interests while maintaining professional boundaries.

  • Proactive and Organised: You take initiative, see where support is needed, and act on it.

  • Growth-Minded: You are hungry to learn and open to professional feedback.

Why Join Dynamic Support WA?

  • Career Launchpad: Gain high-level practical experience relevant to Occupational Therapy, Speech Pathology, or Psychology.

  • Professional Development: Receive client-specific training, supervision, and mentoring development.

  • Real Impact: You will have a genuine impact on the direction a young man's life takes.

  • Culture: Join a team that values high standards and creates a positive environment for both staff and clients.

Essential Requirements

  • Reliable Transport: A roadworthy vehicle with full comprehensive insurance.

  • Clearances: Current NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working with Children Check (WWCC).

  • Safety: Valid First Aid and CPR Certification.

  • Tech Savvy: Access to a smartphone for scheduling and progress notes.

  • Experience: While 1 year of experience is preferred, we hire for character and potential. We will provide the training you need.

Ready to make a difference?

Apply now by sending your resume and a brief cover letter telling us why you’re the right fit for our team.

content.jobHook: Coordinate facilities, housing, fleet and admin in a flexible 30hr/week role in Port Hedland, ensuring smooth operations across sites.
content.unEditedContent:
Location:      Port Hedland, WA
Work Type:  Part Time – 30 hours a week | 7-month Max Term Contract

  • Diverse, autonomous role with end-to-end ownership

  • Supportive, close-knit regional team culture (regular lunches & BBQs)

  • 13.5% super. Award-winning health & wellbeing benefits (gym & health insurance discounts)

  • Choose your working hours – 30 hours across 5 days (6 hours each day)

Are you someone who can juggle priorities, spot issues early and take pride in ensuring operations are always ready to go?
This role would suit a proactive Operational Administrator or Facilities & Property Coordinator who enjoys variety, autonomy and being trusted to own their work. You’ll play a critical role in keeping offices, housing, fleet and depots operational at all times, while confidently coordinating multiple stakeholders and managing shifting priorities.

What makes this role worth considering

  • Choose the hours to fit your life: 6 hours a day, 5 days a week. Flexibility around timing (morning starts preferred).

  • Diversity & autonomy: No two days look the same – you’ll own your workflow and take pride in how things run.

  • You’ll be trusted to improve things: If you notice repeat issues, we’ll welcome suggested practical fixes and improvements.

  • Hands-on, people-facing work: You’ll talk to staff, contractors and suppliers every day. Communication matters in this role!

Your impact in the role

  • Ensure offices, depots, assets and employee housing are always operationally ready.

  • Coordinate property, facilities and maintenance activities both scheduled and reactive with contractors and suppliers.

  • Manage employee housing, including sourcing properties to lease or purchase and overseeing arrangements.

  • Oversee fleet maintenance to ensure vehicles are compliant, serviced and fit for purpose.

  • Act as the central coordination point, triaging requests and balancing competing priorities.

  • Deliver high-level operational administration, including records, reporting, scheduling and Excel based data management.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience or understanding of property maintenance, facilities or property management.

  • Strong administrative and organisational capability, with the ability to multitask and prioritise.

  • Confident communication style and a helpful, service-first approach.

  • A proactive, energised mindset with the ability to anticipate needs beyond the task list.

  • A practical, calm approach when things get busy. Able to prioritise and keep momentum.

  • WA C-class driver’s licence.

Ready to bring your experience to an organisation that will offer you genuine flexibility with working hours?

json.title: Marketing Officer / Business Development Manager

content.jobHook: Drive AIP’s growth in the Indian subcontinent market with a competitive salary for the right candidate.
content.unEditedContent:
Marketing Officer / Business Development Manager – Indian Subcontinent Market

Australian Institute of Professionals (AIP) is seeking an experienced and motivated Marketing Officer / Business Development Manager to support the promotion of our courses to the Indian subcontinent market, including (but not limited to) India, Nepal, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Malaysia and surrounding regions.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong education agent network, an understanding of the international education sector, and the ability to promote AIP’s courses to both onshore students and relevant offshore referral partners in a professional and compliant manner.

As a Marketing Officer / Business Development Manager at AIP, you will play a key role in expanding the college’s presence within the Indian subcontinent market by building strong agent relationships, creating new student recruitment opportunities, and promoting quality education pathways to onshore students. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated professional with strong industry connections to make a real impact, work closely with a growing education provider, and be recognised for driving ethical, compliant and successful student recruitment outcomes. A highly competitive salary package is on offer to the right candidate with the right agent network, market knowledge, and the ability to achieve recruitment targets.

Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

Developing and maintaining strong relationships with education agents from the Indian subcontinent market.

Promoting AIP’s courses to onshore international students and prospective students through agent networks, student referrals, community engagement and other approved marketing channels.

Supporting student recruitment activities in line with AIP’s marketing strategy and enrolment targets.

Providing accurate information to agents and prospective students regarding courses, entry requirements, fees, campus location, student support services and enrolment processes.

Ensuring all marketing and student recruitment activities are conducted in accordance with AIP’s policies and relevant regulatory requirements, including ESOS obligations, the National Code, RTO Standards, CRICOS requirements and AIP’s internal compliance procedures.

Monitoring agent performance and supporting the college with agent engagement, follow-ups and market feedback.

Assisting with student enquiries, lead generation, follow-up activities and conversion of prospective students.

Representing AIP professionally at education events, agent meetings, student information sessions and community-based promotional activities.

Selection Criteria

The successful applicant must have:

  • Strong existing connections with education agents from the Indian subcontinent market.

  • Experience in student recruitment, marketing, business development or international education.

  • A good understanding of the Australian international education sector, including student visa requirements and the importance of compliant recruitment practices.

  • Ability to promote courses to onshore students in a professional, ethical and compliant manner.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to meet recruitment targets while ensuring all marketing activities meet compliance and quality standards.

  • A professional attitude and commitment to protecting the reputation of the college.

  • Knowledge of RTO/CRICOS compliance requirements will be highly regarded.

Important Compliance Requirement

AIP is committed to ethical, transparent and compliant student recruitment. The successful candidate must ensure that all promotional activities, agent communications and student recruitment practices are conducted honestly and in line with applicable regulatory standards and AIP’s policies. Misleading information, false promises or non-compliant recruitment practices will not be tolerated.

How to Apply

Interested applicants are invited to submit their resume and a brief cover letter outlining their experience, agent network and suitability for the role.

Market Focus: South Asia, primarily the Indian Subcontinent
Employment Type: Full-time
Location: Melbourne

content.jobHook:
Relationship orientated role
Supportive, collaborative team culture
On‑the‑job training -career development opportunities
content.unEditedContent:
About Us

proRAD is a modern, privately owned radiology clinic located in Melbourne's west, founded by two highly experienced radiologists.

We are dedicated to providing exceptional patient care and delivering high-quality imaging services. With cutting-edge technology and a compassionate, team-based approach, we strive to create a supportive and welcoming environment for both patients and staff.

We are seeking a Medical Liaison Officer/Assistant.

Reporting to the Senior Medical Liaison Officer, you will play a vital role in managing a dedicated territory and building strong relationships with healthcare professionals and the broader medical community. You will help ensure proRAD’s values and services are consistently and effectively represented.

This is a dynamic, people-focused role suited to someone with excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for healthcare and building relationships. It offers the opportunity to contribute to proRAD’s continued growth while working within a collaborative and supportive team environment.

We are open to training the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities:

Referrer Engagement

  • Build and maintain positive professional relationships with GPs, specialists, practice managers, and allied health professionals

  • Represent proRAD in a professional and positive manner within the widespread medical community

  • Promote awareness of proRAD services, ensuring referrers understand key benefits and service offerings

  • Coordinate and support practice visits, lunch meetings, and events

  • Respond to referrer enquiries or concerns in a timely manner, escalating issues when appropriate

Marketing & Communication

  • Support marketing initiatives, including content creation for social media, website, and promotional materials

  • Assist with the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns, events, and internal and external engagement activities

  • Support brand‑building initiatives aligned with proRAD's growth strategy

IT & Digital Referrer Support

  • Support referrers with access to online images and digital systems

  • Assist with registration, troubleshooting, and basic training on referrer portals

Team Collaboration & Professional Conduct

  • Work collaboratively with the Senior MLO, clinical, and administrative teams

  • Uphold professionalism, confidentiality, and quality assurance standards at all times

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development initiatives

What we're looking for

We are seeking an enthusiastic and professional individual who demonstrates:

  1. Valid working rights in Australia

  2. Valid driving license

  3. Demonstrated work experience in a customer service role (healthcare, radiology, or pathology highly regarded)

  4. Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels

  5. Excellent organisational skills, with strong attention to detail and time management

  6. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

  7. Confidence in verbal and written communication, along with a professional presentation style

  8. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment

  9. A background in sales or relationship-building will be highly regarded

    What we offer

    • Competitive salary and benefits package

    • Opportunities for career development and training

    • Supportive and collaborative team environment

    • Flexible work arrangements to accommodate work-life balance

    • Employee health and wellbeing initiatives

Are you proactive, reliable, and enjoy keeping operations running smoothly? Come and join our team in Canning Vale, WA as we have an exciting opportunity for a Warehouse Assistant!

Reporting directly to the State Manager WA, SA, NT you will play a key role in maintaining a safe, clean, and organised store environment that ensures the smooth flow of materials throughout the business.

About the Role:

This hands-on role is essential to the efficient movement of goods across the business, ensuring stock is received, handled, and dispatched accurately and with care.

  • Receiving, inspecting, and dispatching stock efficiently and accurately.
  • Unrolling, rerolling, measuring, cutting, and relabeling cable products to order.
  • Accepting incoming materials after inspection and releasing conforming products for use or resale.
  • Storing products safely and neatly, keeping aisles and exits clear, and maintaining tools and equipment.
  • Conducting routine equipment maintenance to ensure operational safety.
  • Identifying and reporting suspect or non-conforming products, preventing quality issues, and raising potential safety, quality, or environmental risks.
  • Supporting team objectives, maintaining good working relationships, and contributing cooperatively to a productive work environment.
  • Maintaining accurate work records and complying with company policies, procedures, and QHSE guidelines.

About You:

  • Holding a current forklift licence.
  • Demonstrating the ability to follow written and verbal instructions while working within established procedures and delivering quality customer service.
  • Strong planning, prioritising, and managing skills to meet operational timeframes.
  • A high level of accuracy and compliance in recording work 
  • A commitment to quality assurance, workplace health and safety, and environmental practices

About us:

CMI Electrical Products are specialists in the manufacture and distribution of electrical cables and associated components for industrial, mining, infrastructure, commercial, petrochemical and information technology applications throughout South East Asia and Oceania. CMI is a fully owned subsidiary of the IPD Group.

IPD Group is a dynamic ASX listed, Australian owned business. We provide design, development and distribution of electrical products and technologies. Electrical hardware distribution with product assembly and workshop for customised solutions. Electrical vehicle charging hardware and infrastructure solutions, providing complete electrical engineering and service provider in high and low voltage projects. Having operated for 65 years we are trusted partner to our customers.

Be an integral part of our team and enjoy great benefits, including a day off on your birthday and additional leave in recognition of your years of service and other discounts for working with us!

If this sounds like the role and team for you please send us your resume with a cover letter telling us why this is the role for you. We will be reviewing applications as we receive, so if you have the skills and experience, we are seeking, submit your application now.

You must have the right to work in Australia.

IPD is proud to have a diverse and inclusive workplace, with a team of over 600 people representing more than 30 different cultural backgrounds. We are committed to fostering a culture that values diversity, equity, and human rights, ensuring that every individual feels respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. We welcome people from all cultures, backgrounds, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations, and religious beliefs.

When you apply, please let us know what pronouns you use.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are encouraged to apply.

Only applicants suitable for the position will be contacted.

We kindly ask agencies not to submit any resumes without our consent.

content.jobHook: Network + M365 + Security. Dental-MSP, modern stack (NinjaOne, Avanan), small team, Melb West office. Hybrid after probation. MSP experience required
content.unEditedContent:
About Urban IT

We're a Melbourne-based MSP focused on dental practices across Australia. Small, tight-knit team in Truganina. Modern stack, real autonomy, no ticket-mill.

The role

You'll own the day-to-day technical queue across m365, security, networking and Windows Server. Our Technical Services Manager carries the senior network depth - you'll be his deputy on infrastructure work, growing into the network specialist seat over 18-24 months.

You'll work from our Truganina office with hybrid 2-days-WFH after probation. Site visits to dental clinics across Melbourne, with occasional interstate travel.

What you'll do

  • Resolve helpdesk tickets end-to-end in our PSA platform

  • Troubleshoot networks: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, wireless, VPN, firewall

  • Administer Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Defender, licensing

  • Deploy and support Windows Server, Hyper-V, AD/Entra, RDS, and group policy

  • Action RMM alerts and maintain client documentation

  • Handle email security, EDR and endpoint protection alerts

  • Visit client sites, translate tech into plain English without lecturing

  • Mentor junior team, contribute to SOPs and process improvement

You need

  • Proven MSP experience - this is non-negotiable

  • Strong networking foundations (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewall, VPN, wireless)

  • Solid M365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Defender)

  • Windows Server fundamentals (AD, Hyper-V, RDS, GPO)

  • Time-entry discipline and close-the-loop ticket hygiene

  • Valid driver's licence

  • Willingness to complete Police Check and Working with Children Check

  • Permanent AU work rights

Nice to have

  • Experience across modern PSA, RMM and documentation platforms

  • Hands-on with leading email-security, EDR and endpoint platforms

  • Dental practice management software familiarity

  • PowerShell scripting

  • Certifications: Microsoft (MS-102, AZ-104), networking (CCNA), or ITIL

What you get

  • $90,000 - $100,000 + super

  • Hybrid 2-day WFH after probation

  • Paid certifications and training pathway

  • Birthday off, Fitbit subscription, ergonomic kit, free parking

  • Clear growth path to L3 / Network Specialist in 18-24 months

  • A small team that actually likes what they do

How to apply

Apply via SEEK with your CV and a short cover note telling us why a Melbourne dental-MSP suits you over a generic enterprise IT shop.

content.jobHook: This career-defining role has enormous potential to build a long-term career
content.unEditedContent:
Join the Controlling / FP&A Department at REMONDIS Australia as a Financial Analyst based in the Head Office in Sydney, NSW. This role sits within our Corporate head office function.

We’re looking for a driven finance professional who’s ready to elevate their career beyond traditional accounting or reporting. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in financial accounting or analysis who wants to grow into a broader remit spanning management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and data analytics.

You will be a forward-thinking, tech-savvy individual, eager to learn, and desire to improve processes by leveraging technology and automation.

Reporting to the Controlling/FPA Manager, this career-defining role has enormous potential to build a long-term career with a high growth and dynamic organisation on a transformational and innovative journey.

How you will make an impact

  • Timely, accurate and effective reporting of financial and operational results to the local management teams and parent company
  • Collaborate with business units to drive budget and forecast processes across the whole organisation
  • Provide financial analysis, modelling, and insights to support business decisions
  • Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, finance colleagues, and other stakeholders to facilitate effective communication and collaboration
  • Identify inefficiencies in existing financial processes and recommend improvements to streamline operations and enhance accuracy
  • Be part of the growth and transformation journey involving special projects within the department and across the organisation


Skills and Experience

  • 3 years experience in a financial analyst or accounting role. Well‑suited to a first mover from public practice or someone looking to step into a broader FP&A role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in either Finance and/or Accounting.
  • CPA/CA qualified or working towards.
  • Experience delivering financial support to the operational business, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance reporting.
  • Comfortable building financial models to support ad hoc financial analysis for key company stakeholders.
  • Able to efficiently and accurately consolidate, transform, and analyse large volumes of data
  • Experience with Reporting/Budgeting systems, major ERP desirable
  • Advanced Excel skills (Power Query, SQL, Macro), Powerpoint, Reporting/Budgeting systems and ERP
  • Keen desire to learn the “how to” and “why” of current processes to understand and optimise current business practices.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to build relationships internally and externally.
  • Natural inclination for accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to self-manage and work to deadlines.

 

Who we are

REMONDIS Australia is part of a global leader in sustainable waste and water management. With a strong local presence and a commitment to making a positive environmental impact, we deliver essential services across the country.


How to Apply

  • You’ll need proof of entitlement to work in Australia.
  • You’ll undergo a pre-employment medical, including a drug and alcohol test.

REMONDIS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we invite you to be part of an organisation that fosters a diverse workplace. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are strongly encouraged to apply.

json.title: Compounding Lab technician

content.jobHook: Lab technician for compounding pharmacy. This is a Full Time position, Monday to Friday. No weekends required.
content.unEditedContent:
About the business


We are a compounding only pharmacy. We do not have a shop front and everything sold is hand made in our three state-of-the-art labs. We make medications for specialist and GP doctors and their patients. We provide solutions for patients who cannot be treated with ready prepared proprietary medicines and need their medications custom made to their own needs. 


About the role


The role is a technician's role. It involves making mixtures, cream, capsules and other medication forms from scratch. It suits a person who can work unsupervised and have a technical attitude. Ability to measure accurately and precisely and work in a clean lab is essential. It suits a flexible applicant who is a good organiser and fits well in a team but is very happy to work by themselves in a laboratory setting. An ability to be handle telephone enquiries when short handed is an advantage.


Benefits and perks


Training will be provided to the applicant. We are open 9 to 5.30pm, Monday to Friday. 


Skills and experience


Experience in a laboratory environment is essential whether tertiary or commercial position. Ability to measure and weigh etc accurately is essential. Must be able to work unsupervised and be very hygienic. Must also be able to handle chemicals. Telephone skills will be advantageous.

json.title: IT Desktop Support Officer

content.jobHook: Proactive IT support role in a growing Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity-focused business supporting Australian and offshore teams.
content.unEditedContent:
IT Desktop Support Officer

Part-Time | Monday to Friday | Approx. 8:00am – 1:00pm

Adelaide, SA

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and customer focused IT Desktop Support Officer to join our IT team on a part time basis. This role is critical in ensuring the stability, security, and smooth operation of our IT environment across Australia and offshore teams. You will provide frontline technical support and help maintain a secure, reliable, and efficient IT environment within a modern Microsoft 365 and cybersecurity-focused organisation.

Why SuperGuardian?

SuperGuardian is an innovative, market leading firm founded by Chartered Accountants. We specialise in SMSF administration, accounting, online reporting, and technical services. With a team of more than 90 staff across Australia and offshore, we continue to grow while maintaining a collaborative and inclusive culture.

Here’s what you’ll enjoy about working with us:

  • A positive and team oriented workplace where your contribution is genuinely valued.

  • Regular social events and activities organised by our Fun Committee.

  • The opportunity to play a meaningful role in a growing business where your ideas, initiative, and professionalism can make a real impact.

  • Exposure to modern IT systems, cybersecurity initiatives, and continuous improvement projects.

  • A supportive leadership team that values development, collaboration, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 desktop support across Windows and Microsoft 365 environments

  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and user issues efficiently

  • Set up and configure desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals

  • Manage service desk tickets with strong customer service and SLA adherence

  • Perform patching, updates, and software installations to maintain security and compliance

  • Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and documentation

  • Support onboarding and offboarding processes (accounts, devices, permissions)

  • Assist with video conferencing and meeting room IT setups

  • Monitor compliance with IT policies and report any security concerns

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams and vendors on support and project initiatives

About You

You are a hands-on IT professional with strong problem-solving skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to work independently during core support hours.

This role would suit someone who enjoys taking initiative, solving problems independently, and contributing to continuous improvement across the business.

Skills & Experience Required

  • Minimum 2+ years’ experience in IT support or a similar role

  • Strong experience supporting Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • Active Directory (user and group management)

    • Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Microsoft 365 Admin Centre

    • Exchange Online administration

  • Experience with:

    • Hardware setup, imaging, and troubleshooting

    • Virtual environments (Hyper-V or VMware)

    • Remote Desktop Services / Terminal Services

  • Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals

  • Experience with Sophos Central (Endpoint / MDR / XDR administration or monitoring)

  • Strong documentation and organisational skills 

Desirable (but not essential)

  • Experience in ISO 27001 administration, compliance activities, or similar roles

  • Exposure to NIST or SOC 2 frameworks

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity tools (endpoint protection, patching, awareness training)

  • Experience working in a multi-site or hybrid environment 

What You’ll Be Doing Beyond Support

  • Maintaining IT documentation, procedures, and asset registers

  • Supporting cybersecurity initiatives and compliance activities

  • Assisting with IT audits and policy adherence

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of IT support processes

Ready to join us?

Applications should be addressed to Emma Magee, Associate Director at emma@superguardian.com.au.

(No unsolicited contact from agencies, please.)

bulletPoints: Diverse statewide leadership role with real variety and autonomy
Growing Tasmanian organisation with strong career opportunities
Your work helps support free healthcare outreach for vulnerable Tasmanians
content.jobHook: Lead statewide operations in a growing Tasmanian business helping support free healthcare services for vulnerable Tasmanians.
content.unEditedContent:
Moreton Group Medical Services is a growing Tasmanian-owned organisation delivering services across healthcare, medical transport, training, emergency management, and operational support services.

What makes us different is that the work we do commercially helps support our delivery of free primary healthcare outreach services to vulnerable Tasmanians. Through our Mobile Outreach Clinic Program, we provide no-cost healthcare services to people experiencing homelessness, housing insecurity, and barriers to accessing traditional healthcare services across Tasmania.

As our organisation continues to grow across Tasmania, we are seeking an Operations Manager to help lead and support our statewide operations.

This is a diverse and hands-on leadership role suited to someone who enjoys problem solving, supporting teams, improving systems, and being actively involved in day-to-day operations.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will work closely with operational teams across multiple business divisions and help drive continued growth and service delivery excellence.

About the Role

Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting day-to-day operational management across multiple service areas

  • Leading and mentoring operational staff and team leaders

  • Assisting with workforce planning and rostering oversight

  • Driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement

  • Supporting compliance, reporting, and quality outcomes

  • Working collaboratively with the Senior Leadership Team

  • Assisting with growth opportunities and operational projects

This role will involve regular travel and field-based operational support across Tasmania.

About You

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has previous leadership or operational management experience

  • Is confident managing people and solving problems

  • Can work well in fast-paced and changing environments

  • Has strong communication and organisational skills

  • Leads by example and enjoys supporting teams

  • Is practical, adaptable, and solutions focused

Experience in healthcare, transport, logistics, emergency services, community services, or other operational industries will be highly regarded, however applicants from other sectors with transferable leadership experience are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to join a growing Tasmanian organisation

  • Diverse and rewarding role with real variety

  • A role where your work contributes to positive community outcomes

  • Supportive leadership environment

  • Career growth opportunities

  • Competitive salary package negotiable based on experience

Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter via SEEK

json.title: Operations and experience Manager

content.jobHook: Own the operational heartbeat of Peakhurst's premium S&C facility. Members, staff, systems, conversion. Bring your skills and execute from day one.
content.unEditedContent:
Who We Are

MGF Health Hub is Peakhurst's premium Strength & Conditioning facility for adults and kids. Ten years in this community. Built on real coaching, real relationships, and a standard that doesn't waver.

We're being straight with you, we've had a period where we lost some of that clarity. Chased too many things. Our members felt it. We own that.

We're in a rebuild. Not a rebrand. Not a pivot. A return to exactly what we've always been but sharper, more structured, and more intentional than ever before. Consistency is the product now. Trust is what we're rebuilding. And we need the right person in this role to help make that real, every single day.


The Role

This is the role that makes everything else possible.

While the Founder focuses on strategy, culture, and vision, you will own the operational heartbeat of MGF. Member experience. Staff administration. Trialler conversion. Challenge delivery. Environment standards. The systems and the people-work that hold it all together.

You will be on the floor. You will be in the detail. You will be the reason members feel the difference, across our adult training and our Junior Development Program for kids aged 7–15.

This is not a role for someone who needs to be told what to do. It's not a role for someone who tolerates admin and people-work. It's a role for someone who genuinely loves that stuff, because that's exactly what makes someone exceptional at it.

If systems energise you, if follow-up is second nature, if you find real satisfaction in a converted trialler or a member who feels genuinely looked after... this was written for you.

You'll report directly to the Founder with a clear path to full autonomy as trust is built.

This is not a learn-on-the-job role. You need to walk in knowing how to do this. We're hiring for your skills, your experience, and your ability to execute from day one.


What You'll Own

  • All gym administration (Members and staff)

  • Rostering and staff coordination

  • Member nurture, including relationships, check-ins, retention

  • Trialler onboarding, nurturing, and rollover conversion

  • Challenge and program delivery, start to finish

  • Premium environment standards. Performance, Experience, Culture, Presentation & Energy.

  • Building and documenting systems and processes so the operation runs consistently, with or without you in the room

  • Daily reporting and weekly leadership meetings with the Founder.

  • Staff Growth. We believe in the team around us growing as we do. You'll work with them to help wherever we can to grow them in a path for their futures too.


What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Trialler conversion above 80%

  • Member attrition below 3%

  • Clear improvement in retention and member feedback

  • Every trialler moving through a consistent, structured experience

  • A facility that feels and operates like the premium standard we're known for


Who You Are

  • Organised to your core. Systems aren't a chore, they're how you think

  • A systems builder, you don't just follow processes, you create them. You can take an idea, build it into something repeatable, document it, and make sure it runs without you in the room.

  • A genuine people person. You remember names, you notice things, you follow up without being asked

  • An owner. You see what needs doing and you do it, without being asked.

  • High standards, calm under pressure, zero excuses

  • Comfortable on the floor in a coaching capacity (relevant fitness qualifications required)

  • Background in operations, people management, or customer experience. Fitness industry preferred, but the right person with the right credentials and attitude will be considered

  • Minimum 2 years of operations or management experience is required

  • Must have Australian work authorisation


What You'll Get

  • A founder who is direct, clear on vision, and gets out of your way once trust is built

  • Real autonomy with real accountability

  • A facility and community that genuinely means something to the people in it

  • The chance to be a core part of a business returning to its best... and then some

  • Epic bonus potential (we succeed, you succeed)

  • Opportunity to be part of something bigger

  • Complimentary membership and access to our facilities

  • Multiple corporate events throughout the year focused on personal growth & networking

  • Grow with us.


To Apply

Send us your resume and a cover letter that tells us who you are, what you've built or run, and why this is the role you want.
For bonus points email matt@mygoodfeeling.au with a introduction video covering the above.

content.unEditedContent:
Casual Retail Managers & Assistants – Liverpool & Moorebank

Trutex is a leading schoolwear provider with over 190 years of heritage, trusted by schools and families across Australia. We design uniforms that are made to be outgrown, not outworn.

As part of our continued growth, we are seeking Casual Retail Managers and Retail Assistants to support our busy school uniform stores located in Liverpool and Moorebank.

The Roles

We are looking for hands-on, customer-focused retail professionals to support the day-to-day running of our stores.

  • Casual roles: 16–25 hours per week

  • Must be available during back-to-school peak period (mid-January to mid-February)

  • Flexibility required for additional hours and days during peak trading periods

  • Retail Managers and Retail Assistants roles available

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver exceptional face-to-face customer service to parents, students, and schools

  • Manage or support day-to-day store operations

  • Process sales through POS systems

  • Pick, pack, and fulfil online orders

  • Stock handling, replenishment, and store presentation

  • Fitting support for school uniforms

  • Support smooth and efficient back-to-school trading periods

  • Work collaboratively across multiple store locations when required

About You

  • Previous retail experience (apparel or uniform experience highly regarded)

  • Strong customer service skills with a friendly, professional manner

  • Confident using POS systems and basic computer applications

  • Organised, reliable, and able to work independently and as part of a team

  • Flexible availability during peak trading periods

  • Willingness to travel and support other stores when required

Why Join Trutex

  • Attractive hourly rate

  • Supportive, collaborative team culture

  • Opportunity to work with a respected and growing global schoolwear brand

  • Stable, recurring seasonal retail work in a school-focused environment

Apply Now

If you enjoy retail, working with people, and want a flexible casual role in a fast-paced, supportive environment, we’d love to hear from you.

json.title: SaaS Software Sales - Franchise Industry

bulletPoints: High-growth SaaS platform for franchises
Dynamic mix of inbound & outbound sales
Remote-friendly, supportive team culture
content.jobHook: Join Gorilla Dash as a Sales Executive! Help us scale our powerful franchise SaaS platform by driving inbound leads and outbound prospecting.
content.unEditedContent:
Gorilla Dash is a powerful SaaS platform purpose-built for franchise and multi-location businesses. We bring website management, marketing, internal communication, CRM, recruitment, and real-time performance analytics into a single dashboard — with a centralised master account and unlimited child accounts so franchisors and franchisees stay perfectly aligned.

Our customers are franchise networks who are tired of stitching together five different tools to run their business. Your job is to find them, show them a better way, and bring them on board.

A minimum of 1-2 years sales experience is required for this position.

SaaS sales experience is preferred but not essential for this role.

Knowledge of the franchise industry is preferred but not essential.

Australian citizenship is required for this position.

This sales role involves a combination of inbound lead management and outbound prospecting activities.

What you'll do day-to-day:

  • Prospect into franchise companies and multi-site operators across Australia and New Zealand through outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, and industry events.

  • Qualify opportunities and run discovery conversations with franchisors, marketing leaders, and operations executives.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that map Gorilla Dash's capabilities to each prospect's pain points — websites, marketing, recruitment, analytics, communication.

  • Manage your pipeline end-to-end: follow-ups, proposals, negotiation, and contract sign-off.

  • Coordinate a smooth handover to our onboarding and support team once a deal is signed.

  • Work closely with marketing, product, and customer success — feeding insights back so we keep getting sharper.

  • Hit (and beat) monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

What we're looking for:

  • Strongly preferred: prior experience inside a franchise system — as a business advisor / franchise consultant, franchise development manager (BDM), operations or network manager, or similar field-support role. You already understand how franchisors and franchisees think, what they buy, and what they push back on.

  • 1–6+ years of B2B sales experience is ideal (SaaS preferred), but we'll absolutely consider strong franchise-system operators making the transition into sales — we'll teach you the SaaS sales motion. We're equally happy to hear from BDR/SDR candidates ready to step up and seasoned Account Executives.

  • Confident, professional outbound communicator — phone, email, video, and LinkedIn.

  • Comfortable running product demos and articulating ROI to senior decision-makers.

  • Disciplined pipeline management — you live in your CRM, not your inbox.

  • Self-starter who thrives in a remote environment and doesn't need micromanaging.

  • Coachable, curious, and genuinely interested in the customer's business.

  • Resilient — you understand sales is a numbers game and don't take "no" personally.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Full working rights in Australia or New Zealand.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience selling into the franchise industry (vendor side) on top of working in it.

  • Background selling marketing, website, CRM, or business management software.

  • An existing network of franchise contacts across ANZ.

  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Apollo, Outreach, Gong, or similar.

  • Prior experience working a fully remote sales role.

content.jobHook: If you are a motivated, energetic and passionate person, this is the dream job for you! No farming experience required.
content.unEditedContent:
We are looking for a passionate, positive and energetic farm all-rounder to join our young team at The Food Farm on The Central Coast, NSW

We are a passionate team of people from all over the world farming pasture raised chickens (for eggs and meat), pasture raised pigs and grass fed and finished cattle. We butcher everything on-farm, so you'll have the opportunity to have a full paddock to plate experience.

The Offer: 

  • Each day is a little different, but follows a similar flow. On a typical day, you'll be collecting eggs, moving chicken caravans, fencing, filling feeds/waterers, pasture management, repairing things, filling the farm shop + so much more!

  • The ability to be in a workplace where you are truly valued and celebrated by a young, vibrant team who cares about each other (we're all under 35!)

  • The opportunity to expand your knowledge in skills such as operating machinery, farming, fencing, livestock, irrigation, fencing, repairs and welding.

Remuneration:

  • Remunuration depending on skill set, experience, pace and desired weekly hours

  • Meat allowance provided

  • Lunch provided every Wednesday

About you: 

  • You may/may not have direct farm experience, but we really value experience working outdoors

  • You are strong, fit and have a positive, solutions based mindset

  • You have a deep sense of duty and understand the unique needs of being a farmer, particularly with livestock

  • You live locally

  • You are honest, reliable and community minded

  • You love working outdoors in rain, hail or shine!

  • You are a team player but also happy to work independently with integrity

  • You are comfortable with livestock and big dogs

  • You have your own car and drivers license

Any Questions? 
Flick us an email at jobs@thefoodfarm.com.au or give us a call!

content.jobHook: Blend Projects is seeking a proactive administrator to join its growing team!
content.unEditedContent:
Administrator

Civil Construction | Geebung QLD

Are you an organised and proactive administrator looking for a role where no two days are the same?

Blend Projects, a civil construction company, is seeking an Administrator to join their collaborative team based in Geebung. This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to dynamic projects while supporting key business operations.

About the Role
As the Administrator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of day to day administration across multiple project sites and the head office.

Reporting to the Administration Manager, you’ll liaise with Project Managers, Site Supervisors and senior leadership, ensuring the seamless delivery of projects and office administration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle site related administrative tasks, including dockets management, supplier quantity tracking, and subcontractor invoice filing.

  • Support the servicing workshop’s administration, including vehicle and plant registration, servicing records, fuel cards, and cost attribution.

  • Assist with safety administration: update safety registers, administer HSEQ documentation, monitor inspections and manage PPE inventory.

  • Manage document control systems, staff inductions, and office inventory including supplies and uniforms.

  • Provide administrative support to the Director, Project Manager and Business Development Manager.

  • Assist with scheduling meetings, toolbox talks and training sessions.

About You

  • Prior experience in administration.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel)

  • Strong organisational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Confident learning to use new software and programs (e.g. Gearbox, Hammertech, 1Breadcrumb)

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to build relationships across teams and external partners.

  • Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

What’s on Offer

  • A supportive, collaborative workplace culture where your contributions are valued.

  • Varied and interesting work across office and project sites.

  • Opportunities for growth within a successful and stable business.

  • Appealing salary.

Hours of work: 6:30am – 3:30pm

If you’re ready to bring your administrative talents to a company that values initiative and teamwork, we’d love to hear from you!

Please send a cover letter and resume to Charlie Mitchell (Project Manager) - charlie.m@blendprojects.com.au

Learn more about Blend Projects: https://www.blendprojects.com.au

content.jobHook: Flexible schedule, competitive pay, and opportunity to join a dynamic, growing property management team.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

Tribe Property Co is looking for a casual cleaner to join our team in Benowa, QLD. This is a casual position, offering flexibility in your work schedule. As a casual cleaner, you will play a crucial role in maintaining the cleanliness and presentation of the common areas at our residential buildings.

What you'll be doing

  • Performing general cleaning duties such as vacuuming, mopping, dusting and sanitising all areas of the property

  • Stocking and replenishing cleaning supplies as needed

  • Ability to operate a push scrubbing floor cleaner an advantage

  • Experience operating push scrubbing floor cleaners is preferred but not essential, with training available if required

  • Adhering to all safety protocols and maintaining a clean, organised work environment

  • Providing exceptional customer service to our clients

  • Reporting any maintenance issues or concerns to the property management team

  • Available to work specific assigned shifts as required

What we're looking for

  • Previous experience in a cleaning or janitorial role, preferably in a commercial setting or residential complex common areas cleaning role

  • Minimum 3-6 months of cleaning experience required

  • Excellent attention to detail, initiative and the ability to work independently

  • Strong time management and organisational skills

  • A proactive and flexible approach to your work

  • A friendly, customer-service oriented personality

  • Reliable transportation to access the work site

  • Must hold a valid work visa or have legal work rights in Australia

What we offer

At Tribe Property Co, we value our employees and strive to provide a supportive and rewarding work environment. As a casual cleaner, you'll enjoy the flexibility to work hours (between 20-30 hours per week) that suit your lifestyle, as well as competitive hourly rates and the opportunity to be part of a dynamic, growing team.

About us

Tribe Property Co is a leading property management company serving the Benowa and surrounding areas. Our mission is to provide exceptional property management services and create thriving communities.

If you're interested in this exciting opportunity, apply now!
