json.title: Sr. Client Relationship Manager

content.jobHook: As a trusted advisor, you will help clients unlock the full value of IBISWorld’s platform, expanding usage into new teams, geographies, and products.
content.unEditedContent:
Our Company:

Since 1971, IBISWorld has provided market-leading industry intelligence to professionals across finance, consulting, banking, government and corporate strategy. With offices in Melbourne, London, New York and Los Angeles, we give the world's leading institutions a clear, standardised view of industries across the globe so they can make better decisions, faster.

We have built this business on one principle: data you can trust. For over 50 years, the world's most respected banks, consulting firms and governments have relied on IBISWorld to navigate complex markets. That trust is the foundation of everything we do.

 

Key responsibilities:

The Senior Client Relationship Manager's primary focus is to maximise the lifetime value of an assigned portfolio of key accounts. The remit is two-fold: secure renewals and protect ARR across the book, and drive incremental growth by identifying and closing cross-sell and upsell opportunities within those accounts. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping clients unlock the full value of IBISWorld’s platform and expanding usage into new teams, geographies, and product lines.

·       Own the end-to-end performance of your assigned book of business, including renewal rates, upsell revenue, and client health metrics

·       Build and maintain deep relationships with key stakeholders across your client base, positioning yourself as their go-to resource for industry intelligence

·       Conduct regular business reviews and usage analysis to identify opportunities for expansion and mitigate churn risk

·       Develop and execute strategic account plans for high-value clients, with clear growth targets and engagement strategies

·       Drive product adoption through tailored training sessions, onboarding, and proactive outreach

·       Identify, qualify, and close cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your book, expanding revenue across products, data feeds, API access, additional users, and new business units

·       Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline mapped to each key account, with clear growth plays and forecasted ARR uplift

·       Develop and execute strategic account plans for high-value clients, including stakeholder maps, white-space analysis, and commercial targets for the year

·       Multi-thread across client organisations to broaden relationships beyond the original buyer and unlock new pockets of demand

·       Deliver tailored product demonstrations, value cases, and proposals that align IBISWorld’s solutions to specific client use cases and outcomes

·       Negotiate commercial terms on expansion deals and manage the full cycle from opportunity creation through to contract execution

·       Provide structured market intelligence and client feedback to Product and Research teams to inform roadmap priorities

·       Mentor and support junior team members through coaching, deal reviews, and knowledge sharing

·       Maintain accurate CRM records and provide reliable pipeline forecasts to support business planning

·       Represent IBISWorld at industry events, conferences, and networking functions as required


Qualifications and experience:

·       Must have 5+ years of B2B sales or account management experience, ideally in SaaS, data, research, or information services

·       Demonstrable track record of exceeding revenue targets across both retention and new business

·       Experience managing a portfolio of mid-market or enterprise accounts with complex stakeholder environments

·       Strong commercial acumen with the ability to negotiate contracts and navigate procurement processes

·       Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and pipeline management tools

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills

·       Experience selling into procurement, strategy, finance, or risk functions is a plus

·       Familiarity with industry research, market intelligence, or business information platforms is a plus

·       Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, or a related field preferred

·       Experience mentoring or informally leading peers within a commercial team

With offices in Melbourne, London, New York and Los Angeles, we give the world's leading institutions a clear, standardised view of industries across the globe so they can make better decisions, faster.

We have built this business on one principle: data you can trust. For over 50 years, the world's most respected banks, consulting firms and governments have relied on IBISWorld to navigate complex markets. That trust is the foundation of everything we do.
Key responsibilities:

The Senior Client Relationship Manager's primary focus is to maximise the lifetime value of an assigned portfolio of key accounts. The remit is two-fold: secure renewals and protect ARR across the book, and drive incremental growth by identifying and closing cross-sell and upsell opportunities within those accounts. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping clients unlock the full value of IBISWorld’s platform and expanding usage into new teams, geographies, and product lines.
·       Own the end-to-end performance of your assigned book of business, including renewal rates, upsell revenue, and client health metrics
·       Build and maintain deep relationships with key stakeholders across your client base, positioning yourself as their go-to resource for industry intelligence
·       Conduct regular business reviews and usage analysis to identify opportunities for expansion and mitigate churn risk
·       Develop and execute strategic account plans for high-value clients, with clear growth targets and engagement strategies
·       Drive product adoption through tailored training sessions, onboarding, and proactive outreach
·       Identify, qualify, and close cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your book, expanding revenue across products, data feeds, API access, additional users, and new business units
·       Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline mapped to each key account, with clear growth plays and forecasted ARR uplift
·       Develop and execute strategic account plans for high-value clients, including stakeholder maps, white-space analysis, and commercial targets for the year
·       Multi-thread across client organisations to broaden relationships beyond the original buyer and unlock new pockets of demand
·       Deliver tailored product demonstrations, value cases, and proposals that align IBISWorld’s solutions to specific client use cases and outcomes
·       Negotiate commercial terms on expansion deals and manage the full cycle from opportunity creation through to contract execution
·       Provide structured market intelligence and client feedback to Product and Research teams to inform roadmap priorities
·       Mentor and support junior team members through coaching, deal reviews, and knowledge sharing
·       Maintain accurate CRM records and provide reliable pipeline forecasts to support business planning
·       Represent IBISWorld at industry events, conferences, and networking functions as required
Qualifications and experience:
·       Must have 5+ years of B2B sales or account management experience, ideally in SaaS, data, research, or information services
·       Demonstrable track record of exceeding revenue targets across both retention and new business
·       Experience managing a portfolio of mid-market or enterprise accounts with complex stakeholder environments
·       Strong commercial acumen with the ability to negotiate contracts and navigate procurement processes
·       Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and pipeline management tools
·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills
·       Experience selling into procurement, strategy, finance, or risk functions is a plus
·       Familiarity with industry research, market intelligence, or business information platforms is a plus
·       Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, or a related field preferred
·       Experience mentoring or informally leading peers within a commercial team

content.jobHook: Wander Promotions is seeking a passionate and energetic Content Creator to capture the raw energy, culture, and emotion of boxing.
content.unEditedContent:
Wander Promotions is looking for a creative, energetic, and sport-minded Content Creator to help capture the intensity, discipline, and culture behind boxing. This is not a corporate desk-content role we want someone who understands the emotion of sport, the atmosphere of fight nights, and the personalities behind the athletes.

If you live and breathe sport, fitness, combat culture, or digital storytelling, we want to hear from you.

About Us

Wander Promotions is a growing boxing promotion focused on developing athletes, building events, and creating exciting fight experiences. We’re building a strong media presence around boxing culture, athlete journeys, training camps, events, and behind-the-scenes storytelling.

The Role

You’ll work closely with our team to create engaging digital content across fight nights, training sessions, athlete interviews, promotional campaigns, and social media.

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Understands boxing, fitness, or sports culture

  • Has strong instincts for social media trends and storytelling

  • Can create fast-paced, engaging content

  • Is confident filming in high-energy environments

  • Knows how to capture authentic moments, not just polished edits

Responsibilities

  • Film and edit short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube & Facebook

  • Capture training sessions, weigh-ins, press events, and fight nights

  • Create athlete-focused storytelling and behind-the-scenes content

  • Assist with promotional campaigns and event hype content

  • Produce engaging reels, interviews, highlight clips, and promotional videos

  • Help grow the Wander Promotions brand online

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience with content creation, videography, editing, or social media

  • Strong understanding of sport, fitness, or boxing culture preferred

  • Creative mindset with initiative and energy

  • Ability to work flexible hours around events and training schedules

  • Experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, Canva, or similar tools

  • Someone reliable, motivated, and hungry to grow with the brand

Bonus Points

  • Background in boxing, martial arts, fitness, or sports media

  • Photography skills

  • Experience growing social media accounts organically

  • Ability to create cinematic or documentary-style storytelling

content.jobHook: Lead a premium CBD restaurant and bar while helping launch and shape an exciting new venue within a growing hospitality group.
content.unEditedContent:
OPERATIONS MANAGER – LEADING CBD RESTAURANT & BAR | NEW VENUE TO FOLLOW

Ready to lead one of the city’s most exciting hospitality operations?

We are a premium restaurant and bar group with a strong reputation for exceptional service, exceptional food and wine, and creating memorable guest experiences. With another venue already in the pipeline, we are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to help lead the next stage of growth.

This is not a role for someone who prefers sitting in the office. We are looking for a true hospitality professional — someone who leads from the front, thrives in service, builds strong teams, and knows how to create memorable experiences.

You’ll work closely with senior leadership to oversee daily operations, drive standards, develop the team, and ensure every guest experience feels polished, warm, and effortless.

The role......

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of our premium restaurant and bar, ensuring service, presentation, and standards remain exceptional

  • Drive a strong and positive team culture, while maintaining high performance across all areas of the business

  • Play a key role in the launch, ongoing operations, and management of an exciting new venue within the group

  • Be the face of the business — building guest relationships, creating presence on the floor, and setting the tone for the venue

  • Lead from the front during service with confidence, professionalism, and a hands-on approach

  • Oversee staffing, training, stock control, wages, and COGS performance to ensure a commercially strong operation

  • Work closely with the General Manager on operational strategy, growth, and overall business performance

  • Recruit, lead, and develop the Events & Sales Coordinator, while driving private events and group activations across the business

  • Develop a knowledgeable, polished, and guest-focused team with strong product and service standards

  • Bring genuine passion for food, wine, and hospitality, with a strong focus on beverage operations and service delivery

Your experience....

  • Significant management experience within premium restaurants, bars, or high-end hospitality businesses

  • Proven ability to lead high-performing teams while driving operational excellence and strong financial results

  • A hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, mentor, and develop teams in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong commercial understanding across COGS, wage management, stock control, and venue performance

  • Passion for food, wine, and genuine hospitality

  • Professional, polished, and personable — with the ability to be both a leader and the face of the business

  • Calm under pressure, solutions-focused, and able to adapt across different service styles and offerings

  • Personality, presence, and a sense of humour

The offer....

  • Competitive salary package aligned with your experience

  • The opportunity to play a key leadership role within a growing and ambitious hospitality group

  • Autonomy to make the role your own and genuinely influence the direction of the business

  • Be involved in both an established premium venue and the launch of an exciting new operation

  • Work alongside passionate operators who value high standards, personality, integrity, and great hospitality

  • Long-term career growth and development opportunities as the group continues to expand

content.jobHook: Join LETO as a Service Coordinator – drive daily operations, support engineers, and shape service excellence with autonomy and impact.
content.unEditedContent:
About LETO Technology

LETO Technology is a leader in product identification and coding systems, delivering world-class service and support to major FMCG, pharmaceutical, and manufacturing customers. With strong growth and national expansion, we're building a high-performance team that thrives on ownership, accountability, and delivering reliability at scale.


The Opportunity

This is more than a scheduling role - it's the heartbeat of our service operations. As a Field Service Coordinator, you'll manage the daily flow of work for our Field Service Engineers (FSEs), ensuring customers get proactive communication, jobs are dispatched with precision, and service standards are consistently met. You'll have the opportunity to streamline operations, safeguard quality, and grow into senior operational leadership as LETO continues to expand nationally.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily scheduling, dispatch, and workload allocation for Field Service Engineers

  • Classify and triage service requests to align response with customer

  • Proactively communicate with customers on job readiness, ETAs, and service outcomes

  • Ensure all jobs are closed with accurate notes, photos, compliance documents, and invoices within agreed timeframes

  • Process spare parts, consumables, warranty claims, and service contracts with full tracking

  • Maintain CRM/ERP records, applying operational tags and banners to safeguard quality standards

  • Issue daily reports to the Field Service Manager and stakeholders on service activity, risks, FSE performance, and revenue conversion

  • Support engineers live in the field, securing first-time fix success and resolving emergent issues

  • Monitor and Report KPIs such as start-time compliance, utilization, quote conversion, and customer satisfaction (CSAT)

  • Uphold a High Standard of documentation, compliance, billing accuracy, and follow-up actions


Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in service coordination, scheduling, or operations support (preferred)

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in service coordination, scheduling, or operations support is required

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to balance priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills (internal and customer-facing)

  • Proficiency with ERP/CRM systems

  • Advanced user proficiency with ERP/CRM systems is required

  • High attention to detail with strong process and documentation discipline

  • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of tasks, and meet deadlines

  • Understanding of technical or field service environments (advantageous)


What We Offer

  • Career Growth – Pathways to senior roles and leadership as LETO expands nationally

Be part of the leading Global Fitness Brand
Highly Engage & Enjoyable Culture with a Supportive & Driven Team
content.jobHook: DREAM LEAD SUCCEED - Join our high performing team & one of the largest & successful Anytime Fitness Groups in SA.
content.unEditedContent:
Join our Growing Team as an Assistant Area Manager (AAM) for our Southern & Fluerieu Region – Lead, Inspire, Succeed

We're looking for an experienced and driven Assistant Area Manager to join our senior team in providing support to our Area Managers and lead our dedicated team of Club Managers & Memberships consultants across a network of clubs. We are soon-to-be 11 Anytime Fitness clubs with the ambitious goals of growing another 4 clubs in our portfolio within the next 12-24months.

If you're passionate about fitness, leadership, and creating high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a real impact within a thriving, positive, and close-knit organisation.

We need a leader who strive's for high performance with an attention to detail. By keeping our clubs to the highest standards, while offering a premium experience for our members that set us apart from the competition. A leader who leads by example & work's side by side within a team. Someone who can train & inspire a team to help excel within their results.

We're not looking for average, we're looking for driven, energetic, and ambitious individuals who want to stand out, win, and grow. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and back yourself to be the best, this is your opportunity.

Company Description

Anytime Fitness is the world's leading 24-hour health and fitness franchise, with over 6000 clubs globally and more than 600 in Australia and growing. Our mission is to help people lead healthier, happier lives through accessible, welcoming, and well-equipped fitness facilities. As industry leaders, we not only inspire our members to be the best they can be – we're equally committed to helping our team members grow, thrive, and achieve their own professional goals. Members benefit from personalized coaching, modern equipment, and engaging fitness programs. Anytime Fitness is committed to fostering healthy lifestyles and helping individuals achieve their fitness goals.

Role Description

The Assistant Area Manager (AAM) for the Southern & Fleurieu Region is a full-time, on-site role based in Adelaide, SA. As a AAM for the Marchegiano Group, you will report directly to the Area Management team & Club owner in helping oversee the performance, operations, and strategic development of the Southern & Fleurieu clubs within our Group. This is a hands-on role where you would be attending locations in the Southern & Fleurieu areas & working from your office at our HQ based in Blackwood

This position involves overseeing the day-to-day operations of multiple locations, supporting club managers in achieving business and fitness goals, and ensuring high standards of customer service.

Core responsibilities include team leadership and training, performance monitoring, operational audits, and implementation of strategies to drive member engagement and club success. The AAM will act as a key link between upper management and club teams in the designated region.

Your role will be to help our club managers & membership consultants to be trained, lead & succeed in their role while seeing our clubs grow & excel within the group.

Your focus will be on achieving business targets, developing high-performing teams, maintaining brand standards, and enhancing the overall member experience across all clubs.

Team Leadership & Club Operations

  • Lead and inspire club managers and teams, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and service.

  • Set and monitor monthly club targets and KPIs; provide regular performance reporting.

  • Oversee daily operations to ensure consistent execution of brand standards in cleanliness, presentation, and member engagement.

  • Facilitate regular training sessions & mentor staff to drive retention and performance.

Member Experience & Community Engagement

  • Help address and resolve escalated member concerns professionally and promptly.

  • Support local club initiatives to foster member retention and satisfaction.

  • Champion community engagement by driving club events and partnerships.

Sales, Revenue & Business Growth

  • Drive membership sales and revenue growth across all clubs through effective strategy and campaign execution.

  • Analyze financial and performance data; implement data-informed improvements.

  • Collaborate with the senior leadership team, including the Marketing Manager, Area Managers & Business Owner.

Marketing & Campaign Management

  • Oversee the implementation of national and local marketing campaigns across clubs.

  • Monitor campaign performance and provide feedback on effectiveness.

  • Contribute to the development of marketing materials and club-level strategy.

About You

We're seeking a passionate and experienced leader who lives and breathes fitness and thrives in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. You'll have the ability to inspire those around you, drive performance, and deliver measurable results.

To be successful, you will have:

  • Passionate about health, fitness, and fostering a positive community atmosphere

  • A minimum of 2 years' experience as an Anytime Fitness Club Manager or in multi-site management/Development Role within the fitness Industry.

  • Driven by Results & not afraid to push the limits.

  • Passion for the fitness industry & enjoy working in a team environment.

  • Strong leadership and people management skills, whilst demonstrating respect, communication & inspiring for excellence.

  • Leadership and team management experience, including training and performance oversight

  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills

  • A proactive and solution-focused mindset.

  • Solid understanding of fitness industry trends, marketing, and sales strategies.

  • Competency with performance data analysis and reporting.

  • Exceptional customer service commitment.

  • Social media fluency, particularly on Facebook and Instagram.

  • A collaborative yet self-motivated approach to work.

  • Proven track record in achieving sales and service targets.


Additional requirements:

  • Current First Aid and CPR certification

  • Valid Working with Children Check (DCSI)

  • National Police Clearance

  • Reliable means of transport to travel between locations

  • Australian work rights are required for this position


Why Join Us?

This is more than just a job it's an opportunity to lead a passionate team, drive business growth, and make a meaningful difference in the lives of our members and staff. As our AAM, you'll be a key player in shaping the future of our clubs and supporting the success of our expanding network. Whilst also having opportunities for further growth within our team.

Ready to make your mark in the fitness industry? Apply now and let's build something great together.

Benefits:

  • Employee mentoring program

  • Gym membership

  • Professional development assistance

  • Salary packaging

  • incentive based KPI

  • Further opportunities for promotion

bulletPoints: National recognised Company with opportunity for growth and reward
Competitive salary package
Fast paced environment
content.jobHook: This is a dual-focus role for someone who thrives on owning processes, keeping things moving and closing every loop.
content.unEditedContent:
About The Role

This is a dual-focus role for someone who thrives on owning processes, keeping things moving and closing every loop.

You'll work directly alongside our senior leadership team, splitting your time between high-level executive support and hands-on HR administration. No two days will look the same, but every day will require the same thing: discipline, follow-through, and a genuine ownership mindset.

Part 1 - Executive Assistant

You'll be the engine behind our executive team, anticipating needs, preparing materials, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

▸ Prepare agendas, take minutes, and distribute action items for executive and leadership meetings

▸ Coordinate travel bookings - flights, accommodation, and itineraries for senior leaders

▸ Manage calendars, appointments, and scheduling across the executive team

▸ Prepare correspondence, briefing papers, and presentations ahead of key meetings

▸ Provide personal assistant support to executives as required

Part 2 - Human Resources Assistant

You'll support the day-to-day HR function, keeping our processes accurate, compliant, and moving forward.

▸ Support recruitment activity - review and shortlist applicants, schedule interviews, liaise with candidates, and track all outcomes

▸Prepare and coordinate employment contracts, letters of offer, and variation letters

▸ Coordinate end-to-end onboarding for new starters and visa employees (482), including inductions, medicals, and IT setup

▸ Maintain and update compliance registers, recruitment, workers compensation, incidents, toolbox talks

▸ Assist with workers compensation admin and incident reporting documentation

What We Are Looking For

Experience level matters. We'll prioritise candidates who can demonstrate:

▸ Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information

▸ A background in coordination, executive support, or process-driven administration

▸ Confidence following up managers and stakeholders, and escalating when required

▸ A natural, organised approach to registers, trackers and spreadsheets

▸ Exposure to HR, recruitment, or safety administration (desirable but not essential)

We're looking for someone who wants to be an integral part of a growing team, someone who follows through, and takes pride in doing things well. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. For a more detailed role description please contact er@bullmotorbodies.com.au and/or apply on line via seek.

APPLICATIONS CLOSE FRIDAY, 29TH MAY 2026

content.jobHook: High-energy, RSA-ready hospitality pro who thrives in high-volume rushes. Ready to smash the bar, floor, or kitchen with a smile. Weekend ready!
content.unEditedContent:
We are looking for a high-energy, versatile team member to join our casual cellar door team. This is a dynamic role and not your usual cellar door. You'll need to be just as comfortable chatting with a local over a quiet glass as you are smashing through a rush of hundreds of guests.

The Vibe & Pace

Our cellar door can go from a steady, conversational pace to high-octane, fast-paced environment. During peak periods, we can serve hundreds of people a day. We need someone who can keep their cool, keep the smiles coming, and keep the drinks flowing when the bar has a queue out the door.

Key Responsibilities

  • The Bar: walk-up service, tastings during quieter periods use of POS system.

  • The Kitchen: occasional kitchen duties involving cooking pre-made items.

  • The Floor: Maintaining a clean venue, including clearing tables, resetting the space, general cleaning as needed,


What We're Looking For

  • High-Volume Experience: You've worked in busy environments (bars, pubs, or cafes) and aren't intimidated by a crowd or you're willing to jump in off the deep end!

  • Experience in a retail or hospitality role desirable.

  • Taking direction: You're a team player and able to action directions given.

  • Professionalism Under Pressure: You stay calm, friendly, and efficient even when there's a line at the bar and pizzas in the oven.

  • Multitasking Pro: You can "work the floor" on your way back to the bar and keep an eye on everything at once.

Desired Skills/Attributions

  • Wine and/or beer lover: Not necessary, but an added bonus if you enjoy sampling beverages so you can chat confidently about our offerings.



Schedule & Requirements

  • Weekend Availability: Mandatory

  • Daytime Hours: Generally finishing by 6:00PM with occasional special event evenings.

  • Weekday Potential: For the right candidate who masters the "peak period" hustle there is potential for weekday shifts across the business for example packaging days/winery work etc.

  • Compliance: Valid RSA Certificate or willingness to complete.



Perks

  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy your evenings! Most shifts are done by 6PM.

  • The Team: Join a supportive, fun-loving crew who have each other's backs during the rushes.

  • Love wine and Beer? You'll get an inside look at how it's made and obviously that includes sampling!

  • Discounts: Generous staff rates on our wine and food.

  • Music: You'll get to see lots of great live music and be involved in our music community.

Please send your resume and a short cover letter, detailing your relevanrt experience to info@shirazrepublic.com.au

Application Closing Date: Wednesday 10th June 5pm.

content.jobHook: TIG Welder
content.unEditedContent:
Australian Workforce is a leading national recruitment company partnering with reputable employers across Australia. We are currently seeking a skilled and reliable TIG Welder to join our client’s growing manufacturing team based in Hallam VIC.

This role involves precision TIG welding on stainless steel, aluminium, and other alloys while maintaining high-quality workmanship and workplace safety standards.

What’s on Offer
  • Competitive hourly rate based on experience
  • Supportive and professional team environment
  • Ongoing work with potential long-term opportunities
  • Opportunity to grow within a reputable manufacturing business
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform high-quality TIG (GTAW) welding on stainless steel, aluminium, and other metals
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding procedures
  • Prepare materials through cutting, grinding, and cleaning processes
  • Conduct visual inspections to ensure weld quality and compliance
  • Maintain welding equipment and ensure safe operation
  • Follow workplace health & safety (WHS) procedures at all times
  • Collaborate with fabricators, supervisors, and production staff
Skills & Experience
  • Proven TIG welding experience within manufacturing or fabrication environments
  • Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings
  • Experience with thin gauge and precision welding highly regarded
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
  • Ability to work independently and meet production deadlines
Qualifications & Licences
  • Relevant trade qualification preferred (Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade)
  • Welding certifications highly regarded
How to Apply

If you are a motivated and experienced TIG Welder looking for your next opportunity, click the “Apply Now” button and submit your updated resume online.
Please ensure your resume is submitted in an easily readable Word document format and includes your correct mobile number and email address so our recruitment team can contact you promptly.

json.title: Art Tutor — Creative Class Leader

bulletPoints: Lead lively art classes where young artists grow, imagination and creative voice
Be part of a supportive community of practicing artists who teach with purpose
$50/hr + Super, onboarding and process support
content.jobHook: Art Tutor — Creative Class Leader. Contractor role teaching kids & teens. $50/hr + Super. We’re looking for artists who lead the room with energy.
content.unEditedContent:
Art Academica is a small creative school in Melbourne where imagination is the curriculum and art is a conversation, not a task. Our classrooms are lively studios, our students are young makers with big ideas, and our teachers are artists who create momentum, not spectators.

We are looking for a skilled Artist to join our team as an Art Tutor. This role is for someone who loves both the craft of art and the craft of teaching — someone who steps into a room and brings it to life with curiosity, warmth, and creative leadership.

We’ve learned one thing well: talent matters, but energy ownership matters more. Our teachers don’t sit back — they guide, demonstrate, ask questions, move through the room, and inspire students to think bigger than the page.

What success looks like in this role:
• Students leave class feeling seen, excited, and creatively sparked
• Lessons are run with care, structure, and imagination
• The classroom feels energised, supported, and creatively held
• Communication and admin are completed reliably and on time

Key Responsibilities:
• Teach engaging art classes for kids and teens (various age groups 5–14)
• Plan and deliver lessons with clear timing and active student involvement
• Support creative exploration while guiding students toward their own visual voice
• Communicate with parents and our artistic team in a warm, professional way
• Submit weekly invoices and timesheets on time (templates provided during onboarding)

Role Details:
• Contractor position
• $50 per hour + Superannuation
• On-site teaching in Bentleigh East, Carnegie, Bentleigh Melbourne VIC
• Long-term weekly availability required during school terms
• Paid onboarding period to support success and alignment

Must-Haves:
• Strong art skills (drawing, illustration, painting, mixed media, or design)
• Warm classroom leadership style with active enthusiasm
• Reliable weekly availability for a full term minimum
• Ability to complete admin (invoices, timesheets) in a timely and organised way
• Valid Working With Children Check
• Understanding that teaching art is both a responsibility and a performance

Nice-to-Haves:
• Personal art practice you continue outside the classroom
• Experience working in a team of creatives and kids

Application Process Includes:
• A short interview conversation
• A 7–10 minute micro-teach demo (showing energy + explanation style)

Only the applicants with art folio will be considered. Social media link is fine.

This is not a gig. This is a place where young artists grow taller than they planned. If you’re someone who leads with energy, creates momentum, and takes ownership of both art and responsibility, you’ll feel at home here.

We hire for imagination, reliability, and heart.
If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

Art Academica team

content.jobHook:
Provide high-quality helpdesk support as part of a collaborative IT team working across some of Melbourne's most exciting iGaming brands.
What's in...
content.unEditedContent:
Provide high-quality helpdesk support as part of a collaborative IT team working across some of Melbourne's most exciting iGaming brands.

What's in it for you?
Are you a tech enthusiast with a sharp eye for detail? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? If you’re passionate about technology and problem-solving, we may have the perfect opportunity for you as our next IT Support Officer. At Easygo, we’re looking for someone who loves resolving technical issues, problem-solving and providing a high level of IT support. In this role, you'll have the chance to make an impact while continuously growing your technical skills.

As an IT Support Officer, you’ll play a key role in investigating complex issues and finding technical solutions to help our teams run smoothly. If you're a critical thinker with a passion for technology, an eye for detail and an interest in the iGaming industry, this is the role for you.

This role will only be advertised for one week as it is an urgent role.

Your role with us:
We are looking for an IT Support Officer to join our Melbourne office and be the first point of contact for our people when it comes to IT. In this role, you will provide day-to-day support for a workforce of over 600, making sure our technology runs smoothly and our teams can focus on doing their best work. You will take ownership of incoming IT tickets through Jira, resolving issues directly or escalating when needed, while ensuring every request is handled with care and efficiency.

Your work will cover everything from welcoming new starters with the right tools on day one, to making sure our meeting rooms are ready for collaboration, and being a key part of the IT experience at every stage of the employee journey. There is a hands-on element to the role: you’ll be comfortable moving desks, installing monitors and getting involved in the practical side of keeping an office environment running. You’ll also support both Windows and macOS users, so being confident across different platforms is a must.

This is a role where no two days are the same. Some days you’ll be troubleshooting hardware or WiFi issues, others you’ll be helping the team adopt new systems, or simply making sure everyone has the tools they need. As Easygo continues to scale from our startup roots into a fast-growing global tech company, you’ll be part of an IT team that is laying the foundations for sustainable growth.

We’re looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and customer-focused, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently. If you know your way around a Mac/PC, a HDMI cable, a busy service desk and you’re excited by the chance to grow your career while supporting a company on the rise, apply!

Who are we?

At Easygo we proudly stand as a prominent service provider to a powerhouse of brands within the entertainment industry, including Stake.com, Kick.com and Twist Gaming. 

Stake is the world's largest crypto casino, and leads the industry with a seamless online casino and sportsbook experience.

Level up your online entertainment with Kick.com, the vibrant live-streaming platform, which connects millions of gamers and content creators worldwide.

All alongside the innovative game design studio, Twist Gaming, which takes creativity to new heights by crafting cutting-edge and captivating games. 

Our commitment to placing our clients and their communities' entertainment at the forefront of everything we do, has solidified us as the ultimate online service provider for entertainment companies.

Headquartered in the beautiful city of Melbourne, our growth has been remarkable. From humble beginnings to a thriving workforce of 700+, we've expanded not only in numbers but in ambition. There really is something for everyone here, whether you work in Tech, Marketing, Operations, Mathematics or Design, we are sure to have something for everyone.

Click play, on your career today!

What you will do: 

  • Be one of the first responders for internal IT issues and tickets within Easygo.
  • Provide technical assistance, including in-person on-site deskside support.
  • Interact with stakeholders to escalate and resolve IT issues in a timely manner.
  • Assist with maintaining IT equipment including networking and laptops and more.
  • Support office infrastructure including meeting room systems and AV equipment. 
  • Onboarding tasks including set up of workstations and desks for new starters.
  • Receive and apply on-the-job training, demonstrating a passion for continual learning and skills growth.
  • Other ad-hoc tasks as requested by the IT Manager.
  • Document all actions, troubleshooting steps, and decisions made during problem-solving.
  • Contribute to the team's success by identifying areas of improvement and suggesting innovative solutions.

What you will bring: 

  • Prior experience in a technical support or helpdesk role.
  • Good working knowledge of both Windows and MacOS is desirable.
  • Natural talent for computing and an interest in IT and Technology.
  • Good communication skills, with an ability to explain technical issues to non-technical people.
  • Proactive and adaptable, with an ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong team player, dedicated to team success and continual improvement.
  • Demonstrated analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
Bonus points if you also have:
  • A degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
  • Exposure to iGaming or related industry is an advantage, but not a requirement.
    • Company-wide talks with key partners such as Everton FC
    • Office visits from big-name streamers
    • Meet Ambassadors like Alex Pereira, Israel Adesanya

Ballots for exclusive tickets to events like Formula 1, UFC, and more sporting and music eventsKnowledge of databases, spreadsheets, large datasets and/or manipulating data queries.

Some of the perks of working with us:

Office Perks & Environment

  • In-house baristas serving free coffee, tea, fresh juices, and smoothies
  • Daily catered breakfast and regular company-wide events
  • Snack walls and drink fridges on every floor
  • Fun /modern office spaces with pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, and an F1 simulator

Wellbeing & Personal Development

  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program for you and your loved ones
  • 9,000+ courses on our Learning & Development platform
  • One paid volunteer day per year
  • Weekly Wednesday massages by professional masseuses

Team Connection & Rewards

  • Team budgets for lunches and activities to celebrate achievements
  • Social sports teams and participation in Corporate Games
  • Easygo branded swag
  • Birthday and work anniversary gift vouchers, plus a chance to win prizes 

Events & Experiences

  • Company-wide talks with key partners such as Everton FC
  • Office visits from big-name streamers
  • Meet Ambassadors like Alex Pereira, Israel Adesanya
  • Ballots for exclusive tickets to events like Formula 1, UFC, and more sporting and music events

We believe that the unique contributions of everyone at Easygo are the driver of our success. To make sure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experiences, we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

We’re a global team of dreamers, creators, and game-changers from every walk of life, united by a passion for entertainment that inspires the world.

We believe that the best ideas come from different perspectives, so we actively welcome and champion talent from all backgrounds, cultures, identities, and experiences. Whether you're just starting out or bringing decades of experience, your unique voice matters here.

content.jobHook: Love styling, people and fast-paced fashion retail? Join a trend-led boutique in the heart of Adelaide CBD.
content.unEditedContent:
About our client

Our client is a contemporary Australian womenswear retailer known for trend-driven collections, confident styling, and creating feel-good shopping experiences. With a strong national presence and a loyal fashion-focused customer base, the brand is recognised for its energetic store culture, elevated service standards, and empowering approach to fashion retail.

About the role

An exciting opportunity is available for a passionate and style-driven Assistant Boutique Leader to join the Rundle Mall boutique. This role is perfect for an experienced retail leader ready to step into a fast-paced environment where customer connection, styling, and team culture are at the centre of the experience.

Working closely with boutique leadership, you will play a key role in driving sales performance, supporting team development, and ensuring the boutique consistently delivers an engaging and premium customer journey. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who thrives on the shop floor and enjoys leading through energy, service, and example.

What you will do

  • Support the leadership team in driving boutique sales, conversion, ATV, IPS and customer loyalty results
  • Deliver elevated styling experiences and genuine customer connection on the shop floor
  • Coach and motivate team members to achieve strong individual and store performance
  • Assist with rostering, wage management, and day-to-day boutique operations
  • Maintain exceptional visual merchandising and presentation standards
  • Support stock management, operational processes, and loss prevention procedures
  • Analyse store performance and contribute ideas to improve results and customer experience
  • Help foster a positive, collaborative and fashion-focused team culture

What you will bring

  • Previous leadership experience within fashion retail, ideally at Assistant Manager or senior sales level
  • A strong sales mindset with confidence driving KPI performance
  • Passion for styling and delivering memorable customer experiences
  • Ability to support, motivate and develop a retail team
  • Strong communication skills and a positive, energetic approach
  • Organised, proactive, and confident working in a fast-paced retail environment
  • High attention to detail and operational awareness

What's in it for you

  • $61K - $63K + Super, based on experience
  • Performance-based bonus structure
  • Sunday to Thursday roster
  • Generous staff discounts and clothing allowance
  • Career growth opportunities within a national fashion retailer
  • Supportive and fashion-focused team culture

If you are a passionate retail leader who loves fashion, styling, and creating standout customer experiences, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career within a dynamic boutique environment.

Recruiter: Veronica Vuong | Reference: 218765

json.title: Dairy Cattle Farm Operator

content.jobHook: Join our progressive dairy farming operation as a Dairy Cattle Farm Operator and become part of a hardworking, supportive team environment.
content.unEditedContent:
Duties

• Operate milking plant and equipment.

• Identify and report equipment not operating normally.

• Work co-operatively as part of a team.

• Read record instrument information ie. Milk Vat temperature and cow numbers;

• Understand the principle of safe working.

• Undertake multiple functions, produce a quality outcome e.g. Farm Machinery.

• Maintain machinery, undertake adjustments, and size changes.

• Solve problems and make decisions within given guidelines.

• Know general scientific terminology and assist with processes such as machine repair, artificial insemination, fertiliser mix design etc.

• Operate standard measuring equipment.

• Operate computerised systems using menu options.

• Contribute to the team in a specific role, providing input and assisting other team members; and

• Work at time without supervision.

Criteria

• At least an AQF relevant certificate II or III qualification (or equivalent); or

• One (1) year full-time of recent and relevant work experience.

This job description serves to illustrate the scope and responsibilities of the post and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. You will be expected to perform other job-related tasks requested by management and as necessitated by the development of this role and the development of the business.

json.title: Curtain Sewer

content.jobHook: Create custom curtains with a skilled team. Competitive salary, training & flexible work arrangements available.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

We are seeking a skilled Curtain Sewer to join our dynamic team at Ideal Interior Designers' in Epping, Victoria. As a Curtain Sewer, you will play a crucial role in creating high-quality custom curtains and window treatments for our clients. This is a full-time position, offering a rewarding opportunity to showcase your expertise in the Trades & Services industry, specialising in Tailors & Dressmakers.

What you'll be doing

  1. Measuring and cutting fabric to precise specifications

  2. Operating sewing machines to assemble curtain components

  3. Ensuring curtain panels are properly hemmed, pleated, and finished

  4. Collaborating with interior designers to bring their visions to life

  5. Maintaining a clean and organised work environment

  6. Adhering to quality control standards and timelines

  7. Providing excellent customer service and support

What we're looking for

  1. Proven experience as a Curtain Sewer or in a similar role

  2. Proficient in the use of industrial sewing machines and equipment

  3. Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow technical instructions

  4. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

  5. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team

  6. Passion for the Trades & Services industry, particularly Tailors

What we offer

At Ideal Interior Designers', we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a range of benefits, including:

  1. Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

  2. Flexible work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance

  3. A friendly and collaborative team-oriented culture


About us

Ideal Interior Designers' is a leading provider of high-quality custom window treatments and interior design services. Our team of skilled professionals is dedicated to creating beautiful and functional spaces that reflect the unique needs and preferences of our clients. With over a decade of experience in the industry, we are proud to have built a reputation for excellence and innovation.

If you are an experienced Curtain Sewer who is passionate about delivering exceptional results, we encourage you to apply now for this exciting opportunity.

json.title: Casual Retail Manager – School Uniform Shop (On Campus) | Northern Beaches

content.jobHook:
Attractive hourly rate
Supportive and collaborative team culture
Opportunity to represent a respected, growing global schoolwear brand
content.unEditedContent:
Casual Retail Manager – School Uniform Shop (On Campus) | Northern Beaches

Trutex is a leading schoolwear provider with over 190 years of heritage, trusted by schools and families across Australia. We design uniforms that are made to be outgrown, not outworn. As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Casual On-Campus Retail Manager to support our school uniform store in the Northern Beaches.

The Role

We’re seeking a hands-on, customer-focused Retail Manager to run day-to-day operations of our on-campus uniform shop.

  • Casual role: 6–8 hours per week (2 days)

  • On-campus retail environment (school term-based trading)

  • Must be available to work during back-to-school peak period: mid-January to mid-February

  • Flexibility to work additional hours and days during peak trading periods

  • Delivering exceptional face-to-face customer service to parents and students

  • Managing day-to-day store operations

  • Processing sales through POS systems

  • Pick and pack online orders

  • Stock handling, fitting support, and general store presentation

  • Supporting smooth back-to-school trading periods

About You

  • Retail experience (apparel/uniform experience highly regarded)

  • Strong customer service skills and a friendly, professional approach

  • Confident using POS systems and basic computer programs

  • Organised, reliable, and able to work independently

  • Flexible and available during peak trading periods

Why Join Us

  • Attractive hourly rate

  • Supportive and collaborative team culture

  • Opportunity to represent a respected, growing global schoolwear brand

  • Stable, recurring seasonal work in a school environment

Apply Now

If you enjoy retail, love working with people, and want a flexible casual role in a school-based environment, we’d love to hear from you.

content.jobHook: Join our expert claims team & support customers through challenging times. Hybrid work with flexible benefits.
content.unEditedContent:
Introduction

At Gallagher Bassett, we're there when it matters most because helping people through challenging moments is more than just our job, it’s our purpose. Every day, we help clients navigate complexity, support recovery, and deliver outcomes that make a real difference in people’s lives. It takes empathy, precision, and a strong sense of partnership—and that’s exactly what you’ll find here. We’re a team of fast-paced fixers, empathetic experts, and outcomes drivers — people who care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it well. Whether you're managing claims, supporting clients, or improving processes, you’ll play a vital role in helping businesses and individuals move forward with confidence. Here, you’ll be supported by a culture that values teamwork, encourages curiosity, and celebrates the impact of your work. Because when you’re here, you’re part of something bigger. You’re part of a team that shows up, stands together, and leads with purpose.


Overview

Your Role

We are currently seeking a Property Claims Consultant to lead by example and facilitate excellence in our property claims handling. With a dedicated focus on customer service, this role will be offered on a permanent full-time basis with a hybrid approach working from our Sydney CBD office and Working From Home (WFH).


How you'll make an impact

You will add value to Gallagher Bassett across the following:

  • Manage a portfolio of property claims from end to end
  • Settle claims within client service instructions, company guidelines and delegated authority whilst maintaining excellent customer service skills
  • Build and develop external business relationships
  • Achieve monthly productivity levels as designated by your Team Leader
  • Resolve complaints in accordance with company guidelines

About you

We’re interested in hearing from people who possess:

To excel in this role, you will be a dedicated and driven team member who thrives in a busy yet rewarding environment.

  • Minimum 2 + years Property Claims experience
  • Excellent interpersonal, spoken and written communication skills
  • PC literate – Database and Microsoft Office with outstanding organisational and time management skills
  • A self-motivated individual with the ability to work autonomously
  • Energy and flexibility to work with the Corporate team, and the desire to support projects identified as being critical to the long-term business plan

What we can offer you:

  • Flexible work arrangements – including WFH
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Excellent working environment – our team at GB is renowned for its dedicated and approachable people as well as its friendly, flexible and inclusive working environment which is built around great team support and rewarding opportunities
  • Exciting career – as our Company grows, so do the opportunities for our people
  • Opportunities for ongoing education and development through both external and internal programs delivered by our own claims training experts
  • Service recognition awards and employee assistance program for yourself and immediate family members
  • A dedication to your wellbeing through our peer support program, corporate health insurance discounts and wellness programs
  • Additional purchased leave, novated leases, and access to the Gallagher Rewards Program (including discounts/cash-back for hundreds of retailers!)
  • Reproductive leave
  • Birthday Club - have a day off during your birthday month as a gift from GB!

A brief overview on GB

Gallagher Bassett is Australia’s largest Third-Party Administrator (TPA). Our focus is refreshingly simple: we manage insurance claims on behalf of insurers, brokers, government bodies and self-insured corporations.

Gallagher Bassett (GB) has six offices in Australia located in Northern Territory, Adelaide, Perth, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney, employing over 2000 staff.

GB values its employees and offers a friendly, comfortable working environment that facilitates Work Life Balance!

If this sounds interesting to you, we want to hear from you today, click on Apply for this Job!

Agency applicants will not be considered for this role.

Gallagher Bassett is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Indigenous Australian applicants are encouraged to apply. As a member of the Diversity Council Australia, we recognise the importance of, and embrace diversity in the workplace. We will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant.


Compensation and benefits

On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits. 

Below are the minimum core benefits you’ll get, depending on your job level these benefits may improve:

  • 4 weeks annual leave plus up to 2 weeks additional purchased Lifestyle Leave
  • Novated Leasing opportunities
  • Two paid volunteer days annually
  • Health Insurance Discounts with our Group Insurance Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Paid parental leave

Other benefits include:

  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Mental Health and Wellbeing Support for yourself and immediate family members
  • Employee Recognition Awards and Service Milestone Recognitions
  • Peer Support Program
  • Annual flu vaccinations
  • Access to Reward Gateway – discount offers at over 350 retailers!
  • And more...

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.

Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.

Gallagher believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any form of discrimination by its managers, employees, vendors or customers based on race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy status), sexual orientation, gender identity (which includes transgender and other gender non-conforming individuals), gender expression, hair expression, marital status, parental status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected (herein referred to as “protected characteristics”) by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination. In addition, Gallagher will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

content.jobHook: Supporting children and their families with care and kindness.
content.unEditedContent:
We are seeking applications from experienced Support Workers in the Disability sector who are passionate about making an impact on the lives of children on the Sunshine Coast.


About Us

We provide a family centred support service to families on the Sunshine Coast and Brisbane area. Our service wraps care and support around children and families living with a disability. We provide Support Workers, Therapy Assistants and NDIS support ensuring children get the best from their plan and their therapy. 


We are looking for 


  • Compassionate support workers, experienced in working with children and families with additional needs. 

  • Experience in working with clients who are verbal/ non-verbal/ ASD/ FASD and PDA profile is a must.

  • Previous disability support

  • Resilient, caring and passionate about providing quality care.

  • Committed to ongoing professional development

  • Hold, or be willing to enrol in an industry-standard course and work towards achieving a minimum Cert IV formal qualification.

  • Excellent communication skills 

Why you'll love working for us

  • Career opportunity and training specifically designed to support you in your role

  • Wrap around support for all staff 

  • Opportunities to learn from our Allied health team. 

  • Above award salary

  • Flexible shifts to work around study/ family commitments.

json.title: Executive Assistant To Chief Executive Officer

bulletPoints: Very Flexible + Hybrid Work Environment
Learning & Development Support
A recognition-led and Collaborative Culture
content.jobHook: Support a modern CEO in a human-centred business that moves fast, thinks differently and embraces technology, curiosity and fresh ideas.
content.unEditedContent:
About Law Squared

Forget everything you know about law firms – we’ve found a better way.

Law Squared is a leading Human Centred Law firm, founded in 2016 to provide a true alternative to traditional law firms - for clients and lawyers alike. 

We move fast, think creatively, embrace technology, and care deeply about people - both our clients and our team. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to become the right hand to our CEO and help create leverage at the highest level of the business. This is not your standard “calendar and coffee” EA role - this role is for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, loves solving problems before they exist, enjoys building relationships, and gets genuine satisfaction from making things run brilliantly behind the scenes.

About the role / Key Responsibilities

Our CEO is involved across leadership, clients, business development, people, strategy, and growth. As the business scales, we’re looking for a superstar Executive Assistant who can help create space, momentum, and structure around that work. This role requires someone who operates with professionalism and excellence, however, to be successful in this role, we are also looking for someone who brings positive energy, who helps create an enjoyable, engaging environment, brings warmth and humour to the day-to-day, and makes work feel a little more fun! The successful candidate will be a true strategic support partner - someone who can anticipate needs, manage moving pieces, keep priorities on track, and help ensure the CEO is operating at the highest-value level possible.

One moment you might be coordinating complex stakeholder meetings, the next you could be preparing briefing notes, helping follow up client opportunities, testing a new AI productivity tool, or making sure nothing falls through the cracks after a meeting. You’ll become deeply embedded in the rhythm of the business and play an important role in how we show up internally and externally.

Key Responsibilities Include:

Executive & Strategic Support

  • Managing an ever-changing and high-volume CEO calendar
  • Coordinating meetings, travel, scheduling and executive logistics
  • Preparing briefing notes, agendas, talking points and meeting materials
  • Supporting leadership meetings with preparation, follow-ups and action tracking
  • Helping manage inbox flow, communication priorities and stakeholder responses
  • Creating structure, organisation and efficiency around day-to-day operations for the CEO

Client & Relationship Management

  • Supporting client relationship management and touchpoints
  • Assisting with pre-meeting preparation and post-meeting follow-up
  • Maintaining accurate records and activity updates in CRM platform  
  • Helping ensure opportunities, follow-ups and commitments don’t get missed
  • Acting as a polished and professional extension of the CEO

Business Development & Operations

  • Supporting business development activity, including proactive outreach coordination, relationship follow-ups, pipeline tracking and maintaining momentum across prospective client opportunities
  • Assisting with presentations, proposals and stakeholder communications
  • Identifying opportunities to improve workflows, systems and processes
  • Experimenting with new tools, technology and AI-enabled ways of working
  • Helping bring ideas to life quickly and efficiently

Executive Presence & Culture

  • Bringing energy, positivity and calmness into fast-paced environments
  • Building strong relationships across the business
  • Operating with professionalism, discretion and excellent judgement at all times

About you

The ideal candidate for this role is proactive, confident, highly organised and naturally ten steps ahead. You don’t wait to be asked - you spot what needs doing and take ownership. You enjoy variety, thrive under pressure, and love being the person who keeps things moving.

You’re commercially aware, tech curious, and excited by the idea of supporting a modern female CEO in a modern business.

You’ll bring:

  • Previous experience supporting senior executives or founders
  • Exceptional organisational and prioritisation skills
  • Strong communication and relationship-building capability
  • High emotional intelligence and professional discretion
  • Confidence and composure managing competing priorities in fast-moving environments
  • Excellent technology skills and digital literacy
  • Curiosity around AI tools, automation and smarter ways of working
  • A positive, proactive, can-do attitude and willingness to jump in at anytime

Bonus points if you:

  • Love finding better ways to do things
  • Enjoy experimenting with new technology
  • Can balance professionalism with personality
  • Bring warmth, energy and humour to your work

We’re not looking for someone who simply manages a diary. We’re looking for someone who creates leverage, brings calm to complexity, builds strong relationships, and helps our CEO and the business operate at its best.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 5 years' experience in an executive assistant or similar role - within the legal industry is a bonus
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and other relevant software
  • Exceptional organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a keen attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with integrity.


How you’ll benefit

Our numerous employee benefits include:

  • Hybrid and very flexible work environment;
  • Competitive salary package reflective of experience and capability;
  • Discounted corporate ClassPass membership;
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP);
  • Employee Referral Incentives
  • A recognition-led culture, where contribution is celebrated and career milestones are genuinely acknowledged;
  • Leading-edge legal ops + tech to optimise flexible working and client service outcomes; and


Apply Now

To submit an application, please apply directly with your CV and cover letter.

If you have any further questions please contact: careers@lawsquared.com

content.jobHook: Work flexibly from home and make a real difference through aged care case management across the Inner West and surrounds supporting older Australians
content.unEditedContent:
Care Facilitator - At Home Services

Are you passionate about making a difference in the lives of older Australians? Do you enjoy empowering people to live independently in their own homes? Do you want to join a supportive and values-driven organisation?

If you answered yes to these questions, then we have an exciting full-time opportunity with flexible work-from-home arrangements!

Key Benefits

  • A comprehensive range of Employee Benefits from health & wellness to professional development opportunities 
  • Flexible Monday to Friday schedule with work from home arrangements supported
  • Hourly rate + travel + super + salary packaging 
  • Supportive team culture where your contributions matter
  • Join an organisation that values clients and staff
  • Apply your care coordination and planning skills to support independent living at home

About the Role
As a Care Facilitator supporting clients across Sydney’s Inner West and surrounding areas, you will be part of our BaptistCare At Home team delivering quality care coordination and service planning to help clients remain living independently.

This position provides dedicated support with flexible coverage across additional LGAs in the Inner West, South East, Eastern Suburbs and nearby communities as required, so regular travel between locations is an important part of the role. You’ll work closely with clients and their families to develop individualised care plans, set achievable goals and connect them with services that enhance their wellbeing.

Your day may include:

  • Visiting clients in the community referred for help at home
  • Developing and evaluating care plans tailored to individual needs
  • Building relationships with families and carers
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to implement best practice care
  • Documenting client progress using care management systems

What You'll Bring 
Required qualifications and experience: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Community Services (Service Coordination or Case Management), or equivalent experience 
  • Experience in the aged care sector or demonstrated transferable skills within another community‑based service environment
  • Ability to work independently in the community and as part of a team
  • Strong communication, time management, and organisational skills
  • Intermediate computer skills and proficiency with email and apps
  • Valid Australian Driver Licence and reliable vehicle with a minimum Third Party Property Damage Insurance

About Us
BaptistCare is a leading purpose-led care organisation, guided by our Christian identity and serving people and communities across Australia for more than 110 years. We support people to live better through aged care, home care, retirement living, community services, disability support and housing. We know that life’s challenges can make our world feel smaller. With the right people alongside us, it can feel more connected, supported and hopeful again.

That’s what we work towards every day - enriching lives through communities of care. Today, more than 70,000 customers, 12,000 employees and close to 2,000 volunteers are part of our communities across Australia. 

BaptistCare – Inspired by Jesus to champion care for all

The Employee Benefits are endless when you join BaptistCare! 
Enjoy access to salary packaging which may increase your take-home pay, novated leasing, rewards and recognition, programs to support your wellbeing, employee referral program and retail discounts to name a few.  

Take the next step in your career and make a meaningful impact every day - Apply now!

For any questions about this opportunity, please email mytalent@baptistcare.org.au. Applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible as applications may be reviewed prior to the closing date. Closing Date is subject to change without notice.

bulletPoints: Small team with direct mentoring by senior leaders
Clear pathway for advancement
Remote-first role. with flexible hours
content.jobHook: Opportunity to join a Traffic Signals, Road Lighting, and Intelligent Transport Systems consultancy where your individual efforts will be rewarded
content.unEditedContent:
Company Description

CEI Design Pty Ltd specialises in traffic signals, road lighting and Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) design and consulting for the road infrastructure industry. Our mission is to help create safe, efficient road networks through practical ITS and electrical infrastructure design.

We support projects across the planning, design, construction and operational phases. We are a small team of highly experienced professionals with backgrounds spanning government and private sector delivery, design, construction and operational roles.

About the Opportunity

We’re seeking a Public Lighting Designer with 2–6 years’ experience to join our small team where individual efforts are recognised and rewarded. You’ll work closely with senior leaders who will mentor you to accelerate your technical capability and consulting skills. This is a full-time, remote-first role. Occasional attendance at client meetings, team sessions and site inspections within South-East Queensland will be required.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and colleagues through open, proactive communication.

  • Assist with initial project reviews, data collation, site inspections and field audits.

  • Attend project meetings alongside senior leaders and contribute to achieving project outcomes.

  • Prepare lighting calculations, models, design drawings and documentation.

  • Progressively build your technical capability and consulting skills across a range of projects.

  • Actively engage in professional development to support your career goals.

What you'll bring:

  • 2–6 years’ industry experience in public lighting design (Rate 2 and/or Rate 3 experience highly regarded).

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD (essential).

  • Experience with at least one lighting design package such as PerfectLite and/or AGi32.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools including Excel and Teams.

  • An Associate Degree in engineering (desirable but not essential).

  • A current and valid Queensland C class driver’s licence (or equivalent) for site inspections and field audits.

  • Full Australian work rights.

To Apply

If you value autonomy, take pride in quality work, and want to be part of a small team that invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV and a brief cover letter telling us a little about yourself and why this role appeals to you.

CEI Design Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from all backgrounds.

json.title: Mechanical Engineer – HVAC

bulletPoints: Join an exciting team on great projects
Be involved from start to finish on projects

content.jobHook: Join a growing contractor delivering exciting mechanical solutions.
content.unEditedContent:
Role Purpose

The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the technical delivery of mechanical (HVAC) design and construction across multiple projects. This includes oversight of engineering documentation, coordination with internal teams and external consultants, compliance management with NCC and AS/NZS standards, and mentorship of junior engineers. The role ensures that all mechanical designs are technically robust, efficient, and delivered in line with project budgets and timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Design & Technical Delivery

  • Complete engineering design work including calculations, layouts, equipment selections, and technical documentation

  • Conduct calculations, schematics, layouts, and schedules

  • Ensure compliance with relevant building codes, NCC, AS1668, and project-specific requirements

  • Oversee coordination of services with other disciplines including electrical, structural, architectural, and hydraulics

Project Oversight & Task Management

  • Complete the project trackers and design checklist documents as part of standard engineering workflow

  • Break down design scopes into actionable engineering tasks

  • Track and report on engineering hours to ensure they remain within project budgets

  • Provide technical support during construction, including RFI responses and site issue resolution

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Engage with clients, consultants, builders, and subcontractors to resolve design challenges

  • Represent the company in design coordination meetings, technical reviews, and commissioning activities

  • Contribute to value engineering sessions and technical decision-making

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and completeness of mechanical documentation

  • Timely completion of design packages against milestones

  • Design hours completed within allocated budgets

  • Minimal rework due to design or coordination errors

  • Positive feedback from internal and external stakeholders

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering (required)

  • Minimum 3 years of HVAC design experience in building services or construction

  • Proficiency in relevant design tools (CAMEL, AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, or similar)

  • Sound understanding of HVAC systems across multi-residential, commercial, and industrial sectors

  • Strong coordination, and communication skills

Desirable Traits

  • Proactive, solutions-driven, and accountable

  • Able to work effectively across multiple active projects

  • Collaborative team player with strong attention to detail

  • Comfortable making design decisions
