content.jobHook: Join Viva Solutions in Bella Vista. Full training, uncapped commissions, fast career growth, face-to-face sales, and strong team culture.
content.unEditedContent:
Looking for more than a job?
Want a role where your effort matters, your skills grow fast, and your income rises with performance?

At Viva Solutions, we run high-volume face-to-face sales campaigns across Sydney for major national brands. We’re searching for motivated, competitive people who want to push themselves, learn quickly, and build a serious career in sales.

This role is active, people-focused, and performance-driven.
If you enjoy talking to people, can handle a bit of pressure, and want a role where you’re rewarded for your work — this could be the perfect fit.

💼 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Speaking to customers across Sydney (based out of Bella Vista)

  • Delivering clear, confident sales presentations

  • Handling objections professionally

  • Staying calm, positive, and composed after rejection

  • Building real communication and sales skills

  • Working in a high-energy, high-support team

  • Hitting daily and weekly performance targets

  • Continuously improving your approach and confidence

We train you fully from day one — all you need is the attitude.

🔎 Who We’re Looking For

Experience helps, but mindset wins.

You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have strong energy and a solid work ethic

  • Are competitive (with yourself or others)

  • Want to progress and earn more than average

  • Don’t fold after a “no”

  • Take coaching seriously

  • Enjoy being on your feet and speaking to people

  • Want to build confidence and sales skills quickly

If you’ve ever been the type to push beyond average — you’ll do well here.

 What You Get

  • Base salary + uncapped commission

  • Typical OTE in year one: $100k–$120k+

  • Fast, structured progression into leadership roles

  • Weekly training & ongoing sales coaching

  • A supportive team that rewards consistency and effort

  • High-energy work environment with strong team culture

  • Recognition for growth, grit, and performance

We don’t just reward the top seller — we reward the people who show up hungry.

 This Role Will Challenge You

Sales builds:

  • Confidence

  • Resilience

  • Communication

  • Work ethic

  • Emotional toughness

It’s fast-paced. It’s active. It requires effort.
But if you lean into it — you grow fast.

If that excites you more than it scares you… you’re the person we want.

🚀 Ready to Level Up?

If you’re ambitious, competitive, and want a career where your effort pays off — apply today.

Successful applicants will hear back within 1–3 days.

Team Viva

content.jobHook: Join a clinic where you are more than just a receptionist — you are an integral member of a high-performing clinical team.
content.unEditedContent:
Love Sport & Healthcare? Experienced Medical Receptionist Wanted for Dynamic Sports Podiatry, Physio and Biomechanics Clinic


The Biomechanics Lab is a leading sports podiatry, physiotherapy and biomechanics clinic based in Norwood, South Australia. We are a busy practice with a strong case load in orthopaedic surgery rehabilitation, sports injuries and biomechanics. Our custom-built clinic provide a unique and modern working space, with our staff being some of the most experienced in Australia.

We're looking for an experienced and committed Medical Administrator who can run a front desk and clinic properly — someone organised, confident, warm, and able to keep calm in a busy clinical environment. The right person won't just answer phones and book appointments; they'll become a key part of the patient experience and an important part of the team.

What makes this role different is the environment. Our clinic is professional, fast-paced, modern, and very team-oriented. You'll be surrounded by clinicians who are passionate about biomechanics, movement, sports performance, and helping people stay active and pain-free. We also value reliability, initiative, and people who take pride in doing things well. In return, you'll work in a respected clinic where your role actually matters, your contribution is noticed, and you're treated as part of the business — not just 'the receptionist.'

This role would suit someone who enjoys healthcare but also likes energy, movement, sport, and working with motivated patients and professionals every day. We are flexible to provide the roles either full-time or part-time, with a minimum of 3 days a week commitment being required. Candidates need to be available to work from 8:30 am and available until 5:30pm. Parking is provided onsite.

  • Candidates ideally have a minimum 6-month history working in similar medical reception roles across industries including allied health (physio/podiatry), radiology, surgery, sports or general medicine.

  • A formal job description will be provided to short-listed candidates.

  • The advertised job is at our Norwood clinic. Opportunities can be provided to collaborate across our network of clinics, namely our new clinic at Eastwood Private Hospital.

  • Additional opportunities for work as the Director's personal assistant are available to the right candidate.


If you're experienced, capable, and looking for a role where you can genuinely enjoy coming to work, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply directly through seek, as well as sending your CV and personalised cover letter expressing your interest in this position and how you can contribute to our business by email addressed to:


Dr Chris Bishop PhD

Director

The Biomechanics Lab

91 Kensington Rd, Norwood SA 5067.

E - chris@thebiomechanicslab.com.au

Closing date for application: COB Friday 29th May 2026

Notes:

  • Please ensure your cover letter includes a summary of your experience in Medical Administration as well as a statement of what you feel you could contribute to The Biomechanics Lab.

  • Only short listed applicants will be contacted for interview.

Location: Sunshine Coast, QLD

Permanent Part Time / Casual (depending on applicant)

About Us


Sunshine Coast Medical Weight Loss Centre is a growing, multidisciplinary clinic specialising in medical and surgical weight management. Our team of Surgeons, GPs, Bariatric Surgeons, Dietitians, Psychologists and support staff work together to provide compassionate, patient-centred care.

We are looking for a Medical Receptionist / Administrator to join our friendly team.

This role is the first point of contact for our patients and supports the smooth running of the clinic.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information

What We Offer

  • 4 days per week with scope for extra shifts to cover leave

json.title: Live-In Housekeeper in Sydney

content.jobHook: An experienced Live-in Housekeeper is required to support a beautifully run private residence in Manly, Sydney, with travel to a second property.
content.unEditedContent:
We are seeking an experienced Live-in Housekeeper to support a beautifully run private residence in Manly, Sydney, with travel to a second property. This is a rare opportunity to join a respectful, well-structured household where previous staff have remained in their roles for five years or more, reflecting the principals’ commitment to consistency, mutual respect and long-term working relationships.
This role will suit someone who genuinely enjoys managing a home to an exceptional standard and who takes pride in delivering thoughtful, discreet service.
Ideal candidates will have experience in private households or superyachts and feel confident overseeing the daily running of a residence with calm efficiency and attention to detail. 
You will be responsible for all aspects of housekeeping, laundry and organisation, as well as preparing wholesome evening meals for the principals and assisting when guests are entertained.
The household already has established systems and routines in place, and the successful candidate will be comfortable following these while bringing a proactive and polished approach to their work.
The position offers separate live-in accommodation and is designed as a stable, long-term role for someone seeking continuity within a professional and welcoming environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Preparing and cooking evening meals for two principals, with assistance during dinner parties when required (does not have to be an experienced chef)
  • Full housekeeping to a high standard is a must
  • Laundry and wardrobe care, including ironing and fabric management
  • Receiving deliveries, welcoming guests and maintaining immaculate presentation of the home
  • Care of outdoor terraces, BBQ area and exterior entertaining spaces (additional external staff employed)
  • Organisation and maintenance of fridges, pantries, cupboards and storage areas
  • Adhering to existing household systems and weekly schedules
  • Travelling with the family to their 2nd property on occasions and performing the same duties while in residence
  
Candidate Profile
  • Proven experience in a similar private household, superyacht or high-end hospitality environment
  • A confident, capable home cook able to plan and prepare balanced meals
  • Strong knowledge of laundry, ironing and fine fabric care
  • Discreet, self-directed and able to anticipate household needs
  • Warm, composed and professional in manner
  • Energetic, highly organised and detail-focused
  • Comfortable with occasional weekend work and household guests, including children
  • Full working rights in Australia
  • Police Check and WWCC
  • Excellent, verifiable references  
Position Details
  • Live-in role with separate, self-contained accommodation
  • Monday to Friday, with occasional weekend work (discussed prior) and time off in lieu
  • Based in Manly, Sydney, with occasional travel
  • Competitive salary plus superannuation
  • Long-term opportunity for the right candidate
  • Job Reference: 1610304

content.jobHook: Opportunity for a customer focussed Rural Merchandise Salesperson at our Kalbar store in the beautiful Scenic Rim region.
content.unEditedContent:
Farmcraft, an independent family owned business established in 1992, is SE Queensland's largest independently owned group of rural merchandise stores. We service a diverse customer base including primary producers, landscapers, fencing contractors, pet owners, home gardeners, and lifestyle block owners.

We have an opening for a customer focussed Salesperson at our Kalbar store.

The successful applicant will be expected to take an active part in all areas of the branch including but not limited to sales, stock movement, merchandising, stocktaking, order processing and administration.  A team player with a can-do attitude will be a distinct advantage.
 

Duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Engage with customers, understanding their needs, and providing product recommendations and sales assistance

  • Provide outstanding customer service to clients in store, and via email and phone.

  • Sales transactions, including loading of produce into vehicles

  • Assist with customer account management

  • Stock management administration

  • Stocktaking & store merchandising

Ideally the successful applicant will possess:

  • Previous experience working in a similar role involving sales / customer service

  • An understanding of the rural industry, horticulture, &/or knowledge of rural merchandise 

  • Computer literacy skills

  • Excellent communication

  • The ability to work both autonomously and as part of a team

  • High attention to detail with ability to prioritise and execute tasks

  • Self-motivated with a can-do attitude

  • A current forklift ticket (or be willing & able to gain one)


Ideally we're looking for a full-time team member.

Job Type: Full-time


Please apply using the apply now button and attach a resume and covering letter.

content.jobHook: Join us as a Sales Consultant! Use your people skills to build trust, hit goals & grow your career. No bike knowledge needed—full training!
content.unEditedContent:
You don’t have to be a bike expert – we can train you!

SALES CONSULTANT     

WHY WORK AT 99 BIKES

  • Generous above-award salary package including uncapped commission in the range of $67 - $95K
  • Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements – as well as monthly awards and events, our top 10% of high achievers fly off to an all-inclusive annual conference called “Global Gathering”. Previous Globals have been in New Zealand, Canada, Japan and this year is in Cairns! 
  • Enjoy unmatched career growth opportunities – we promote from within wherever possible and our people have become Team Leaders, State Leaders, Product/Online/Marketing Specialists and even GMs of overseas countries.
  • Grow your skills and expertise – we have our own 7-program Leadership Academy, a 99 Bikes Bicycle Academy, and we offer $1000 per person per year for a self-development activity such as attending a wellness retreat or getting some personal mentoring.
  • Save money – we pay our people to ride to work and offer cost price on bike products, plus we offer generous employee benefits like a paid parental leave package and free counselling services.
  • Overseas Opportunities – we have shops in Australia, New Zealand and the UK. We support short and long-term relocation opportunities via initiatives such as our Peak-to-Peak Program between AUS and the UK, which offers participants an endless summer.
  • Grow your wealth – buy in or be allocated reward shares as part of our Employee Share Scheme which started at 99c per share and is now worth $5 per share. Current and ex-employees own over 16% of our company, with this number growing every year.
  • Enrich our communities – we donate 1% of our total wage bill to the charity of our people’s choice through our Earning To Give program. Past recipients include RSPCA, Beyond Blue and the Children’s Cancer Institute. We have donated over $2.8 million dollars to charities of our people's choice since 2016
  • Enrich our planet – we are committed to reducing our environmental impact and helping others to do the same. Bikes are a low carbon transport option, helping our customers lower their carbon footprint. We are also working on reducing ours with solar panels installed on 70% of our shops.
  • Certified B Corp – We proudly became a certified B Corp in 2023. B Corp is a third party certification to show that we are committed to more than just profit - we’re committed to doing good for people and the planet.
     

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • No need to be a bike expert—full on-the-job training provided
  • Help our customers find the best products that suit their needs through your advice and support.
  • Be a customer champion to help us deliver on our vision: The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops 
  • Work towards achievable sales and product knowledge goals with tiered financial rewards
  • Be a part of a high-performing culture with structured team communication: daily, weekly, and monthly meetings, plus monthly one-on-ones with your team leader.
  • Experience career development opportunities with access to our in-house Leadership Academy.
  • High achievers are recognised with awards and exclusive invites to our Global Gathering (previous locations include Whistler, Canada and Hakuba, Japan).
  • Be part of a collaborative, community-driven team—compete for store awards and take part in charity and local events
  • Flexible rostering - our leaders aim to accommodate personal needs with roster flexibility and offer plenty of weekend work if desired.
    We embrace innovation and welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds.
  • Perfect for high performers looking to take the next step or sales professionals seeking a more supportive, rewarding employer.

ABOUT YOU:

  • Key qualities: strong team player, relationship builder, and customer-focused.
  • Demonstrated and proven achievement in any field – these could be personal goals, sporting, educational or work-related.
  • A track record of success in past sales or customer service roles in any industry is advantageous but not essential.
  • Good communication skills and demonstrated success in developing and maintaining good relationships with workmates and clients.
  • A history demonstrating honesty and reliability
  • A demonstrated commitment to continual improvement and learning.

 
ABOUT US:
99 Bikes opened the doors of its first tiny 170m2 shop in Milton, Brisbane in May 2007, a shop so small that we could only fit 99 bikes into the store. From that humble beginning, we have grown to become the largest bicycle retailer in Australia with 798 employees and we now have retail stores in the UK, New Zealand and Australia. In the last 12 months we sold over 164,000 bikes and we have a loyal customer base of over 1.8 million Club 99 Members in Australia, part of our vision to be ‘The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops’. Best Employer multi-award winner and global retail giant Flight Centre also bought into the business, giving us access to shared resources and enabling us to fast-track our growth.

 In addition to our retail stores, we also own Advance Traders, a bicycle distributor importing popular brands such as Merida, BMC, plus many more. Together we form the Pedal Group and this integration has underpinned our growth and given our people much greater career opportunities across the group.

For instance, someone who started as a bike builder in a shop went on to become GM of our UK operation. Another of our Melbourne high achievers wanted to move to Canberra so we opened our first store there. We build our business around our people, promote from within wherever possible, and have numerous training pathways to help them achieve their potential.

We have always been about living our purpose of enriching mind, body, earth or soul with the freedom of riding and focused on balancing purpose with profit. In 2023 we made it official by becoming a certified B Corporation™ (B Corp). Learn more about B Corp certification here. Just by doing business everyday, we are proud to sell products that have the potential to significantly improve the mental and physical health of our customers and communities whilst also lowering their carbon footprint, if they make the choice to ride bikes instead of drive.

Since 2016 we have donated over $2.8 million to charities chosen by our employees through our annual Earning To Give program. We pay our people to ride to work to help them stay healthy and reduce their environmental impact with over 75% of our employees using this initiative. Over 70% of our stores have solar panels installed and we are committed to finding ways to reduce waste from our stores with upcycling and recycling programs in most stores.

How to Apply 

  • Hit the “Quick Apply” Link
  • Apply directly through our website

Are you an experienced Practice Manager looking for a leadership role where you’ll be valued, supported, and connected to the local community?

content.jobHook: Become part of a team environment that packs excellent quality produce for Australians to consume on a daily basis
content.unEditedContent:
FRUIT & VEGETABLE PACKING OPERATION

PACKING SHED SUPERVISOR


North Queensland Fresh Pty Ltd require a competent person to supervise the activities of our Packing Shed team in a full-time position as a Facility Supervisor. 

This is a busy operation situated in Gumlu which is 45 mins north of Bowen, North Queensland and the person appointed would be required to demonstrate a capacity for high energy input and commitment to the position. 

This position entails the supervision of packing staff and ensuring the correct handling of product to meet the customers’ requirements including grading, packing, cool chain, hygiene and dispatch. The successful applicant will be required to manage, coordinate and monitor staff performance and KPI’s. 

The successful applicant will be able to demonstrate:

• An ability to meet targets, KPI’s and report back to Shed Manager

• Knowledge of fruit & vegetable industry and be able to assess incoming product quality and determine grading resources

 • Be able to monitor quality of product through various stages in production – shed, washing, 1st, 2nd and final grading

• Reporting any issues due to mechanical damage/grading for rectification by maintenance

• Reporting safety concerns or unsafe behaviour from staff to management

• Ability to liaise with Maintenance Manager and Dispatch Manager 

• Ability to ensure all Quality Assurance (QA) records are correct, allowing for complete traceability 

• Ensure all personnel are trained and performing as per standard procedure for the business

• Ability to ensure all waste products are handled as per standard procedure for the business

• Ability to relieve shed manager when required

• Forklift license will be favourable


Remuneration will be based on a season contract of approximately 38 weeks.


Remuneration is commensurate with experience and qualifications. Position will be based on an above horticultural award hourly rate, plus super and bonus incentives for performance.  


Applications providing full details of experience, qualifications and personal data should be emailed to jobs@nqfresh.com.au.

content.jobHook: Electrical Apprentice wanted! Join our growing family business, learn the trade with real support & great team culture. Apply now!

At Black Rock Electrical, we're not just building careers — we're building people. We're a growing electrical business with a serious passion for the trade and an even bigger passion for the team behind it. content.unEditedContent:
About the role

Savco Vegetation Services Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Powerline Vegetation Worker to join our team in Brisbane, Queensland. As a Powerline Vegetation Worker, you will play a vital role in maintaining the safety and reliability of our power generation and distribution infrastructure by ensuring vegetation is managed effectively around powerlines.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting regular inspections of powerline easements and access tracks to identify vegetation growth that could pose a risk to the power network

  • Utilizing a range of vegetation management equipment, such as chainsaws and mulchers, to remove or prune problematic vegetation

  • Ensuring work is carried out in compliance with all relevant safety regulations and industry best practices

  • Maintaining detailed records of vegetation management activities and reporting on progress to the broader team

  • Collaborating with other members of the vegetation management crew to complete tasks efficiently and effectively

What we're looking for

  • Previous experience in a similar powerline vegetation management or arboriculture role

  • Proficiency in the use of chainsaws, mulchers, and other vegetation management equipment

  • Strong safety-focused mindset and the ability to work in accordance with relevant regulations and procedures

  • Good physical fitness and the ability to work in challenging outdoor conditions

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team

What we offer

At Savco Vegetation Services, we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment for our employees. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a range of benefits, including:

About us

Savco Vegetation Services is a leading provider of vegetation management services to the power generation and distribution industry. With a team of highly skilled professionals and a fleet of specialized equipment, we work closely with our clients to ensure the safe and reliable operation of their critical infrastructure. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and customer service has made us a trusted partner in the industry.

Apply now to become part of the Savco Vegetation Services team!

An exciting opportunity exists for a Finance and Insurance Sales Consultant to join our Ford, Geely & Trucks dealership in Wodonga.

Located in beautiful Albury/Wodonga, Blacklocks has been operating in the local region for over 100 years, and is one of the oldest dealerships in the country.

This is a frontline role providing expert assistance to our valued customers with their finance, insurance, and warranty requirements.

  • Strong IT skills, attention to detail and data accuracy

  • Well developed time management and organizational skills

content.jobHook: Our Myer Garden City team are looking for an additional Stylist to support with cover across weekdays & weekend shifts.  Apply today!
content.unEditedContent:
Taking Shape is one of Australia and New Zealand’s premier retailers, constantly striving to innovate and create a memorable customer experience. Our purpose is to create awesome, unique and fabulous fashion and curate the customer experience to support this.

Our Myer Garden City store is looking for an amazing Sales Stylist to provide exceptional service to our customers through a personalized experience, and exceptional product knowledge.

To support a flexible working environment, all our Sales Stylists are contracted on a base of 6 hours a fortnight, and rostered in line with store needs.

At present our Garden City store has approximately 1 to 3 shifts available per week. This currently includes Monday, Wednesday and occasional Sundays. This may change in line with the store needs.

Our Sales Stylists:
  • Provide exceptional customer service, creating a memorable experience and understanding our customer needs
  • Are innovative, and always look for new and better ways of working
  • Are confident and stylish, acting as ambassadors of the  Taking Shape brand
  • Build belonging and a community spirit, with both their team members and customers
  • Maintain high standards of visual merchandising, and ensures our floors are well stocked to support our customer needs
Join us if you:
  • Have an affinity with the Taking Shape brand, and live, love and breathe our product
  • Possess exceptional customer service skills, preferably within a customer led industry
  • Are a self-starter, and flexible in line with business needs
  • Are bubbly, passionate and committed, holding a professional stance and high emotional intelligence
Taking Shape offers you:
  • The opportunity to work with our Tribe, where our employees and customers are celebrated
  • Amazing Reward and Recognition opportunities
  • A fun work environment where we believe in play as part of your day
  • Structured Learning and Development Programs
  • Generous Staff Discounts
We are on the lookout for talented and inspired people to join our tribe - people who share our vision, who recognize the importance of making a difference and who want to be part of something special.

If you have the innovation and dedication to help take us to the next level, we invite you to apply today!

content.jobHook: Site Engineer required for civil infrastructure projects across Queensland.
content.unEditedContent:
A reputable civil contractor delivering major infrastructure and subdivision projects across Queensland is seeking a Site Engineer to join the team.

This is a permanent opportunity offering long-term project work across regional Queensland. Travel between project sites is required depending on project demands, however this is not FIFO/DIDO.

About the role
You will work closely with Project Engineers and site teams to coordinate daily construction activities across road construction, bulk earthworks, drainage and utilities packages.

Key responsibilities
• Daily site coordination and supervision of works
• Managing subcontractors and site documentation
• QA, compliance and progress reporting
• Assisting with planning, programming and procurement
• Ensuring works are delivered safely and efficiently

Requirements
• Previous experience as a Site Engineer within civil construction
• Strong understanding of earthworks, roads and drainage
• Ability to work closely with crews and subcontractors on-site
• Strong communication and organisational skills
• Open to travel across project locations when required

What’s on offer
• Permanent full-time opportunity with strong pipeline of work
• $100k to $140k + vehicle + super
• Exposure to large-scale infrastructure projects
• Supportive team environment with career progression opportunities

Click APPLY or contact Daley Cullinane | Daley@FranklinSmith.com.au for a confidential discussion.

content.jobHook: Are you passionate about driving teams to success? Step into this leadership role & unlock a world of career growth & transformative development
content.unEditedContent:
The role

As one of our Desktop Home Assessing Team Leaders, you will be playing a pivotal role in guiding and overseeing the Home Assessing Team, who are responsible for assessments of impacted properties, cost validation, ensuring high scope accuracy and end-to-end management of claims assigned to them.

Responsible for providing ongoing training & coaching to the team and ensuring that the Home Assessors are consistent and effective in their approach to a variety of assessments, validation of Scopes of Work, and end-to-end management of a select claim’s portfolio. 

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead, monitor and inspire the team to execute a high standard of service.
  • Provide guidance & support to team members, with the goal of enhancing skills, overcoming challenges and achieving career goals, providing constructive feedback when required.
  • Handle escalated claims, complaints and other matters of complexity.
  • Implement and continuously refine cost control strategies to achieve planned cost outcomes and drive improvements across the Home Claims Value Chain in line with business objectives.
  • Build & maintain relationships with a variety of stakeholders, providing constructive feedback as required.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of strategic and operational activities that will continually improve Claims performance, including systems & process development and staffing requirements.
  • Track, monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring productivity and quality metrics are in line with internal expectations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience managing a team of professionals along with the ability to lead, inspire, performance manage, coach and mentor a team.
  • Strong change-agility, exceptional communication, negotiation, time management & organisational skills.
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in Home Assessing, or Building Industry and previous estimating and assessing experience essential.
  • Demonstrated experience in building effective business relationships with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Insurance experience is preferred, but not essential.

The benefits of working at A&G

  • Be rewarded - we recognise high performance and reward our people for their hard work through bonuses and other perks.
  • Options for leave - life happens, so we’ve got volunteer days, an additional paid ‘ME’ day, paid parental leave and the opportunity to purchase additional leave to cover all of the big stuff.
  • Grow with us - we’ve got learning and professional development opportunities to suit everyone. 
  • Give back - our A&G Difference program gives you the power to change our community for the better through volunteering, fundraising and donation opportunities for causes that you’re passionate about.
  • Take care of yourself - your wellbeing is important to us and our healthy mind and body hub, mental-health support and fitness discounts will help you be your best self.
  • Celebrate the wins - we love sharing our successes and celebrating together - join us and you’ve got a ticket to our many on-site events throughout the year, family fun days and annual celebrations.
  • Save money - as well as discounts on insurance products, we’ve teamed up with some incredible retailers, hospitality providers and others to bring you discounts on your purchases, no matter where you are in Australia.
  • Perks App - Access to an employee benefits and discounts app called ‘Perks’ offering your great discounts, offers and programs across a range of areas.

About us

Auto & General (A&G) is the fastest-growing major Motor and Home insurer in Australia, providing insurance products and solutions to safeguard a brighter future for our customers and community. 

Our range of general insurance products including Car, Motorcycle, Home, Contents Pet and Travel products are delivered through our multi-award-winning brand Budget Direct and partnerships with leading brands - ING, Qantas and Coles Insurance.

We’re excited about the future and we’re always on the lookout for talented, passionate individuals who can help us achieve our goal of being Australia’s best insurer! If this sounds like you, apply today.

Auto & General values individual differences and believes in fostering an inclusive culture that creates a great place to work for all.

*A note from Auto & General to recruitment agencies: We politely ask that you avoid making any approaches or sending any unsolicited resumes to our Recruitment Team or Hiring Leaders across our business. Auto & General is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

content.unEditedContent:
Client Services Coordinator

  • Relaxed accounting firm based in Townsville
  • Flexi working conditions + half days on Friday
  • Very social culture and positive office environment
  • Up to $75k + Super

PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WITH AUSTRALIAN PUBLIC PRACTICE EXPERIENCE WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE.

FIRM

This represents an amazing opportunity with a very social and vibrant accounting firm based in Townsville. This firm has been in operation for many years and led by very down to earth and relaxed Partners.

The firm has invested heavily in their office culture and focus on employee wellbeing.

POSITION

Due to strong growth the position of Client Services Coordinator has been created.

The role will involve the following:

  • Work alongside the admin team and support the accounting team
  • Client relationship management
  • Onboarding new clients
  • Solid undersanding of general accounting firm admin
  • Experience with ASIC Corp Sec + ATO Lodgements is highly desirable
  • Database management
  • Any other administrative duties as required

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following:

  • 2+ years experience within Australian Public Practice
  • Experience with all facets of public practice administration
  • Strong experience with Xero and MYOB
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to be a team player

BENEFITS

The successful candidate will be rewarded with a competitive salary package that reflects their skills and experiences.

The firm has a social, relaxed and easygoing culture and promote genuine work life balance.

If this is the opportunity that you have been waiting for with a local accounting firm, apply today without hesitation. Alternatively, please contact Desha Joseph on 0439 775 709 for a strictly confidential discussion.

json.title: Unique opportunity for an amazing online Personal Trainer/Coach

bulletPoints: Large realm of responsibility
Work remotely
Get given a full roster of your own clients
content.jobHook:
Hungry, loyal and reliable online Personal
Trainer/ Coach wanted for a small, booming
business!
content.unEditedContent:
You're a hungry, driven and organised person who wants to take their next career step. You love people, get enjoyment out of seeing others progress and overcome challenges. You could be considered the 'go to' person in your social circles, you just have the right answers and are supportive.

You love to work, are career focused and are ready to get your hands dirty. You are solution-focused and propose solutions constantly. When you're unsure about something, you will research and try to find the answer, rather than giving in and saying "I don't know".

You're a great communicator and efficient. You're not likely to get intimidated, and can stand your ground and speak your mind when necessary.

You're a sponge for information and love learning, striving to know as much as you can, as quickly as you can.

You're well presented and earn the respect of others easily. You're upfront and A to B, and

love to find the most efficient way to get things done.

You must be computer literate and have a minimum of Cert 3+4 in Fitness.

A minimum of 1+ years personal training experience is required for this position.

Full Australian working rights are mandatory for this role.

NOTE: We do not require any additional qualifications, other than being brilliant at the above. Though having some training in yoga or pilates is a bonus!


About the role:

You will basically be the backbone of your client's success, keeping them accountable

throughout the week, a cheerleader, a friend but also their captain. You're not there to baby

them though, you'll be working with women between 40-60yrs old.

You will have a lot of responsibility on your shoulders; seeing the client all the way to their end

goal via text and 1on1 zoom meetings. There is a small amount of online zoom group training

sessions to be conducted by you as well (under 5 per week).

This role is 100% online, meaning you won't have someone looking over your shoulder every

10 minutes so you have to be self motivated, focused and able to keep yourself on task. You

must be a fast learner and willing to dive in and learn everything you need to, to be able to do

this role successfully.

You will be part of a team and have access to weekly training and support but will also have

your independence as a working professional.

If this sounds like a challenge for you, please apply now!

HR Tilt Tray Truck Driver | Caboolture-based | $40 p/h + Overtime

The Opportunity

Join a leading national equipment hire company as a skilled HR Tilt Tray Truck Driver based out of their Caboolture branch. This is a fantastic opportunity offering consistent daytime hours, a great hourly rate, and the chance to significantly boost your earnings with ample overtime.

Key Details
  • Role: HR Tilt Tray Truck Driver
  • Location: Caboolture, QLD
  • Pay Rate: $40 per hour for ordinary hours
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 6:00 am start
  • Hours: Plenty of overtime available!
About the Role

You will be responsible for the safe and efficient transport and delivery of hire equipment across a dedicated and manageable local service area.
  • Operate an HR Tilt Tray truck.
  • Perform runs covering the Northside of Brisbane, from areas like Nudgee, all the way up to the North Sunshine Coast.
  • Ensure all loads are safely secured and adhere to all road transport legislation.
  • Complete pre-start checks and required paperwork accurately.
  • Represent the client professionally at all times.
What You Need to Be Successful
  • Current and valid Heavy Rigid (HR) Licence is essential.
  • Proven experience operating a Tilt Tray truck is essential.

  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Physical fitness and the ability to manually handle equipment (within safe limits).
If you are a reliable, experienced HR Tilt Tray Driver looking for consistent work with excellent earning potential, apply now!

At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

content.jobHook: You'll manage the day-to-day coordination of plant, equipment, labour, dry hire and inventory ensuring zero loss of production
content.unEditedContent:
This is Unyte.

Unyte is a well-established Australian business with over 30 years of experience in the civil construction industry.

Having stuck to our roots in providing wet and dry plant hire solutions to clients across the eastern seaboard since our inception, Unyte have evolved into an all-encompassing, self-performing contractor, and having forged a legacy in Victoria spanning back decades, we have recently expanded into NSW & QLD to take on the next chapter.

We're a part of the wider Symal Group, a construction company determined to make a meaningful difference and we're proud to have some of the best in the game working with us. We're known as a young and ambitious group filled with energy, momentum, and innovation to drive change with bold thinking making us leaders in the building and construction industry.



Make it yours

Experience the excitement of building your Assets & Logistics Coordination career in our evolving construction company where people and performance make amazing things happen.

Who we are

We're Unyte, a team of problem solvers that have seen it all and conquered the lot, delivering construction projects across the country as a principal contractor and supporting partner.

With a history stretching back decades, we focus on tailored solutions and reliable delivery in complex project environments, with one of the nation's largest fleet of plant and operators.

Backed by the resources of Symal, a national construction group, we're breaking new ground with limitless capability.

The role:

Join our high-performing Assets & Logistics team and play a key role in keeping our projects moving. As an Assets & Logistics Coordinator, you'll manage the day-to-day coordination of plant, equipment, labour, dry hire and inventory ensuring zero loss of production and smooth project delivery.

This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and can juggle multiple priorities while maintaining strong compliance standards.

Your everyday
  • Coordinate daily logistics, transport, routing, permits and asset allocations to ensure zero production delays.
  • Manage plant, machinery and dry hire needs, including servicing, breakdowns, inspections, and site compliance.
  • Maintain accurate records across prestarts, job tracking, maintenance logs, labour rosters and inventory levels.
  • Engage and manage suppliers, drivers and subcontractors while ensuring full COR, HVNL, fatigue, mass and safety compliance.
  • Support client and commercial requirements, including quotes, contracts, onboarding, invoicing and resolving issues.
  • Provide weekly and monthly reporting across assets, labour, hire, inventory, transport and utilisation.
Who are you?
  • Qualification in logistics, supply chain, business, construction or similar (advantageous)
  • Experience in logistics, asset coordination, construction or plant/machinery
  • Strong understanding of COR, HVNL, fatigue, mass and load restraint
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Strong attention to detail with accurate recordkeeping skills
  • Proficiency in MS Office and logistics/asset management systems
A career with us

At Unyte, we've always known that people and performance make amazing things happen. Work like ours needs problem solvers, bold thinkers and genuinely good people. If you're looking for a passionate team and a pathway to career success, now's the time to make it yours.

There are plenty of good reasons to dig into a career at Unyte.

  • Forge pathways: We open doors to diverse, challenging and future-shaping construction projects to expand your experience and develop your career.
  • Get ahead: From early career support and specialised learning to leadership development, we back you with tailored development programs to help you reach your goals. Success is defined by your direction and progress.
  • Keep well: A healthy and happy workplace builds a brighter future. With wellness benefits, discounted health insurance, a perks and rewards platform and an industry-leading employee assistance program, we're here to support you when you need it.
  • Stay social: People are the core of Unyte. Our leading-edge work and breakout spaces stocked with snacks bring the best out of our teams and keep them fuelled for their next challenge, while our social calendar is stacked with events to connect, celebrate and reward our people.
Diversity of thought fuels our progress

Our inclusion offerings are designed to open doors for individuals who may not see a traditional entry point into the construction industry. We're empowering women to thrive in construction through Shine, championing veteran career transitions through Resolve and building meaningful careers for Aboriginal people with Wamarra - helping you build a future where you belong.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, veterans and individuals from diverse cultural and life experiences are encouraged to apply.

content.jobHook: Calling on all A Double drivers with their MSIC card and wharf experience we need you!
content.unEditedContent:
The Opportunity

We are seeking experienced MC Drivers with proven A Double experience to join a well established transport and logistics operation based at the Port of Brisbane. This business has built a strong reputation across Australia for delivering reliable, high volume container and refrigerated freight solutions, with a long standing presence in port and distribution networks.

This role offers consistent day shift work with early starts and strong weekly hours. Drivers will be operating within a structured and professional environment, supporting container movements from the wharf through to local customers and distribution points across South East Queensland.

This is a high paying opportunity suited to drivers who are confident, experienced, and take pride in operating A Double combinations safely and efficiently.


What We’re Looking For
  • Current MC Licence (non negotiable)
  • Valid MSIC Card (non negotiable)
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated A Double driving experience (non negotiable)
  • Proven experience working within container freight operations
  • Strong understanding of load restraint and NHVR compliance
  • Ability to confidently operate within port environments and tight spaces

Shift & Pay
  • Day Shift Start Time: Between 4:00am - 5:00am
  • $40 per hour Day Shift
  • Average 55 hours per week with opportunity to work up to 60 hours
  • Consistent overtime available

Why This Role Stands Out
  • Premium hourly rate for experienced drivers
  • Consistent, high volume work with strong weekly hours
  • Work within a respected and established transport operation
  • Structured environment with professional standards and expectations
  • Long term opportunity for the right drivers

Apply Now
If you are an experienced MC A Double driver with an MSIC card and looking for a high paying, stable role out of the Port of Brisbane, apply now or email jburley@hpeople.au with the subject line “MC B Double Driver - Port of Brisbane”.

content.jobHook: Mining Conveyor systems & components Maintain, develop and grow the business  Perth based role with great Comms! About Us PROK Conveyor Component
content.unEditedContent:
• Mining Conveyor systems & components
  • Maintain, develop and grow the business 
  • Perth based role with great Comms!

About Us

PROK Conveyor Components is Australia’s largest manufacturer of conveyor components, specialising in high-quality pulleys, idlers, and rollers. With over 130 years of industry experience, we’re renowned for delivering engineering excellence and forming trusted, long-term relationships with clients to improve efficiency and performance through proactive account management.

Our Opportunity

We are currently seeking a driven and customer-focused Account Manager to join our team based in Bayswater, WA in a full-time, permanent role which will see you responsible for managing and growing customer accounts across WA.

As an Account Manager with PROK, you will take ownership of a portfolio of WA based customers and act as their point of contact, playing a critical role in maintaining strong client relationships. Ou will identify opportunities for growth and deliver value-added solutions. Working closely with engineering, estimating, and site-based teams, you will represent PROK as a trusted partner, supporting continuous improvement for our clients.

At PROK, we don’t just manufacture conveyor components – we engineer solutions that keep Australia’s mining industry moving. If you’re a relationship-driven Account Manager who enjoys being on-site, solving real operational problems, and building long-term partnerships, this is an opportunity to make a genuine impact.

    Key responsibilities include:

  • Identify and develop new sales opportunities
  • Provide technical recommendations and close deals.
  • Manage and grow key client accounts across WA mining and industrial sectors at both site and corporate level
  • Gain a deep understanding of their needs and deliver the right solutions.
  • Undertake regular visits to client sites and port operations
  • Offer on-the-ground technical support and provide proactive follow-up to ensure long-term satisfaction.
  • Help clients improve efficiency and performance through proactive account management.
  • Implement strategic agreements such as exclusive supply or fixed-price contracts where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure efficient quoting, engineering input, and project delivery.
  • Gather insights on competitor activity and client operations to help PROK  competitive, agile, and innovative in its offerings.
  • Champion customer feedback and use it to drive service delivery enhancements and solution development.

    About you
  • You will possess a proven background in B2B sales within the mining, mechanical, or industrial sectors, and ideally understand conveyor system components or related engineered products.pable of understanding client challenges and work with internal and external technical teams to design practical, fit-for-purpose solutions
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently at all levels of an organisation.
  • Driven, proactive, and able to work autonomously and consistently follow through on commitments and earning your clients' trust.

         What you’ll get in return

  • Competitive base salary plus sales performance incentives
  • All necessary tools of trade – mobile, laptop, and more
  • A supportive and professional work environment
  • Work for a highly respected, growth-focused Australian manufacturer
  • Opportunities for long-term career development and training

If you’re ready to challenge the standard and represent this leading Australian owned business, Apply today via the link below.

PROK is committed to diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, LGBTQIA+ communities, culturally and linguistically diverse groups, and people with disabilities.

content.jobHook: Join a high-performing team and grow your career in liability claims management.
content.unEditedContent:
Introduction

At Gallagher Bassett, we're there when it matters most because helping people through challenging moments is more than just our job, it’s our purpose. Every day, we help clients navigate complexity, support recovery, and deliver outcomes that make a real difference in people’s lives. It takes empathy, precision, and a strong sense of partnership—and that’s exactly what you’ll find here. We’re a team of fast-paced fixers, empathetic experts, and outcomes drivers — people who care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it well. Whether you're managing claims, supporting clients, or improving processes, you’ll play a vital role in helping businesses and individuals move forward with confidence. Here, you’ll be supported by a culture that values teamwork, encourages curiosity, and celebrates the impact of your work. Because when you’re here, you’re part of something bigger. You’re part of a team that shows up, stands together, and leads with purpose.


Overview

Your Role

Gallagher Bassett are searching for an experienced General Liability Claims Consultant to join our current high performing General Liability team. You'll collaborate with government agencies, solicitors, lawyers, third parties and internal and external stakeholders working on both litigated and non-litigated claims in a dynamic and impactful role!

The position will be offered on a permanent full-time basis with a hybrid approach of WFH and in our Sydney CBD office.


How you'll make an impact

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing a portfolio of General liability (litigated and non-litigated) claims end to end
  • Interpreting public liability and professional indemnity policy wordings and apply accurately
  • Providing advice to insured clients on indemnity, liability, quantum, reserving and settlement
  • Liaising with various third-party providers including solicitors, loss adjusters, brokers and barristers
  • Settling claims within client service instructions, company guidelines and delegated authority
  • Resolving complaints in accordance with company guidelines and identify potential fraud/recovery indicators for claims where applicable

About you

We’re interested in hearing from people who possess:

  • A minimum 2 years of Claims experience in public liability and/or professional indemnity claims management
  • Industry specific ANZIIF qualifications (desirable) with a strong exposure to claims involving Third Party Liability
  • Flexibility and receptivity to change
  • Focus on customer / client relationships
  • Excellent customer service, communication, time management, organisation and interpersonal skills
  • PC literacy – Database and Microsoft Office

What we can offer you:

  • Flexible work arrangements – including some WFH
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Excellent working environment – our team at GB is renowned for its dedicated and approachable people as well as its friendly, flexible and inclusive working environment which is built around great team support and rewarding opportunities
  • Exciting career – as our Company grows, so do the opportunities for our people
  • Opportunities for ongoing education and development through both external and internal programs delivered by our own claims training experts
  • Service recognition awards and employee assistance program for yourself and immediate family members
  • A dedication to your wellbeing through our peer support program, corporate health insurance discounts and wellness programs
  • Additional purchased leave, novated leases, and access to the Gallagher Rewards Program (including discounts/cash-back for hundreds of retailers!)
  • Reproductive leave
  • Birthday Club - have a day off during your birthday month as a gift from GB!

If this sounds interesting to you, we want to hear from you today, click on Apply for this Job!

Agency applicants will not be considered for this role.

Gallagher Bassett is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Indigenous Australian applicants are encouraged to apply. As a member of the Diversity Council Australia, we recognise the importance of and embrace diversity in the workplace. We will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant.


Compensation and benefits

On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits. 

Below are the minimum core benefits you’ll get, depending on your job level these benefits may improve:

  • 4 weeks annual leave plus up to 2 weeks additional purchased Lifestyle Leave
  • Novated Leasing opportunities
  • Two paid volunteer days annually
  • Health Insurance Discounts with our Group Insurance Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Paid parental leave

Other benefits include:

  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Mental Health and Wellbeing Support for yourself and immediate family members
  • Employee Recognition Awards and Service Milestone Recognitions
  • Peer Support Program
  • Annual flu vaccinations
  • Access to Reward Gateway – discount offers at over 350 retailers!
  • And more...

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.

Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.

Gallagher believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any form of discrimination by its managers, employees, vendors or customers based on race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy status), sexual orientation, gender identity (which includes transgender and other gender non-conforming individuals), gender expression, hair expression, marital status, parental status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected (herein referred to as “protected characteristics”) by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination. In addition, Gallagher will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

content.jobHook: We have an exciting opportunity available for an experienced Sous Chef at our large venue, The Observatory.
content.unEditedContent:
About Darling Group:

Darling Group is a leading Melbourne-based hospitality company that develops, owns and operates many of Australia’s most recognised and acclaimed hospitality venues including Top Paddock, Token Restaurant, Cheri Eatery, Higher Ground, Darling Cafe, The Kettle Black, Dundas & Faussett, Bambu Asian Eating House, Stringers Sorrento and The Terrace at Royal Botanic Gardens. Our forward thinking philosophy creates world-class hospitality brands, all with a focus on service, design, innovation and experience. We have a commitment to creating new and exciting experiences across Melbourne and Australia within the next few years.


About the role:

As the Sous Chef of our exciting venue The Observatory you will play a pivotal role in bringing our culinary vision to life. Operating within a state-of-the-art kitchen and restaurant, you will lead the back of house team and oversee kitchen operations, menu development, and financial aspects, all while fostering a positive work culture and reporting to the Head Chef. This role is primarily breakfast and lunch, with occasional evenings working Events.


Experience & Skills:

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience as a sous chef in a high-quality restaurant with a focus on australian/european cuisine.

  • Expertise in brunch, events and all day venue kitchen operations

  • Creative and innovative approach to menu development and food presentation using traditional and modern cooking techniques. 

  • Strong leadership, training, and development skills. 

  • Experience leading a brigade of 8+ staff of all levels.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

  • Knowledge of food safety regulations and best practices.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

  • Adaptable to change.

  • Exposure to financial budgets, food and labour costs.

  • Understanding of stock control & ordering processes.

  • Able and willing to work shift work, including weekends and public holidays.

  • Trade certificate or equivalent experience.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

  • Be part of an exciting pre-opening team and play a pivotal role in shaping our success.

  • Opportunity to lead a dynamic kitchen team in our brand-new, state-of-the-art kitchen.

  • Most evenings off, working primarily day shifts.

  • Career growth opportunities within our expanding group.


Apply now:

If you are a passionate and experienced Sous chef with a deep love for energetic fast paced venues and you're ready to take on the challenge, we want to hear from you.

content.jobHook: Join a leading contractor delivering major projects and drive winning tenders in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
content.unEditedContent:
The Company
Our client is a leading construction contractor with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality infrastructure projects across Australia. Known for their collaborative culture and commitment to excellence, they are seeking an experienced Tender / EOI Coordinator to support the successful delivery of major bids and submissions across the business.

The Role
As a Tender / Bid Coordinator, your primary objective will be to produce high-quality, fully compliant EOIs and tender submissions that align with client requirements, company standards, and strict deadlines. You will play a key role in coordinating the end-to-end submission process while working closely with internal stakeholders across the business.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
  • Coordinating the preparation and submission of EOIs and tenders to ensure all deadlines are achieved.
  • Preparing and managing bid schedules, facilitating review processes, and tracking actions to ensure timely completion.
  • Serving as a central contact for stakeholders throughout all stages of the tender and EOI lifecycle.
  • Producing, reviewing, and enhancing submission documents to maintain a high professional standard.
  • Engaging with estimators, engineers, project managers, and senior management to obtain detailed technical and project information.
  • Liaising with internal teams including marketing, legal, business development, and executive management.
  • Administering tender management platforms and document control systems such as SharePoint.

We’re looking for a Tender / EOI Coordinator with:
  • Demonstrated experience managing tenders, EOIs, bids, or submissions within the construction, engineering, or infrastructure industries.
  • Highly developed written communication, proofreading, and document presentation capabilities.
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills, with the ability to handle competing priorities and strict deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the confidence to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficiency using SharePoint or comparable document and records management platforms.
  • A motivated, detail-focused, and team-oriented working style

To apply, please click the apply now button or email your CV to jobs@hasterecruitment.com.au

content.unEditedContent:
• Eyre and Far North Local Health Network, Community Health, Port Lincoln
  • Salary: $32.81 - $34.32 per hour + 25% casual loading - Casual (up to 30 June 2027) - ASO2

Join Our Community Health Team

The Eyre and Far North Local Health Network is seeking organised, customer-focused and motivated Administrative Officers to join our Community Health Business Support team on a casual basis.

This role provides high-quality administrative and reception support to staff, clients and visitors across Community Health services within the EFN region. You will play an important role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of administrative services while contributing to a positive client experience.

About the Role

As an Administrative Officer, you will:

  • Provide professional reception and front office support
  • Respond to telephone and in-person enquiries in a timely and courteous manner
  • Coordinate appointments and maintain administrative records
  • Perform data entry, word processing and general clerical duties
  • Manage filing systems, medical records and confidential information
  • Assist with room bookings, stock ordering and office supplies
  • Support staff and clients with administrative enquiries
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and quality service delivery
  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team environment

About You

You are an organised and adaptable administration professional with excellent communication and customer service skills.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Experience providing administrative and clerical support services
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines
  • High level of competency in Microsoft Office and computer systems
  • Demonstrated customer service experience
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
  • Ability to work effectively within a team environment

This casual role suits candidates seeking flexible employment with the stability and benefits of working for a respected public health organisation. Experience the satisfaction of supporting healthcare delivery in regional South Australia while enjoying the coastal lifestyle that Port Lincoln offers.

About Us

With its ancient outback landscapes, boutique vineyards, oyster farms and Australia’s best-kept-secret surf coast, Eyre and Far North will inspire and energise you.

The Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN) is responsible for the planning and delivery of hospital and health services over 337,626 square kilometres, taking in the Eyre Peninsula, western part of South Australia and north to Coober Pedy.  We are one of the largest LHNs by area in Australia and communities include Ceduna, Cleve, Coober Pedy, Cowell, Cummins, Elliston, Kimba, Oodnadatta, Port Lincoln, Streaky Bay, Tumby Bay and Wudinna.

Services include acute care, medical, accident and emergency, surgery, birthing and midwifery, specialist consultancy, renal dialysis, chemotherapy, transfusions, rehabilitation, residential and community aged care, respite care, transitional care packages, Aboriginal health, mental health, allied health, community health, community nursing, palliative care, community home support packages and home modifications.

Click here to learn more about living and working in Eyre and Far North Local Health Network.

Explore Port Lincoln Hospital

Why Join Us

  • Make a real difference and feel like an important part of the community. Being part of Eyre & Far North means you will be supported both personally and professionally, can take advantage of education and training opportunities, will have access to flexible working hours and be part of an inter-professional approach to holistic health care.
  • Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT year Click here more information
  • Wellbeing and counselling support: support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program
  • Relocation support: relocation reimbursement of up to $15,000 may be available to people relocating for this opportunity. More information available from SA Health Careers - Relocation support.
  • Employee recognition: supportive and collaborative work environment where your contributions are valued and recognised.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and/or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

Applicant Information

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Check(s)

  • DHS National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) Worker Check
  • National Police Certificate (NPC) for employment involving unsupervised contact with vulnerable groups required for this position (E.g. aged care employment or work involving vulnerable clients)
  • Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category B (Indirect contact with blood or body substances)

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

For more information about the role please refer to the role description provided below. Job Ref: 938761

Enquiries

Susie Chapman
Position: Program Manager Business Support
Phone: 0458537553
E-mail: susie.chapman@sa.gov.au

Application Closing Date: 30 June 2027 - 11:55PM

Refer to the SA Health Career Website - How to apply for further information.

Eligibility: Open to Everyone

content.jobHook: AGL are seeking highly motivated individuals to join our team as a Mechanical Apprentice for 2027!
content.unEditedContent:
Join the change. Electrify your future!


We've been proudly Aussie since 1837, always finding new ways to innovate in energy and essential services. Now, we're moving towards a sustainable future through electrification and investing in renewable energy-and we'd like you to join us. Whether you're on-site, in the office, or somewhere in between, you'll find opportunities to grow your career here. You'll work with a team that's passionate about powering Australian lives, in a culture that values inclusivity, respect, and learning. Help us create a cleaner energy future, and we'll back you every step of the way as you build your career.



Join the change. Electrify your future.



About the role


2027 AGL Bayswater Mechanical Apprenticeship Program.



AGL acknowledges the Traditional Owners of the land and waters where its Bayswater Power Station is located, the Wonnarua/Wanaruah People, and pays its respects to their Elders past and present.


About AGL



Our purpose, Powering Australian Life, reflects our commitment to being part of Australia's energy transition.



In August 2023, AGL launched its second Innovate Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), formalising our commitment in a detailed framework that speaks to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander engagement and reconciliation.



AGL is committed to working with local partners of the Wonnarua/Wanaruah nation and beyond to ensure we support indigenous communities and careers.


About the role



At AGL Bayswater in the Upper Hunter of NSW, we are seeking highly motivated individuals to join our team as a Mechanical Apprentice. This apprenticeship offers the opportunity to gain a nationally recognised Trade Qualification in a supportive and team-oriented environment.



AGL Bayswater's 2027 Apprentice Program intake has 5 positions available, and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples to apply.


What You'll Receive:

  • Nationally recognised Trade Qualification.
  • Above industry-standard remuneration.
  • The opportunity to get involved in a range of Diversity and Inclusion Networks which support AGL's six inclusion dimensions: First Nations, Gender, Disability, Caring, Cultural Identity and LGBTQ+.
  • Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander employees may access up to three (3) days paid compassionate leave for Sorry Business/Sad News in addition to our standard two (2) days paid compassionate leave.
  • Access an amazing discount on energy and share discounts with your family and friends.
  • Support from a company renowned for developing outstanding apprentices.
  • Opportunity to learn in a team-oriented and supportive environment with On-the-job and Tafe training.
  • Recognition Program - be recognised and rewarded for your achievements and contributions delivering on AGL's values.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - AGL's offers a confidential and independent counselling and advice service for employees and their immediate families for personal and work-related problems.

To be successful, you'll need:

  • Completion of Year 10 or equivalent by the end of 2026.
  • Demonstrated interest in your nominated trade.
  • Strong commitment to safety.
  • Reliable transport and driver's license (no public transport to AGL Macquarie).

How to Apply:



Please submit your application, including your Cover Letter and Resume outlining your relevant qualifications and experience, and your two most recent school reports (If applicable).


Selection Process:



Shortlisted candidates will undergo aptitude testing and a full medical as part of the selection process.


Application Deadline:



Sunday, 29th of May 2026.



AGL's vision for reconciliation is a unified and inclusive Australia where First Nations people are respected and have an equal voice, rights, and opportunities for prosperity. AGL supports the Uluru Statement from the Heart and accepts the invitation of the Uluru Statement from the Heart to walk with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities for a better future.



Inclusion at AGL


At AGL, we value diversity and welcome applicants from various backgrounds, including Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples, individuals with disabilities, culturally diverse individuals, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. AGL is dedicated to maintaining a diverse workforce and encourages applicants to share their lived experiences.
We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and respect the privacy of those who choose not to disclose. To learn more visit: www.agl.com.au/careers



AGL is proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for All Women.



Our pre-employment screening process includes a Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check and a medical assessment if necessary.

The information provided as part of your application to AGL will be managed in accordance with the AGL Privacy Policy.

AGL does not accept agency submissions unless approval has been granted by a member of the Talent Acquisition team. Candidates submitted by an agency without approval will not be considered by AGL.



Location

Muswellbrook NSW 2333

Job Family Group

Maintenance

bulletPoints: Join as we build the next chapter of Chobani Australia!
12 Month Fixed Term Contract
Hybrid, 3 days onsite
content.jobHook: Newly created opportunity for an experienced and commercially minded Financial Accountant to join our high-performing Finance team
content.unEditedContent:
About Chobani

Inspired by Australia’s great people and vibrant food culture, Chobani Australia was formed in 2011 following the acquisition of Gippsland Dairy alongside the Chobani brand. Flash forward 15 years and Chobani is Australia’s #1 yogurt brand, living in the hearts (and tummies) of fans across the country. 

At Chobani it’s always been about more than yogurt. Access to delicious and nutritious food should be a right, not a privilege. Chobani Australia is building the next chapter of growth – investing in major site upgrades and new capability to meet demand and deliver on our aspiration: in every fridge, everywhere, every day. Yogurt is one of the fastest growing categories in Australian grocery, driven by high protein, healthy options and convenient formats – creating genuine growth opportunity for our customers and our team. 

The Opportunity 

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced and commercially minded Financial Accountant to join our high-performing Finance team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.  

Working closely with the Finance & Reporting Manager, you will play a key role in supporting financial reporting, reconciliations, taxation compliance, fixed asset management and audit activities, while ensuring the accuracy and integrity of month-end and year-end finance processes. 

This hands-on role is suited to someone who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and brings a practical, solutions-focused approach, strong analytical capability and the ability to build effective relationships across internal and external stakeholders. 


Key Responsibilities: 

  • Support month-end close activities, including journals, reconciliations, accruals and reporting  

  • Assist with taxation and statutory compliance obligations including BAS, PAYG, FBT and other reporting requirements  

  • Manage and maintain fixed asset accounting processes and lease accounting requirements  

  • Partner cross-functionally with finance, operations, legal, marketing and external stakeholders  

  • Assist with internal and external audit processes and governance activities  

  • Prepare financial analysis and reporting to support business decision-making  

  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and strengthen internal controls 

Skills & Experience: 

Ideally to be successful in the role you will have: 

  • Tertiary qualifications in Accounting, Finance or Commerce, with CPA qualification (or working towards) 

  • Proven Financial Accountant experience within FMCG, manufacturing or a complex commercial environment 

  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting, month-end processes, taxation compliance and statutory reporting requirements 

  • Strong understanding of Australian Accounting Standards (AASB), with experience or exposure to US GAAP highly regarded. 

  • Advanced Excel skills, strong analytical capability and experience managing fixed assets, reconciliations and general ledger processes 

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment 

  • High attention to detail, strong organisational skills and a proactive, continuous improvement mindset. 

While technical capability is important, this role is best suited to someone who enjoys working in a dynamic operational environment, takes ownership of outcomes and builds strong working relationships across the business. 

Benefits

You’ll be joining a team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact on our communities, our people, and the planet. You’ll work in a modern, state-of-the-art facility and enjoy a range of great perks, including financial and lifestyle benefits, flexible working options, and 18 weeks’ parental leave to support you and your family. We also offer well-being support for your loved ones, free on-site electric vehicle charging - plus a few extras to keep things fun, like barista-style coffee onsite and weekly yogurt giveaways.
