content.jobHook: Opportunity is provided to grow with our expanding business, assisting clients, government agencies, and other businesses in the Toowoomba area.
content.unEditedContent:
The opportunity

Better Call Kel' is seeking a skilled and dedicated Handyman to join our team in Toowoomba, Queensland. As our Handyman, you will be responsible for providing a wide range of maintenance and repair services to our residential and commercial clients, ensuring their properties are well-cared for and in top condition.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform general maintenance and repair tasks

  • Respond promptly to service requests and diagnose issues to provide effective and efficient solutions

  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service when interacting with clients, tenants and businesses

  • Ensure all work is completed to a high standard, adhering to relevant safety and building regulations

  • Maintain a clean, organised, and well-stocked work vehicle to enable efficient service delivery

  • Collaborate with the team to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies

What we're looking for

  • Experience as a Handyman or in a similar maintenance/repair role, or having relevant certification or trade experience

  • Strong working knowledge of general building maintenance

  • Ability to work independently and prioritise tasks effectively to meet client deadlines

  • Excellent customer service skills and the ability to communicate clearly with clients, tenants and businesses

  • A valid driver's licence and your own reliable vehicle

  • Demonstrated commitment to safety and quality workmanship

What we offer

  • Ongoing training and development to expand your skills

  • Flexible work arrangements and a supportive team environment

  • Opportunities for career advancement within the growing Better Call Kel' business

  • Competitive wages

About us

Better Call Kel' is a leading provider of maintenance and handyperson services in the Toowoomba region. We take pride in our commitment to quality, safety, and excellent customer service. Our goal is to exceed our clients' expectations on every job, and we are looking for talented individuals to join our team and contribute to our continued success.

If you're a Handyman or tradesperson who is passionate about delivering exceptional service, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to become a part of the Better Call Kel team!

Newcastle Based | Technical Sales | Pump & Water Management Solutions

J.A.C. Pump Services is a well-established provider of water management solutions to the municipal, mining, and engineering sectors. As a leading distributor of globally recognised pumping equipment and engineered systems, we are focused on delivering innovative, reliable solutions backed by exceptional customer service.

We are now seeking a driven Area Sales Manager to grow our Mining and Heavy Industry customer base across NSW.

About the Role

This is a Newcastle-based external sales role focused on developing and managing key mining and heavy industry accounts across NSW. You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, building long-term client relationships, and delivering tailored technical water management solutions.

You will work closely with internal technical and operational teams to ensure exceptional service delivery and customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a territory sales strategy for NSW Mining and Heavy Industry

  • Grow and manage existing key accounts while identifying new business opportunities

  • Build strong, long-term customer relationships focused on trust and value delivery

  • Provide technical product support, training, and in-field customer assistance

  • Act as the customer advocate to improve products and service delivery

  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver engineered pump solutions

  • Proven success in technical sales (pump, mining, industrial, or engineering sectors preferred)

Apply Now

content.jobHook: Join Gorilla Jobs, a fast-growing recruitment agency for Dental Professionals. Earn big, take over an established desk and advance your career
content.unEditedContent:
Gorilla Jobs is a powerhouse in healthcare and legal recruitment, proudly home to a dynamic team of 30 professionals.

With a trusted network of over 8,000 clients - including some of Australia's most recognisable healthcare and legal brands - we're not just participating in the recruitment industry, we're setting the standard.

Our environment fosters excellence through innovation, collaboration and a laser focus on career development. Now, we're seeking driven professionals to help us continue reshaping the landscape of Dental recruitment.

Why Choose Gorilla Jobs
  • Industry-leading commission structure of up to 35% with no threshold. You earn commission on every dollar you bill.
  • Inherit an established Dental desk with live vacancies to work on from day one.
  • Join our specialist Dental Recruitment team, recruiting Dentists, Dental Specialists, Oral Health Therapists and Dental Hygienists into permanent roles across Australia.
  • Work from a purpose-built, 350m² open-plan office just steps from Wynyard Station, featuring sleek boardrooms, private meeting spaces and harbour views.
  • Proprietary sourcing and AI tools with support from our in-house development team to help you work smarter.
What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in any field (required).
  • 1-2 years of proven success in sales (recruitment or B2B preferred).
  • Entrepreneurial drive with a vision for building a team or growing into an Account Director role.
  • High integrity and a natural ability to build long-term partnerships.
  • Strong self-motivation and independence, balanced with team collaboration.
  • Common sense and the resilience to handle disappointments while celebrating wins.
Your Responsibilities
  • Source and place Dental professionals, including Dentists, Dental Specialists, Oral Health Therapists and Dental Hygienists, into permanent roles nationwide.
  • Cultivate lasting relationships with clients and high-calibre candidates.
  • Consistently meet and exceed sales targets in a fast-paced, high-reward environment.
  • Participate in team events and contribute to our collaborative culture.
What You'll Enjoy
  • Take over an established desk: our current consultant is joining our UK office.
  • Intensive 8-week training regardless of prior experience.
  • Manage established national client accounts with vacancies from day one.
  • Commitment to internal promotion is key — we do not hire managers externally.
  • We offer clear, performance-based pathways for every consultant, unlike other agencies where advancement may be influenced by politics. On average, our consultants are promoted twice a year.
  • Inclusive, diverse and supportive environment comprising members from various cultural backgrounds, ranging from those with families to younger individuals. We maintain a healthy balance between male and female staff members.
  • One WFH day per week post-probation when meeting Senior targets.
  • Quarterly Lunch Clubs, all-expenses-paid trips (Vietnam 2025!), regular events and celebrations.
  • Up to 6 additional RDOs when overachieving your targets.
  • Flexible Hours: complete your 8-hour day with a start time as late as 9:30 am.
Take the Next Step

Don't miss your chance to join one of Australia's fastest-growing recruitment agencies. This is more than a job - it's a lucrative, long-term career path with unmatched potential.

Submit your CV to Jimmy Bosmans (Managing Partner | Founder) at jimmy@gorillajobs.com.au and begin your journey with Gorilla Jobs today.
Reference code: GO12IN

content.jobHook: Grow an NDIS provider's reach across Melbourne. Hybrid BDM contract with extension potential.
content.unEditedContent:
Business Development Manager - NDIS

TrueBlue Care | Melbourne | 6-Month Contract (Hybrid) | Extension on Offer for Top Performers


About TrueBlue Care

TrueBlue Care is a Melbourne-based registered NDIS provider delivering high-quality, person-centred disability support to participants across Melbourne.

We are committed to empowering participants to live with dignity, independence and choice while ensuring safe, respectful and well-governed service delivery. We combine genuine compassion with strong operational capability and clear processes, because we believe great support is built on both heart and discipline.

As our services continue to grow across Melbourne, we are building a team that shares our values, people who are passionate about making a genuine difference in the lives of the participants we support.


About the Role

TrueBlue Care is looking for a driven Business Development Manager to help us reach more participants who need us.

This is a 6-month contract role with real scope. You'll be the face of TrueBlue Care in the market - building relationships, opening doors, and creating pathways that connect people living with disability to the supports that change their lives.


What You'll Be Doing

As our BDM, you'll own the growth agenda from day one:

  • Build and grow referral networks across Melbourne - connecting with NDIS planners, support coordinators, Local Area Coordinators (LACs), allied health professionals, and community organisations

  • Drive new participant acquisition by identifying and converting opportunities aligned with TrueBlue Care's service offerings

  • Develop strategic partnerships with key stakeholders in the NDIS ecosystem to strengthen TrueBlue Care's market presence

  • Represent TrueBlue Care at industry events, network groups, and community forums

  • Collaborate with the operations team to ensure seamless onboarding and service delivery for new participants

  • Track pipeline and report on growth metrics against agreed targets


What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated business development experience within health, aged care, disability, or community services

  • A solid understanding of the NDIS framework - how it works, who the key players are, and how participants make decisions (NDIS experience highly regarded)

  • An existing network or the proven ability to build one quickly across Melbourne's disability sector

  • Strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills

  • A self-starter mindset - comfortable working autonomously and managing your own pipeline

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Current driver licence

  • Current NDIS Worker Screening Check, or willingness to obtain one


Why Join TrueBlue Care

  • Values-driven organisation with genuine commitment to participant outcomes

  • Supportive leadership that backs you to do your best work

  • Hybrid working, flexibility to work from home and in the field, with office touchpoints that matter

  • A role where your results directly translate into lives improved

  • Contract extension available for strong performers, a genuine opportunity to build something longer-term

  • Opportunity to shape growth and make your mark during a key phase for the organisation


Apply Now

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter telling us about a referral network you've built and the impact it had.

For any queries, please reach out to us at: talent@truebluecare.org


TrueBlue Care is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity, inclusion, and culturally safe practice.

content.jobHook: About Us PROK are Australia’s largest manufacturer of conveyor components, delivering high-quality pulleys, idlers, and rollers to the mining and m...
content.unEditedContent:
About Us

PROK are Australia’s largest manufacturer of conveyor components, delivering high-quality pulleys, idlers, and rollers to the mining and materials handling industries. With over 130 years of engineering excellence and as part of the global NEPEAN group, we operate across 20+ countries with more than 2,000 employees worldwide.

Our success is built on the expertise and commitment of our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative environment where continuous improvement is encouraged and long-term careers are supported.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on HSE Coordinator to join our team in Bayswater, WA. Reporting to the HSEQ Manager, you will play a key role in leading and supporting health, safety, and environmental initiatives across the site.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a manufacturing environment and is passionate about driving safety culture, ensuring compliance, and continuously improving systems and processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain HSE systems, policies, and procedures in line with legislative requirements
  • Coordinate site training and competency requirements
  • Lead and conduct risk assessments and maintain the site risk register
  • Deliver safety training, inductions, and toolbox talks and drive safe work practices, particularly for high-risk activities
  • Support incident investigations, near misses, hazard reporting, and corrective actions
  • Coordinate and support internal and external HSE audits
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards (ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001)
  • Monitor and report on HSE performance and data
  • Support Return to Work processes and injury management
  • Manage H&S Committee activities and contractor safety compliance
  • Promote a strong safety culture and lead by example
  • Collaborate with production, leadership, and support teams
  • Maintain accurate records and complete administrative tasks
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across the site

 Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Certificate IV in Workplace Health & Safety (As a minimum)
  • 2-3 years’ experience in HSEQ within a manufacturing environment
  • Sound understanding of WHS legislation and compliance requirements
  • Strong knowledge of integrated management systems
  • Experience in risk assessment, incident investigation, and return-to-work processes 
  • Excellent communication, people and presentation abilities
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • High attention to detail and problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to influence, engage, and hold stakeholders accountable
  • Self-motivated with a collaborative approach
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and general systems

Why Join PROK?

  • Be part of a global organisation with strong local roots
  • Work in a supportive, safety-focused environment
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Contribute to meaningful improvements in workplace safety and operations

If you’re ready to take the next step in your HSE career and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and join a team committed to safety, quality, and excellence.

NEPEAN is committed to diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, LGBTQIA+ communities, culturally and linguistically diverse groups, and people with disabilities.

Hands-on work with real responsibility and autonomy
Opportunity to grow into a supervisory position
content.jobHook: Maintenance role with responsibility, variety, and the chance to grow into a supervisor.
content.unEditedContent:
Are you a motivated tradie looking to grow your career? Join a growing service provider with a portfolio of high-profile, premium clients in Victoria, and become part of a team where your skills are valued and your potential recognised.

Our client is seeking an up-and-coming maintenance and facilities professional to grow with their organisation. You will be site-based at a premium asset with a supportive team, where you will coordinate maintenance activities that include a mix of hands-on work and contractor management.  This opportunity offers real career growth with the potential to step up should you prove yourself.

 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Using the asset management system to log, triage, and action maintenance tasks
  • Assigning external contractors when specialist trades are required
  • Proactively identifying issues before they become requests, ensuring a safe and supportive environment
  • Managing the site induction of subcontractors performing maintenance
  • Raising and completing events in the asset management system as required
  • Hands-on maintenance work, including:
    • General building and grounds maintenance
    • Minor repairs and upkeep (painting, plumbing, basic electrical, carpentry)
    • Supporting site improvement projects
    • Moving furniture, equipment, and general site upkeep
About You:
 
We are looking for a hands-on, trade-qualified Maintenance Officer or an aspiring supervisor who is productive, reliable, and adaptable, with strong problem-solving skills.  The ideal candidate is energetic, proactive and comfortable with utilising technology to assist in a planned preventative approach.  You will enjoy delivering a first-class service, with excellent communication and relationship skills and be committed to fostering a positive team culture with a clear pathway to a supervisory role.

 
Other skillsets include:
  • Proven experience in general maintenance OR trade-qualified and looking to expand into maintenance
  • Comfortable handling a variety of trades tasks
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent relationship management skills and a positive approach to building team culture and working with stakeholders.
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Driver's licence required
  • Ability to pass a Police Check and Working With Children Check
  • 2 referees
 
 
What Is On Offer:
We are sourcing a Maintenance Officer who is keen for development!  This opening offers real potential for career progression and development, including a pathway to a supervisory role.
  • Exposure to a variety of maintenance work in a geographical region that suits your suburb.
  • Family-friendly and professional environment
  • Supportive, dynamic, and growing team environment
  • Opportunity to contribute to a positive workplace culture
If you're ready to take the next step in your career, grow with a company that values initiative, talent, and personality, we want to hear from you.

json.title: Tractor Driver (Ground Prep) (seeder)

bulletPoints: Seeding
Ground prep
MON-FRI Work
content.jobHook: Operate tractors and machinery in rural Tasmania; training and career growth opportunities await.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

FreshGro Australia is seeking a skilled Tractor Driver (Ground Prep) (seeder) to join our team in Richmond, Tasmania.

Alongside our new professional management team, we are looking to run another seeding position with all-year-round employment.

This is a full-time position, responsible for operating various agricultural machinery to prepare the land for planting and seeding. As a vital member of our horticulture operations, you will play a key role in ensuring the efficient and effective preparation of our fields for successful crop cultivation and seeding. Attention to detail is a must in this role. Training Provided.

What you'll be doing

  1. Operate tractors and other ground-preparation equipment, such as Rippers, Rotary Hoes, and seeders, to till, cultivate, and seed the land.

  2. Maintain and perform routine checks on agricultural machinery to ensure optimal performance and safety

  3. Monitor soil conditions and adjust equipment settings accordingly to achieve the desired seedbed preparation

  4. Collaborate with the farm management team to plan and execute ground preparation activities in line with the crop seeding schedule

  5. Identify and report any issues or concerns with the equipment or field conditions to the appropriate personnel

  6. Adhere to all workplace health and safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment

What we're looking for

  1. 2 years of experience operating agricultural machinery, particularly tractors and seeders

  2. Strong knowledge of soil types, field preparation techniques, and crop cultivation practices

  3. Ability to perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting on farm equipment

  4. Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills to adapt to changing field conditions

  5. Effective communication skills to collaborate with the farm management team

  6. Commitment to maintaining a safe and sustainable working environment

  7. Relevant qualifications or certifications in agricultural machinery operation or horticulture would be highly regarded

What we offer

At FreshGro Australia, we are committed to providing our employees with a supportive and rewarding work environment. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a range of benefits, including:

  1. Ongoing training and development opportunities

  2. Flexible work arrangements to maintain a healthy work-life balance

  3. Opportunities for career advancement within the company


If you're ready to be a part of our dynamic team and contribute to the growth of our horticulture operations, we encourage you to apply for this role today.


Individuals will need to demonstate there skills.

Only successful applicants will be contacted.

json.title: Marketing Manager / Graphic Designer

bulletPoints: Flexible part-time hours with strong work-from-home options
Build the marketing strategy from the ground up
Varied role across signage, technology and software businesses
content.jobHook: Part-time flexible marketing role across four businesses, creating content, managing websites, social media, SEO, digital marketing and UX design.
content.unEditedContent:
Marketing & Digital Content Coordinator

Part-time | 15–25 hours per week | Flexible / Hybrid
Sunshine West, Melbourne

Visual Technologies, Visual Exposure, We Fab Signs and GoDOOH are looking for a capable and self-driven Marketing & Digital Content Coordinator to help build and manage the marketing presence across our group of companies.

This is a newly shaped role in a medium-sized business that has not historically focused heavily on structured marketing. That means there is a genuine opportunity for the right person to help design the marketing strategy from the ground up, bring fresh ideas, and have a real impact.

You will be working across four related businesses:

  • Visual Technologies — LED screens, digital billboard technology, digital signage and lighting solutions

  • Visual Exposure — signage projects for end clients

  • We Fab Signs — trade signage manufacturing, including lightboxes, pylons, fabricated letters and custom signage components

  • GoDOOH — custom billboard management software and hardware platform

The role will suit someone who enjoys learning technical products and turning that knowledge into clear, professional marketing content.

About the role

This is a flexible part-time position of approximately 15–25 hours per week, with the exact hours negotiable to suit the right candidate.

In the early stages, you will be required to spend a solid period of time in our Sunshine West office to learn the businesses, meet the team and understand our products and services. Once established, the role will become highly flexible and hybrid.

Long term, we would expect you to be in the office around one day per week, but this does not need to be a full 8-hour day. The remaining hours can be worked flexibly. Work hours can be at any suitable time, within reason, and arranged in a way that works for both the business and the successful candidate. For example, the role could be worked over 3 days, 4 days or 5 shorter days.

There are many areas of the business that would benefit from stronger marketing, better content and a more professional digital presence. The work will be ongoing and varied. You will start by working on agreed priority projects, then progressively move into other areas of the business as you learn the companies, understand the products and identify new opportunities.

Pay rate

This role will be paid on an agreed hourly rate, based on the agreed number of hours worked each week.

We have not listed a specific pay rate because this is a new type of role for our business and we have not employed someone in this capacity before. We are genuinely open-minded about what the right person should be paid and what level of experience, capability and output comes with that rate.

We are not looking to low-ball anyone. We want to work with the right person, agree on a fair hourly rate, and build a role that works well for both the successful candidate and the business.

Key responsibilities

You will help build and manage the marketing presence for Visual Technologies, Visual Exposure, We Fab Signs and GoDOOH.

Your tasks will include:

  • Creating marketing materials for products and services across the businesses

  • Developing brochures, product sheets, capability statements, case studies and sales material

  • Writing website content, project updates, product descriptions and service pages

  • Managing website content updates

  • Coordinating with our external web developers and contractors for larger website tasks

  • Helping improve the structure, presentation and usability of our websites

  • Reviewing website SEO and recommending improvements

  • Advising on suitable digital advertising opportunities

  • Creating and managing social media content, particularly LinkedIn

  • Building a social media presence from the ground up

  • Planning regular posts, project updates and product/service content

  • Coordinating with staff, installers, photographers or videographers to capture suitable project images and video content, possibly gathering the content yourself

  • Building a library of project photos, product images, video clips and marketing assets for future use

  • Gathering information, photos and project details from staff across the businesses

  • Turning technical information into clear marketing messages

  • Helping develop marketing campaigns for key products and services

  • Supporting the front-end UX design of custom software programs. Zoho Creator, Figma and custom HTML.

  • Helping communicate and position the GoDOOH software and hardware platform

  • Identifying new marketing opportunities across the group

  • Working with management to shape the overall marketing strategy

  • Managing multiple marketing tasks and priorities independently

About you

We are looking for someone with practical marketing experience who can work independently, manage multiple tasks and take ownership of the role.

You will ideally have:

  • 4 years' experience in marketing, digital content, communications or a similar role

  • Strong writing and content creation skills

  • Experience managing LinkedIn and other business social media platforms

  • A good understanding of websites, content management and SEO

  • The ability to understand and communicate technical products and services

  • Good design judgement and an eye for professional presentation

  • The ability to work independently and manage priorities efficiently

  • Confidence dealing with internal teams, external contractors and developers

  • A willingness to ask questions and learn from people across the company, not just senior management

  • An interest in B2B marketing, technical products, signage, construction, manufacturing, digital technology or software platforms

  • Must be able to attend work at least 1 day per week.

You do not need to be a web developer, but you should be comfortable managing website content and communicating clearly with developers and contractors.

What we offer

  • Flexible part-time role, approximately 15–25 hours per week

  • Hours negotiable to suit the right candidate

  • Flexible work hours that can be arranged at suitable times, within reason

  • Strong work-from-home flexibility once established

  • Office based in Sunshine West

  • Opportunity to build a marketing strategy from the ground up

  • Ongoing and varied work across multiple parts of the business

  • A role that can grow and evolve over time

  • A varied role across four related businesses

  • Direct access to decision-makers

  • A manager who will value your input and ideas

  • Exposure to digital billboards, signage, LED technology, lighting, manufacturing, software and hardware platforms

  • A practical, down-to-earth team environment

  • A fair hourly rate negotiated with the right candidate

About us

Our group of companies works across the signage, digital display, lighting, manufacturing and technology industries.

Visual Technologies supplies LED screens, digital billboard technology, digital signage and lighting solutions.

Visual Exposure delivers signage projects for end clients.

We Fab Signs manufactures signage products for the trade, including lightboxes, pylons, fabricated letters and custom signage components.

GoDOOH is a custom billboard management software and hardware platform being developed to improve how digital billboard sites are monitored, managed and maintained.

We are looking for someone who can help us present these businesses more professionally, communicate what we do, and build a stronger marketing presence over time.

How to apply

Please apply with your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience, expected hourly rate and why this flexible part-time role interests you.

json.title: HEAD CHEF

bulletPoints: LIfestyle- NO SPLIT SHIFTS- dinner service only with room for expansion
Creativity and flair encouraged
content.jobHook: Dream Job— build your chef career in beautiful Lennox Head, with beaches, lifestyle, great food and coastal culture in a small, passionate team.
content.unEditedContent:
Position Title: Full-Time Chef
Location: Lennox Head, NSW
Salary: Above award wage per annum + superannuation (based on experience)
Employment Type: Full-Time (38 hours/week)
CHIDO Cantina is a fast-paced, quality-driven restaurant known for our inclusive menu. We pride ourselves on using fresh, locally sourced seasonal produce to deliver exceptional dining experiences for our guests, and catering for most dietary requirements .

The Role
We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Full-Time Chef to join our culinary team. Working as the Chef you will be deeply involved in daily kitchen operations, food preparation, and service. We encourage creativity, and seasonal menu's utilising our regions food bowl.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Food Preparation & Cooking: Prepare, cook, and present menu items to the highest standards, ensuring consistency in taste and portion control.

  • Kitchen Operations: Manage a kitchen and kitchen staff during prep/service, ensuring timely food output and smooth kitchen flow.

  • Menu Development: menu planning, seasonal changes, and designing specials.

  • Hygiene & Safety: Strictly adhere to, and enforce, Australian food safety, hygiene, and OHS regulations.

  • Inventory & Stock: Monitor stock levels, rotate ingredients to minimize wastage, and ordering.

  • Team Leadership: Supervise, mentor, and assist in training junior kitchen staff and apprentices.

Skills & Experience:

  • Relevant trade qualification (e.g., Certificate III in Commercial Cookery).

  • Strong recent experience in a similar fast-paced kitchen environment.

  • Strong understanding of food costs, stock control, and kitchen administration.

  • Cleaning & maintenance of kitchen equipment.

  • A current and valid Food Safety Supervisor certificate (or willingness to obtain).

  • Ability to remain calm and efficient under pressure

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary package- above award dependent on experience

  • Great work-life balance- no split shifts- Dinner service only

  • Opportunities for career progression and ongoing professional development.

  • Staff meals and venue discounts.

How to Apply:
If you have a genuine passion for food and thrive in a collaborative kitchen environment, we would love to hear from you. Please send your updated CV and a brief cover letter to or apply via the portal.

bulletPoints: Start out your career within Australia's leading energy company
Discounts on energy, telcos and solar plans
Help us create a cleaner energy future, and we'll back you every step of the way
content.jobHook: AGL are seeking highly motivated individuals to join our team as an Electrical Apprentice!
content.unEditedContent:
Join the change. Electrify your future!


We've been proudly Aussie since 1837, always finding new ways to innovate in energy and essential services. Now, we're moving towards a sustainable future through electrification and investing in renewable energy-and we'd like you to join us. Whether you're on-site, in the office, or somewhere in between, you'll find opportunities to grow your career here. You'll work with a team that's passionate about powering Australian lives, in a culture that values inclusivity, respect, and learning. Help us create a cleaner energy future, and we'll back you every step of the way as you build your career.



Join the change. Electrify your future.



About the role


2027 AGL Bayswater Electrical Apprenticeship Program.



AGL acknowledges the Traditional Owners of the land and waters where its Bayswater Power Station is located, the Wonnarua/Wanaruah People, and pays its respects to their Elders past and present.


About AGL



Our purpose, Powering Australian Life, reflects our commitment to being part of Australia's energy transition.



In August 2023, AGL launched its second Innovate Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), formalising our commitment in a detailed framework that speaks to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander engagement and reconciliation.



AGL is committed to working with local partners of the Wonnarua/Wanaruah nation and beyond to ensure we support indigenous communities and careers.


About the role



At AGL Bayswater in the Upper Hunter of NSW, we are seeking highly motivated individuals to join our team as an Electrical Apprentice. This apprenticeship offers the opportunity to gain a nationally recognised Trade Qualification in a supportive and team-oriented environment.



AGL Bayswater's 2027 Apprentice Program intake has 5 positions available, and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples to apply.


What You'll Receive:

  • Nationally recognised Trade Qualification.
  • Above industry-standard remuneration.
  • The opportunity to get involved in a range of Diversity and Inclusion Networks which support AGL's six inclusion dimensions: First Nations, Gender, Disability, Caring, Cultural Identity and LGBTQ+.
  • Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander employees may access up to three (3) days paid compassionate leave for Sorry Business/Sad News in addition to our standard two (2) days paid compassionate leave.

content.unEditedContent:
Want to work for a multi award winning retailer? Then look no further! As the fastest growing optical retail group in the world, Specsavers strive to be the best professional healthcare provider in Australia and New Zealand, offering the ultimate in affordable eye care, eye wear, hearing aids and care. We pride ourselves on our culture and people by providing a fun and supportive working environment for our staff.

We are currently seeking a motivated individual to join our team as an Optical Assistant. Whether you are meeting and greeting customers, providing advice on products or placing specialised orders, you'll constantly be busy as no two days are ever the same at Specsavers. An interest in retail, optics or audiology

An ability to build rapport with customers

content.unEditedContent:
About Lismore Toyota

Incredible opportunity to get in at the ground floor and work with the number one manufacturer in Australia – Toyota. Lismore Toyota is a modern dealership featuring first class facilities and a contemporary showroom. As a dynamic and progressive dealership, we pride ourselves on fostering a strong team environment, positive workplace culture and the professional development of our highly valued staff.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Used Vehicle Sales Manager to lead our used vehicle department. In this pivotal role, you will take ownership of the full used vehicle operation — from stock acquisition through to delivery — while leading and developing a dedicated team of sales professionals.

You will work closely with our General Manager and Dealer Principal to grow the used vehicle department and set the standard for used vehicle retailing in our region. This is an exceptional opportunity for a proven operator who understands today’s market, knows how to buy and turn stock profitably, and is ready to build something they can be proud of.

The modern buyer is informed and fast-moving — researching across multiple platforms before making contact. We are looking for someone who understands that landscape and knows how to position a team to win within it.

Employment Details

Employment Type: Full time

Schedule: Monday to Saturday with one rostered day off during the week

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of sales consultants — building capability, accountability, and a customer-first culture

• Manage sales enquiries, prospect for new customers, and maintain a systematic follow-up process to encourage repeat business and generate leads

• Take ownership of stock acquisition, pricing, days-in-stock management, and wholesale decisions

• Implement and uphold business rules across the used vehicle department with consistency and discipline

• Oversee inventory management to ensure the right stock mix to meet customer demand

• Understand and respond to the modern buying journey — digital enquiry, online pricing transparency, and AI-assisted research are part of today’s environment

• Work collaboratively with the General Manager to report on performance and identify opportunities for growth and improvement

• Foster a positive and productive work environment that encourages teamwork and continuous improvement

• Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and company policies

 

Skills and Experience

• Minimum five years in used vehicle sales management or a similar leadership role within the automotive industry

• Proven ability to source, evaluate, and purchase stock profitably across auction, trade, and private channels

• Strong understanding of current market dynamics — live pricing platforms, days-in-stock benchmarks, and digital retailing tools

• Awareness of how AI tools and online research have changed the way customers buy, and how to position a team accordingly

• Process-driven with the ability to implement business rules and maintain them under operational pressure

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with customers and stakeholders

• Outstanding negotiation skills across both the buying and selling sides of the transaction

• A driven, results-oriented mindset with the genuine ability to lead a team to success

• Genuine passion for the automotive industry with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service

• Current driver’s licence

 

What We Offer

• A generous commission structure that rewards performance and reflects the results you deliver

• Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development opportunities

• Employee discounts on vehicles and services

• Clear pathways for career progression within a growing dealership

• A dynamic and supportive work environment backed by the General Manager and Dealer Principal

 

This is an outstanding opportunity to advance your career with a leading automotive brand. If you are passionate about building a high-performing team, driving growth, and delivering exceptional customer service — we encourage you to apply. We would love to hear from you.

content.jobHook: A hands-on role combining environmental field sampling and lab work with a globally recognised science company in Newcastle.
content.unEditedContent:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.
When you join us, you'll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.

ALS Environmental Newcastle is seeking a full time Field Technician/Lab technician for our dedicated sampling, inorganics and soil team. The role will suit someone who wants to work in a field technician role while still performing some lab work.

The Filed Technician will become part of a team that strives to exceed client expectations by delivering quality results on time and by maintaining strong relationships with their colleagues and clients.

The day-to-day responsibilities includes:

  • Sampling of client sites in accordance with client requirements, including on-site field analyses where applicable.
  • Ensuring the appropriate sampling equipment and approved methodology is used to provide a quality service to the clients.
  • Ensuring that preparation and analytical procedures and associated tasks are conducted in accordance with ALS Quality Work Instructions
  • Organising designated tasks to maximise daily efficiencies
  • Completing all tasks within both the timeframe set by the Supervisor and the relevant analysis standard
  • Highlighting anomalies in results and sample type/behaviour
  • Some weekend and on call work will be required


The essentials - the successful candidate will possess the following skills and abilities:

  • Tertiary qualifications in a related area are desirable but not essential
  • Sampling and field experience is desirable but not essential as training will be provided
  • A desire to work in a high-throughput, client-focused environment, with preference given to those with previous commercial laboratory experience
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisational and time management skills
  • Dedication to good laboratory practices regarding quality of results and health and safety
  • Willingness to be cross trained in other sections of the laboratory

Everyone Matters
ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.

Eligibility
To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.

content.unEditedContent:
FIFO Chef - South Australia

 

Connect Staffing Group is currently seeking experienced FIFO Chefs for exciting opportunities across multiple remote and mining camp sites throughout South Australia. This role is ideal for chefs who enjoy working in fast-paced, high-volume environments and are looking to embrace the FIFO lifestyle.

With a variety of roster options available (including 2:1, 7:1, and flexible swings), you will play a key role in delivering high-quality meals to site personnel while maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly rates + penalty rates + super
  • Salary packaging through Maxxia to help maximise your take-home pay
  • Flexible FIFO roster options to suit your lifestyle
  • Ongoing casual and contract opportunities
  • Travel, accommodation, and meals provided
  • Supportive team environment with ongoing site placements
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for wellbeing support

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and cook high-volume meals (buffet and bulk catering)
  • Maintain consistent food quality and presentation
  • Ensure compliance with food safety, HACCP, and WHS standards
  • Work effectively within a team in a remote environment
  • Manage time efficiently during peak service periods
  • Maintain cleanliness and organisation of kitchen areas

 

Essential Requirements

  • Valid SA Manual Driver’s Licence
  • Food Safety Supervisor Certificate
  • Ability to pass pre-employment medical & drug/alcohol screening
  • National Police Clearance (or willingness to obtain)
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Minimum 12 months’ experience in a commercial kitchen, with strong bulk and buffet cooking experience
  • Certificate III in Commercial Cookery or equivalent trade qualification
  • Previous FIFO or remote site experience within a high-volume kitchen environment (desirable)
  • Ability to work 12-hour shifts across day and night rosters
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to perform well under pressure
  • Ability to FIFO from Adelaide, SA

 

About Connect Staffing Group

Founded in 2004, Connect Staffing Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions, serving the Aged Care, Healthcare, Hospitality, and Mining sectors. With a strong presence across Western Australia, Northern Territory, Victoria, Tasmania, New South Wales and South Australia, we offer flexible contract shift opportunities in metropolitan, regional, and remote areas. As a StaffSure accredited provider, Connect Staffing makes it easy for businesses and job seekers to engage with a reliable and reputable staffing partner.

Ready to Apply?

Ready for your next FIFO opportunity?

If you are an experienced Chef with a strong background in bulk catering and remote site kitchens, we would love to hear from you.

Click ‘Apply’ to submit your application, and one of our friendly recruitment consultants will be in touch to discuss available opportunities across regional South Australia.

For more information, contact our team on 08 9206 0490 or email operations@connectstaffing.com.au

content.jobHook: Commercial Claims Consultant joins dynamic GB team. Competitive salary, flexible work.
content.unEditedContent:
Introduction

At Gallagher Bassett, we're there when it matters most because helping people through challenging moments is more than just our job, it’s our purpose. Every day, we help clients navigate complexity, support recovery, and deliver outcomes that make a real difference in people’s lives. It takes empathy, precision, and a strong sense of partnership—and that’s exactly what you’ll find here. We’re a team of fast-paced fixers, empathetic experts, and outcomes drivers — people who care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it well. Whether you're managing claims, supporting clients, or improving processes, you’ll play a vital role in helping businesses and individuals move forward with confidence. Here, you’ll be supported by a culture that values teamwork, encourages curiosity, and celebrates the impact of your work. Because when you’re here, you’re part of something bigger. You’re part of a team that shows up, stands together, and leads with purpose.


Overview

Your Role

Life at GB is an adventure – often fast paced, unpredictable, challenging and deeply rewarding. It is social and engaging, with our unique and positive culture underpinned by The Gallagher Way – values lived daily by our people.

We have a great opportunity for an experienced Commercial Property Claims Consultant to join our team in Brisbane. This role will require end to end claims experience, as well as a customer centric approach when dealing with complex claims whilst working with a collaborative and talented team.

This role will be based in our Brisbane or Sydney CBD office and will be offered on a permanent full-time basis, with flexible hybrid working arrangements to be agreed.


How you'll make an impact

You will add value to Gallagher Bassett across the following:

  • Manage client accounts on a national basis including fire & peril, business interruption, reinsurance, and property damage claims for commercial insurers
  • Interpret ISR commercial policy wordings and applying accurately
  • Proactively settling claims within client service instructions, company guidelines and delegated authority
  • Building and developing internal & external business relationships to ensure client expectations are met and exceeded
  • Achieve daily productivity level as designated by management
  • Comply with relevant legislation such as The General Insurance Code of Practice, and other relevant legislation / regulations and policy requirements
  • Resolve complaints in accordance with company guidelines
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement
  • Identify potential fraud/recovery indicators and pursue recovery for claims where applicable

About you

We’re interested in hearing from people who possess:

  • 2 years or more end-to-end commercial property claims experience
  • Excellent customer service skills and a high attention to detail
  • Well-rounded communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong time management and organisational skills, with ability to work in a fast-paced environment

What we can offer you:

  • Flexible work arrangements – including WFH
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Excellent working environment – our team at GB is renowned for its dedicated and approachable people as well as its friendly, flexible and inclusive working environment which is built around great team support and rewarding opportunities
  • Exciting career – as our Company grows, so do the opportunities for our people
  • Opportunities for ongoing education and development through both external and internal programs delivered by our own claims training experts
  • Service recognition awards and employee assistance program for yourself and immediate family members
  • A dedication to your wellbeing through our peer support program, corporate health insurance discounts and wellness programs
  • Additional purchased leave, novated leases, and access to the Gallagher Rewards Program (including discounts/cash-back for hundreds of retailers!)
  • Reproductive leave
  • Birthday Club - have a day off during your birthday month as a gift from GB!

A brief overview on GB

Gallagher Bassett is Australia’s largest Third-Party Administrator (TPA). Our focus is refreshingly simple: we manage insurance claims on behalf of insurers, brokers, government bodies and self-insured corporations.

Gallagher Bassett (GB) has six offices in Australia located in Northern Territory, Adelaide, Perth, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney, employing over 2000 staff.

GB values its employees and offers a friendly, comfortable working environment that facilitates Work Life Balance!

If this sounds interesting to you, we want to hear from you today, click on Apply for this Job!

Agency applicants will not be considered for this role.

Gallagher Bassett is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Indigenous Australian applicants are encouraged to apply. As a member of the Diversity Council Australia, we recognise the importance of, and embrace diversity in the workplace. We will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant.


Compensation and benefits

On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits. 

Below are the minimum core benefits you’ll get, depending on your job level these benefits may improve:

  • 4 weeks annual leave plus up to 2 weeks additional purchased Lifestyle Leave
  • Novated Leasing opportunities
  • Two paid volunteer days annually
  • Health Insurance Discounts with our Group Insurance Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Paid parental leave

Other benefits include:

  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Mental Health and Wellbeing Support for yourself and immediate family members
  • Employee Recognition Awards and Service Milestone Recognitions
  • Peer Support Program
  • Annual flu vaccinations
  • Access to Reward Gateway – discount offers at over 350 retailers!
  • And more...

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.

Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.

Gallagher believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any form of discrimination by its managers, employees, vendors or customers based on race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy status), sexual orientation, gender identity (which includes transgender and other gender non-conforming individuals), gender expression, hair expression, marital status, parental status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected (herein referred to as “protected characteristics”) by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination. In addition, Gallagher will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

content.jobHook: Join our team as a bike mechanic! No experience needed—just mechanical aptitude, a great attitude & drive. Full training provided.
content.unEditedContent:
BIKE MECHANIC

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM

  • Generous above-award salary package including uncapped commission in the range of $67 - $95K.
  • Gain qualifications - we offer an internationally recognised Cytech Bicycle Mechanic Technical Accreditation
  • Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements – as well as monthly awards and events, our top 10% of high achievers fly off to an all-inclusive annual conference called “Global Gathering”. Previous Globals have been in New Zealand, Canada, Japan, Cairns and this year is in Bali!
  • Enjoy unmatched career growth opportunities – we promote from within wherever possible and our people have become Team Leaders, State Leaders, Product/Online/Marketing Specialists and even GMs of overseas countries.
  • Grow your skills and expertise – we have our own 7-program Leadership Academy, a 99 Bikes Bicycle Academy, and we offer $1000 per person per year for a self-development activity such as attending a wellness retreat or getting some personal mentoring.
  • Save money – we pay our people to ride to work and offer cost price on bike products, plus we offer generous employee benefits like a paid parental leave package and free counselling services.
  • Overseas Opportunities – we have shops in Australia, New Zealand and the UK. We support short and long-term relocation opportunities via initiatives such as our Peak-to-Peak Program between AUS and the UK, which offers participants an endless summer.
  • Grow your wealth – buy in or be allocated reward shares as part of our Employee Share Scheme which started at 99c per share and is now worth $5 per share. Current and ex-employees own over 16% of our company, with this number growing every year.
  • Enrich our communities – we donate 1% of our total wage bill to the charity of our people’s choice through our Earning To Give program. Past recipients include RSPCA, Beyond Blue and the Children’s Cancer Institute. We have donated over $2.8 million dollars to charities of our people's choice since 2016
  • Enrich our planet – we are committed to reducing our environmental impact and helping others to do the same. Bikes are a low carbon transport option, helping our customers lower their carbon footprint. We are also working on reducing ours with solar panels installed on 70% of our shops.
  • Certified B Corp – We proudly became a certified B Corp in 2023. B Corp is a third party certification to show that we are committed to more than just profit - we’re committed to doing good for people and the planet.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
We’re growing and looking for hard-working, high achievers to join our team as a Bike Mechanic.

  • No need to be a bike expert—full on-the-job training provided with our bicycle academy program 
  • Responsible for building, servicing, and repairing bikes to a high standard of safety and quality. 
  • Assisting customers with technical enquiries and providing support to the retail team by recommending suitable products and services. 
  • Managing workshop booking system and keeping customers informed about their bookings
  • Tiered financial upfront payments and rewards based on achievement, efficiency, quality, upskilling knowledge and team work
  • Be a part of a high-performing culture with structured team communication: daily, weekly, and monthly meetings, plus monthly one-on-ones with your team leader.
  • Experience career development opportunities with access to our in-house Leadership Academy.
  • High achievers are recognised with awards and exclusive invites to our Global Gathering (previous locations include Whistler, Canada and Hakuba, Japan).
  • Flexible rostering - our leaders aim to accommodate personal needs with roster flexibility and offer plenty of weekend work if desired.
  • We embrace innovation and welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds.
  • Perfect for high performers looking to take the next step and build a career with an industry leader

 

ABOUT YOU:

  • Solid proven achievements. These can be demonstrated in personal goals, sporting or through study and work. We value a successful track record and drive
  • A past history demonstrating commitment, reliability, continual improvement and learning.
  • Good communication skills and demonstrated success in developing and maintaining good relationships.
  • Mechanical aptitude - we will provide on the job training
  • Some mechanical experience in a related field is desirable and experienced Bicycle Mechanics are highly valued.

 

ABOUT 99 BIKES:
99 Bikes opened the doors of its first tiny 170m2 shop in Milton, Brisbane in May 2007, a shop so small that we could only fit 99 bikes into the store. From that humble beginning, we have grown to become the largest bicycle retailer in Australia with 798 employees and we now have retail stores in the UK, New Zealand and Australia. In the last 12 months we sold over 164,000 bikes and we have a loyal customer base of over 1.8 million Club 99 Members in Australia, part of our vision to be ‘The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops’. Best Employer multi-award winner and global retail giant Flight Centre also bought into the business, giving us access to shared resources and enabling us to fast-track our growth.

 In addition to our retail stores, we also own Advance Traders, a bicycle distributor importing popular brands such as Merida, BMC, plus many more. Together we form the Pedal Group and this integration has underpinned our growth and given our people much greater career opportunities across the group.

 For instance, someone who started as a bike builder in a shop went on to become GM of our UK operation. Another of our Melbourne high achievers wanted to move to Canberra so we opened our first store there. We build our business around our people, promote from within wherever possible, and have numerous training pathways to help them achieve their potential.

 We have always been about living our purpose of enriching mind, body, earth or soul with the freedom of riding and focused on balancing purpose with profit. In 2023 we made it official by becoming a certified B Corporation™ (B Corp). Learn more about B Corp certification here. Just by doing business everyday, we are proud to sell products that have the potential to significantly improve the mental and physical health of our customers and communities whilst also lowering their carbon footprint, if they make the choice to ride bikes instead of drive.

Since 2016 we have donated over $2.8 million to charities chosen by our employees through our annual Earning To Give program. We pay our people to ride to work to help them stay healthy and reduce their environmental impact with over 75% of our employees using this initiative. Over 70% of our stores have solar panels installed and we are committed to finding ways to reduce waste from our stores with upcycling and recycling programs in most stores. See our latest ESG report here. 

 

HOW TO APPLY

  • Hit the “Quick Apply” Link
  • Apply directly through our website

TESTIMONIAL
"Growing up with an interest in riding and fixing bikes in 2010 I was fortunate to get an opportunity as a bike builder with 99 Bikes and have not looked back! Progressing into a mechanic role where I enjoyed the problem solving and challenges of fixing bikes. Now I am an State Leader and really enjoy the new and different challenges I experience in the role" - Oliver Price, State Leader WA & SA

99 Bikes opened the doors of its first tiny 170m2 shop in Milton, Brisbane in May 2007, a shop so small that we could only fit 99 bikes into the store. From that humble beginning, we have grown to become the largest bicycle retailer in Australia with 798 employees and we now have retail stores in the UK, New Zealand and Australia. In the last 12 months we sold over 164,000 bikes and we have a loyal customer base of over 1.8 million Club 99 Members in Australia, part of our vision to be ‘The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops’. Best Employer multi-award winner and global retail giant Flight Centre also bought into the business, giving us access to shared resources and enabling us to fast-track our growth.

In addition to our retail stores, we also own Advance Traders, a bicycle distributor importing popular brands such as Merida, BMC, plus many more. Together we form the Pedal Group and this integration has underpinned our growth and given our people much greater career opportunities across the group.

For instance, someone who started as a bike builder in a shop went on to become GM of our UK operation. Another of our Melbourne high achievers wanted to move to Canberra so we opened our first store there. We build our business around our people, promote from within wherever possible, and have numerous training pathways to help them achieve their potential.

We have always been about living our purpose of enriching mind, body, earth or soul with the freedom of riding and focused on balancing purpose with profit. In 2023 we made it official by becoming a certified B Corporation™ (B Corp). Learn more about B Corp certification here. Just by doing business everyday, we are proud to sell products that have the potential to significantly improve the mental and physical health of our customers and communities whilst also lowering their carbon footprint, if they make the choice to ride bikes instead of drive.

Since 2016 we have donated over $2.8 million to charities chosen by our employees through our annual Earning To Give program. We pay our people to ride to work to help them stay healthy and reduce their environmental impact with over 75% of our employees using this initiative. Over 70% of our stores have solar panels installed and we are committed to finding ways to reduce waste from our stores with upcycling and recycling programs in most stores. See our latest ESG report here.
HOW TO APPLY
Hit the “Quick Apply” Link
Apply directly through our website
TESTIMONIAL

"Growing up with an interest in riding and fixing bikes in 2010 I was fortunate to get an opportunity as a bike builder with 99 Bikes and have not looked back! Progressing into a mechanic role where I enjoyed the problem solving and challenges of fixing bikes. Now I am an State Leader and really enjoy the new and different challenges I experience in the role" - Oliver Price, State Leader WA & SA

Community and Team
Career Progression
content.jobHook:
Are you ready for the next step?
More to offer and want to achieve more?
Technically proficient, doing great work, and being overlooked?
content.unEditedContent:
Focus Engineering is looking for a skilled Welder / Fabricator who is serious about their trade, takes ownership of their work, and is ready to be part of and help build a high-performance environment. First and foremost, this is a hands-on welding and fabrication role — and you need to be very good at it.

For the right person who demonstrates the right qualities, there is a potential pathway as the business grows. This is not a given — it will be earned. But if you are the type of tradesperson who leads by example, takes initiative, and has more to offer than your current role is drawing out of you, we want to hear from you.

WHO WE ARE

Focus Engineering specialises in structural fabrication, machining, and mechanical fitting across industrial, mining, manufacturing, and infrastructure projects throughout Western Australia.

The work we do ends up in critical infrastructure and mining operations where quality is non-negotiable. When our work leaves this workshop, it has to be right. Our clients operate in environments where the quality of fabrication directly affects operational safety and performance. That context shapes how we work — it is why our standards exist, and why attention to detail is the baseline, not the goal.

HOW WE OPERATE

Our business runs through a structured four-phase methodology that governs how we assess projects, communicate with clients, control quality, and deliver work to specification and schedule:

—   Evaluate

—   Validate

—   Optimize

—   Execute


This is a highly process-oriented environment. It will suit individuals who thrive within structured systems, defined workflows, and high-performance standards.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a trade-qualified Welder / Fabricator with proven hands-on experience who can hit the ground running from day one. This is not a hand-holding environment. We need someone who can step into a project, take full ownership, and deliver to specification and standard without needing to be managed through it.

Technical ability is the starting point. Beyond that, we are looking for someone who takes genuine pride in their work, operates with accountability and discipline, and wants to build a long-term career — not simply work a job.

How you show up around others matters as much as the work you produce. We are a team. We win together and we lose together. We respect each other, hold each other to a high standard, and take pride in what we build together. If you are a genuine team player — you will fit here.


REQUIREMENTS

—   Trade qualified Welder / Fabricator with proven industry experience

—   Strong GMAW, FCAW, and GTAW welding skills across a range of materials and thicknesses

—   Solid fabrication skills — layout, fit-up, and assembly to specification

—   Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings accurately

—   High attention to detail and finish and consistent quality of workmanship

—   Able to follow work instructions, procedures, and quality processes accurately

—   Able to work autonomously and contribute effectively within a team

—   Communicates clearly and professionally

—   Demonstrates accountability, professionalism, and a positive team mindset

—   Committed to quality, precision, and continuous improvement

OUR PRINCIPLES

We are guided by seven principles. We do not expect candidates to perform these words. We expect them to already live by them.

—   Accountability

—   Action

—   Discipline

—   Consistency

—   Commitment

—   Focus

—   High Standards

WHAT WE OFFER

—   Structured, professional workshop environment

—   Exposure to diverse industrial, mining, and infrastructure fabrication projects

—   Training, mentorship, and a clear pathway for progression

—   A team culture built on accountability and high standards

—   Long-term career opportunity within a growing business


For the right candidate who demonstrates technical ability and alignment with our principles — structured progression will follow.

HOW TO APPLY

Your application is the first thing we evaluate. It tells us how seriously you take this opportunity and how well you can follow a clear instruction.

To be considered, please submit all of the following:


1.    A current CV detailing your trade qualifications, skills, and employment history

2.    A cover letter outlining your personal and professional goals, your career direction, and what you are actively doing right now to work towards them

3.    Two references from direct supervisors or managers from your most recent positions


Applications that do not include all three will not be progressed. This is not a barrier — it is the standard. If following this instruction is difficult, working within our systems will be too.

content.jobHook: Are you frustrated in your current role... Are you looking to work within a collaborative & professional environment!
content.unEditedContent:
Pinnacle Rehab is an award-winning workplace rehab provider, with the goal of achieving quality recovery and return-to-work outcomes for individuals who have been injured at work, our dedicated consultants support these individuals to regain their confidence and independence. 

Our people are at the forefront of the business, we are committed to staff development and training. The collaborative team culture, extensive induction and onboarding into the business will support you to build a solid foundation into the industry of occ rehab. 
  • Certified ‘Great Place to Work’ and #2 Best workplaces in Healthcare and Social Assistance in Australia, Best Workplace for Women 
  • Structured induction, and individually tailored onboarding program 
  • Flexibility to organise your own calendar with appointments, office days and work-from-home 
  • Ongoing support in a collaborative and fun team environment 
What is on offer: 
  • Excellent remuneration on offer plus achievable bonus 
  • All travel reimbursed at $0.99 per km, including tolls and parking expenses 
  • Structured induction and on-boarding with buddy system, including ongoing weekly and monthly team meetings to support your learning 
  • Professional development opportunities 
  • Latest technology with laptop and iPhone provided  
  • Regular seasonal social events throughout the year 
  • Annual staff company wide party 
  • Opportunity to participate in our Emerging Leaders Program for career development opportunities  
Your Wellbeing our Heartbeat - Our employee benefits program   
  • Wellbeing Support - Employee Assistance Programs
  • Employee Connection - Social entertainment budgets
  • Life Balance - Unplug agreement, flexible working arrangements
  • Paid Parental Leave - Entitlements to support your growing family
  • Learning and Development - Group supervision sessions, quarterly  formal professional development and monthly bites and insights
The Opportunity

Your new role as a Employment Consultant will see you managing a portfolio of clients who are in the job seeking phase of their rehabilitation.

Within this role you will be travelling to different hubs within your region to have face to face meetings with your clients and attend the office for team catch-ups on a monthly basis. 

This role requires a people oriented professional with a positive, forward thinking caring attitude and the desire to help others secure new employment.

Within your new role you will;
  • Providing support for clients, preparing them for new employment 
  • Contacting prospective businesses to discuss staffing solutions & incentives for job trials/placements
  • Assisting clients with resume drafting
  • Delivering job seeking training (specific training modules)
  • Career planning, job matching 
  • Developing local relationships with prospective employers
  • Post placement check-in support
  About You
  • 1 + years’ experience in a similar role 
  • Recruitment background assisting individuals with barriers secure new employment
  • Car and valid Driver’s license
  • Exceptional time management and attention to detail
  • Ability to build strong stakeholder relationships
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
  • Confidence over the phone and ability to strong network with potential employers
  • Police check or willingness to obtain a police check prior to commencement
Pinnacle Rehab is an equal opportunity employer who encourages applications from suitably qualified candidates from all cultures, ages, religions and genders. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you are looking for the next step in your career, apply today.

Next Steps! Apply now or contact Ash via email: ashk@pinnaclerehab.com.au or phone: 0455 118 755  for more information. Applications close 14th June, 2026

json.title: Head Chef

content.jobHook: Lead our award-winning kitchen. Create innovative menus with local seasonal produce. Competitive salary and career growth.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced and talented Head Chef to join our team at Headlands Austinmer Beach, a renowned hospitality location in the picturesque coastal town of Austinmer, NSW. As our Bisto Head Chef, you will be responsible for overseeing all main floor operations, crafting exceptional dishes that showcase the local and seasonal ingredients. This full-time position offers the opportunity to lead a large & passionate kitchen team and contribute to the continued success of our award-winning venue.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop and refine the bistro's menu, ensuring a balance of innovative and pub classic dishes

  • Manage and train a team of skilled chefs, fostering a collaborative and dynamic kitchen environment

  • Ensure the highest standards of food quality, presentation, and consistency across all menu items

  • Implement effective inventory management and cost-control measures to optimise operational efficiency

  • Collaborate with the management team to align culinary offerings with the venue's overall vision and brand

  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, techniques, and best practices to continuously enhance the dining experience

  • Maintain a safe, organised, and well-maintained kitchen in compliance with all health and safety regulations

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 3 years of experience as a Head Chef or equivalent role in a high-quality restaurant or hospitality establishment

  • Demonstrated expertise in creating and executing innovative, flavourful, and visually appealing dishes

  • Strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and motivate a diverse kitchen team

  • Excellent time management, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities

  • Thorough understanding of food cost control, inventory management, and budgeting

  • Passion for working with fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced ingredients

  • Certification in food safety and hygiene, with a commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant kitchen environment

What we offer

At Headlands Austinmer Beach, we are committed to providing our employees with a rewarding and fulfilling work experience. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a range of benefits, including:

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
- Generous employee discount on all food and beverage items
- Flexible work arrangements and a supportive, collaborative work environment

About us

Headlands Austinmer Beach is a premier family destination situated on the stunning Illawarra coastline. Our venue has been recognised for its exceptional service, innovative cuisine, As part of our passionate team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the ongoing success and evolution of our award-winning establishment.

Apply now to become our next Head Chef and join our dynamic culinary team at Headlands Austinmer Beach.

json.title: Sales Development Representative

content.jobHook: Drive enterprise growth at Avetta by turning outbound conversations into qualified opportunities using world-class SaaS sales tools and coaching.
content.unEditedContent:
Avetta’s SaaS platform connects the world’s leading organizations with qualified suppliers, contractors, and vendors. We bring unmatched visibility to companies through cloud-based technology and human insights. As a result, we foster sustainable growth for businesses and their supply chains. Our SaaS subscription software is used by 85k+ active customers in over 100 countries. 

SUMMARY

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for the outreach to prospective clients with the objective of identifying potential client customers and setting qualified appointments for the field sales team.

This is a hybrid role, working three days a week in our beautiful Newcastle office

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Raise awareness and generate interest for Avetta through cold calling, emails, and social outreach to prospective customers

  • Schedule initial discovery calls for Account Executives

  • Meet or exceed assigned daily activity minimums of 80-100 activities (calls + emails)

  • Manage your own book of accounts and set the strategy for effective book management

  • Become a power user of Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce, Chili Piper and Gong as tools

  • Provide constructive feedback on how to improve effectiveness and efficiency within the SDR role to SDR Managers and Sales Enablement

  • Collaborate with team members to share and learn from best practices

  • Maintain a schedule aligned with the business hours of your assigned region

  • Regular and predictive attendance

  • This position requires travel to attend sales conferences, events, training sessions and other travel as outlined by management.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

  • Collaborate with team members to share and learn from best practices

  • Minimum of 6 months of sales experience (ideally as an SDR) working with Enterprise accounts

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • You have a high degree of resilience, enabling you to bounce back from setbacks

  • You possess a player mindset; you strive to grow and develop and never back down from a challenge

  • Your work ethic is unmatched- anything you don't know you'll make up with hard work

  • You're extremely coachable and willing to receive and implement feedback

METRICS THAT MATTER:

  • Ability to complete a minimum 8-hour in-office workday

  • Minimum of 10 introductory meetings in which 6 are qualified per month

  • Support the Enterprise Account Executive Team for Inbound and Outbound communication

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which includes health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), and PTO.

Avetta is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.
