content.jobHook: If you take pride in your work and want to be part of a professional and expanding company, we want to hear from you.
content.unEditedContent:
About Us: Quantum Civil is a civil construction company specializing in commercial civil construction projects. With a strong commitment to quality, safety, and innovation, we take pride in delivering exceptional results to our clients. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a skilled Civil Construction Labourer to join our dedicated team.

Job Description: We are looking for an experienced and skilled Civil Construction Labourer to play a key role in our construction projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of tasks associated with civil construction, ensuring that projects are completed efficiently, safely, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform various manual tasks and operating rollers, water cart and other construction plant.

  • Assist in the installation of utilities such as drainage, electrical conduits, etc. 

  • Operate and maintain construction equipment and tools.

  • Follow safety guidelines and maintain a safe working environment.

  • Work effectively as part of a construction team.

  • Perform general labor tasks as required.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Civil Construction Labourer.

  • Knowledge of construction tools, equipment, and techniques.

  • Tickets for roller, posi track and excavator would be ideal.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction plans is a plus.

  • Strong commitment to safety and adherence to safety protocols.

  • Physical fitness and stamina to perform manual labor tasks.

  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills.

  • Valid HR driver's license and reliable transportation.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary.

  • Opportunities for career growth and development. 

  • A positive and supportive work environment.

  • Ongoing training and education opportunities.

How to Apply: If you are a skilled Civil Construction Labourer looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity with a reputable company, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience to hr@quantumcivil.com.au. 

Quantum Civil is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Join our team and be a part of our commitment to building a better future through exceptional construction projects!

Join an organisation that offers dedicated support and career progression
Something for everyone - range of staff benefits, discounts & wellbeing programs
content.jobHook: Grow your motor claims career at Gallagher Bassett - flexible hybrid work and incredible benefits.
content.unEditedContent:
Introduction

At Gallagher Bassett, we're there when it matters most because helping people through challenging moments is more than just our job, it’s our purpose. Every day, we help clients navigate complexity, support recovery, and deliver outcomes that make a real difference in people’s lives. It takes empathy, precision, and a strong sense of partnership—and that’s exactly what you’ll find here. We’re a team of fast-paced fixers, empathetic experts, and outcomes drivers — people who care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it well. Whether you're managing claims, supporting clients, or improving processes, you’ll play a vital role in helping businesses and individuals move forward with confidence. Here, you’ll be supported by a culture that values teamwork, encourages curiosity, and celebrates the impact of your work. Because when you’re here, you’re part of something bigger. You’re part of a team that shows up, stands together, and leads with purpose.


Overview

Your Role

Our established and diverse Motor team are searching for Claims Consultants looking to manage a large portfolio of differentiating complex motor claims, in a fast-paced claims environment. You’ll be dealing directly with Third Parties, Loss Adjusters, NSW Government Agencies and provide support to all members of staff whilst focusing on building strong client relationships with all of our customers and external partners, and adhering to our companies values.

The position will be offered on a permanent full-time basis with flexible hybrid working arrangements, WFH and in our Parramatta office.


How you'll make an impact

You will add value to Gallagher Bassett across the following:

  • End to end motor claims management
  • Raise payments and settle claims with client service instructions, company guidelines and delegated authority
  • Achieve monthly productivity levels as designated by management
  • Resolve complaints in accordance with company guidelines
  • Find opportunities for process improvement and recognise potential fraud/recovery indicators for claims where applicable

About you

We’re interested in hearing from people who possess:

  • Motor claims insurance experience is essential
  • Passion and drive to take ownership of your own claims portfolio
  • Outstanding organisational and time management skills
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
  • Energy and flexibility to work with the Corporate team, and the desire to support projects recognised as being crucial to our long-term business plan
  • Insurance policy interpretation skills
  • Stakeholder management

What we can offer you:

  • Flexible work arrangements – including WFH
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Excellent working environment – our team at GB is renowned for its dedicated and approachable people as well as its friendly, flexible and inclusive working environment which is built around great team support and rewarding opportunities
  • Exciting career – as our Company grows, so do the opportunities for our people
  • Opportunities for ongoing education and development through both external and internal programs delivered by our own claims training experts
  • Service recognition awards and employee assistance program for yourself and immediate family members
  • A dedication to your wellbeing through our peer support program, corporate health insurance discounts and wellness programs
  • Additional purchased leave, novated leases, and access to the Gallagher Rewards Program (including discounts/cash-back for hundreds of retailers!)
  • Reproductive leave
  • Birthday Club - have a day off during your birthday month as a gift from GB!

If this sounds interesting to you, we want to hear from you today, click on Apply for this Job!

Agency applicants will not be considered for this role.

Gallagher Bassett is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Indigenous Australian applicants are encouraged to apply. As a member of the Diversity Council Australia, we recognise the importance of, and embrace diversity in the workplace. We will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant.


Compensation and benefits

On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits. 

Below are the minimum core benefits you’ll get, depending on your job level these benefits may improve:

  • 4 weeks annual leave plus up to 2 weeks additional purchased Lifestyle Leave
  • Novated Leasing opportunities
  • Two paid volunteer days annually
  • Health Insurance Discounts with our Group Insurance Plan
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Paid parental leave

Other benefits include:

  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Mental Health and Wellbeing Support for yourself and immediate family members
  • Employee Recognition Awards and Service Milestone Recognitions
  • Peer Support Program
  • Annual flu vaccinations
  • Access to Reward Gateway – discount offers at over 350 retailers!
  • And more...

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.

Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.

Gallagher believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any form of discrimination by its managers, employees, vendors or customers based on race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy status), sexual orientation, gender identity (which includes transgender and other gender non-conforming individuals), gender expression, hair expression, marital status, parental status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected (herein referred to as “protected characteristics”) by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination. In addition, Gallagher will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

json.title: Senior Beauty Advisor /Sales Assistant

content.jobHook: We are looking for experienced beauty retail sales team member to support daily store operations, drive sales performance,and achieve store sales goal
content.unEditedContent:
La Cosmetique is a growing Korean beauty retail chain with multiple stores across Australia. We are looking for some experienced and motivated Senior Full-Time Retail Team Member to join our retail team and support the daily operations of our beauty stores.

This role is suitable for someone with strong retail experience, a passion for beauty products, and the ability to support the store team in delivering excellent customer service and strong sales performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent customer service and product recommendations to customers

  • Support daily store operations and ensure the store runs smoothly

  • Maintain store presentation, merchandising, cleanliness, and product displays

  • Assist with achieving store sales targets and improving sales performance

  • Support stock replenishment, inventory control, and stock organisation

  • Assist with product receiving, stock checking, and stock transfers when required

  • Support promotional activities, in-store campaigns, and new product launches

  • Assist customers with enquiries, feedback, returns, and exchanges according to company policy

  • Help train and support junior team members in customer service, product knowledge, and store procedures

  • Work closely with the Store Manager and Head Office team regarding promotions, stock, and daily operations

  • Monitor customer shopping behaviour and provide feedback to improve store performance

  • Maintain a professional, positive, and responsible attitude at all times

Requirements

  • Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in retail, preferably in beauty, cosmetics, skincare, or fashion retail

  • Previous experience as a senior sales assistant, key holder, 2IC, or similar role is preferred

  • Strong customer service and sales skills

  • Passion for Korean beauty, skincare, and cosmetics

  • Good communication skills and a positive team attitude

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment

  • Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills

  • Reliable, responsible, and able to work independently when required

  • Experience with POS systems, stock control, or inventory management is preferred

  • Availability to work full-time, including weekends and public holidays as required

About You

We are looking for someone who is passionate about beauty retail, enjoys working with customers, and has the confidence to support the team in daily store operations.

You should be friendly, responsible, sales-driven, and willing to grow with the company. This is a great opportunity for an experienced retail team member who wants to develop further in the beauty industry.

content.jobHook: Join our professional team of trainers helping students learn how to drive trucks confidently and safely!
content.unEditedContent:
Transport Training Academy are seeking professional and qualified HR or HC/MC Trainers and Assessors to join our Industry leading team on either a casual, part-time, or full-time basis due to a substantial increase in demand. Contract is also considered.

A minimum of 6 months experience as a Heavy Vehicle Driving Instructor is required.

Positions is South of the river available with flexible working hours.

Duties & responsibilities:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of student progress

  • Assist students in completing necessary paperwork related to training and assessment

  • Identify and report any vehicle faults to supervisor

  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety regulations and procedures

  • Provide feedback and guidance to students to help them improve their driving abilities

  • Evaluate students' performance and determine whether they are ready to progress to the next level of training

  • Collaborate with other trainers and assessors to ensure consistency in training and assessment processes.

Position requirements:

  • Heavy Rigid manual licence or higher

  • Current Qualified Instructor certification with the Department of Transport must be held at the time of application

  • Certificate IV in Training & Assessment (TAE40116 or equivalent)

  • Clear and effective communication skills with people of all ages and genders

  • Great customer service & interpersonal skill

  • Professionalism, reliable and punctual

  • Australian citizenship or permanent residency required

Benefits:

  • Flexibility & as many training hours as you want

  • On-site parking available

  • Job security

  • Career advancements


About us:

We have been part of the Transport Industry for over 30 years and are now passing on our experience and have helped thousands of students learn how to drive trucks confidently and safely. Whether it's for a new job, a change in career direction or something you want to do, we cater to all levels of experience, offering one-on-one driver training.

Join us today! Click the Apply button and send us a copy of your resume outlining your qualifications. We look forward to having you on board!

json.title: Operations Manager

content.jobHook: Excellent Operations Manager role in an established air-conditioning business in Hawthorn inc some WFH. Alot of variety, autonomy & a friendly team!
content.unEditedContent:
Independent, established air-conditioning business

Full-time | Hawthorn office | WFH flexibility 2 days a week

Interlandi Refrigeration & Air Conditioning is a well-established and growing business providing residential and commercial air conditioning installation, repair and maintenance services across Melbourne.

We are looking for an experienced, highly organised Operations Manager to work closely with our supportive, hands-on owner and help keep the business running smoothly day to day.

This is a varied, autonomous role suited to someone with strong experience in a busy small business, trade, construction, HVAC or service-based environment. It will suit someone reliable, practical and proactive who is looking for a stable, long-term role they can make their own.

The role

You will help manage the day-to-day operations of the business, including:

• Scheduling jobs for the onsite trade team

• Managing customer enquiries, bookings, invoicing and assisting on quoting

• Coordinating job workflows from enquiry to completion

• Liaising with suppliers, ordering and managing stock

• HR including team management, reviews and recruitment

• Supporting the admin/bookkeeping team member with admin & bookkeeping

• General office administration and operational responsibilities

• Helping improve systems, processes and customer experience

About you

You are calm under pressure, highly organised and confident managing your priorities. You communicate clearly, follow through properly and can work independently without needing to be micromanaged. You will bring:

• Experience in operations, office management or service coordination

• Strong organisational, communication, numerical skills and attention to detail

• Confidence dealing with customers, staff and suppliers

• Experience using Xero or similar software

• A reliable, professional and practical approach

• Full Australian working rights

Experience in HVAC, trade services, bookkeeping, marketing or social media would be highly regarded but is not essential.

Why join us?

• Stable role in an established, growing business

• Competitive salary package with genuine autonomy and variety

• Supportive, hands-on owner and friendly team environment

bulletPoints: Skin Cancer Surgery
content.jobHook: Treat skin cancer with leading experts. Join our dynamic team with great work-life balance and benefits.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

Are you an experienced skin cancer doctor looking for a new challenge? We are seeking a dedicated Skin Cancer Doctor to join our team at TopDoctors Medical Centre in Bellara, Queensland. This is a full-time opportunity to play a vital role in providing high-quality skin cancer diagnosis and treatment to our patients.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting comprehensive skin examinations to identify and diagnose skin cancer and other skin conditions

  • Developing and implementing personalised treatment plans for patients, including surgical procedures, cryotherapy, and other evidence-based treatments

  • Essential requirement for extensive experience in performing surgical procedures for skin cancer treatment

  • Educating patients on skin cancer prevention, self-examination, and the importance of early detection

  • Collaborating with the wider medical team to ensure seamless, coordinated care for patients

  • Maintaining detailed and accurate patient records in accordance with industry standards and regulations

  • Participating in ongoing professional development to stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in skin cancer diagnosis and treatment

What we're looking for

  • Fully registered and qualified medical practitioner with a specialisation in skin cancer management

  • FRACGP Fellowship required for this position

  • Demonstrated experience in performing comprehensive skin examinations, diagnosing skin conditions, and providing effective treatment plans

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to educate and empower patients

  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality, patient-centred care

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team

  • Commitment to ongoing professional development and staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in skin cancer management

What we offer

At TopDoctors Medical Centre, we are committed to supporting our employees and providing a fulfilling work environment. As a Skin Cancer Doctor, you can expect:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

  • Supportive and collaborative team environment

  • Access to state-of-the-art medical equipment and facilities including MoleMAX

  • Work-life balance initiatives, including flexible working arrangements


About us

TopDoctors Medical Centre is a leading healthcare provider in the Bribie Island region, known for our commitment to delivering high-quality, patient-centred care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and state-of-the-art facilities, we are dedicated to improving the health and wellbeing of our local community.

If you are a passionate and experienced Skin Cancer Doctor who is excited to join our team, we encourage you to apply now, principaldoctor@topdoctors.com

content.unEditedContent:
About the Practice

We are an established, independent optometry practice in Melbourne's South East. dedicated to delivering patient-centred family eye care. We pride ourselves on a personalised, professional experience for every patient and a supportive working environment for our team.


The Opportunity

We are seeking a qualified Optometrist to join us on a casual or part-time basis, with genuine potential to expand hours over time. This is an exciting chance to become a valued, long-term member of our team and grow alongside the practice.

We are looking for someone who is not just filling a role, but who is keen to invest in their career and build something meaningful. The right candidate will find real scope to develop here.

  • Conducting eye examinations across a diverse patient base

  • Diagnosing and managing a broad range of ocular conditions

  • Prescribing and fitting spectacles and soft contact lenses

  • Building strong relationships with patients and referrers

  • Supporting front-of-house staff with dispensing when necessary

  • Qualified Optometrist with current AHPRA registration

  • Strong clinical skills and a genuine passion for eye care

  • Excellent communication skills and a patient-first attitude

  • Ability to work independently with confidence and initiative.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, interested in owning their own practice one day

  • Flexible scheduling - casual or part-time arrangement to suit you

  • Genuine pathway to expanded hours and greater responsibility

  • Opportunity to gain real exposure to the business side of optometry


How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and what you are looking for in your next role. Applications are reviewed as they are received, so we encourage you to apply promptly.

json.title: Female Disability Support Worker

content.jobHook: Support individuals with disabilities with compassionate care. Flexible hours, ongoing training, and competitive pay.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

YH Support is seeking a Female Disability Support Worker to join our team in Coburg North, VIC and surrounding areas. This is a casual role that will involve providing compassionate and high-quality care to our clients with disabilities. You will work closely with our clients to assist them with daily living activities and support their independence and wellbeing.

What you'll be doing

  • Assisting clients with personal care, such as showering, dressing, and grooming

  • Helping clients with household tasks, including meal preparation, cleaning, and laundry

  • Accompanying and supporting clients in the community, such as during social outings or appointments

  • Providing emotional support and engaging clients in meaningful activities

  • Documenting client progress and communicating with the broader care team

  • Adhering to all relevant policies, procedures, and safety protocols

What we're looking for

  • Certificate III or IV in Disability or Aged Care, or equivalent relevant experience

  • Experience in providing person-centred support to individuals with disabilities

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients

  • Patience, empathy, and a genuine desire to make a positive difference in the lives of others

  • Reliable, flexible, and able to work a variety of shifts, including weekends and public holidays

  • A current driver's license and access to reliable transport

What we offer

At YH Support, we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. You'll have access to ongoing training and development opportunities, as well as a range of benefits, including competitive pay rates, access to an Employee Assistance Program, and the opportunity to work with a passionate and dedicated team. We also offer the flexibility to balance your work and personal commitments.

About us

YH Support is a registered NDIS service provider in SA, NSW, QLD, VIC and WA . Our mission is to empower individuals with disabilities to live their best lives by providing personalised, high-quality care and support. We take pride in our commitment to person-centred practice, and we work closely with our clients and their families to ensure their needs are met.

If you're interested in this role and have the necessary skills and experience, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join our team and make a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients.

Centre Director – Lead a Large, High‑Performing Early Learning Centre
Full-time | Executive Leadership | Exceptional Culture & Support

We are seeking an accomplished and inspiring Centre Director to lead a large, high‑capacity early learning centre in South Brisbane. This is a rare opportunity for a seasoned leader who brings vision, professionalism, and a deep commitment to excellence in early childhood education.

About the Opportunity

As the Centre Director, you will be entrusted with the full leadership and strategic direction of a thriving service. You will guide a passionate team, champion high‑quality practice, and cultivate a warm, inclusive environment where children, families, and educators feel genuinely supported.

This role is ideal for a confident, polished leader who thrives in a fast‑paced environment and is ready to elevate a centre to its highest potential.

  • A large, dynamic team of educators committed to quality and collaboration

  • A high‑capacity centre with strong community presence

  • A culture that values professionalism, innovation, and continuous improvement

  • Provide strong, inspirational leadership across all aspects of centre operations

  • Ensure excellence in compliance, quality standards, and educational programs

  • Build trusted relationships with families, educators, and community partners

  • Drive a culture of growth, accountability, and professional development

  • Maintain a safe, nurturing, and aesthetically inviting environment

  • Proven leadership experience as a Centre Director or Assistant Director, ideally within a medium or large service

  • A polished, professional leadership style with a passion for excellence

  • Ability to inspire teams and foster a culture of respect, collaboration, and high performance

  • A premium, well‑resourced centre environment

  • Supportive leadership team and ongoing professional development pathways

  • Competitive salary package reflective of experience and capability

  • Autonomy to shape the centre’s culture, vision, and long‑term success

  • A stable, reputable provider committed to quality and educator wellbeing

How to Apply

If you are a confident, forward‑thinking early childhood leader ready to take the next step in your career, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your leadership philosophy and experience.

json.title: OSHC Co-ordinator

content.jobHook: A great step up into a Co-ordinators role for a small Service.
content.unEditedContent:
Heathcote East OSHC Coordinator / Nominated Supervisor

Heathcote East OSHC is a small 30-place service located within the grounds of Heathcote East Public School, on the edge of the beautiful Royal National Park. Our school is small, community-focused and relationship-driven, and our OSHC reflects that same spirit. The service is independently operated by the Heathcote East P&C, who are the Approved Provider and oversee the governance and management of the centre.

Due to movement within our team, we are seeking a full-time OSHC Coordinator / Nominated Supervisor to lead our service.

We are looking for a proactive, capable and experienced leader who can confidently manage the day-to-day operations of the centre while building strong, genuine relationships with children, families, educators and the school community. Beyond qualifications and experience, we want someone who is present, approachable and invested in creating a positive, engaging environment where children feel safe, valued and excited to attend.

You will oversee daily operations, lead your team, manage compliance and administration requirements, and drive high-quality, innovative programs aligned with the My Time, Our Place framework. You will also take on the responsibilities of Nominated Supervisor under the National Law and Regulations, ensuring the service operates in line with the National Quality Framework.

As the Coordinator / Nominated Supervisor you will:

  • Provide a safe, secure, welcoming and nurturing environment for all children.

  • Implement high-quality, inclusive and developmentally appropriate programs aligned with the My Time, Our Place framework.

  • Manage day-to-day operations including administration, staffing, HR processes, compliance, risk management and financial oversight within P&C-approved budgets.

  • Lead, mentor and actively develop your team of educators.

  • Maintain compliance with the National Quality Framework, National Law and Regulations and Child Safe Standards.

  • Build and sustain strong relationships with families, the school and the wider community.

  • Contribute to the continued growth of the service, including enrolments across OSHC and vacation care.

The Role:

This is a part-time permanent position of 30 hours per week. Contact hours will align with service operating hours, with additional non-contact time negotiated. Remuneration is in accordance with the Children’s Services Award and based on qualifications and experience.

To be successful you will have:

  • Minimum Certificate III in Children’s Services (or working towards an approved qualification).

  • At least 12 months’ paid experience in childcare, ideally within an OSHC setting.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience.

  • Sound knowledge of the National Quality Framework and My Time, Our Place.

  • Sound knowledge of the Child Safe Standards

  • Current paid Working With Children Check.

  • Current First Aid, CPR, Anaphylaxis and Asthma Management training.

  • National Criminal History Check.

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for, we would love to hear from you. Please send your resume to accounts@hepsoshc.org.au.

You can find out more about our school community via the Heathcote East Public School website.

json.title: Head Pastry Chef

content.jobHook: Seeking a passionate Head Pastry Chef to lead pastry production, creativity and team development at EBV.
content.unEditedContent:
Head Pastry Chef

To Be Frank Bakery | East Brunswick Village

At To Be Frank, we believe great pastry is made with care, creativity and attention to detail.

We’re currently looking for an experienced Head Pastry Chef to lead the pastry section at our East Brunswick Village store and help shape an exciting and evolving pastry offering.

This is an opportunity for someone who loves both craft and creativity — someone who takes pride in beautiful execution, enjoys mentoring a team, and is excited by the opportunity to bring ideas to life in a supportive, quality-focused environment.

At To Be Frank, we care deeply about quality, thoughtful ingredients, and creating products that people genuinely look forward to eating. From laminated pastries and seasonal specials and new concepts, we’re looking for someone who shares that passion.

About the role

You’ll oversee the day-to-day running of the pastry section at our EBV location.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll be involved in everything from daily production and baking to menu development, quality control, team training and production planning.

You’ll play an important role in shaping the pastry identity of the store, helping us maintain consistency while continuing to evolve and create exciting offerings for our customers.

Key responsibilities

  • Leading daily pastry and viennoiserie production to ensure exceptional quality and consistency

  • Preparing, mixing, laminating, shaping and baking pastries to To Be Frank standards

  • Training, mentoring and developing the pastry team

  • Managing team scheduling and ensuring efficient production flow

  • Monitoring sales and forecasting production quantities to minimise waste

  • Developing and refining seasonal pastry offerings and menu items

  • Costing products to maintain healthy margins

  • Maintaining exceptional cleanliness, organisation and food safety standards

  • Managing ingredient stock levels and ordering requirements

  • Testing and developing new recipes and concepts — we encourage creativity and innovation

  • Ensuring quality control and maintaining high visual standards across all products

About you

You’re someone who genuinely cares about quality and loves the process of creating beautiful pastries.

You might be the right fit if you:

  • Have a Certificate III in Patisserie

  • Have 2+ years’ experience in a senior pastry role, ideally leading a team

  • Have strong laminated pastry and viennoiserie experience

  • Are a calm, positive and motivating leader

  • Have excellent organisational and communication skills

  • Have exceptional attention to detail and consistency

  • Enjoy innovation and bringing new ideas to life

  • Value teamwork, respect and creating a positive workplace culture

Why join To Be Frank?

We’re an independent bakery that values craftsmanship, creativity and community.

At our East Brunswick Village store, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead and shape an exciting pastry program

  • Work with a passionate and supportive team

  • Contribute creatively to seasonal menu development

  • Work in a beautiful, growing neighbourhood with a strong local community

  • Be part of a business that values ideas, initiative and quality

If you’re passionate about pastry, love leading a team, and want to be part of something thoughtful and evolving, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now with your resume and a short cover letter telling us a little about yourself and why you’d love to join To Be Frank.

Classification: IN14

Role description

Inglewood Health are looking for a Food & Domestic Service Assistant to join our team on a casual basis.

  • Provide assistance in the preparation, cooking and service of food within the hospital and aged care facilities.
  • Provide patient/resident movement services with providing a practical oversight of all aspects of Environmental Services within the hospital and aged care facilities

 

About you

  • A highly motivated individual with great attention to detail
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work in a team and independently

 

Please refer to the relevant attached position description and address the key selection criteria on your cover letter when applying.

IDHS prides itself on being an employer of choice and on the support and supervision provided to its staff.

Please note that candidates are required to submit a cover letter and CV together with a document addressing the key selection criteria (which can be found on the Position Description). Only candidates that supply this information will be considered for roles at Inglewood Districts Health Service.

content.jobHook: Electrician, Cable Jointer & Trade Assistant - (ASP1 experience), excellent remuneration, company vehicle (For Trades person), roster days.
content.unEditedContent:
Nexus Power is a specialist level 1, 2 & 3 ASP operating in NSW. Nexus Power’s operators have over 30 years’ experience in the industry, with a focus on structuring their services to meet the needs of their customers. Due to strong demand for their services and rapid growth, Nexus Power is looking for a motivated and focused individuals to join their team as Trade Assistant, Electrician or Cable Jointer.

The successful applicant will be involved in, but not limited to the following:

·         Cabling work;

·         Cable & conduit installation work;

·         Terminating pillars and streetlights;

·         Pit & pipe work; and

·         Substation kiosk installation.

To join this high performing team, it is essential you have the following:

·          ASP1 Experience

·         WHS White Card (General Construction Induction Card)                         

·         HR license (highly desirable);

·         Ability to work at heights;

·         Industry experience (on-site work);

·         Ability to work well in a team environment;

·         Ability to follow instructions;

·         Willingness to learn and a genuine interest in the industry;

·         Ability to work flexible hours Mon / Friday / Weekends;

.         Willingness to adhere to all company Policies, Procedures and legislative compliances;

The following will be considered desirable:

·         Excavator ticket (highly desirable);

·         Forklift ticket (highly desirable)

Nexus Power is seeking an experienced, reliable, focused and team orientated individual who is committed to quality and service. Nexus Power is committed to ensuring safety in the workplace at all times. The successful applicant will have a high level of initiative and awareness of workplace safety, and be willing to work to meet the needs of the business for an immediate start. 

In return, Nexus Power will offer an excellent renumeration, accrual of Roster day every month.

The successful applicant may have a number of future training opportunities made available to them. Nexus Power is looking for someone committed to developing and growing with the business.

If this sounds like the type of role that you would be suited for, please include a resume and a copy of your White Card with your application.

Applications will close on 13th June 2026

content.unEditedContent:
About Farm Frites Australia

Farm Frites Australia Pty Ltd is a leading manufacturer and distributor of premium quality frozen potato products. As a subsidiary of the global Farm Frites group, we are dedicated to providing innovative and sustainable food solutions to our customers throughout Australia and New Zealand. With a strong focus on quality, innovation, and environmental sustainability, we are a dynamic and growing company committed to excellence.


Join Farm Frites Australia as a Learning & Development Specialist and play a key role in building a skilled, safe and high-performing workforce at our new manufacturing facility in Dooen, Victoria.

Working closely with Operations, Quality, Safety and HR teams, you’ll design and deliver engaging training programs that support employee capability, compliance and continuous improvement across the site.

In this hands-on role, you will:

  • Develop and deliver training programs, inductions and on-the-job training
  • Support compliance training including WHS, food safety and SOPs
  • Maintain training records, competency matrices and LMS systems
  • Partner with leaders to identify skills gaps and development opportunities
  • Support leadership development and cross-skilling initiatives
  • Drive a strong learning culture across the site
About You

You’ll bring:

  • Experience in Learning & Development, Training or HR, ideally within manufacturing or FMCG
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Knowledge of compliance training requirements in manufacturing environments
  • A proactive mindset and passion for developing people
  • Tertiary qualification in Business Management, Human Resources or similar field

The pay range for this role is:
80,000 - 80,000 AUD per year(Dooen)

content.jobHook: Great rates, work with quality gear, get strong support, enjoy career growth, and feel appreciated and valued while keeping your work-life balance
content.unEditedContent:
Want a plumbing role that pays top rates, values your skills, and gives you the tools to grow?
At Salmon Plumbing & Hot Water, we believe quality work starts with looking after our people. We're offering $120,000–$140,000 annual salary, paid training, and genuine career development – all while working with a friendly, professional team.

What you'll get:

  • $130k–$140k annual salary

  • Paid training & upskilling – we invest in extra licences and qualifications for you

  • Late-model, fully stocked vehicle + phone + iPad

  • 12 RDOs per year + all leave entitlements

  • Minimal after-hours work (paid at top rates)

  • Flexible start/finish times around family commitments

  • Regular team social events & a positive workplace culture

  • Support from experienced tradespeople and office staff so you can focus on the job

The role:
We're looking for a licensed maintenance plumber to join our domestic and commercial maintenance team. You'll work across residential, commercial, and small project jobs, delivering high-quality plumbing solutions that meet Australian standards and exceed client expectations.

Your week:

  • 40–45 hours of varied, local work

  • On-call once every 5–7 weeks (flexible)

  • Opportunities to work independently and in a team

  • The right tools, tech, and processes to get the job done right

You'll be great at this if you:

  • Are a qualified plumber or near the end of your apprenticeship

  • Have a minimum of 3+ years post-qualification experience as a qualified plumber

  • Hold (or can obtain) your QLD plumbing licence

  • Must hold a current QLD plumbing licence at the time of application

  • Have a current driver's licence

  • Take pride in workmanship and delivering quality service

  • Can problem-solve on site and work safely to Australian standards

Extra skills that score you more:

  • Gas licence

  • Restricted electrical

  • Solar hot water experience

We value professionalism, reliability, and safety – and we back it up with the right equipment, training, and support so you can perform at your best.

Ready to work for a company that values your skills and your future?
Apply now or check us out at www.salmonplumbing.com.au to see why our plumbers stick around.

All applications confidential.

content.jobHook: Join a modern Brisbane law firm offering strong mentorship, quality property work, and real career growth in a supportive team.
content.unEditedContent:
Property & Conveyancing Paralegal
Brisbane | $80,000 - $100,000 + Super 

About the Firm
Our client is a well-regarded and growing commercial law firm based in Brisbane, known for its modern approach, strong client relationships, and collaborative culture.

With a young and high-performing team, the firm works closely with SME clients, developers, investors, and business owners across a broad range of property matters. Due to continued growth, they are now looking to add an experienced Property & Conveyancing Paralegal to the team.

About the Role
Working closely with experienced Partners and senior lawyers, you will play a key role across a mix of conveyancing and broader property matters.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to step into a role offering strong exposure, autonomy, and long-term career development within a supportive team environment.

Responsibilities include:
  • Managing residential and commercial conveyancing matters from start to finish
  • Preparing contracts, transfer documents, and settlement documentation
  • Conducting property and title searches
  • Liaising with clients, banks, brokers, and external parties
  • Coordinating settlements through PEXA
  • Assisting with broader property transactions and matters
  • File and matter management
  • Supporting senior lawyers and Partners on property-related matters
About You
We are open to candidates from either a conveyancing or broader property law background.

You will ideally have:
  • 3+ Years previous experience as a Conveyancing or Property Paralegal
  • Strong understanding of conveyancing processes and procedures
  • PEXA experience
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines
  • A proactive and team-focused approach
What's on Offer
  • Work closely with approachable and experienced Partners
  • Young, collaborative, and supportive culture
  • High-quality property work and client exposure
  • Genuine long-term growth opportunities
  • Modern office environment
  • Competitive salary package based on experience
If you are looking for a change to a fresh firm with exceptional internal culture with growth opportunities this option is for you.

Strong backend and API engineering focus across cloud-native platforms
High-impact role with architectural influence
content.jobHook: Senior / Principal API Engineer opportunity based in Moore Park, Sydney, working across large-scale backend and cloud platform initiatives
content.unEditedContent:
Senior / Principal API Engineer
 
Backend Engineering | Cloud Platforms | API Architecture
�� Moore Park, Sydney | Permanent Opportunity
We are partnering with a leading organisation undergoing significant digital and platform transformation, seeking a Senior / Principal API Engineer to play a key role in designing and delivering scalable backend systems and modern API platforms.
This is a hands-on engineering opportunity suited to someone who thrives in backend development, enjoys solving complex integration challenges, and wants to influence architecture, engineering standards, and platform capability across a high-performing technology environment.
You'll work closely with engineering, architecture, product, and platform teams to build secure, scalable, and high-performing APIs that power critical digital products and services.
About the Role
As a Senior / Principal API Engineer, you will lead the design and development of modern API and backend solutions across cloud-native environments. You'll contribute to architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and help shape best practices around scalability, reliability, performance, and security.
This role is heavily backend-focused and ideal for someone passionate about API-first development, distributed systems, and modern engineering practices.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and API platforms
  • Develop RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs across cloud-native architectures
  • Drive API strategy, governance, security, and integration standards
  • Build highly available and performant microservices-based solutions
  • Collaborate with product, platform, DevOps, and engineering teams to deliver robust backend capabilities
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and engineering best practices
  • Lead technical discussions and mentor engineers across backend development and integration patterns
  • Ensure platform reliability, observability, performance optimisation, and security compliance
  • Support architectural evolution across modern cloud and distributed systems environments
About You
You are an experienced backend engineer with strong API development expertise and a passion for building scalable, modern platforms.
You will bring:
  • Extensive experience in backend software engineering and API development
  • Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, microservices, and event-driven architectures
  • Experience with API gateways, authentication, and security protocols including OAuth2 and OpenID Connect
  • Strong cloud engineering experience, ideally within AWS environments
  • Experience building scalable, high-traffic, customer-facing platforms
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and deployment automation
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and technical leadership capability
  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to engineering standards and best practices
Tech Environment
Experience across some of the following is highly regarded:
  • Node.js / TypeScript / Java / .NET
  • AWS Cloud Services
  • GraphQL & REST APIs
  • Docker & Kubernetes
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • API Gateway technologies
  • Microservices & distributed systems
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
Why Apply?
  • Permanent opportunity based in Moore Park, Sydney
  • Opportunity to work on large-scale digital and backend transformation initiatives
  • High-impact engineering role with architectural influence
  • Collaborative, modern engineering environment
  • Strong focus on innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
  • Long-term career growth and development opportunities
If you're a backend-focused API Engineer looking to step into a senior or principal-level opportunity where you can genuinely influence platform direction and engineering capability, we'd love to hear from you.

content.jobHook: Luxury Sanctuary Cove salon seeking hairstylists + 1st year apprentice. Above award pay, commission & lifestyle balance.
content.unEditedContent:
WE’RE HIRING ✨

Luxury Hair Salon in Sanctuary Cove

We are growing and currently looking for both:

• An experienced hairstylist (full-time or part-time)

• A passionate first year apprentice ready to start their career in a luxury salon environment

Located in the heart of Sanctuary Cove, our luxury hair and beauty salon is known for delivering a high-end client experience in a supportive, professional and team-focused environment.

For experienced stylists, this is an opportunity to step into a salon where your earning potential is genuinely valued and rewarded. We offer an above award base wage along with an uncapped commission structure once targets are reached, allowing motivated stylists to build a strong and rewarding income.

We’ve also created a workplace that prioritises lifestyle and balance, because we believe great careers shouldn’t come at the expense of your personal life.

• Above award base wage

• Uncapped commission opportunities

• High client spend and premium service environment

• No late nights

• Half day Saturdays

• Flexible roster options, including alternating Saturdays for longer weekday hours

• Closed all public holidays

• Closed over Easter

• Closed between Christmas & New Year

• Ongoing education, support and growth opportunities

• Beautiful luxury salon environment with a supportive team culture

We are looking for someone who:

• Is passionate about hair and client experience

• Presents professionally and takes pride in their work

• Is motivated, reliable and team-oriented

• Wants to grow financially and professionally within the industry

For our apprentice position, we are looking for someone enthusiastic, well-presented, eager to learn and excited to begin a long-term career in the hair industry within a luxury salon setting.

Whether you’re an experienced stylist ready for your next opportunity, or someone wanting to begin your hairdressing journey the right way, we would love to hear from you.

📩 Please apply via email to learn more.

json.title: Podiatrist

content.jobHook: We are looking for a Podiatrist to work in a family-like team providing care to clients from all walks of life on the “coolest street in the world”.
content.unEditedContent:
• Podiatrist

  • Location: High Street, Thornbury

  • Fixed Term - Part Time (Negotiable)

  • Salary range:  Negotiable dependent on years of experience 

Talaria - Podiatrist of Thornbury is a wholesome, tight-knit, community orientated clinic conveniently located on the “coolest street in the world” - High Street in Thornbury on Wurundjeri Land. We are on a hunt for a Podiatrist that will enjoy working in this unique area & becoming a valued part of our family-like team!


Our well-respected owner & Podiatrist Kristy Markopoulos (she/her) opened the clinic in 2017, with the ambition of providing the local Thornbury, Preston, Northcote, Reservoir, Fairfield & Northside surrounds with a Podiatry clinic with a difference. To fit in with the Thornbury vibe, we take pride in creating a clinic that is modern, inviting, clean & cosy. Our ethos at Talaria is to be authentic & treat every customer as a VIP with a personable approach. We like to make the effort to ensure they have a comfortable, relaxed visit, while feeling understood & cared for in our capable hands.


At Talaria, we have established a positive & wholesome team culture where every member of our team feels like a part of the family. Our clinic has a relaxed & close-knit vibe with a motivated and passionate team of Podiatrists & reception staff. We are proud of the supportive & loyal client community we have created. Our clinic reflects our values for compassionate & high-quality care. Our Talaria family is full of love, which is why we enjoy caring for our clients, their loved ones & the local community. Our staff & their loved ones often get together throughout the year at social & team building events in the area.


We are looking for someone unique, motivated & passionate about becoming a valued member of our Podiatry family & local community. We would love someone with diverse Podiatry skills & an inclusive nature. The role is currently part time but very negotiable. You will be working as part of a supportive team to provide compassionate and high-quality Podiatry services to wonderful clients from all walks of life!


  • Salary role with bonuses for orthotics & nail procedures

  • All aspects of Podiatry, however clientele vastly includes biomechanical 
    & children’s Podiatry 

  • Experience preferred, especially with extra modalities such as Dry Needling, Shockwave & Keryflex.

  • Flexible hours

  • We are very much a part of the local Thornbury community and would love for our new team member to be willing to embrace this too! 


Desired:

  • Diverse range of Podiatry skills & specialities

  • Someone with a connection to the local Thornbury area or community


For more info on our clinic, please check out our website: www.talariapodiatrist.com.au

You can also check out our socials on Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok & YouTube (@talaria_podiatrist).


How to apply:

If this sounds like an opportunity you would like to explore, please apply with a CV & cover letter to Kristy via email at kristy@talariapodiatrist.com.au & address the following:

Why would you like to work at Talaria - Podiatrist of Thornbury & why you would be a good fit for our team?


Enquiries are welcome. If you are not sure whether to apply or have any questions, we are more than happy to take your questions. Our interviews will also be focussed on getting to know you, your needs, skills & taking any questions in a relaxed & open discussion about the role.


We look forward to hearing from you!

FUTURE TEAM LEADER     $67 - $95K 

You don’t have to be a bike expert – we will train you!


WHY WORK AT 99 BIKES

  • Generous above-award salary package including uncapped commission in the range of $67 - $95K.
  • Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements – as well as monthly awards and events, our top 10% of high achievers fly off to an all-inclusive annual conference called “Global Gathering”. Previous Globals have been in New Zealand, Canada, Japan and this year is in Cairns! 
  • Enjoy unmatched career growth opportunities – we promote from within wherever possible and our people have become Team Leaders, State Leaders, Product/Online/Marketing Specialists and even GMs of overseas countries.
  • Save money – we pay our people to ride to work, offer cost price on bike products and discount prices on travel products (through our shareholder Flight Centre), plus we offer generous employee benefits like a paid parental leave package and free counselling services.
  • Overseas Opportunities – we have shops in Australia, New Zealand and the UK. We support short and long-term relocation opportunities via initiatives such as our Peak-to-Peak Program between AUS and the UK, which offers participants an endless summer.
  • Grow your wealth – buy in or be allocated reward shares as part of our Employee Share Scheme which started at 99c per share and is now worth $5 per share. Current and ex-employees own over 16% of our company, with this number growing every year.
  • Enrich our communities – we donate 1% of our total wage bill to the charity of our people’s choice through our Earning To Give program. Past recipients include RSPCA, Beyond Blue and the Children’s Cancer Institute. We have donated over $2.8 million dollars to charities of our people's choice since 2016
  • Enrich our planet – we are committed to reducing our environmental impact and helping others to do the same. Bikes are a low carbon transport option, helping our customers lower their carbon footprint. We are also working on reducing ours with solar panels installed on 70% of our shops.
  • Certified B Corp – We proudly became a certified B Corp in 2023. B Corp is a third party certification to show that we are committed to more than just profit - we’re committed to doing good for people and the planet.

 

About The Role:

We’re growing and looking for hard-working, high achievers to join our team as Future Team Leader. Opportunities to progress into a leadership position. 

  • Experience career development opportunities with access to our in-house Leadership Academy.
  • One on one coaching with an experienced leader 
  • No need to be a bike expert—full on-the-job training provided
  • Help our customers find the best products that suit their needs through your advice and support.
  • Be a customer champion to help us deliver on our vision: The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops 
  • Work towards achievable sales and product knowledge goals with tiered financial rewards
  • Be a part of a high-performing culture with structured team communication: daily, weekly and monthly meetings
  • High achievers are recognised with awards and exclusive invites to our Global Gathering (previous locations include Whistler, Canada and Hakuba, Japan).
  • Be part of a collaborative, community-driven team—compete for store awards and take part in charity and local events
  • Flexible rostering - our leaders aim to accommodate personal needs with roster flexibility and offer plenty of weekend work if desired.

We embrace innovation and welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds. Perfect for high performers looking to take the next step or sales professionals seeking a more supportive, rewarding employer.

About You:

  • Demonstrated and proven achievement in any field – these could be personal goals, sporting, educational or work-related
  • You take initiative, enjoy guiding others, and thrive when leading teams toward shared goals
  • Key qualities: strong team player, relationship builder, and customer-focused
  • A track record of success in past sales or customer service roles in any industry is advantageous but not essential.
  • Good communication skills and demonstrated success in developing and maintaining good relationships with workmates and clients.
  • A history demonstrating honesty and reliability
  • You are resilient, hardworking, and able to stay focused under pressure
  • A demonstrated commitment to continual improvement and learning

 

  About Us:

99 Bikes opened the doors of its first tiny 170m2 shop in Milton, Brisbane in May 2007, a shop so small that we could only fit 99 bikes into the store. From that humble beginning, we have grown to become the largest bicycle retailer in Australia with 798 employees and we now have retail stores in the UK, New Zealand and Australia. In the last 12 months we sold over 164,000 bikes and we have a loyal customer base of over 1.8 million Club 99 Members in Australia, part of our vision to be ‘The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops’. Best Employer multi-award winner and global retail giant Flight Centre also bought into the business, giving us access to shared resources and enabling us to fast-track our growth. 

In addition to our retail stores, we also own Advance Traders, a bicycle distributor importing popular brands such as Merida, BMC, plus many more. Together we form the Pedal Group and this integration has underpinned our growth and given our people much greater career opportunities across the group.

For instance, someone who started as a bike builder in a shop went on to become GM of our UK operation. Another of our Melbourne high achievers wanted to move to Canberra so we opened our first store there. We build our business around our people, promote from within wherever possible, and have numerous training pathways to help them achieve their potential.

We have always been about living our purpose of enriching mind, body, earth or soul with the freedom of riding and focused on balancing purpose with profit. In 2023 we made it official by becoming a certified B Corporation™ (B Corp). Learn more about B Corp certification here. Just by doing business everyday, we are proud to sell products that have the potential to significantly improve the mental and physical health of our customers and communities whilst also lowering their carbon footprint, if they make the choice to ride bikes instead of drive.

Since 2016 we have donated over $2.8 million to charities chosen by our employees through our annual Earning To Give program. We pay our people to ride to work to help them stay healthy and reduce their environmental impact with over 75% of our employees using this initiative. Over 70% of our stores have solar panels installed and we are committed to finding ways to reduce waste from our stores with upcycling and recycling programs in most stores.

Hit the Apply Link or apply directly through our website

progressive and fun environment and for the next leg of my journey with 99 Bikes”

content.jobHook: For the Pelvic Health Physio who wants meaningful part-time work without the compromise. Warm caseload, flexible hours, beautiful location.
content.unEditedContent:
The caseload is warm, the patients are waiting, and the location is hard to beat.

Sunny Natal is a Women's Health Physiotherapy practice based in Kiama on the NSW South Coast. We're looking for a Pelvic Health Physiotherapist to join our multidisciplinary team 2–3 days per week, with school hours available for the right person.

Our patients are predominantly pregnant and postnatal women who are engaged, motivated, and genuinely invested in their health. It's the kind of clinical work that reminds you why you chose this specialty.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a part-time position, 2–3 days per week, with genuine flexibility around school hours if required. You'll step into an established referral base and work alongside an experienced, supportive multidisciplinary team.

Day to day you'll be working across:

— Antenatal and postnatal physiotherapy
— Pelvic floor assessment and rehabilitation
— Continence management, pelvic organ prolapse, SUI
— Chronic pelvic pain and pelvic floor downtraining
— Collaborative care with GPs and local specialists

Appointment blocks are structured so you have the time to actually do your job well, no conveyor belt.


WHAT WE OFFER

— 2–3 days per week, school hours available
— 60% commission or competitive salaried package, depending on your preference
— Mentoring from a senior, experienced Women's Health Physiotherapist available as required
— An established, warm caseload
— A multidisciplinary team that communicates and collaborates properly
— One of the most beautiful places to work on the NSW coast


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're a Pelvic Health Physiotherapist who can hit the ground running. You're warm with patients, clear with referring clinicians, and confident managing your own caseload independently.

You have:

— AHPRA registration
— APA Women's Health Level 2 qualification (or equivalent) — completed, or due to complete before August 2026
— Genuine experience in Women's Health Physiotherapy
— The ability to work autonomously and manage your patient load with confidence
— A collaborative approach and good communication with GPs and the wider team

This role does require independent practice from day one. Mentoring is available but we need someone who is clinically confident in the women's health space.


ABOUT SUNNY NATAL

We're a small, close-knit women's health practice that takes this work seriously. We maintain strong GP and specialist relationships, we give patients the time they need, and we've built a referral base that reflects that. We're growing carefully, and we want the right person, not just someone to fill a spot.


TO APPLY

Send a brief introduction and your CV to hello@sunnynatal.com.au — Brianna will be in touch personally.

If you're not actively looking but this caught your eye, reach out anyway. We're happy to have a conversation.

No recruitment agencies please.

content.jobHook: Boost your claims management career - join our high-performing, supportive team at Gallagher Bassett.
content.unEditedContent:
Introduction

At Gallagher Bassett, we're there when it matters most because helping people through challenging moments is more than just our job, it’s our purpose. Every day, we help clients navigate complexity, support recovery, and deliver outcomes that make a real difference in people’s lives. It takes empathy, precision, and a strong sense of partnership—and that’s exactly what you’ll find here. We’re a team of fast-paced fixers, empathetic experts, and outcomes drivers — people who care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it well. Whether you're managing claims, supporting clients, or improving processes, you’ll play a vital role in helping businesses and individuals move forward with confidence. Here, you’ll be supported by a culture that values teamwork, encourages curiosity, and celebrates the impact of your work. Because when you’re here, you’re part of something bigger. You’re part of a team that shows up, stands together, and leads with purpose.


Overview

About the Role

As a Performance Manager, you’ll work closely with claims staff within our Workers' Compensation team to uplift GB’s claims management performance, whilst ensuring the delivery of a customer-centric and best in class claims management service. This will be achieved through conducting thorough and in-depth reviews of various reporting and claims. Engaging with Worksafe and claims teams, and coaching and mentoring claims staff.

You will play a key role in promoting best practice claims management and supporting initiatives across our VIC Workers' Compensation team.


How you'll make an impact

Responsibilities

  • Conducting thorough and in-depth reviews and providing recommendations
  • Assessing the need for referrals and investigative tools to expedite information gathering
  • Making liability decisions within the quality decision making framework
  • Promoting best practice claims management
  • Supporting continuous improvement with VIC Workers Compensation
  • Mentoring and coaching team members
  • Coordinating and managing reporting and programs
  • Engaging key stakeholders in the development, execution, and evaluation of appropriate strategy, business plans and initiatives

About you

Qualifications

  • Significant, in depth understanding of the legislation (ACA & WIRCA) and the VWA guidelines and procedures, as well as practical application of these
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the workers' compensation industry, business requirements and administrative practices and requirements
  • Claims Management experience in a leadership capacity
  • Outstanding leadership skills
  • Coaching and mentoring experience
  • Time management and organisation skills
  • Tertiary qualifications within the disciplines of business or personal injury (or similar)
  • Private Investigative (PI) qualification is preferred

What we can offer you

  • Attractive remuneration packaging and hybrid work arrangements including Work from Home

  • Monthly RDO (Rostered Day Off) after the completion of your probationary period

  • Paid Leave: Generous Paid Parental Leave and reproductive leave to support your family needs

  • Supportive Environment: A friendly, flexible, and inclusive working environment with great team support and rewarding opportunities

  • Career Growth: Exciting career advancement prospects as our company continues to grow

  • Ongoing Education: Continuous education and development opportunities through external and internal programs

  • Recognition and Support: Service recognition awards and employee assistance programs for you and your immediate family members

  • Wellbeing Focus: A commitment to your wellbeing through our peer support program, corporate health insurance discounts, and wellness programs

  • Additional Benefits: Access to additional purchased leave, novated leases, and the Gallagher Rewards Program, which includes discounts and cash-back offers from hundreds of retailers

  • Birthday Club: Enjoy a day off during your birthday month on GB

To Apply:

Does this sound like the perfect job for you? We want to hear from you today! Click on "Apply for this Job" to join our team.

Eligibility: To be considered for this opportunity, you must have the right to live and work in Australia.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Gallagher Bassett is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages Indigenous Australian applicants to apply. As a member of the Diversity Council Australia, we embrace diversity in the workplace and will make reasonable accommodations for known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant with a disability, unless it imposes an undue hardship on our business operations.

Join the Zen Body Sculpting Family: Become a Body Contouring Therapist

Are you passionate about helping people achieve their body goals? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, supportive environment? We're looking for a talented Body Contouring Therapist to join our vibrant team at Zen Body Sculpting!

About the Role:

As a Body Contouring Therapist, you'll:

  • Perform non-surgical body treatments, including fat reduction, skin tightening, and HIFU treatments

  • Conduct consultations to understand client goals and create personalized treatment plans

  • Deliver exceptional customer service and drive client retention

  • Participate in reels for social media

  • Keeping a high standard of cleaning

  • Assist with administrative tasks, housekeeping

What We're Looking For:

  • Previous experience in a similar role is a plus, but not essential

  • Passion for body transformation and wellness

  • Confidence in consulting clients and presenting treatment plans

  • Exceptional customer service and care skills

  • Previous selling experience in beauty is a plus, but not essential

  • Must be available every Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday

  • Must be an Australian citizen

What You'll Get:

  • Excellent remuneration with lucrative incentives

  • 3% commission on packages, treatments, and products sold

  • Superannuation and work-life balance (closed Sundays, Mondays, and public holidays)

  • Full training and support with certification

  • Free treatments for team members

  • Opportunities for growth and skill development with our experienced team

Apply Now:

Ready to start your Body Contouring career with us? Apply now and join our fun and dynamic team at Zen Body Sculpting!

content.jobHook: Graduate / Intermediate Auditor - Progress to CA / CPA
content.unEditedContent:
About the business

Morris Cohen Glen & Co is a firm of Chartered Accountants based in Camberwell with a focus on providing a high level of service, advice and expertise to our varied and interesting client base.

An exciting opportunity is available for a Intermediate level position, where you will join our team of young professionals, where the skills you have the opportunity to learn have lasting value and will form the foundation of your career.

Our team is dedicated to providing our clients with high standard of service using the latest technology with a particular focus on cloud based accounting.

Our Firm takes great pride in the work we do and as a result we have high standards. We aim to provide a polished and professional service to our clients – giving the same high-quality service that we would like to receive.

 

About the role

Initially working in the graduate / intermediate role which will progress to qualified accountant, your duties will include but are not limited to:


• Preparation of special purpose and general purpose financial statements;
• Client visits for stock takes and assets physical verification;
• Liaising with client to collect audit documents and information;
• Planning for the audit including confirmations control etc;
• Risk assessment and audit procedures;
• Audit field work on various risk areas; 
• Knowledge of Australian Accounting and Auditing Standards; 
• Audit of not for profit organisations;
• Audit of trust accounst;
• Audit of foreign subsidiaries; and
• Other assurance activities like due diligence, acquittals etc.

 

Benefits and perks

Our firm does not believe in our team working unnecessary long and extended hours, we have standard 36.25 hours per week. 

Whilst we work hard and give high quality service to our clients this can be done without the long hours of many big firms.

And we have a full A4 page of wonderful benefits including yearly salary increases, progression pathways and a long list of thoughtful social perks.

We offer the successful applicant:

  • Direct contact with Partners to help develop you

  • Strong specialised training support to supplement your skills

  • We will train and guide you in all major tax, audit and accounting areas

  • A healthy work life balance

  • Paid study leave for your CA / CPA exams

  • Free office and on street car parking and office just two minutes walk from the nearby train station

  • Support for VISA / Permanent Residency (PR)


Skills and experience

We are seeking a bright, enthusiastic and committed candidate, who possesses:

- Minimum 12 months Australian Accounting / Auditing role experience
- Studied Accounting major at university
- Intention to start CA program in the future / have already started CA program
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong attention to detail
- The ability to multi-task and meet deadlines
- Strong dedication to teamwork, a willingness to work hard, learn and develop new skills using the latest technology
- The right to work in Australia. Our Company has the ability to sponsor candidates and will consider this on a case by case basis in future.

If this sounds like the role for you, please submit your CV outlining why you believe you are the right hire for Morris Cohen Glen & Co, using the apply now function below.

If you have queries that you would like to discuss before submitting your CV, please contact Harish Budhiraja at harish@morco.com.au

content.jobHook: Seeking experienced Duct Installers, DX Pipe Installers, Mech Plumbers and TAs for immediate start on commercial projects. Competitive rates on offer.
content.unEditedContent:
Job Description:


Applied Mechanical Services (AMSQ) is seeking multiple experienced trades


Positions Available:

1. Commercial DX Pipe Installers

The Role: Installation, brazing, and commissioning of VRF/VRV and split DX systems.

Requirements: ARCtick license (or relevant restricted license), proven experience with copper pipework/brazing on commercial construction sites, and your own basic tools.

2. Duct Installers

The Role: Installing sheet metal and flexible ductwork, hanging brackets, and setting up FCUs/fans/grilles on commercial construction sites.

Requirements: Previous experience installing commercial ductwork, the ability to read mechanical layout drawings, and your own basic hand tools.

3. Mechanical Plumbers / Pipe Installers

The Role: Rough-in and fit-out of chilled water, condenser water systems.

Requirements: Relevant Trade Qualification, White Card, and proven experience with commercial pipe installations.

4. Trade Assistants (TAs)

The Role: Supporting our qualified tradesmen on-site, material handling, site cleanup, and assisting with installations as required.

Requirements: Construction White Card, reliable transport, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn.


The Company

Applied Mechanical Services (AMSQ)  is a privately owned HVAC Company with a combined 50 years’ proven experience in the industry. We have gained an enviable reputation for technical excellence in designing and installing mechanical systems in unique applications to meet the individual needs of a wide range of clients. 


The Company’s continuing success and growth is founded on our demonstrated ethos of delivering quality projects and achieved though the synergy and professionalism of our workforce. We employ staff directly and utilise the use of reliable subcontractors, to provide a work environment built on respect, appreciation and trust so that you will be working next to people you enjoy. 


Listening is a big part of our company culture. Our Engineers, Project Managers and Office staff support and collaborate with a talented, experienced team of tradespeople including Refrigeration Mechanics, HVAC Pipe installers, Mechanical Plumbers, Electricians and Sheet Metal workers to achieve our mutual goals, foster continued learning and improve practices.


The Position 

(We have multiple positions available for all trades)

Applied Mechanical Services (AMSQ) specializes in design and construct HVAC projects of up to $20m in value.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Install HVAC piping according to drawings, specifications and manufacture schematics.

  • Ensure all installations comply with industry standards

  • Collaborate with AMSQ site managers, project managers, engineers, and other team members to complete projects on time and within budget.

  • Maintain a clean and safe work environment.

  • Document all work performed and maintain accurate records.

  • Have a proactive work ethic and take pride in your work with a good attention to detail.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Commercial construction installation.

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems and installation techniques.

  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, schematics, and manufactures technical drawings.

  • Proficiency in using hand and power tools related to Commercial HVAC pipe installation.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

  • Valid driver's license.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary.

  • RDOs

  • Full time role

  • Paid time off and holidays.

  • Opportunities for professional development and training.

  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and qualifications to admin@amsq.au. 

Or contact the office on 07 3667 8237
