content.jobHook: Operate high reach forklifts in a leading Lytton DC with strong pay, consistent shifts and long term opportunity.
content.unEditedContent:
The Opportunity

We are seeking experienced High Reach Forklift Operators to join a major national distribution centre based in Lytton, Brisbane. This site plays a critical role in keeping supply chains moving across Australia, handling high volumes of freight in a structured and well managed environment.

This is a full time, ongoing opportunity offering both morning and afternoon shifts. You will be operating modern forklifts, working within a professional team, and contributing to a high performing warehouse operation.

If you are confident operating high reach forklifts and enjoy working in a fast paced DC environment, this is a strong long term opportunity.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Operate High Reach and Counterbalance forklifts across warehouse operations
  • Load and unload trucks with palletised, stillage and loose freight
  • Pick, stage and move stock within the distribution centre
  • Work across inbound and outbound freight movements
  • Operate forklifts at height with accuracy and control
  • Follow all WHS procedures and site safety requirements

What You’ll Need
  • Current LF Forklift Licence
  • Minimum 12 months High Reach forklift experience
  • Confidence operating forklifts at height in a busy DC environment
  • Strong safety awareness and attention to detail
  • Reliable, consistent and able to work within a team
  • Physically fit and capable of supporting warehouse tasks where required

Shift & Pay
  • AM Shift: 4:00am – 12:00pm | $37.54 per hour
  • PM Shift: 12:00pm – 8:00pm | $42.95 per hour
  • Monday to Friday
  • Full time hours with overtime available

Why This Role Stands Out
  • Work within a large, well established national distribution centre
  • Above market pay rates across both shifts
  • Modern equipment and structured warehouse operations
  • Consistent hours with long term opportunity
  • Supportive team environment with clear processes

Apply Now

If you are an experienced High Reach forklift operator looking for a stable role in Lytton, apply now or email jburley@hpeople.au with the subject line “High Reach Operator – Lytton”.

content.jobHook: Lead an experienced HVAC team and deliver exceptional results. Competitive salary, professional development.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

This is a full-time HVAC Project Manager role with Applied Mechanical Services (QLD) Pty Ltd, based in Brisbane, Queensland. As the HVAC Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the successful delivery of heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) projects for our diverse client base across the construction industry. Your role will be vital in ensuring the completion of these projects to the highest standards, on time and within budget.

What you'll be doing

  • Manage the planning, scheduling and coordination of HVAC installation and maintenance projects

  • Liaise with clients, contractors and other stakeholders to ensure effective communication and timely project delivery

  • Monitor project progress and identify and mitigate any risks or issues that may arise

  • Ensure projects comply with all relevant building codes, safety regulations and quality standards

  • Prepare detailed project reports and documentation

  • Lead and motivate a team of HVAC technicians and subcontractors to achieve project goals

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our HVAC project management processes

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 3 years' experience as an HVAC Project Manager

  • Strong technical knowledge of HVAC systems and their installation

  • Excellent project management, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and contracts

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Demonstrated experience in leading and motivating project teams

What we offer

At Applied Mechanical Services (QLD) Pty Ltd, we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment for all our employees. As an HVAC Project Manager, you can expect:

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses• Opportunities for professional development• A collaborative and inclusive team culture

About us

Applied Mechanical Services (QLD) Pty Ltd is a leading provider of commercial and industrial HVAC solutions in Queensland. We have been delivering high-quality project management and installation services to a diverse range of clients in the construction, manufacturing, healthcare and retail sectors. Our commitment to innovation, safety and customer service has made us a trusted partner for businesses across the state.

If you are an experienced HVAC Project Manager who is passionate about delivering exceptional results, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Click the "Apply Now" button to submit your application.

content.jobHook: We’re looking for full-time Qualified HVAC installers, Refrigeration Mechanics, and 2nd–4th year HVAC Apprentices to join our team.
content.unEditedContent:
***Cover letter required to apply for this position:

To apply for this position, only candidates who submit a cover letter together with his/her resume will be considered for interview opportunities

Apprentice candidates based in Melbourne’s West, North, or East are all welcome to apply.

Job Description

We’re looking for motivated full-time qualified HVAC Mechanical Plumber/Refrigeration Mechanics, and 2nd–4th Year HVAC Plumber Apprentices and Refrigeration Technicians Apprentices to join our growing team. This is a hands-on role supporting residential HVAC installations including Ducted Reverse Cycle and Multi-head Split Systems under government rebate programs, with opportunities for leadership responsibilities for senior apprentices.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with the installation of ducted, multi-split, VRF multi, and single split AC systems — all residential jobs.

  • Maintain van stock and materials (apprentice responsibility).

  • Keep worksites clean and safe.

  • Step up to lead a small installation team when the lead plumber is on leave (for qualified and 3rd/4th year apprentices).

  • Attend service calls as required.

  • Log jobs via our digital portal.

  • Complete OHS documentation.

  • Liaise professionally with customers on-site.

  • Attend weekly meetings at our Springvale office (other days go directly to job sites).

What You’ll Bring

  • You must be a 2nd–4th year HVAC Mechanical Plumbing, or Refrigeration Technician apprentice, and qualified HVAC Mechanical Plumbers/Refrigeration Technicians.

  • Experience installing residential HVAC systems (ducted, VRF, multi, and single splits).

  • Your own tools and willingness to use them.

  • Fault-finding skills (preferred).

  • Manual driver’s licence (preferred).

  • Current Police Check, Working with Children Check, and White Card.

  • EWP Licence (preferred).

  • Punctual, honest, reliable, and self-motivated.

What’s In It for You

  • Potential career growth and full-time employment after completing your 4th year.

  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.

  • Unlimited snacks, drinks, and a welcome goodie bag.

Work with a company that has a stellar 4.9/5 Google rating from over 979 reviews, reflecting our genuine care for customers. content.unEditedContent:
The Company

Our client excels in creating dynamic, functional commercial spaces. With a skilled team and innovative design approach, they offer end-to-end fitout solutions tailored to client needs.

The Role 

As a dedicated Site Manager, your primary goal is to oversee and lead the seamless delivery of your projects, ensuring compliance with quality, timelines, health and safety, and labour regulations. Your role extends to managing preliminary stages within the assigned budget, making you a pivotal player in our dynamic team.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
  • Overseeing all on-site activities, ensuring safety and quality standards are met.
  • Managing subcontractors and suppliers, fostering strong working relationships.
  • Coordinating project timelines, resources, and schedules.
  • Keeping a close eye on project budgets and costs.

content.unEditedContent:
The Lounge Aesthetics Team is growing! We are on the lookout for a Cosmetic Nurse Injector to join our team. Training will be provided (and paid) in clinic so you’ll start feeling confident and supported.

At The Lounge, we’re all about creating a space where clinical precision meets a soft, luxury vibe, think olive green, white, and a touch of neutrals with lots of laughs in between. Our clients trust us because we deliver safe, natural results while making them feel like part of our community.

If you’re looking for more than just a job, if you want to join a team where you’re valued, supported, and celebrated, then Buderim is calling.

We can’t wait to meet you 💚

content.jobHook: Our detailing company is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Detailing Technician to join our growing team in.
content.unEditedContent:
Position Overview

Our detailing company is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Detailing Technician to join our growing team in.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who enjoy hands-on work, take pride in craftsmanship, and are interested in growing within a fast-expanding company.

This role goes beyond traditional automotive detailing. You will work closely with a small, high-performing team, receive hands-on training, and have opportunities for professional growth as you develop your skills and contribute to company operations.

We are looking for individuals who are dependable, eager to learn, and motivated to grow within the organization.

Company Overview

Our detailing company is a premium automotive detailing company, currently operating multiple mobile crews servicing clients six days per week.

Role Overview

This is an on-site Detailing Technician role. Technicians perform services both at customer locations and in-shop (as applicable), while upholding the company's standards of professionalism and service excellence.

Core Responsibilities

● Arrive on time and prepared for scheduled workdays

● Maintain a professional appearance and represent the company positively

● Perform interior and exterior detailing services on customer vehicles

● Handle a variety of vehicle conditions, including heavily soiled or restoration-level details

● Follow company procedures and quality standards

● Communicate professionally with customers and team members

● Maintain tools, supplies, and work areas in an organised manner

● Contribute ideas to improve efficiency and service quality

Growth & Development

At our detailing company, we prioritise long-term growth and development. We are seeking individuals who are interested in building a career with the company. As you gain experience and demonstrate reliability and leadership, opportunities

may include:

● Advanced detailing training

● Leadership or crew lead responsibilities

● Specialised services (paint correction, ceramic coatings, etc.)

● Operational or training responsibilities

● Additional compensation aligned with expanded responsibilities

Your success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

● Deliver high-quality services consistently

● Demonstrate professionalism and reliability

● Support a positive team environment

● Improve efficiency and contribute ideas

● Grow in skillset and responsibility over time

Qualifications

● Valid Driver's Licence

● Must be 18 years of age or older

● Reliable transportation to work

● Strong attention to detail

● Professional and customer-focused demeanour

● Ability to perform hands-on, physical work

● Must be capable of moderate lifting and bending as required for detailing tasks

● Strong work ethic and willingness to learn

● Prior experience in automotive detailing preferred but not required

● Experience in hands-on or labour-based roles preferred

● Must hold valid Australian work rights

Compensation

● Additional compensation opportunities for advanced skills such as:

● Paint correction

● Ceramic coating

● PPF installation (if applicable)

● Leadership responsibilities

How To Apply

Please submit the following:

● Resume

● Phone number

● A brief video (under 3 minutes) introducing yourself and covering:

○ Your background and qualifications

○ Why you are interested in this role

○ Your interests outside of work

Send all application materials to our email:

booking@adlautodetailing.com.au

Applications without a video submission will not be considered.

content.jobHook: Play a Key role in completing Inland Rail's I2S project - One of Australia's most significant nation-building infrastructure program.
content.unEditedContent:
Rail Delivery & Engineering Professionals (Civil | Track | Structures)

About the opportunity

Inland Rail - Illabo to Stockinbingal (I2S) Greenfield | Active Construction Phase | Immediate needs 14:7 roster | FIFO or DIDO | Project Specified contracts


Roles / Disciplines:

  • Construction Manager
  • Senior Project Engineer - Civil
  • Senior Project Engineer - Track
  • Senior Project Engineer - Civil/Structures
  • Project Engineer - Civil
  • Project Engineer - Track
  • Project Engineer - Civil/Structures
  • Supervisor / Site Surveillance - Civil x 2
  • Supervisor / Site Surveillance - Track x 2

Why join Inland Rail now:

This is your opportunity to be part of one of Australia's most significant nation‑building infrastructure programs-join us now and play a critical role in completing Inland Rail's I2S Project.



About the Project

The Illabo to Stockinbingal (I2S) Greenfield section is a ~39km new rail corridor in regional NSW, creating a more efficient route by bypassing local townships and the steep, winding Bethungra Spiral section.

Construction is ramping up and we're recruiting experienced rail delivery & engineering professionals to support corridor delivery across civil (including structures/culverts, earthworks), rail and road related work packages.


What you'll be working on:
Site-based delivery across packages including bulk earthworks, structures, culverts, track formation rail system interfaces on a 14:7 roster


About you

You are a capable and collaborative construction professional experienced in delivering major rail or linear infrastructure projects, with strong technical capability, clear communication skills, and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

What we're looking for:

  • Proven delivery experience on major rail or linear infrastructure projects
  • Degree in Civil Engineering for the PE & SPEs. Related Construction / Project Management qualifications for the Construction Manager position.
  • Strength across project delivery, safety leadership, stakeholder communication, quality assurance and reporting
  • Experience in rail corridor environments and understanding of rail safety assurance requirements (ARTC / TfNSW advantageous)
  • Greenfield experience highly regarded
  • Availability for site-based, rostered work
  • Strong organisation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen.
  • Valid Class C driver's licence.


What you'll be joining

  • You will join one of the largest infrastructure programs in Australia.
  • This project will generate thousands of jobs and billions of dollars in local investment, boosting regional economies and communities right along the alignment.
  • Inland Rail is proud to have over 40% female representation and we would like to see these numbers grow.

Our Organisation and Culture


The values that drive us and the work we deliver in the program incorporate Collaboration, Accountability, Respect and Excellence. We welcome like-minded individuals who value our culture.

At Inland Rail, we celebrate, support, and thrive on attracting people from all horizons and walks of life for the benefit of our employees, our program, and our community. Inland Rail is proud to be an equal opportunity and an affirmative action employer. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates to submit their details to us.

All employment is decided based on suitability to the role, cultural fit, merit, and business needs.

Apply Now

If this opportunity sounds like the challenge you have been looking for please apply online today.

As part of the application process, you will be required to undergo pre-employment criminal history, reference and medical checks, including drug and alcohol testing. Inland Rail is a drug and alcohol-free working environment.


Please note that applications are reviewed from point of advertising so don't delay your application.

content.jobHook: Digitise, archive and make accessible our extensive language and culture collection, based in a dynamic Aboriginal Language and Cultural Centre.
content.unEditedContent:
Why Join Muurrbay? 

As a leader in Aboriginal language revitalisation, Muurrbay Aboriginal Language and Culture Co-operative is dedicated to language revitalisation, research and education. Our work spans across seven Aboriginal language groups from the Central to the North Coast of NSW, supporting a range of community initiatives, educational programs and publishing projects. We collaborate with Elders, language teachers and communities to ensure that Aboriginal languages thrive for future generations.  

The archivist is responsible for the preservation, digitisation and management of Muurrbay’s extensive collection of language recordings, historical documents and cultural records. This role ensures that materials are stored according to both professional archival standards and Aboriginal cultural protocols.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collection management: Oversee the accessioning, arrangement and description of archival materials including audio recordings of Elders, linguistic research and community stories.

  • Cultural safety: Implement and maintain protocols for Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property, ensuring restricted/sensitive materials are managed correctly.

  • Digitisation: Lead the digitisation of paper records and legacy audio-visual formats to ensure long-term accessibility for language revitalisation projects, liaise with external organisations such as AIATSIS and the National Film and Sound Archive of Australia.

  • Policy Development: Develop a set of policies and procedures for the archives, including supporting community and staff access and use.

  • System Administration: Serve as the lead administrator for the platform (Keeping Culture or other) managing user permissions and content accessibility based on cultural protocols.

  • Data migration and entry: Oversee the upload and cataloguing of audio, video, photos and documents, ensuring accurate metadata.

  • Staff training and mentorship: Deliver training programs for Muurrbay staff.

  • Cultural protocol implementation: Use tools to apply specific access restrictions (e.g. Men’s/Women’s business, deceased persons) to reflect local Aboriginal knowledge frameworks.

  • Community access: Assist community members and researchers in identifying and accessing relevant records for language learning and family history.

Professionalism

  • Well-presented, friendly, courteous and obliging when dealing with community members and colleagues

  • Represent the centre in a confident and positive manner

  • Ensure communication is factual, accurate and presented in a clear and concise manner.

Other

  • Any other duties as requested by the General Manager or Regional Languages Co-ordinator that are required to fulfill Muurrbay’s goals.


Position Highlights:

  • Full-time position, reporting to Regional Languages Co-ordinator.

  • Wage will depend on skills and experience.

  • Salary sacrifice options.

  • Work in a supportive organisation with an Employee Assistance Program.

  • Location: Muurrbay office in Nambucca Heads with occasional visits to Southern Office in Raymond Terrace.

  • Rental subsidy available for the right candidate.

  • Provided with laptop, monitor and professional ICT support.

  • Fixed-term contract: to 30 June 2027.

  • Probationary period: Six months.

 

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who is committed to supporting the revitalisation of Aboriginal languages, through professional archiving, and who brings:

  • A deep understanding of Aboriginal languages and culture.

  • Experience in archiving project management.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • The ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and communities.

We strongly encourage people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander descent to apply.


Selection Criteria

Essential

sections: Why Join Muurrbay?

As a leader in Aboriginal language revitalisation, Muurrbay Aboriginal Language and Culture Co-operative is dedicated to language revitalisation, research and education. Our work spans across seven Aboriginal language groups from the Central to the North Coast of NSW, supporting a range of community initiatives, educational programs and publishing projects. We collaborate with Elders, language teachers and communities to ensure that Aboriginal languages thrive for future generations.

The archivist is responsible for the preservation, digitisation and management of Muurrbay’s extensive collection of language recordings, historical documents and cultural records. This role ensures that materials are stored according to both professional archival standards and Aboriginal cultural protocols.
Key Responsibilities
Collection management: Oversee the accessioning, arrangement and description of archival materials including audio recordings of Elders, linguistic research and community stories.
Cultural safety: Implement and maintain protocols for Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property, ensuring restricted/sensitive materials are managed correctly.

Digitisation: Lead the digitisation of paper records and legacy audio-visual formats to ensure long-term accessibility for language revitalisation projects, liaise with external organisations such as AIATSIS and the National Film and Sound Archive of Australia.
Policy Development: Develop a set of policies and procedures for the archives, including supporting community and staff access and use.
System Administration: Serve as the lead administrator for the platform (Keeping Culture or other) managing user permissions and content accessibility based on cultural protocols.
Data migration and entry: Oversee the upload and cataloguing of audio, video, photos and documents, ensuring accurate metadata.
Staff training and mentorship: Deliver training programs for Muurrbay staff.
Cultural protocol implementation: Use tools to apply specific access restrictions (e.g. Men’s/Women’s business, deceased persons) to reflect local Aboriginal knowledge frameworks.
Community access: Assist community members and researchers in identifying and accessing relevant records for language learning and family history.
Professionalism
Well-presented, friendly, courteous and obliging when dealing with community members and colleagues
Represent the centre in a confident and positive manner
Ensure communication is factual, accurate and presented in a clear and concise manner.

Full-time position, reporting to Regional Languages Co-ordinator.

Salary sacrifice options.

content.unEditedContent:
Sales & Estimating Engineer – BMS & Mechanical Electrical

Clayton, Victoria


We’re looking for a Sales & Estimating Engineer who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and helping deliver smart, energy-efficient building solutions.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in BMS, mechanical electrical works, HVAC controls, electrical systems or building technologies who wants to be part of a business that’s growing, evolving and genuinely enjoyable to work in.

At Evolv Building Technologies, we specialise in Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS) and mechanical-electrical installations, delivering practical, clever solutions that improve building performance and sustainability.

We’re experiencing strong growth, which means real opportunity for the right person to develop their career, broaden their experience and make a genuine impact.

But growth is only part of the story.

We’ve worked hard to build a team culture where people support each other, enjoy coming to work, and feel trusted to do their best work. We believe good results come from good people working together, without ego, unnecessary pressure or corporate nonsense.

One of our core values is:

“Enjoyable – There’s no work and life, just life!”

That doesn’t mean we don’t work hard, we absolutely do. It means we value creating an environment where people enjoy what they do, enjoy who they work with, and feel supported while doing it.

You’ll be joining a united team with plenty of technical support, experienced people around you, and a business that wants to see you succeed.


Your role will include:

  • Preparing BMS and mechanical-electrical estimates and proposals

  • Reviewing project documentation and specifications

  • Working closely with clients, consultants and contractors

  • Assisting with solution design and value engineering

  • Supporting tender submissions and sales activities

  • Developing strong client relationships

  • Collaborating with project delivery teams to ensure smooth handovers

  • Contributing ideas and improvements to systems and processes

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience in BMS, HVAC controls, electrical, mechanical-electrical or building services

  • Estimating, technical sales or project engineering experience

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills

  • A practical, solutions-focused mindset

  • A willingness to learn and grow

  • A team-first attitude that aligns with our culture

What you’ll get from us:

  • A supportive and experienced team

  • A genuinely positive workplace culture

  • Career growth opportunities in a rapidly growing business

  • Exposure to exciting and diverse projects

  • Ongoing development and mentoring

  • A flexible and collaborative environment

  • 38-hour week with monthly RDO


If you’re looking for a role where you can build your career, enjoy the people around you, and be part of a business heading somewhere exciting, we’d love to hear from you.

content.jobHook: Senior Automation Engineer role leading PLC/SCADA projects, commissioning, and technical mentoring at NEPEAN Power in Thornton.
content.unEditedContent:
NEPEAN Power – Thornton, NSW

About Us:

At NEPEAN™, we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services, and industrial manufacturing organisation. For more than 40 years, we have delivered innovative and sustainable solutions to some of the world’s leading mining, construction, transport, and industrial companies.

Today, NEPEAN employs more than 2,000 people across six continents and exports products and services to over 65 countries worldwide.

NEPEAN Power is a recognised leader in electrical and automation solutions, supporting the mining, construction, utilities, and industrial sectors with high-quality, reliable technology and engineering expertise.

The Opportunity:

NEPEAN Power is seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to join our growing Automation team based in Thornton, NSW.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong and hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex automation challenges while also providing leadership and mentoring to engineers and technicians.

You will play a key role in the design, development, commissioning, and continuous improvement of industrial control systems, ensuring NEPEAN Power’s equipment meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance across both workshop and onsite environments.

Key Responsibilities:
 
Technical Leadership
  • Lead PLC, SCADA, HMI, and VSD software development, configuration, and commissioning activities.
  • Provide technical guidance and support during testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
  • Assist with integrating new automation technologies and products into NEPEAN Power standard designs.
Engineering & Project Management
  • Oversee engineering deliverables, project progress, labour allocation, and project costs.
  • Coordinate team resources in collaboration with the Automation Manager.
  • Mentor and support engineers and technicians to build team capability and technical excellence.
  • Maintain engineering management systems including Jira, Tempo, and associated workflows.
Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation across engineering documentation, control systems, and digital processes.
  • Develop and improve engineering procedures, templates, and workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Liaise with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and deliver project outcomes.
  • Identify customer needs, system enhancements, and optimisation opportunities.
Safety & Compliance
  • Apply SWMS, WHS procedures, and risk assessments in all engineering activities.
  • Ensure all equipment complies with NEPEAN Power quality and compliance standards.
  • Report and address workplace hazards in a timely manner.
About You:

To be successful in this role, you will bring strong automation engineering capability combined with leadership and problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
  • Electrical trade qualification and/or engineering qualification.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in industrial automation.
  • Proven experience in PLC/SCADA development, testing, and commissioning.
  • Strong fault-finding and troubleshooting capability across complex control systems.
Technical & Professional Skills
  • Strong knowledge of PLCs, VSDs, HMI/SCADA systems, and industrial communications.
  • Excellent organisational, analytical, and time management skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
  • Ability to mentor and guide team members while supporting project delivery.
  • Flexible and adaptable approach with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • High-level computer literacy and experience using digital engineering tools.
Why NEPEAN:
  • Work on complex and technically challenging automation projects.
  • Opportunity to lead innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Long-term career development opportunities across the wider NEPEAN Group.
  • Supportive team culture with strong technical expertise and collaboration.
  • Competitive salary package and long-term job stability with an Australian industry leader.
To Apply

If you are ready to take the next step in your automation engineering career and make a meaningful impact within a growing organisation, we would love to hear from you. 

Apply now to join NEPEAN Power as our next Senior Automation Engineer.

NEPEAN is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, culturally and linguistically diverse communities, people living with disability, and members of the LGBTIQ+ community.

content.jobHook: A Barista is responsible for preparing and serving high-quality coffee, espresso-based drinks, and other beverages to customers in a café
content.unEditedContent:
At kloud99 , we're passionate about crafting exceptional coffee and creating an unforgettable experience for our guest. As the best-in- business class café in town, we pride ourselves on serving high-quality coffee, delicious pastries, and providing a warm, welcoming atmosphere. We're seeking a skilled and enthusiastic Barista to join our dynamic team and elevate our café to even greater heights.

What We’re Looking For:Junior Team Member

Passion for Coffee: A deep love for coffee, from the bean to the brew.

Experience: Previous experience as a Barista or in a similar customer-facing role is a plus, but we’re willing to train the right candidate with a positive attitude!

Customer-Focused: Excellent communication skills and a genuine love for making customers feel welcome and valued.

Team Player: Collaborative, friendly, and able to work seamlessly with others in a fast-paced environment.

Attention to Detail: Ability to craft consistent, high-quality drinks and maintain a clean, organised workspace.

Creativity: Willingness to learn and experiment with new techniques and ideas, from latte art to seasonal beverages.

Responsibilities:

Prepare and serve espresso-based drinks, brewed coffee, and tea with precision and care.

Maintain the cleanliness of the café and equipment to ensure a hygienic environment.

Engage with customers, providing friendly service and expert recommendations.

Operate the cash register and manage customer orders efficiently.

Assist with inventory management and restocking supplies.

Stay up to date with industry trends and continuously improve skills.

What We Offer:

Competitive pay.

Employee discounts on all food and beverages.

A fun and supportive work environment with room for growth and career advancement.

Opportunities for coffee education and training.

Flexible scheduling options to fit your lifestyle.

How to Apply: Before submitting your application, please ensure that you've read at least two articles about coffee and coffee beans.

If you're ready to be a part of our incredible team and contribute to making Kloud 99  the best café in town, send your resume and a brief cover letter to [email address] or drop them off in person at 
We can’t wait to meet you and share our passion for great coffee!

Evolv Building Technologies
Clayton, Melbourne VIC
Project Management (Engineering)
Full Time

We’re looking for an experienced BMS Project Manager who enjoys delivering quality projects, building strong client relationships, and being part of a team that genuinely works well together.

At Evolv Building Technologies, we specialise in Building Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS) and mechanical-electrical installations, delivering smart and practical solutions that improve building performance and sustainability.

We’re growing quickly, with a strong pipeline of exciting projects and clients. This creates real opportunity for experienced people who want to take ownership, contribute to the direction of the business, and continue developing professionally.

What makes this role different is the environment you’ll be working in.

We’ve built a culture around collaboration, support and enjoyment. We work hard, back each other, and genuinely enjoy what we do. There’s no big corporate hierarchy or politics, just good people working together to deliver great outcomes.

One of our core values is:

“Enjoyable – There’s no work and life, just life!”

  • Client and stakeholder management

  • Programming and project planning

  • Procurement and subcontractor coordination

  • Financial and commercial management of projects

  • Site management and commissioning coordination

  • Managing project performance, reporting and delivery outcomes

  • Supporting and mentoring junior team members

  • Driving continuous improvement in systems and processes

  • Strong experience delivering BMS projects

  • Experience in mechanical-electrical or building services environments

  • Excellent client-facing and communication skills

  • Strong commercial and organisational capability

  • A practical, solutions-focused mindset

  • Leadership capability and a collaborative approach

  • A team-first attitude that aligns with our culture

What you’ll get from us:

  • A supportive and experienced team environment

  • A genuinely positive and enjoyable workplace culture

  • Career progression opportunities in a growing business

  • Diverse and technically interesting projects

  • Autonomy and trust in your role

content.jobHook: lade Group a long historied recruitment agency seek a Senior Recruitment Consultant to join the team - white collar professional roles
content.unEditedContent:
About Slade Group
Slade Group is a purpose led recruitment business known for delivering high-quality talent solutions and building long-term partnerships with clients and candidates alike. We pride ourselves on our professional, high performing, collaborative culture and our commitment to excellence. This has led to Slade becoming a trusted recruitment partner to leading organisations across the market, with some client relationships spanning across decades. What sets us apart is that we partner with purpose-led organisations that are genuinely passionate about their industry – they are the leaders and the innovators. Our clients value true collaboration and partnership, making them enjoyable partners to work with.

The Role
We are seeking an experienced a Senior Recruitment Consultant to join our team and make a significant contribution to the continued growth of the business. This role presents an excellent opportunity for a high-performing recruitment professional with a strong track record in client relationship management, business development, and the mentoring of junior consultants. The successful candidate will have experience recruiting across white-collar professional disciplines and will be comfortable working with a diverse portfolio of white collar professional roles.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the full 360° recruitment lifecycle, from business development through to successful placement.
Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships through a consultative, partnership-led approach.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within your specialist market.
Source, assess, and place high-calibre candidates across a range of roles.
Provide clients with informed market insights and recruitment advice.
Support and mentor junior consultants where required.
Contribute to strategic discussions and forums.
About You
Minimum 5 years’ experience in recruitment.
Proven track record of successful client development.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Commercially minded with a proactive, self-driven approach.
Ability to manage multiple roles and competing priorities effectively.
Learning-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.
Passion for recruitment and delivering outstanding client and candidate experiences.
What We Offer
Competitive base salary and commission package.
Clear career progression and leadership opportunities.
Supportive, high-performing, and collaborative team culture.
Ongoing training and professional development.
Flexible working options (where applicable).
For further information please contact Slade Group General Manager Evan Xeres on e: exeres@sladegroup.com.au or m:0488 55 22 42

json.title: Dentist

content.unEditedContent:
Join Our Collaborative Team at Perfect Dental Care!

Perfect Dental Care in Tallawong is on the lookout for an enthusiastic and skilled dentist to join our friendly, patient-focused team. With a principal dentist who maintains a consistently busy book, we're seeking a clinician who is ready to hit the ground running and become an integral part of our thriving community-based practice.

As a group practice, and a part of the wider My Local Dentists Group, we offer a comprehensive range of dental services, including surgical extractions, implants, and orthodontics, all delivered with a strong focus on the needs of our local community. We take pride in providing high-quality dental care for patients of all ages and encourage a collaborative and supportive team environment. Our team regularly participates in CPD and social events, fostering both professional growth and meaningful team connections.

About the Practice:

  • A well-supported practice with a strong, loyal patient base

  • Fully digital clinic: Praktika (cloud-based PMS), OPG and Lat Ceph, Conebeam CT digital scanner, and digital PSP X-rays

  • Services include general dentistry, orthodontics, and surgical procedures

  • Focused on quality, continuity of care, and community connection

  • Access to CPD opportunities and a supportive group culture.

About You:

  • Strong clinical skills and a commitment to delivering high-quality, patient-centred care

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to interact with patients of all ages and backgrounds

  • Dedication to continuing professional development

  • A team player who thrives in a collaborative environment

  • Availability on Saturdays

  • Ideal for someone looking for long-term employment in a supportive, vibrant practice

Looking for Your Next Big Step?

If you're passionate about dentistry and looking to grow your career within a well-established clinic, we’d love to hear from you.

Remuneration:

  • Competitive percentage-based remuneration (36-40%) depending on experience

If you're looking to join a team that values professional development, a supportive culture, and long-term growth, apply via Seek—no direct emails to the clinic, please.

json.title: Project Engineer

content.jobHook: Infrastructure Specialist in Morningside, QLD as a Project Engineer, competitive salary, no built-in Saturdays, and paid overtime when required.
content.unEditedContent:
Who We Are and What We Stand For:

Vaughan Civil are one of the industry’s leading Civil Utility Infrastructure Specialists across the eastern coast with a presence in NSW and QLD. We put our steady growth and trusted reputation with our clients down to our people! Our staff, both site and office, are instrumental to our continued growth and achievements.

The Role:

We are seeking a Project Engineer to join our team in Morningside. The successful applicant must have a minimum 4 years civil engineering experience with 3 years specifically related to the utility and infrastructure sector.

Competencies Required for the Role:

  • Demonstrated civil engineering experience in the utility and infrastructure sector
  • Ability to coordinate all aspects of a projects and deliver key construction requirements in line with safety, quality, budget & time
  • Knowledge of the relevant legislation, standards and codes of practice
  • Understanding contractual agreements, preparing claims and dispute management
  • Expert leadership and negotiation skills
  • Attending project meetings, preparing progress updates, and maintaining clear communication with clients.
  • Overseeing project timelines, budgets, and resource allocations
  • Keeping track of and reporting project progression, identifying potential risks, and devising strategies for risk mitigation.

What’s on Offer:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Opportunity for Career Progression
  • No built-in Saturday work
  • Paid overtime if Saturdays are required.
  • Friendly and supportive work environment
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Company Vehicle and additional benefits

Apply today!

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all backgrounds to apply. We encourage applications from Australian Defence Force veterans and reservists and value the transferable skills gained through military service, including leadership, teamwork, and problem solving.

Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

json.title: ASP Level 1 Electrician, Cable Jointer & Trade Assistant.

content.jobHook: Electrician, Cable Jointer & Trade Assistant - (ASP1 experience), excellent remuneration, company vehicle (For Trades person), roster days.
content.unEditedContent:
Nexus Power is a specialist level 1, 2 & 3 ASP operating in NSW. Nexus Power’s operators have over 30 years’ experience in the industry, with a focus on structuring their services to meet the needs of their customers. Due to strong demand for their services and rapid growth, Nexus Power is looking for a motivated and focused individuals to join their team as Trade Assistant, Electrician or Cable Jointer.

The successful applicant will be involved in, but not limited to the following:

·         Cabling work;

·         Cable & conduit installation work;

·         Terminating pillars and streetlights;

·         Pit & pipe work; and

·         Substation kiosk installation.

To join this high performing team, it is essential you have the following:

·          ASP1 Experience

·         WHS White Card (General Construction Induction Card)                         

·         HR license (highly desirable);

·         Ability to work at heights;

·         Industry experience (on-site work);

·         Ability to work well in a team environment;

·         Ability to follow instructions;

·         Willingness to learn and a genuine interest in the industry;

·         Ability to work flexible hours Mon / Friday / Weekends;

.         Willingness to adhere to all company Policies, Procedures and legislative compliances;

The following will be considered desirable:

·         Excavator ticket (highly desirable);

·         Forklift ticket (highly desirable)

Nexus Power is seeking an experienced, reliable, focused and team orientated individual who is committed to quality and service. Nexus Power is committed to ensuring safety in the workplace at all times. The successful applicant will have a high level of initiative and awareness of workplace safety, and be willing to work to meet the needs of the business for an immediate start. 

In return, Nexus Power will offer an excellent renumeration, accrual of Roster day every month.

The successful applicant may have a number of future training opportunities made available to them. Nexus Power is looking for someone committed to developing and growing with the business.

If this sounds like the type of role that you would be suited for, please include a resume and a copy of your White Card with your application.

Applications will close on 13th June 2026

bulletPoints: NEPEAN Longwall
Paget, Mackay QLD
4-Day Compressed Working Week
content.jobHook: Local Paget position offering a 4-day compressed working week.
content.unEditedContent:
• NEPEAN Longwall
  • Paget, Mackay QLD 
  • 4-Day Compressed Working Week

NEPEAN Longwall is a leading provider of specialised mining equipment and services to Australia’s underground coal industry. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Workshop Electrician to join our team based in Paget in Mackay QLD. 

This is a local, workshop-based role offering a 4-day compressed working week, providing genuine work–life balance while working on high-quality underground mining equipment.

About the Role

Reporting to the Electrical Supervisor, you will be responsible for carrying out both minor and major repairs on a variety of underground mining equipment and electrical components within the NEPEAN Longwall facility.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Electrical assembly, overhaul, and fit-out of longwall and mining equipment
  • Fault finding, diagnostics, function testing, and repairs
  • Control and power wiring of electrical equipment
  • Interpreting electrical schematics and scopes of work
  • Maintenance of onsite fixed and mobile plant
  • Testing, commissioning, and quality assurance of equipment
  • Maintaining calibration of test equipment
  • Ensuring all equipment, machinery, and tooling is kept in good working order
  • Accurate document control and progress reporting
  • Liaising with Project Coordinators to meet deadlines and priorities
  • Work in accordance with Safe Work Instructions and WHS procedures
  • Ensure all work complies with company systems, policies, and quality standards

About You

  • Electrical Trade Certificate (essential)
  • Current Electrical Licence (QLD or NSW depending on location)
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a similar role or leading hand capacity
  • Forklift licence (required)
  • Experience in workshop or heavy industrial environments
  • Underground coal or mining equipment experience (highly regarded)
  • Strong ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and schematics
  • Excellent fault-finding and problem-solving skills
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
  • Reliable, team-oriented, and proactive approach
  • Applicants must be living locally or be willing to relocate

What NEPEAN Offers

  • 4-day compressed working week
  • Competitive hourly rate plus penalties
  • Secure, full-time employment
  • Modern workshop facilities
  • Career development within a growing national business
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Local role – no FIFO

If you’re looking for a stable workshop role with excellent work–life balance and the opportunity to work with a respected industry leader, we’d love to hear from you.  Apply now to join NEPEAN Longwall.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also includes various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

content.unEditedContent:
About the role

Hylin West Leederville is seeking an experienced Bar/Cafe Chef to join our team in West Leederville. As a full-time Bar/Cafe Chef, you will play a vital role in crafting and preparing high-quality food offerings that delight our customers and align with our café's brand and flavour profile.

This full-time position requires availability for some evening and night shifts.

What you'll be doing

  1. Prepare and execute a variety of dishes for the café and bar

  2. Collaborate with the Head Chef to develop new menu items

  3. Assist in the training and supervision of kitchen staff

  4. Manage kitchen inventory and order supplies as needed

  5. Contribute to a positive and productive kitchen environment

  6. Maintain strict food safety and hygiene standards in the kitchen

What we're looking for

  1. Minimum 2 years' experience as a chef in a café, restaurant, or similar food service establishment

  2. Strong working knowledge of food preparation, plating, and food safety best practices

  3. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced kitchen environment

  4. Creative flair and passion for developing new menu items

At Hylin, we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment for our team. In addition to a competitive full time salary of between $77,000 - 80,000, you will enjoy:

  1. Opportunities for ongoing training and professional development

Our mission is to provide our customers with an exceptional café/ bar experience through high-quality coffee, food and exceptional service. As a growing business, we are seeking passionate individuals to join our team and help us continue to deliver on this promise.

If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply now.

content.jobHook: Level 3 Designer and Drafter.
content.unEditedContent:
Nexus Power is a specialist level 1, 2 & 3 ASP operating in the Hunter region and Central Coast. Nexus Power’s operators have over 30 years’ experience in the industry, with a focus on structuring their services to meet the needs of their customers. Due to strong demand for their services and rapid growth, Nexus Power is looking for a motivated and focused individuals to join their team as Electrical Design Engineer and Drafter.

The successful applicant will be involved in, but not limited to the following:

  • Level 3 Design for Essential Energy and Ausgrid.

  • Private Subdivisions.

  • Asset Relocation.

  • NBN.

  • Streetlight Upgrades.

To join this high performing team, it is essential you have the following:

  • ASP3 Experience.

  • WHS White Card (General Construction Induction Card).                    

  • Ability to work well in a team environment.

  • Ability to follow instructions.

  • Willingness to learn and a genuine interest in the industry.

  • Ability to work flexible hours Mon / Friday.

  • Willingness to adhere to all company Policies, Procedures and legislative compliances.

The following will be considered desirable:

  • Level 3 experience with Ausgrid and Essential Energy.

  • CAD experience.

  • Neara experience.

Nexus Power is seeking an experienced, reliable, focused and team orientated individual who is committed to quality and service. Nexus Power is committed to ensuring safety in the workplace at all times. The successful applicant will have a high level of initiative and awareness of workplace safety and be willing to work to meet the needs of the business for an immediate start. 

In return, Nexus Power will offer an excellent renumeration and an accrual of Roster Day every month.

The successful applicant may have a number of future training opportunities made available to them. Nexus Power is looking for someone committed to developing and growing with the business.

If this sounds like the type of role that you would be suited for, please include a resume and a copy of your White Card with your application.

content.jobHook: Join a passionate culinary team. Competitive remuneration and opportunities for career growth.
content.unEditedContent:
About the role

We are seeking experienced and talented chefs to join our team at The Boatshed La Perouse in La Perouse NSW 2036. These multiple full-time roles are an exciting opportunity to be a key part of our vibrant restaurant and contribute to the overall success of our business.

Chef responsibilities

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking high-quality, creative dishes using fresh, seasonal ingredients

  • Maintaining excellent standard of food presentation and portion control

  • Collaborating with the kitchen team to develop new menu items and optimise kitchen operation

  • Work closely with the Head Chef, Restaurant Managers to monitor feedback on popularity of all dishes

  • Ensuring compliance with all food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Assisting with inventory management and stock control

  • Providing exceptional customer service and contributing to a positive team culture

  • Maintaining a clean and safe working environment ensuring compliance with all food safety legislation and food handling policies and procedures

  • Managing and supervising the day-to-day operations of the kitchen

 What we're looking for

  1. Significant experience in a reputable restaurant or similar hospitality establishment (1 year minimum )

  2. Strong knowledge of food preparation techniques, flavour profiles and current food trends

  3. Excellent time management and multitasking abilities to handle a fast-paced environment

  4. Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high quality standards

  5. Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and contribute to a positive kitchen culture

  6. Relevant qualifications in Hospitality, Culinary Arts or a related field

What we offer

At The Boatshed La Perouse', we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment for our employees. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, grow your career and be part of a passionate team dedicated to delivering an exceptional dining experience. We offer competitive remuneration, opportunities for career progression and a range of employee benefits to support your work-life balance.

About us

The Boatshed La Perouse' is a renowned waterfront restaurant located in the iconic La Perouse precinct. We pride ourselves on our commitment to sourcing the freshest local produce and creating innovative, flavourful dishes that celebrate the best of Australian cuisine. As part of our team, you will be instrumental in upholding our reputation for excellence and contributing to the continued success of our establishment.

If you're an experienced and talented Chef who is passionate about food and delivering exceptional customer service, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to be considered for these exciting opportunities.

content.jobHook: Unique opportunity to drive product direction, technical leadership and delivery capability across a diverse software ecosystem
content.unEditedContent:
Due to growth, our client is seeking an experienced Product and Technology Lead to help drive product direction, technical leadership and delivery capability across a diverse software ecosystem.

This is a unique opportunity for a commercially minded product and technology leader who enjoys operating in fast-moving environments and wants genuine influence over product evolution, engineering standards and delivery execution.

About the role:

The successful candidate will work closely with leadership, developers and designers to improve product quality, strengthen engineering workflows, guide technical decision-making and support the continued growth of the company's software portfolio.

The role offers significant ownership, direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to help shape the long-term technical and product direction of a scaling software company.

The role has strong long-term potential to evolve into a broader CTO leadership position as the business scales.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Technology Leadership

  • Help define product priorities, feature direction and technical initiatives across multiple software products
  • Identify product gaps, usability issues and opportunities to improve customer experience
  • Provide technical leadership across architecture, scalability, security, DevOps and software quality
  • Review and improve existing technical approaches, workflows and delivery practices

Team & Operational Support

  • Assist with hiring, onboarding and management of developers, designers and technical resources
  • Guide developers and technical contributors across front end, back end and infrastructure projects
  • Improve delivery processes, technical documentation, SOPs and workflow management
  • Maintain oversight of timelines, priorities, blockers and project risks
  • Support QA processes and product reliability standards
  • Support coordination across distributed and offshore teams where required
  • Help improve operational structure, execution capability and team efficiency

Required Experience

  • Strong technical capability across modern software development practices and architectures
  • Exposure across front end, back end, infrastructure, DevOps and security principles
  • Experience leading or mentoring developers, designers or technical teams
  • Strong product thinking with the ability to identify friction points and improve user outcomes
  • Experience delivering software products, features or platforms from concept through to release
  • Strong organisational capability across delivery management, workflows, documentation and SOPs
  • Ability to operate autonomously and solve problems proactively
  • Startup or scale-up experience

To be considered for the role click the 'apply' button or for more information about this and other opportunities please contact Anita Cunningham on 07 33395626 or email: acunningham@paxus.com.au

Paxus values diversity and welcomes applications from Indigenous Australians, people from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, and people living with a disability. The recruitment and selection process varies, and some roles may include completion of pre-employment assessments, in-person or online interviews, psychometric testing, written assessments, scenario-based tasks, presentations, and pre-employment checks such as medical (including drug and alcohol), criminal history, or financial. If you require an adjustment to any part of the recruitment process, including the application form or assessments completed in an alternate format, please contact me using the above details. As part of our ongoing commitment to accessibility, we are also in the process of updating our website to reach full conformance with WCAG 2.2 AA. If you experience any difficulties, please contact me on the above details.

json.title: Junior Estimator

content.jobHook: We are seeking an Estimator to join our team, with opportunities for Junior Estimators looking to grow their careers.
content.unEditedContent:
Black Diamond Group owns and operates a portfolio of businesses specializing in modular buildings and remote and temporary workforce housing solutions, along with a digital marketplace for business-to-business crew travel management. We create value by providing differentiated solutions. We believe each customer and each project is unique and that we can tailor a combination of products and services that deliver an enhanced outcome. Our Way is to Create a Better Way – this is our challenge, our call to action, our why!


We believe that a clear strategic vision, with measurable objectives, along with disciplined accountability and data-based decision-making leads to successful outcomes. When we couple this approach with our values-driven, collaborative, safety conscious culture, we achieve top decile performance, deliver results, and have fun while doing it!


We offer careers, not jobs, and we strive for an environment where the best people come to work and feel rewarded for their contributions. We are a team of the best and the brightest in industry, and since our inception, we have led with a people-first approach. We give our employees ample opportunity to pursue their interests and passions and support them as their careers progress.


Black Diamond Group's Workforce Solutions Australia Division has a full-time position for an Estimator. Opportunity for a Junior Estimator to be considered and trained.

Reporting To: Project Manager

Location: Brisbane Branch, Northern Gold Coast location

Primary Role:

To be successful in this role you will have to provide excellent customer service and successfully manage estimating and reporting expectations across the business. Strong administrative, IT, written and verbal communications and organizational skills are vital to meet this need.

You will also have excellent skills in time management and the ability to build strong relationships with our clients.

Duties and Responsibilities:

· Produce educated and accurate reports, quotes, estimates and assist in construction programming as required.

· Ensure all provided information is compliant with current industry standards and formats

· Maintain good overall knowledge of current market rates including keeping up to date price book

· Review, interpret and evaluate a range of technical documents including relevant and regulatory legislation of the Building & Construction industry

· Ensure client and internal KPIs are met throughout the claim process

· Liaise effectively with subcontractors and suppliers to ensure project understanding and accurate costing.


Qualifications:

· 2+ Years in Commercial/Residential Estimating

· A minimum of 1-2 years of commercial or residential estimating experience is required for junior candidates entering the role

· Strong WHS awareness

· Tertiary education in Building and Construction is preferred

· Previous modular industry knowledge is helpful but not mandatory

· Strong background and experience with tendering projects including New manufacture and hire industry

· Sound knowledge of market rates and requirements

· Ability to meet strict deadlines

· Ability to work autonomously

· The successful candidate will have the willingness to develop, learn new skills, be adaptable to new environments and grow within the company.

· Ability to read and interpret plans

· Experience with MS Office suite


Black Diamond Modular Buildings P/L is a business unit of Black Diamond Group. Black Diamond rents and[AG1] sells modular space solutions and workforce accommodation solutions to customers in Canada, the United States and Australia.. We serve diverse sectors including oil and gas, mining, power, construction, engineering, military, government, and education.

For more information, please visit www.BlackDiamondGroup.com.au


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

Black Diamond Group Limited is committed to diversity, equal opportunity and ensuring that our employees have the ability to thrive in an inclusive environment. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, veteran status, Indigenous status, national origin, age, disability or any other legally-protected factors. Provision for applicants with disabilities is available upon request during the recruitment process.

Company: Black Diamond Modular Buildings P/L

content.unEditedContent:
Take a chance, progress your career and discover all that the Wide Bay has to offer.

Your opportunity: 

  • Provide advanced clinical pharmacy services, professional leadership and operational management to the medical work units and associated multidisciplinary teams within Bundaberg Hospital with a focus on patient flow and criteria led discharges. Clinical pharmacy service provision will extend to supporting continuity of care between facilities of Wide Bay Hospital and Health Service and to stakeholders and customers of Queensland Health in accordance with organisational goals.
  • This role requires the successful applicant to work a consistent roster pattern of Friday to Sunday each week including participation in the departments oncall roster.

Find out more in the Role Description.

Our offer:

You will receive a competitive remuneration package value up to $109,020 p.a., comprising salary between $73.13 - $76.30 p.h., employer contribution to superannuation (up to 12.75%) and annual leave loading (17.5%) (HP5) (Permanent Part Time, 48 hours p.f.) (Applications will remain current for 12 months). Job Ad Reference: H2604WB681922.

Other benefits include:   

  • Generous superannuation contribution (up to 12.75%)
  • Annual Leave Loading (17.5%)
  • Fantastic salary sacrificing benefits
  • Professional Development Allowance 
  • Professional Development Leave 
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Lower cost of living

Discover Bundaberg   

Bundaberg and the Coral Coast region is where the coastline meets the country, just four hours' drive north of Brisbane. Indulge in the region's fresh local produce, seafood and iconic drinks and enjoy endless stretches of family-friendly beaches and nearby national parks where you can camp, fish, swim and surf the day away. Bundaberg is the gateway to the Southern Great Barrier Reef and has an enviable year-round climate. The city boasts excellent shopping, sporting, cultural, education and tourism facilities including Mon Repos Turtle Rookery.  

How to apply:

The Role Description and Information Package provide specific information on how to apply for the advertised position. ***APPLICATIONS ARE ONLY ACCEPTED ONLINE***

Join our Hospital and Health Service family and see what it's like to be in a supportive workplace with engaged teams working together to ensure

‘Care, connection and compassion for all'

Great team culture and fun environment
Opportunities for training, development and career growth
content.jobHook: We are seeking an experienced and driven Site Supervisor to lead daily operations within our fast-paced transport and logistics environment.
content.unEditedContent:
About Vella Transport Administration

Vella Transport Administration Pty Ltd is part of an established transport and logistics group operating across Australia. We provide reliable, efficient transport and administration services to a diverse range of clients. Our operations function plays a central role in supporting the business and we are growing our team to meet the demands of an expanding operation.

Our Values

At Vella Transport Administration, we value reliability, integrity, and a commitment to getting things right. We are a close-knit team that supports one another and takes pride in the quality of our work. We are looking for someone who shares these values and is eager to grow with the business.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and driven Site Supervisor to lead daily operations within our fast-paced transport and logistics environment. This role is responsible for overseeing all site operations to ensure freight is received, sorted, loaded, and distributed safely, efficiently, and within designated timeframes.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in managing fleet utilisation, operational compliance, staff performance, site safety, and customer outcomes while driving operational efficiencies and maintaining high service standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on leader with strong transport operations experience and a passion for safety, compliance, and team leadership.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Oversee daily transport and warehouse operations to ensure efficient freight movement and on-time departures

  • Ensure compliance with Mass, Fatigue, Maintenance and Dangerous Goods Management requirements.

  • Lead, coach and support operational staff to achieve performance expectations and facilitate effective communication across shifts and departments.

  • Ensure customer requirements and service expectations are consistently met and respond to any operational issues and customer queries in a professional and timely manner.


About You:

  • Have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in transport management or in a site supervision role.

  • Current Forklift and Heavy Vehicle licences are desirable.

  • Have a strong understanding of transport compliance, safety and operational procedures

  • Excellent leadership, communication and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work autonomously and prioritise competing deadlines

  • High attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.


Why Join Us?

  • Permanent, full-time role with genuine career development opportunities

  • Supportive and experienced team

  • Stable, established organisation with a strong industry presence

  • Opportunity to gain additional accreditation and licences.

 

How to Apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

content.jobHook: Join our Service team at Brendale as a Service Advisor and enjoy the flexibility of a 9 day fortnight!
content.unEditedContent:
🚗 Service Advisors Automotive Industry
📍 Location: Brendale
🕒 Full-time
💼 Department: Service


Backed by one of Australia’s largest automotive groups, Eagers Automotive, we are looking for motivated and customer-focused individuals to join our growing Service Advisor team at Brendale.

 No previous automotive experience is required. Full training will be provided by a strong leadership team alongside multiple long-serving staff and managers with extensive industry experience. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career within the automotive industry in a supportive, structured and high-performing environment.

 Our site processes approximately 80 vehicles per day and operates with a front counter team of 6 across multiple brands including Hyundai, Isuzu Ute, Kia, LDV and MG.

 This role offers a genuine 9-day fortnight with a rotating Monday, Wednesday, Friday day off roster, giving you a long weekend every second week.

 What’s on offer:

·                  9-day fortnight roster

·                  No weekend work

·                  Very competitive base salary with strong commission structure

·                  Full training provided

·                  Supportive leadership team and established processes

·                  Ongoing manufacturer and in-house training

·                  Career progression opportunities across multiple brands and departments

·                  Modern dealership environment backed by Eagers Automotive

 

The role:

·                  Manage customer bookings, vehicle drop-offs and pick-ups

·                  Build and maintain strong customer relationships

·                  Communicate customer concerns clearly to technicians

·                  Provide updates to customers throughout the repair process

·                  Assist in recommending additional service and repair work where required

·                  Help drive customer satisfaction and NPS/CSI performance

·                  Work closely with workshop control, parts and management teams

 

What we’re looking for:

·                  Strong communication and customer service skills

·                  Positive attitude and willingness to learn

·                  Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

·                  Strong organisational and time management skills

content.jobHook: Play a Key role in completing Inland Rail's I2S project - One of Australia's most significant nation-building infrastructure program.
content.unEditedContent:
Rail Delivery & Engineering Professionals (Civil | Track | Structures)

About the opportunity

Inland Rail - Illabo to Stockinbingal (I2S) Greenfield | Active Construction Phase | Immediate needs 14:7 roster | FIFO or DIDO | Project Specified contracts


Roles / Disciplines:

  • Construction Manager
  • Senior Project Engineer - Civil
  • Senior Project Engineer - Track
  • Senior Project Engineer - Civil/Structures
  • Project Engineer - Civil
  • Project Engineer - Track
  • Project Engineer - Civil/Structures
  • Supervisor / Site Surveillance - Civil x 2
  • Supervisor / Site Surveillance - Track x 2

Why join Inland Rail now:

This is your opportunity to be part of one of Australia's most significant nation‑building infrastructure programs-join us now and play a critical role in completing Inland Rail's I2S Project.



About the Project

The Illabo to Stockinbingal (I2S) Greenfield section is a ~39km new rail corridor in regional NSW, creating a more efficient route by bypassing local townships and the steep, winding Bethungra Spiral section.

Construction is ramping up and we're recruiting experienced rail delivery & engineering professionals to support corridor delivery across civil (including structures/culverts, earthworks), rail and road related work packages.


What you'll be working on:
Site-based delivery across packages including bulk earthworks, structures, culverts, track formation rail system interfaces on a 14:7 roster


About you

You are a capable and collaborative construction professional experienced in delivering major rail or linear infrastructure projects, with strong technical capability, clear communication skills, and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

What we're looking for:

  • Proven delivery experience on major rail or linear infrastructure projects
  • Degree in Civil Engineering for the PE & SPEs. Related Construction / Project Management qualifications for the Construction Manager position.
  • Strength across project delivery, safety leadership, stakeholder communication, quality assurance and reporting
  • Experience in rail corridor environments and understanding of rail safety assurance requirements (ARTC / TfNSW advantageous)
  • Greenfield experience highly regarded
  • Availability for site-based, rostered work
  • Strong organisation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen.
  • Valid Class C driver's licence.


What you'll be joining

  • You will join one of the largest infrastructure programs in Australia.
  • This project will generate thousands of jobs and billions of dollars in local investment, boosting regional economies and communities right along the alignment.
  • Inland Rail is proud to have over 40% female representation and we would like to see these numbers grow.

Our Organisation and Culture


The values that drive us and the work we deliver in the program incorporate Collaboration, Accountability, Respect and Excellence. We welcome like-minded individuals who value our culture.

At Inland Rail, we celebrate, support, and thrive on attracting people from all horizons and walks of life for the benefit of our employees, our program, and our community. Inland Rail is proud to be an equal opportunity and an affirmative action employer. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates to submit their details to us.

All employment is decided based on suitability to the role, cultural fit, merit, and business needs.

Apply Now

If this opportunity sounds like the challenge you have been looking for please apply online today.

As part of the application process, you will be required to undergo pre-employment criminal history, reference and medical checks, including drug and alcohol testing. Inland Rail is a drug and alcohol-free working environment.


Please note that applications are reviewed from point of advertising so don't delay your application.
