Manage a...
content.unEditedContent:
Company Description

Are you ready to be a big part of something big? 

At carsales, we’re all about making buying and selling a great experience. Since 1997, we’ve been evolving with the new economy to help people choose how they move today and tomorrow.

When it comes to your career, we want to offer meaningful opportunities that empower you to make a lasting impact. But for that to happen, we strive to feel small, small enough to stay agile, learn across teams, and connect authentically with each other.

With a vision to be the global leader in online vehicle marketplaces, we’re transforming how people buy and sell across the world. We discover new ideas and bring them to life. We continue to grow, and we continue to evolve and we’re not afraid to take bold steps to get there.

This role sits within our visual media team, a customer‑facing group focused on showcasing vehicles through high‑quality imagery. The team works closely with dealership clients, combining creative expertise with strong relationship management to deliver consistent, high‑impact results while living our values of ownership, curiosity, and collaboration.

We embrace hybrid working combining the flexibility of remote work with the energy and connection of in-person collaboration. We champion flexibility and offer a range of policies and leave options to support your wellbeing.

What’s on offer

  • Recognition as one of Australia’s Best Workplaces™ by Great Place to Work®, a Family Friendly Workplace, a WORK180 endorsed employer.
  • A highly engaged, collaborative team where you’ll learn from exceptional talent.
  • 24 weeks paid parental leave for primary caregivers, four weeks for secondary caregivers, and six weeks paid gender-affirming care leave.
  • Regular hackathons, continuous learning opportunities, and wellbeing initiatives that support your mental, emotional, and physical health.

Job Description

What you will do:

  • Understand and share expertise in photography. You will photograph a variety of vehicles that are advertised by our dealership clients.
  • Manage a portfolio of clients, who you will visit regularly to capture their vehicles and assist with any enquiries.
  • Work in a variety of locations, both indoors and out.

Qualifications

  • What we are looking for

  • Demonstrated inclusive and interpersonal attributes that connect you to our behaviours (we change the game, we own it, we step in, we are curious, we don’t take ourselves too seriously).
  • Must haves: own SLR camera kit with an 18-70mm lens as a minimum, an iPhone (preferred), a computer and photo editing software (Adobe Photoshop is preferred), a reliable form of transport, and a valid driver’s licence.
  • A creative flair and passion for photography and videography! An interest in the automotive industry is a bonus.
  • Flexible availability from Monday to Friday.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with clients and internal stakeholders.

As part of your application please submit your resume along with 20 images of a car of your choice detailing the best angles and features of the car. Be sure to include interior and exterior photographs.  Photos will need to be submitted via PDF format. Alternatively, you can include a link to your work. Please note that there is an upload limit of 2MB.

Additional Information

A few other things we want you to know...

  • As an equal opportunity employer, carsales welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and life experiences. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.
  • If you have a disability or require adjustments to participate fully in the recruitment process, please let us know - we’re here to support you.
  • We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements, including part-time options. If you’d like to explore this, just ask during the process.
  • We’re also a proud Circle Back Initiative employer, which means we commit to responding to every applicant.
  • Successful candidates joining the carsales team will need to complete a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights.

So come join us - because every role plays a vital part in our journey toward something big!

As an essential member of the...
content.unEditedContent:
Kingston State College is seeking a dedicated, motivated and collaborative person to join our Administration team.

As an essential member of the school support staff, this position works within our team servicing the Kingston community and will incorporate a range of duties working across areas including but not limited to: Student Services, Client Services, assist with Enrolment management, Finance,

Human Resources and Facilities. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

Who We Are:

Kingston State College is one of Logan's leading bespoke co-educational Independent public schools. Our College consists of a 7-12 High School with over 900 students and the Kingston Learning College with 230 students completing 1-3 subjects from years 10-12.

We provide a variety of learning opportunities to suit individual needs.

Both our campuses accept enrolments from all areas as there is no management plan in place for the College.

Our College's motto is Progress with Pride which means that all members of the Kingston State College community will Progress with Pride towards their personal best.

We have promoted and sustained a school culture based on the values of Commitment, Courtesy, Cooperation and Common sense.

We pride ourselves on “Nothing left to Chance” ensuring our graduates continue to be successful in their transition from school to employment, traineeships, apprenticeships and further education and training.

We feel sure that you will enjoy your time at Kingston State College and appreciate our positive school culture as we work collaboratively to ensure every student achieves academically, socially, and emotionally.

Step Into Your Next Chapter:

The successful candidate will need to have great relational skills with experience in the areas of administration and/or student services, be driven to build a positive, welcoming and supportive school culture.

The position will be multifaceted, working across areas including but not limited to: Student Services, Client Services, assist with Enrolment management, Finance, Human Resources and Facilities.

To be successful in this role, you should display the following:

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good organisational skills.
  • High-level customer service and the ability to work independently.
  • Comfortable multi-tasking and prioritising tasks without guidance and able to manage high-pressure environments.
  • Provide ad-hoc administrative duties. Assist with the financial, human resources, and administrative operations of the office, including skilled use of Microsoft Office applications, OneSchool, OnePortal, SharePoint, and Compass.
  • Knowledge of OneSchool (enrolment process, student, finance). Familiar with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook). Provide a comprehensive range of executive and administrative support services including preparation of accurate and timely reports, correspondence, and other documents where necessary.
  • Operate autonomously to undertake day-to-day office procedures within well-defined policies and utilise information and management systems to support effective and efficient reporting and administration.
  • Be a dedicated team player that works collaboratively with all team members.
  • Able to contribute positively as part of a team, helping out with various tasks as required. Undertake routine activities including client services, student services (telephone and counter enquiries), attending to first aid, arranging correspondence and general administration, maintaining school records, and processing mail and emails.

Submit Your Application:

  • Applications (no more than 2 pages) must outline relevant skills and abilities to support the position as outlined in the Role Description including knowledge and experience, as well as a current Resume with 2 Referees, 1 being your current Supervisor.

We welcome all applicants to share any support needed to ensure our recruitment process is inclusive.

Applications remain current for 12 months from the closing date and may be considered for appointment to identical or similar vacancies within the Department.

Applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted.

content.jobHook: We are seeking an experienced Manager to join KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to high-impact...
content.unEditedContent:
Company Description

For more than 20 years, KordaMentha has supported businesses through some of their most complex matters and opportunities. Founder owned and led; we are an advisory firm that helps corporations, financiers, lawyers, private investors and government clients to grow, protect and recover value.

That’s what we do, but it’s how we do this that makes us who we are.

Proudly independent, strategically local, and with a bias for action to get things done, we focus on doing what is right by our clients, our people, and the wider community. Our track record shows that we help navigate the best path forward in challenging times, and do so across cities, regions and territories.

In the most stressful or demanding environments, we continue to drive change where it really counts.

Job Description

KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team provides independent, outcomes-focused advice across the full real estate lifecycle, supporting clients through some of their most significant and complex property decisions. The team works across high-value assets, sensitive stakeholder environments, matters under public scrutiny and engagements with material financial implications. 

The practice advises private, institutional and government clients across all asset classes, with services spanning transaction and deal advisory, asset and development strategy, and implementation and delivery. A key differentiator is the team’s focus on outcomes — not just reports — by working alongside clients to execute strategies and manage delivery risk. 

This role sits within a nationally integrated real estate advisory platform and forms part of the broader KordaMentha group, providing access to deep multidisciplinary capability and trusted senior relationships across Australia and New Zealand.

We are seeking an experienced Manager to join KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to high-impact engagements, delivering commercial advice across both private and public sector clients, with a particular focus on lender and government-related work.

You will work across the full project lifecycle, from early-stage feasibility analysis and project review through to project delivery, and collaborate across multiple service lines, including Restructuring, Public Sector Advisory and Major Projects Advisory. 

For the successful candidate, this role offers broad exposure and genuine variety, including the opportunity to work alongside senior executives, government and lenders on high-value, high-impact projects across a range of asset classes, client types and delivery models.

As a Manager in the team, you will:

  • Lead delivery of real estate advisory engagements, managing workstreams and aligning outputs with client commercial, policy and governance objectives. 
  • Oversee due diligence and market analysis across assets and portfolios, providing clear, evidence-based insights. 
  • Develop and review financial models and feasibility analyses, ensuring robustness of assumptions and clarity of key risks and value drivers. 
  • Support and manage transaction processes across acquisitions, disposals and developments, including strategy, evaluation and stakeholder coordination. 
  • Lead or contribute to lender-led and asset repositioning engagements, including restructuring and value recovery strategies. 
  • Prepare business cases and investment papers, integrating financial, commercial and policy considerations into decision-ready recommendations. 
  • Deliver high-quality reports, models and presentations tailored to senior stakeholders across government, finance and corporate sectors. 
  • Build client relationships and support team leadership, including mentoring junior staff and contributing to proposals and business development.

Qualifications

We’re looking for a commercially minded advisory professional who combines strong technical capability with sound judgement, stakeholder confidence and a collaborative approach. You will likely bring:

  • 5–6 years’ relevant experience in the private sector or government, for example within consulting, advisory, professional services, government infrastructure teams, treasury or investment banking. 
  • Tertiary qualifications in property, commerce, finance, economics or a related discipline.
  • Strong analytical and financial modelling capability, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. 
  • High-level PowerPoint skills, with the ability to develop clear, structured and compelling presentations. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset. 
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Additional Information

Join KordaMentha — Where Your Growth Is Our Priority

We don’t just hire talent; we invest in it - with support that accelerates your success in every way

Why Join Us?

  • Professional Development: Expert mentorship, tailored training via KordaMentha Business School, study support, and our Accelerate program for Analysts to Associate Directors — build your brand, expand your network, and gain strategic insights from senior leaders
  • Flexibility: We champion work/life integration with options that fit your lifestyle.
  • Career Growth: Merit-based promotions, secondments, and opportunities to work alongside senior leaders on impactful projects.
  • Leave That Works for You: Buy extra leave and access volunteer, generous parental leave and career break options.
  • Culture & Connection: Social events, cultural celebrations, and our bi-ennial black-tie ball.

We approach situations, challenges, and opportunities with optimism, curiosity, and diversity of thought. We seek novel solutions to problems and encourage unconventional and innovative approaches.

sections: Company Description

For more than 20 years, KordaMentha has supported businesses through some of their most complex matters and opportunities. Founder owned and led; we are an advisory firm that helps corporations, financiers, lawyers, private investors and government clients to grow, protect and recover value.
That’s what we do, but it’s how we do this that makes us who we are.

Proudly independent, strategically local, and with a bias for action to get things done, we focus on doing what is right by our clients, our people, and the wider community. Our track record shows that we help navigate the best path forward in challenging times, and do so across cities, regions and territories.
In the most stressful or demanding environments, we continue to drive change where it really counts.
Job Description

KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team provides independent, outcomes-focused advice across the full real estate lifecycle, supporting clients through some of their most significant and complex property decisions. The team works across high-value assets, sensitive stakeholder environments, matters under public scrutiny and engagements with material financial implications.

The practice advises private, institutional and government clients across all asset classes, with services spanning transaction and deal advisory, asset and development strategy, and implementation and delivery. A key differentiator is the team’s focus on outcomes — not just reports — by working alongside clients to execute strategies and manage delivery risk.

This role sits within a nationally integrated real estate advisory platform and forms part of the broader KordaMentha group, providing access to deep multidisciplinary capability and trusted senior relationships across Australia and New Zealand.
We are seeking an experienced
Manager

to join KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to high-impact engagements, delivering commercial advice across both private and public sector clients, with a particular focus on lender and government-related work.

You will work across the full project lifecycle, from early-stage feasibility analysis and project review through to project delivery, and collaborate across multiple service lines, including Restructuring, Public Sector Advisory and Major Projects Advisory.

For the successful candidate, this role offers broad exposure and genuine variety, including the opportunity to work alongside senior executives, government and lenders on high-value, high-impact projects across a range of asset classes, client types and delivery models.
As a Manager in the team, you will:
Lead delivery of real estate advisory engagements, managing workstreams and aligning outputs with client commercial, policy and governance objectives.
Oversee due diligence and market analysis across assets and portfolios, providing clear, evidence-based insights.
Develop and review financial models and feasibility analyses, ensuring robustness of assumptions and clarity of key risks and value drivers.
Support and manage transaction processes across acquisitions, disposals and developments, including strategy, evaluation and stakeholder coordination.
Lead or contribute to lender-led and asset repositioning engagements, including restructuring and value recovery strategies.
Prepare business cases and investment papers, integrating financial, commercial and policy considerations into decision-ready recommendations.
Deliver high-quality reports, models and presentations tailored to senior stakeholders across government, finance and corporate sectors.
Build client relationships and support team leadership, including mentoring junior staff and contributing to proposals and business development.
Qualifications

We’re looking for a commercially minded advisory professional who combines strong technical capability with sound judgement, stakeholder confidence and a collaborative approach. You will likely bring:
5–6 years’ relevant experience in the private sector or government, for example within consulting, advisory, professional services, government infrastructure teams, treasury or investment banking.
Tertiary qualifications in property, commerce, finance, economics or a related discipline.
Strong analytical and financial modelling capability, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
High-level PowerPoint skills, with the ability to develop clear, structured and compelling presentations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
The ability to manage competing priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

content.unEditedContent:
About Nova

NOVA Entertainment is Australia’s fastest growing audio entertainment business, creating experiences loved and shared by audiences. NOVA Entertainment owns and operates the Nova Network, the most listened to metro network in Australia, which includes Nova 96.9 Sydney, Nova 100 Melbourne, Nova 106.9 Brisbane, Nova 93.7 Perth and Nova 919 Adelaide, in addition to Australia’s premium intimate live music brand, Nova’s Red Room.
The company’s broadcast offering is complemented by a range of on-demand assets across digital, social, mobile, including the NOVA Entertainment Podcast Network, which brings together the largest stable of accessible talent in the country to create a suite of quality podcast content that connects audiences and brands.

Our values are integral to who we are. We believe in creating and working in an environment that supports Unwavering Unity, Relentless Curiosity and Radical Empathy

We have an amazing opportunity for you.

We are looking for someone experienced in the Digital Advertising Operations space to oversee the Digital Inventory of our Media Advertising assets. This role is a great opportunity for someone who can manage working independently while knowing when to collaborate and ask questions. You will be part of a friendly, collaborative team within Nova that well and truly punches above their weight and is well respected for their understanding of the Digital Advertising Operations. 

What you will be doing:

As the Digital Inventory Analyst, you will be:

Managing and evolving Nova’s digital audio inventory model across Podcast, Streaming and Retail revenue streams

  • the go-to expert for digital audio inventory and pricing, enabling the commercial team to focus on advertiser conversations
  • Forecasting and modelling digital inventory, identifying opportunities to maximise utilisation and revenue
  • Developing inventory views and frameworks that support a range of campaign types, including sponsorships, audience targeting, direct IO and programmatic activity
  • Collaborating with Pricing, Broadcast Inventory, Digital Audio Commercial and Ad Operations teams to optimise inventory and drive fill rates
  • Supporting annualised trading deals, bonus, barter and holding group discussions with inventory and pricing insights
  • Applying seasonal and market insights to pricing strategies and supporting commercial negotiations

Why we want to meet you – these are some of the skills that may help you succeed in this role (but don’t think you need all of this to apply!)

  • Experience in digital inventory management, yield, or a similar analytical role
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and turn it into clear recommendations
  • Confidence working with inventory forecasting, models and data analytics tools
  • Advanced Excel skills and a strong attention to data accuracy and integrity
  • Ability to apply seasonal, market and environmental insights to commercial decision-making
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work across commercial, pricing and operations teams
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

Why you will love working at NOVA

  • This is a high-profile role that will lead to personal and professional career development in a market leader
  • Workplace flexibility to support a work-life balance
  • Additional leave days: Anniversary & Loyalty leave, Give-back Leave, Mental Wellbeing days, Paid Parental Leave (one of the best programs in Australia)
  • Access to Learning and Development programs & internal opportunities - such as Future Women Scholarships, Internal Mentoring Program etc
  • Access to health and wellbeing initiatives (Nova’s Life+ & Employee Assistance Program, mental health training programs, discounted memberships etc).
  • Frequent staff lunches and survey celebration!
  • Access to the BEST events in town
  • Plus, a whole lot more!

HOT TIP - you will be asked about our audio products and what you love about NOVA so make sure you log in to the Nova Player

Nova Entertainment Diversity & Inclusion Commitment:

 The Aim:
Promote a diverse workforce that invites people of all backgrounds to work and grow with us in their own unique way.

How we do it:

  • Providing a work environment that embraces and values Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
  • Supporting candidates that may have diverse needs by providing reasonable adjustments ensuring each candidate can put their best efforts into their application.
  • By being allies of the LGBTIQA+ community and members of the Welcome Here initiative 
  • By utilising our membership and guidance of the Diversity Council of Australia

@welcomehereproject  #FollowTheRainbow  #ACONWelcomeHere

 What’s next?

  • Only successful applicants will be contacted.
  • Our interview process will involve a telephone interview initially followed by up to 2 face-to-face interviews
  • Police Checks may be required.
  • No Agencies 

Please reach out during the application process if you think you may require any considerations for the recruitment process.

content.jobHook: Our award-winning Creative Services team is looking for a Commercial Producer/Sound Designer/Audio Engineer who lives and breathes audio. Someone...
content.unEditedContent:
ABOUT NOVA:

NOVA Entertainment is Australia’s fastest growing audio entertainment business, creating experiences loved and shared by audiences. NOVA Entertainment owns and operates the Nova Network, the most listened to metro network in Australia, which includes Nova 96.9 Sydney, Nova 100 Melbourne, Nova 106.9 Brisbane, Nova 919 Adelaide and Nova 93.7 Perth, in addition to Australia’s premium intimate live music brand, Nova’s Red Room.

NOVA Entertainment also owns and operates Australia’s feel-good station, Smooth FM in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, the talk station FIVEAA in Adelaide, Star 104.5 on the NSW Central Coast and the DAB+ stations - Smooth Relax, Smooth 80s, Smooth Vintage, Nova Throwbacks, Nova 90s, Nova Nation, and Coles Radio.

Our values are integral to who we are. We believe in creating and working in an environment that supports Unwavering Unity, Relentless Curiosity and Radical Empathy.

The Role:

At Nova Entertainment, sound isn't background noise…it's the whole point.

We're Australia's leading audio destination, and our Brisbane production suite is where that reputation gets made, one cracking spot at a time Across broadcast, streaming, podcast, and retail.

Our award-winning Creative Services team is looking for a Commercial Producer/Sound Designer/Audio Engineer who lives and breathes audio. Someone who hears the difference between good enough and genuinely great and simply cannot let good enough leave the studio.

This isn't your average edit and carting gig. You'll be working across a diverse and fast-moving suite of audio commercials, brand integrations and advertorial delivering all of audio content in a state-of-the-art production studio that takes craft seriously.

You'll direct voice talent, record foley, mix music and shape sonic identity for some of Australia's biggest brands, while collaborating daily with creatives across our network who actually value what you bring to the brief.

What you'll bring:

  • 2+ years in audio production - radio, post-production, or sound design (you know who you are)
  •  A natural ear for direction, music, and sound design that elevates a script beyond the page
  • The organisational instincts to juggle competing deadlines without dropping a single dB
  •  A calm, collaborative presence in the studio - and the technical chops to back it up
  •  Genuine enthusiasm for staying ahead of the curve on tools, tech and trends

What you'll get:

  • A seat in an award-winning, specialist audio studio running the latest version of Protools.
  • Real creative collaboration, cross commercial, strategic teams and of course our clients.
  • The variety and pace of a major market broadcaster with the culture of a team that genuinely gives a sh*t!
  • Brisbane base. National scope.

To support & reward your success in this role we will offer the successful candidate:

  • A high-performance culture where you will work amongst a team that prides itself on being engaged, dynamic and able to leap over any obstacle put before it
  • Exclusive early bird access to the biggest events & concerts across Australia
  • Additional leave days: Anniversary & Loyalty leave, Give back Leave, Mental Wellbeing days
  • Access to Learning and Development programs & internal opportunities
  • Access to health and wellbeing initiatives (Nova’s Life+ & Employee Assistance Program, mental health training programs)
  • Amazing employee benefits from a huge variety of partners nationally (we don’t want to boast, but it is a lot)
  • Frequent staff lunches & survey celebrations (2026 is already shaping up to be a BIG year with some BIG wins)
  • Depending on the needs of the business we are able to explore flexible work options where appropriate.

HOT TIP - you will be asked about our audio products and what you love about NOVA so make sure you log in to the Nova Player.

This is a Full-time position located in our Teneriffe studios. Our teams are dynamic, engaged and highly collaborative and being on-site will ensure your personal and professional career development.

Nova Entertainment Diversity & Inclusion Commitment:

The Aim:

Promote a diverse workforce that invites people of all backgrounds to work and grow with us in their own unique way.

How we do it:

  • Providing a work environment that embraces and values Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion - we have an active and ACRA Award-Winning D&I Committee that is passionate about ensuring Nova Entertainment supports and welcomes people from all abilities and all walks of life. This extends to our community work and sustainable charity initiatives.
  • Supporting candidates that may have diverse needs by providing reasonable adjustments ensuring each candidate can put their best efforts into their application.
  • By being allies of the LGBTIQA+ community and members of the Welcome Here initiative
  • Best utilising our membership and guidance of the Diversity Council of Australia

@welcomehereproject #FollowTheRainbow #ACONWelcomeHere

What’s next?

  • PLEASE ATTACH YOUR RESUME AND A COVER LETTER STATING WHY YOU ARE INTERESTED IN THIS OPPORTUNITY
  • Successful applicants will be contacted within 5-10 working days.
  • Our interview process will involve a telephone interview initially followed by up to 2 face-to-face interviews that may involve a panel and a prepared presentation
  • Police Checks may be required.
  • Please reach out during the application process if you think you may require any considerations for the recruitment process.

Respectfully, No Agencies

content.jobHook: Strategy is looking for an Account Executive to lead strategic sales efforts across enterprise accounts in Melbourne/Australia. Responsibilities...
content.unEditedContent:
Company Description

Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR) is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

Job Description

Strategy is looking for an Account Executive to lead strategic sales efforts across enterprise accounts in Melbourne/Australia. Responsibilities include prospecting, qualifying, selling, and closing new logo business into prospects and installed accounts. This is a new business hunter and individual contributor role with quota carrying responsibility. 

Your Focus

  • Drive complex, enterprise-wide sales cycles and effectively present Strategy’s value proposition to both C-level business and IT stakeholders through strategic value-led engagements

  • Prospect, develop and close new business while creating satisfied and referenceable customers

  • Research the customer environment to create effective business impact models, account plans and win plans; and create business cases, ROI and TCO models

  • Manage all aspects of the sales process including lead generation, qualification, evaluation, close and account care, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales (Inside Sales, Sales Engineering), Marketing and Professional Services

  • Work strategically with Inside Sales to develop a territory and target account plan to create a healthy pipeline that will yield overachievement in booking targets

  • Manage an individual sales pipeline to ensure an appropriate mix of prospects, new business opportunities and firm proposals

  • Balance long-term objectives with short term results to maximize overall revenue generation

  • Meet and exceed direct sales goals within assigned territory

  • Acquire and maintain a thorough working knowledge of Strategy’s Business Intelligence software products and services and a deep understanding of their applications

  • Position Strategy’s solutions through strategic value-based selling, business case definition, return on investment analysis, customer references and analyst data

  • Coordinate and manage industry events and user groups to generate market interest

  • Ensure that all stages of the sales cycle are undertaken effectively to achieve the required results whilst adhering to Strategy’s chosen sales methodology - MEDDPICC

  • Identify and manage risk in his/her business activities and take responsibility for reporting risks in a timely, open, and appropriate manner

  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts and sales cycle reporting using Strategy’s CRM tool

  • Leverage and enhance partner relationships to drive additional value and revenue.

Requirements:

  • Extensive experience of quota-carrying sales of software products and services into large enterprises

  • Demonstrable track record of consistent over-quota sales performance

  • Proven track record of senior level stakeholder engagement on complex IT and Business-led opportunities with referenceable client wins

  • Extensive experience in prospecting, driving, and closing complex enterprise sales cycles

  • Experience in areas such as Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, CRM, ERP, Cloud enterprise software sales

  • Experience with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively, network internally to get things done and be accountable for their decisions; ensuring all stages of sales cycle are running concurrently; opening pipe; progressing; closing deals; prioritizing tasks

  • Demonstrable knowledge of key Return on Investment and Total Cost of Ownership principles

  • A creative self-starter who can work effectively within a supportive team culture whilst independently managing their own business

  • Ability to work in a fast paced, open, collaborative, and success-driven environment

  • A strong storyteller with a customer-centric approach who can quickly build rapport

  • Hungry for success and driven to achieve high financial rewards

  • Degree educated or equivalent academic/work experience

This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.
Job Description
Strategy is looking for an Account Executive to lead strategic sales efforts across enterprise accounts in
Melbourne/Australia

. Responsibilities include prospecting, qualifying, selling, and closing new logo business into prospects and installed accounts. This is a new business hunter and individual contributor role with quota carrying responsibility.
Your Focus
Drive complex, enterprise-wide sales cycles and effectively present Strategy’s value proposition to both C-level business and IT stakeholders through strategic value-led engagements
Prospect, develop and close new business while creating satisfied and referenceable customers
Research the customer environment to create effective business impact models, account plans and win plans; and create business cases, ROI and TCO models

Manage all aspects of the sales process including lead generation, qualification, evaluation, close and account care, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales (Inside Sales, Sales Engineering), Marketing and Professional Services
Work strategically with Inside Sales to develop a territory and target account plan to create a healthy pipeline that will yield overachievement in booking targets
Manage an individual sales pipeline to ensure an appropriate mix of prospects, new business opportunities and firm proposals
Balance long-term objectives with short term results to maximize overall revenue generation
Meet and exceed direct sales goals within assigned territory
Acquire and maintain a thorough working knowledge of Strategy’s Business Intelligence software products and services and a deep understanding of their applications
Position Strategy’s solutions through strategic value-based selling, business case definition, return on investment analysis, customer references and analyst data
Coordinate and manage industry events and user groups to generate market interest
Ensure that all stages of the sales cycle are undertaken effectively to achieve the required results whilst adhering to Strategy’s chosen sales methodology - MEDDPICC
Identify and manage risk in his/her business activities and take responsibility for reporting risks in a timely, open, and appropriate manner
Prepare accurate sales forecasts and sales cycle reporting using Strategy’s CRM tool
Leverage and enhance partner relationships to drive additional value and revenue.
Requirements:
Extensive experience of quota-carrying sales of software products and services into large enterprises
Demonstrable track record of consistent over-quota sales performance
Proven track record of senior level stakeholder engagement on complex IT and Business-led opportunities with referenceable client wins
Extensive experience in prospecting, driving, and closing complex enterprise sales cycles
Experience in areas such as Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, CRM, ERP, Cloud enterprise software sales
Experience with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler

Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively, network internally to get things done and be accountable for their decisions; ensuring all stages of sales cycle are running concurrently; opening pipe; progressing; closing deals; prioritizing tasks
Demonstrable knowledge of key Return on Investment and Total Cost of Ownership principles
A creative self-starter who can work effectively within a supportive team culture whilst independently managing their own business
Ability to work in a fast paced, open, collaborative, and success-driven environment
A strong storyteller with a customer-centric approach who can quickly build rapport
Hungry for success and driven to achieve high financial rewards
Degree educated or equivalent academic/work experience

content.jobHook: We are seeking a highly proficient Project Engineer to join our Manufacturing team at Old Toongabbie. This position presents a distinctive chance...
content.unEditedContent:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 

The Role

We are seeking a highly proficient Project Engineer to join our Manufacturing team at Old Toongabbie. This position presents a distinctive chance to contribute to small-medium sized CAPEX projects with a focus on equipment and automation, ensuring timely and within-budget delivery, while working closely with cross-functional teams, including operations, engineering, and procurement, to drive project success.

This is a 24 months fixed term role based at the Baxter Toongabbie Plant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead small to medium-scale CAPEX projects (around $0.5 to $10m USD annually) on machinery and procedures

  • Establish and manage project timelines, financial allocations, and resource frameworks to secure timely and cost-efficient delivery

  • Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to ensure project requirements are met

  • Offer technical advice and assistance to project teams regarding equipment and processes

  • Work together with engineering teams to develop and implement process enhancements

  • Formulate and sustain technical documentation, covering design specifications, operational procedures, and maintenance instructions

  • Share project updates, progress, and challenges with project collaborators, including senior management, operations teams, and external participants

  • Establish and nurture connections with project collaborators to guarantee project success and discover areas for enhancement

  • Formulate and carry out improvements to processes, covering the development and deployment of new equipment and procedures

  • Guarantee that all projects are finished in accordance with regulatory standards, encompassing cGMP and ISO 9001

  • Work together with quality teams to guarantee that all projects adhere to quality standards and requirements.

Key requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related field) or equivalent experience

  • Demonstrated ability in project management, engineering, or a related industry, emphasizing equipment and procedures

  • Proficiency in leading CAPEX undertakings, covering budget management, scheduling, and resource coordination

  • Skilled in project management, involving budget control, scheduling, and resource planning

  • Proficiency in packing machinery and procedures, encompassing design, functionality, and upkeep

  • Excellent communication and collaborator coordination skills

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and prioritize multiple tasks and projects

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link (opens in new window) here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice (opens in new window).

content.jobHook:
An exciting opportunity for a Part Time Retail Team Member is now available at our Bathurst store.
Our Retail Team Members are at the forefront of...
content.unEditedContent:
Job Description

Let's get to know each other

WHO ARE WE?

At Fantastic Furniture, we're all about making life fantastic for our team and customers.

Our success is driven by our people; an incredibly talented team across multiple disciplines (both in-store and behind the scenes) with an unwavering passion for helping our customers create a home they love.

We are learners, collaborators and changemakers.
We prioritise personal growth to enhance our collective capability and see our business flourish. We value unique perspectives, and actively work together to achieve better results. Most importantly, we create and inspire continual transformation, because our future depends on it.

Making the decision to join us is making the decision to work with a team of fun, talented and super passionate team members keen to see you and our business succeed.

ABOUT YOUR NEW ROLE?

An exciting opportunity for a Part Time Retail Team Member is now available at our Bathurst store.

Our Retail Team Members are at the forefront of making life fantastic for our customers by providing an exceptional experience at every touch point. In this varied role, you will have an opportunity to learn all store operations, (including further exposure to our back of house operation), work collaboratively with passionate team members and explore plenty of opportunities to advance your career.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for team members who are passionate about delighting customers, want to grow their career, and can be relied on to support our teams – sometimes at short notice.

You may bring with you some experience from a sales/customer service, retail or hospitality background, but we are also interested in speaking to people who are keen to bring transferable skills into a retail setting (full training will be provided).

Join our team and embark on a journey of personal and professional growth! At our company, we prioritize investing in our people to help you thrive in your career.

Here's what you can expect:

•          Education and Development: We believe in continuous learning. That's why we offer you the opportunity to complete a Certificate III in Retail, fully sponsored by us. You'll gain valuable skills that will benefit you throughout your career.

•          Generous Staff Discounts: Enjoy exclusive discounts on our Fantastic Furniture products, making your home even more fabulous. We believe in sharing the perks with our team.

•          Work-Life Balance: We're dedicated to ensuring you have a healthy work/life balance. Flexibility is at the core of our culture, enabling you to achieve both personal and professional success.

•          Health and Wellbeing: Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of health and wellness programs to help you stay at your best, both physically and mentally.

•          Career Advancement: We're committed to your growth. Our programs are designed to support your development in your current role and help you reach your future career aspirations.

If you believe we could be your ideal match, we'd love to have a conversation with you! Your journey to a rewarding career starts here.

Fantastic Furniture is committed to responding to every applicant. We look forward to hearing from you!

content.jobHook: We are looking for an Associate to join our nationally integrated Real Estate Advisory platform. In this role, you will contribute to high-impact...
content.unEditedContent:
Company Description

For more than 20 years, KordaMentha has supported businesses through some of their most complex matters and opportunities. Founder owned and led; we are an advisory firm that helps corporations, financiers, lawyers, private investors and government clients to grow, protect and recover value.

That’s what we do, but it’s how we do this that makes us who we are.

Proudly independent, strategically local, and with a bias for action to get things done, we focus on doing what is right by our clients, our people, and the wider community. Our track record shows that we help navigate the best path forward in challenging times, and do so across cities, regions and territories.

In the most stressful or demanding environments, we continue to drive change where it really counts.

Job Description

KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team provides independent, outcomes-focused advice across the full real estate lifecycle, helping clients navigate some of their most significant and complex property decisions. Our work spans high-value assets, sensitive stakeholder environments, projects under public scrutiny and matters with material financial implications.

We advise private, institutional and government clients across all asset classes, delivering support across transaction and deal advisory, asset and development strategy, and implementation and delivery. What sets us apart is our focus on outcomes — not just reports — working alongside clients to execute strategies and manage delivery risk.

We are looking for an Associate to join our nationally integrated Real Estate Advisory platform. In this role, you will contribute to high-impact engagements, providing commercial advice to both private and public sector clients, with a particular focus on lender and government-related work.

You will gain exposure across the full project lifecycle, from early-stage feasibility analysis and project review through to delivery, while working closely with senior executives, government stakeholders and lenders on major, high-value projects. The role also offers the opportunity to collaborate across multiple service lines, including Restructuring, Public Sector Advisory and Major Projects Advisory. 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, thrives in a collaborative environment and is looking to build their career across a broad range of asset classes, client groups and engagement types.

In this role, you will:

  • Support the delivery of real estate advisory engagements, contributing to scoping, analysis and client outputs aligned to commercial, policy and governance objectives. 
  • Take ownership of defined workstreams, delivering analysis and insights with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Undertake market research and due diligence across assets and portfolios, synthesising findings into clear, actionable insights. 
  • Assist with financial modelling and feasibility analysis, building your understanding of key value drivers, project risks and commercial considerations. 
  • Support asset repositioning and lender-led engagements, including options analysis and exposure to capital structures and risk allocation.
  • Help prepare business cases, investment papers and high-quality client deliverables for senior stakeholders. 
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams and external stakeholders, while contributing to team culture, client delivery and proposal support.

Qualifications

We’re interested in professionals who bring a strong analytical skill set, commercial curiosity and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic advisory environment. We’re likely to be speaking with candidates who have:

  • 3–4 years’ relevant experience in consulting, advisory, professional services, government infrastructure teams, treasury, investment banking or a similar environment.
  • Tertiary qualifications in property, commerce, finance, economics or a related discipline.
  • Strong analytical capability and financial modelling skills, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. 
  • Well-developed PowerPoint skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured and compelling presentations. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Additional Information

Join KordaMentha — Where Your Growth Is Our Priority

We don’t just hire talent; we invest in it - with support that accelerates your success in every way

Why Join Us?

  • Professional Development: Expert mentorship, tailored training via KordaMentha Business School, study support, and our Accelerate program for Analysts to Associate Directors — build your brand, expand your network, and gain strategic insights from senior leaders
  • Flexibility: We champion work/life integration with options that fit your lifestyle.
  • Career Growth: Merit-based promotions, secondments, and opportunities to work alongside senior leaders on impactful projects.
  • Leave That Works for You: Buy extra leave and access volunteer, generous parental leave and career break options.
  • Culture & Connection: Social events, cultural celebrations, and our bi-ennial black-tie ball.
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, return-to-work support through our partner GracePapers, and resources for every stage of family life.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Inclusive wellness initiatives and confidential and industry leading EAP for you and your family.

This isn’t just a job — it’s a place where your ambitions are nurtured, your wellbeing is valued, and your contributions celebrated. Ready to shape your future with us?

At KordaMentha, we believe there is strength in difference. Our entrepreneurial spirit expands the possibilities for action. We approach situations, challenges, and opportunities with optimism, curiosity, and diversity of thought. We seek novel solutions to problems and encourage unconventional and innovative approaches. 

Our team's diverse skillsets, backgrounds and experiences fuel KordaMentha's different mindset. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, recognising that talent and potential extend beyond traditional qualifications. Our selection process values diverse perspectives and considers each applicant's unique strengths and capabilities.

content.jobHook: Reporting into the GM Quality, Pharmacovigilance & Medical, this position leads the day-to day operations of the PV Team, as well as the Product...
content.unEditedContent:
As Australia’s most trusted manufacturer of natural health products 15 years running, and one of the Financial Reviews Best Places to Work in 2023, it couldn’t be a better time to join a truly purpose-led brand that has wellbeing and workplace flexibility at the heart of our culture! We are excited to offer the role of Director of Pharmacovigilance.

Reporting into the GM Quality, Pharmacovigilance & Medical, this position leads the day-to day operations of the PV Team, as well as the Product Quality Complaints Team, who together champion change, process improvement and product safety across the Blackmores Group. Demonstrating strong business acumen, initiative and communication skills, this role is ideal for a registered pharmacist with considerable experience in industry.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead, coach and Mentor a team of c.7, inc. 2 team leaders, providing day-to-day guidance and running of the function
  • Lead the full implementation and compliance of the Pharmacovigilance (PV) program and Product Safety Assessments across Blackmores Group
  • Perform PV training to the broader business, and for targeted teams as required.
  • Identify and deliver continuous improvement opportunities
  • Champion change to help others adopt positively to change
  • Understand and communicate how the Product Safety program and the PV program support optimal patient care, protect the patient, protect brand reputation, and minimise business exposure.

What we offer?

  • Opportunities to support your local community through paid community leave
  • 20 weeks gender neutral paid parental leave
  • Flexible working across most of our roles
  • Great benefits to support your health and wellbeing, including access to discounted products
  • Mental health support for you and your family through our Sonder assistance program

Who are you?

  • Must be a registered pharmacist with considerable experience working in industry, leading a Pharmacovigilance or Medical Affairs function
  • Signals detection experience
  • Exposure to Product Quality Complaints is an advantage
  • You have people leadership experience, gained from within Industry
  • Strong communication skills, can coach and mentor, excellent business acumen

json.title: Administrative Officer - Charters Towers State High School

content.jobHook: Located on Gudjal country, in the heart of the historic gold-mining town, Charters Towers State High School has been proudly serving our rural...
content.unEditedContent:
Charters Towers State High School is looking for someone who will be a great fit for our front office team — a warm, friendly and organised person who brings a calm and positive approach to working alongside our current office staff.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

This position is being offered in a Temporary Part-Time capacity (0.83FTE), 60 hours per fortnight.

Who We Are:

Located on Gudjal country, in the heart of the historic gold-mining town, Charters Towers State High School has been proudly serving our rural community for over 100 years. 

We work together to prepare students for the exciting, challenging and rapidly changing future in which they will live and work.

 In enacting our vision, we strike a balance between preserving proud traditions and instilling important values as we deliver an innovative and responsive curriculum. 

Step Into Your Next Chapter:

  • Providing administrative and operational support to the school leadership team.
  • Managing reception, enquiries, correspondence and school records.
  • Supporting HR, finance and general office processes.
  • Assisting with school activities, bookings and documentation.
  • Communicating professionally with staff, students, families and community members.
  • Working independently while contributing to a positive and inclusive school environment.

Please view the role description for a full list of responsibilities.

Submit Your Application:

  • Attach a brief resume including contact details for 2 referees (referees should have an understanding of your relevant work history)

We welcome all applicants to share any support needed to ensure our recruitment process is inclusive.

Applications remain current for 12 months from the closing date and may be considered for appointment to identical or similar vacancies within the Department.

Applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted.

json.title: Service Director | Wollondilly Mobile Community Preschool

content.jobHook: Right now, we’re looking for a Service Director for Wollondilly Mobile Community Preschool. Our centre has an abundance of indoor and outdoor space...
content.unEditedContent:
Service Director I Wollondilly Community Preschool

  • Permanent, Part Time
  • 16 hours per week, Thursday and Friday @ 8 hours per day
  • Term only Preschool
  • Operates exclusively during the school term
  • 8.30am to 4.00pm operation times

Working at Big Fat Smile, there’s a lot to smile about. The trust you’ll be given in exchange for your expertise. The freedom you’ll be given to use your judgement, adapt learning approaches, and bring creativity and playfulness to a child’s day. And the beautiful relationships you’ll form with peers, children, and families – through shared experiences that are as rich as they are rewarding.

There are lots of reasons why a role with us is rewarding

  • Due to our size, there are big opportunities for those who want to go further. You’ll find meaningful career paths with opportunities for further development and promotions across our centres and head office.
  • Professional learning and growth are at the heart of everything we do, from learning more about infant-toddler pedagogy, trauma responsive practice, cultural immersion and truth telling, to leadership through a neuroscience lens – these are some of the things our people have benefited from.
  • Support to further your studies, such as scholarships, time off floor for coursework, study leave, paid prac and more.
  • Save money with our Perks Hub which has great deals and discounts from over 500 major retailers and the biggest brands, including groceries, cinema tickets, clothing, homewares, tech, travel and more.
  • Access to our Wellness Hub which has a wealth of curated content focused on your wellbeing, plus monthly health and wellbeing webinars, free flu vaccinations and more.
  • A holistic approach to your wellbeing with our employee assistance program, including counselling, First Nations clinicians, health assessments, financial and legal support, and a dedicated manager hotline.
  • Save with a 60% discount on early learning and care and out of school hours care services.
  • Focus on what matters most because you have support from head office specialists and expertise, such as safeguarding, inclusion professionals, and pedagogy and practice specialists.

Right now, we’re looking for a Service Director for Wollondilly Mobile Community Preschool. Our centre has an abundance of indoor and outdoor space that enables children to have access to a curriculum that promotes the wellbeing and development of the whole child. We also focus on sustainability and teaching the children how to nurture and respect their environments.

As a Service Director, you’ll play a critical role in shaping young minds. You’ll create happy, healthy relationships between a child and the most important people in their lives. You’ll bring fun, laughter and play to each day, but most importantly, you’ll create magical moments for children to experiment and grow.

What your work will involve

  • Providing quality education and care to all children
  • Contributing to planning educational programs that supports a child’s learning to meet their goals
  • Building strong relationships with children, families, and the community

What you need to succeed

  • Commitment to making sure the children in our care are safe and healthy
  • Dedication to improving the lives and minds of children, families, and the community
  • A fun-loving attitude and big smile!

Our commitment to safeguarding children

Safeguarding children is at the heart of every decision, policy and practice at Big Fat Smile. And we have a zero tolerance towards child abuse, harm and neglect.

This starts with ensuring the people we select to work here will contribute to our child safe culture. During the recruitment process we conduct a range of pre-employment checks. To assist us with this, you will need:

  • A cleared valid for paid work, NSW working with Children’s Check (WWCC)
  • A cleared National Criminal Record Check
  • Demonstrated commitment to protecting all children from abuse, harm and neglect.
  • Demonstrated commitment to cultural safety for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children and families.
  • Evidence of completion of the National Child Safety Training Foundation Course
  • Details of a minimum two referees, where one must be a manager or supervisor at your current or most recent workplace.

How to apply

Please send us:

  • A copy of your resume
  • A brief cover letter that outlines why you are a good fit for the role

At Big Fat Smile we are deeply committed to Reconciliation and encourage Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people to apply.

content.jobHook: We are seeking an experienced Associate Director to join KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team. In this role, you will lead high-impact...
content.unEditedContent:
Company Description

For more than 20 years, KordaMentha has supported businesses through some of their most complex matters and opportunities. Founder owned and led; we are an advisory firm that helps corporations, financiers, lawyers, private investors and government clients to grow, protect and recover value.

That’s what we do, but it’s how we do this that makes us who we are.

Proudly independent, strategically local, and with a bias for action to get things done, we focus on doing what is right by our clients, our people, and the wider community. Our track record shows that we help navigate the best path forward in challenging times, and do so across cities, regions and territories.

In the most stressful or demanding environments, we continue to drive change where it really counts.

Job Description

KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team provides independent, outcomes-focused advice across the full real estate lifecycle, supporting clients through some of their most significant and complex property decisions. The team’s work often involves high-value assets, sensitive stakeholder environments, public scrutiny and material financial implications.

The practice advises private, institutional and government clients across all asset classes, with services spanning transaction and deal advisory, asset and development strategy, and implementation and delivery. A key differentiator is the focus on outcomes — not just reports — by working alongside clients to execute strategy and manage delivery risk. 

This role sits within a nationally integrated real estate advisory platform and forms part of the broader KordaMentha group, providing access to multidisciplinary capability and trusted senior relationships across Australia and New Zealand.

We are seeking an experienced Associate Director to join KordaMentha’s Real Estate Advisory team. In this role, you will lead high-impact engagements and deliver commercial advice across both private and public sector clients, with a particular focus on lender and government-related work.

You will work across the full project lifecycle, from early-stage feasibility analysis and project review through to delivery, while collaborating across multiple service lines, including Restructuring, Public Sector Advisory and Major Projects Advisory. 

This is a broad and varied opportunity, offering exposure to senior executives, government stakeholders and lenders on high-value, high-impact projects across multiple asset classes, client groups and delivery models.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of real estate advisory engagements, setting direction and ensuring alignment with client commercial, policy and governance objectives.
  • Oversee due diligence and market analysis, translating findings into strategic, evidence-based insights. 
  • Own and challenge financial models and feasibility analyses, clearly articulating key drivers, risks and investment implications. 
  • Lead transaction and commercial advisory mandates, including strategy, negotiations and coordination of advisers and stakeholders. 
  • Drive lender-led and asset repositioning engagements, developing and implementing restructuring and value recovery strategies. 
  • Prepare and present business cases and investment papers, delivering clear, decision-ready recommendations to senior and board-level stakeholders. 
  • Oversee high-quality client deliverables, ensuring outputs meet senior audience expectations across government, finance and corporate sectors.
  • Build and manage client relationships while contributing to business growth, including mentoring team members and leading proposal

Qualifications

We are looking for a commercially minded advisory professional who brings strong technical capability, sound judgement and the confidence to lead complex engagements. You will have:

  • 6–8 years’ relevant experience in the private sector or government, for example in consulting, advisory, professional services, government infrastructure teams, treasury or investment banking. 
  • Tertiary qualifications in property, commerce, finance, economics or a related discipline. 
  • Strong analytical and financial modelling capability, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. 
  • High-level PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear, structured and compelling presentations. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Additional Information

Join KordaMentha — Where Your Growth Is Our Priority

We don’t just hire talent; we invest in it - with support that accelerates your success in every way

Why Join Us?

  • Professional Development: Expert mentorship, tailored training via KordaMentha Business School, study support, and our Accelerate program for Analysts to Associate Directors — build your brand, expand your network, and gain strategic insights from senior leaders
  • Flexibility: We champion work/life integration with options that fit your lifestyle.
  • Career Growth: Merit-based promotions, secondments, and opportunities to work alongside senior leaders on impactful projects.
  • Leave That Works for You: Buy extra leave and access volunteer, generous parental leave and career break options.
  • Culture & Connection: Social events, cultural celebrations, and our bi-ennial black-tie ball.
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, return-to-work support through our partner GracePapers, and resources for every stage of family life.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Inclusive wellness initiatives and confidential and industry leading EAP for you and your family.

This isn’t just a job — it’s a place where your ambitions are nurtured, your wellbeing is valued, and your contributions celebrated. Ready to shape your future with us?

At KordaMentha, we believe there is strength in difference. Our entrepreneurial spirit expands the possibilities for action. We approach situations, challenges, and opportunities with optimism, curiosity, and diversity of thought. We seek novel solutions to problems and encourage unconventional and innovative approaches. 

Our team's diverse skillsets, backgrounds and experiences fuel KordaMentha's different mindset. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, recognising that talent and potential extend beyond traditional qualifications. Our selection process values diverse perspectives and considers each applicant's unique strengths and capabilities.

content.unEditedContent:
Job Description

Let's get to know each other

WHO ARE WE?

At Fantastic Furniture, we're all about making life fantastic for our team and customers.

Our success is driven by our people; an incredibly talented team across multiple disciplines (both in-store and behind the scenes) with an unwavering passion for helping our customers create a home they love.

We are learners, collaborators and changemakers.
We prioritise personal growth to enhance our collective capability and see our business flourish. We value unique perspectives, and actively work together to achieve better results. Most importantly, we create and inspire continual transformation, because our future depends on it.

Making the decision to join us is making the decision to work with a team of fun, talented and super passionate team members keen to see you and our business succeed.

ABOUT YOUR NEW ROLE

An exciting opportunity for a Casual Retail Team Member is now available at our Darwin store.

Our Retail Team Members are at the forefront of making life fantastic for our customers by providing an exceptional experience at every touch point. content.unEditedContent:
An exciting opportunity is available for a Part Time Administration Officer to join the TSIRC team at Division 10, Warraber Island

What we offer:

  • Based at Division 10, Warraber Island
  • Part time, Permanent
  • 18 hours per week, Monday - Friday
  • 6 Weeks Annual Leave
  • Additional TSIRC Public Holidays
  • Uniforms
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

About us:

Torres Strait Regional Council (TSIRC) is the largest employer in the Torres Strait serving 15 ‘outer' island communities with unique characteristics and service requirements. Beyond traditional local government services, we are deeply invested in the social, environmental, and economic development of our region. We are values driven and work as One with respect for Ailan Kastom.

About the role:

  • Provide friendly, efficient customer service and administrative support to the community.

  • Handle general administration tasks including enquiries, records management, and basic financial registers.

  • Process purchasing requests and support procurement activities in line with policy.

  • Maintain accurate records using Council systems and ensure compliance with procedures.

  • Support day-to-day operations to ensure services and resources are available.

What We're Looking For:

We need someone who shares our values of One, Respect, Accountability, Courage, and Resilience. The ideal candidate will have:

  • Minimum 12 month's administration experience.
  • Certificate III in Business Administration and or previous experience in a similar role is essential.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team environment.
  • Excellent customer service skills in a frontline role.
  • High level of attention to detail and time management skills with the ability to plan, manage and prioritise workloads.
  • Excellent computer skills to operate a computer and electronic communication devices and processes.
  • The ability to be culturally responsive, by demonstrating an understanding of the issues affecting Torres Strait Islander people and communicating with sensitivity and effectiveness.

Applying:

If you are interested in this opportunity, candidates will need to download the Position Description and submit a cover letter and an updated resume addressing how your knowledge, skills, experience, qualifications and personal attributes are most relevant to the position by Thursday, 28 May 2026..

Applicants who do not address these requirements will not be considered for shortlisting.

For more information:

Contact Clara-May Pearson on 0474 913 762

TSIRC is an equal opportunity employer, celebrating diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

content.unEditedContent:
Fletcher, Newcastle NSW

Full Time | Maximum Term until 20th July 2027

8:00am-4:00pm

About the role

The Communications and Engagement Officer leads the development and delivery of the school’s communications strategy, creating impactful content across channels and supporting engagement initiatives, events, and marketing activities.

About Bishop Tyrrell Anglican College

Bishop Tyrrell Anglican College (BTAC) is an independent Preschool to Year 12 co-educational school. With a focus on educating the whole childâintellectually, emotionally, physically and spirituallyâthe College provides a supportive and inclusive environment where students are encouraged to discover their strengths, pursue their interests and achieve their personal best

Bishop Tyrrell is known for its strong sense of community and values-based approach, fostering leadership, service and personal growth. Students benefit from diverse learning pathways, co-curricular opportunities in sport, creative arts and technology, and modern facilities designed to support contemporary education.

Why work for us?

Our team is at the heart of what we do at Bishop Tyrrell Anglican College and the Newcastle Anglican Schools Corporation. As a part of our organisation, you have access to the following great benefits:

  • Generous salary and salary packaging options.
  • Discount on school enrolment fees at any of our 4 Newcastle Anglican schools.
  • The opportunity to make a significant difference in our students’ futures.
  • Career and development opportunities across the Newcastle Anglican community.
  • The opportunity to work within an innovative, collaborative team environment.
  • 14 weeks paid parental leave or 3 weeks paid partner leave + Super Contributions

Essential Criteria: 

  • Tertiary qualifications in Communications or Public Relations, or commensurate relevant experience in one or more of these fields.
  • Demonstrated capacity to manage a broad range of communication tools
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills and the capacity to develop and sustain productive relationships across the school community and the Newcastle Anglican shared services teams.
  • Demonstrated support for and the capacity to develop and maintain an organisational culture based on Christian, professional and personal behaviors and the school’s core values
  • Creative and innovative mindset
  • Evidence of the capacity to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, work well under pressure and to meet timelines/deadlines
  • Evidence of preparation and implementation of clear communication plans, results monitoring and evaluation
  • Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
  • Web design and management skills using WordPress and other website design platforms
  • Demonstrated skills in the use of various types of social media
  • Demonstrated capacity for effective management to achieve agreed goals and strategic targets 

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a cover letter.

For more information visit www.newcastleanglican.org.au or email the talent team at careers@newcastleanglican.org.au   

To obtain a copy of the full position description, please email our Talent Team atâ¯careers@newcastleanglican.org.au 

You must have the right to live and work in Australia.

Newcastle Anglican Schools Corporation supports the rights of children and young people and are committed to ensuring the safety, welfare, and wellbeing of students.
