data.title: Expressions of Interest - Perth Management
data.descriptionHtml:
At Sephora, we believe that beauty thrives in diversity and discovery. Our purpose is to expand the way the world sees beauty by empowering the ExtraOrdinary in each of us.


Join Sephora and be part of the Management team in one of our Perth stores on a Full-Time (38hr) basis. This is your opportunity to bring your passion, share your knowledge, and make your mark at a leading global beauty retailer.


Some of our well-liked benefits:

  • Gifted products throughout the year along with store discounts of up to 45% off
  • Paid Parental Leave, Birthday Leave & Personal Leave
  • Health and well-being initiatives including 24/7 Mental Health well-being programs & Life Insurance
  • Discounted Gym memberships incl. Virgin Active & Fitness First + more!
  • Opportunities for personal development in ANZ through succession
  • Opportunities across our global group of high-end luxury brands within LVMH
  • Unique online learning platform
  • Fun social calendar


The opportunity:


You'll play a key role in:

  • Being the role model to your team by showcasing the Sephora experience to customers through embodying Sephora’s DNA of delivering a curated, innovative prestige beauty experience.
  • Driving a selling culture to exceed KPI’s and consistently raise the performance and capability of your team through coaching and supporting their growth and development.
  • Utilising and interpreting reporting data to support with operational decisions by working closely with the Store Manager, Assistant Store Manager and fellow team of Senior Beauty Advisors.
  • Facilitating open communication with your team by providing effective feedback and consistent communication with the Management team.
  • Serving as the point of contact when being the Manager in Charge (MIC) for client and cast member matters within a fast-paced environment to confidently make store decisions.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across all our categories from beauty, skincare, haircare, and wellness; as well as store functions of sales, management, and back-of-house operations.


You will be equipped with initial onboarding training and continuous learning through our unique online learning platform and field trainers to help clients discover Sephora's amazing offerings. By being part of Sephora and the LVMH community, your options for discovery and career growth are endless.


We would love to hear from you if:


  • Are open to working a 38hr rotating roster to support store needs.
  • You have previous retail management experience across areas of managing profit and loss, sales forecasting, people management & training, stock control and visual merchandising.
  • You have proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite to interpret and input data for daily reporting.
  • You're a hands-on leader who loves being on the sales floor to motivate, coach, and help your store team members succeed.
  • You're passionate about excellent client service and experiential retail to ensure your store represents the Sephora brand.
  • You have a passion to maintain a strong and positive culture where everyone is valued, recognized, and enabled to succeed through feedback and career development, coaching, learning, and recognition.
  • You have a drive for results with a history of exceeding sales targets and KPI's


Please keep in mind when considering a role at Sephora that each of our stores have their own individual needs. Only Australian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered for this opportunity.


As our busiest days of trade are between Thursday to Sunday the ideal candidate will be able to provide 5 full days of availability across key trading times including but not limited to late-night, weekend and public holiday trading.


Sephora is part of the Global Louis Vuitton Moet Hennessey Group which is the world's largest luxury goods conglomerate. Across Australia and New Zealand, we have circa 30 stores, a growing online platform and we plan to expand this year on year. Not only do we offer diverse store opportunities, we also have our head office based in Sydney CBD.


Your application:

Sephora is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace for all. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, or other employment practices. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.


If you consider yourself to require reasonable adjustments to any part of our recruitment process, we invite you to share those requirements with us when completing your application. We will make every effort to ensure your needs are met to provide a fair and transparent process of assessment.

data.title: Desktop Support Engineer
data.descriptionHtml:
Role: Desktop Support Engineer

Location: Fortitude Valley QLD 4006, Australia

Annual Rate: 45,000 AUD to 55,000 AUD

The overall service delivery model for end user services is as below. Provider shall ensure proper understanding of this structure and integrate its operation to this model as called out below

SOE and Maintenance Services: Assist in supporting a Standard Operating Environment (SOE) image for Customer’s Standard Workplace Device in accordance with Customer’s Standards.

Service Request Management Services: Manage the quality and timeliness of installs, moves, add, and changes for all Supported Workplace Devices and

Supported Workplace Software at all Supported Customer Sites. This includes using request data and reports to ensure device delivery for projects and other requests is happening as expected.

SOE Image and Deployment Management Provide manual installation of SOE Image wherever required.

Break / Fix Support Services – Workplace Devices: Provide hardware/software support (Incident resolution) for Supported Workplace Devices, including dispatch, leveraging vendor warranty where possible, etc., at Supported Customer Sites.

Facility Hands and Feet Hardware Support: Perform physical support activities for all Supported Hardware at Customer Facilities, including management of on- premises stock location for receiving new and decommissioned Hardware and

Workplace Devices, soft asset disposal of old equipment and coordinate with client hardware disposal vendor for hardware disposal of old equipment, and maintaining the Asset Management system based on the movement and deployment of equipment.

VIP Support: Provide dedicated, proactive and superior desk side support services for selected End Users as in this Service Description.

  • Provider shall provide onsite 12x5 support to VIPs at designated Customer

Facilities. Provider personnel proposed to fill onsite VIP support functions must first be presented to staff supporting C-Level Customer VIPs, and Customer will have the right to interview and approve such personnel before their assignment to a VIP;

  • Provide an enhanced level of service (i.e., higher priority of Tickets and Incidents) to other VIPs (executives) .
  • Support VIP End User onboarding and offboarding activities
  • Support VIPs at executive-level events at hotels and Customer sites (e.g., Board Meetings, Investor Calls)
  • Update agreed to IT Service Management tool to reflect completion of Service Request or resolution of Incident.

Level 2 and 3 Support Services: If requested by L2/L3 team, provide onsite support to resolve any Incident

Asset Management: Provide hands C feet support for managed, current, and Customer approved asset inventory for all Supported Workplace Devices and Supported Workplace Software, including but not limited to printers, mobile devices, tablets, laptops, scanners, and card readers. This includes working with Customer’s existing Provider to ensure continuity between asset records as they pass through the lifecycle from “received” status to “decommissioned” status, including any spare Supported Workplace Devices that are stocked at Customer Facilities or Provider Delivery Locations.

Conference Room Support: Provide Level 2 support Services for conferencing equipment within conference rooms at Supported Customer locations.

Ad-hoc Consulting (Discretionary Services): Provide hands C Feet ad-hoc consulting support, as requested.

Field Support Dedicated and Dispatch Services

Provider will provide field support services.

  • Installs, moves, adds, changes (IMAC)
  • Technical support and break-fix
  • Software re-imaging
  • Support including, but not limited to workstation and mouse, keyboard, monitor, scanner and printer support

Office Equipment support including, but not limited to:

  • Office workstation
  • Mouse
  • Keyboard
  • Monitor

Printer Support

  • Printer settings configuration
  • Coordinate third party repairs with customer approved printer vendor
  • Paper Jam Removal, all 1st line support for printers

Audio-Video Support

  • Periodic Health check up/sanity check of the Conference room
  • Escort Vendors to the conference room for any break fix.
  • Additional scope items to Scope to be confirmed

Exiting Employees

  • Collection of computer hardware from exiting employees
  • Collection of Cellular devices

New Hire/First Day Ready support

  • Coordinate with New joiners for any support for New Joiners to start if required

Disposal:

  • Soft Asset Disposal (single wipe pass + storage of asset at Customer facility) services will be provided by dedicated FTEs at Dedicated locations
  • Hard Asset Disposal - Provider will coordinate with Customer's asset disposal vendor for hard asset disposal

Process Activities and Tools

General overall activities

  • Incident management
  • Request fulfilment
  • Deskside intervention for Software deployment as needed
  • IMAC (Deskside) and Break fix Installation of Devices
  • Move and configuration change
  • Asset management
  • Configuration Management
  • Tools provided by ADSL - ServiceNow for Provider support teams

4. General End User Computing Services:

Provider shall perform the in-scope Services as per the defined scope.

  • Provider shall provide and manage life-cycle Services including inventory management, assisting ADSL in asset management and reporting, warranty support coordination using existing Customer’s contracts, recovery, redeployment, preparation for disposal, and on-site support for Equipment while complying with Customer specified processes and policies or working with Customer designated Third Parties.

data.title: Team Member - Toukley - NSW
data.descriptionHtml:
Do you love Slurpee’s and sustainable Coffee? Well, so do we! It sounds like it’s time for you to come and join the team at 7-Eleven.

We are on the lookout for casual team members with Overnight availability to join the team in our Toukley store.

Being the face of your store, you will:

  • Delight your customers with service and store standards
  • Contribute to a safe and positive store environment for you and your team
  • Grow your capability in a collaborative & personable environment

What we offer you!

  • Free Coffee, Slurpee and first access to exclusive products
  • Ongoing paid, on the job training and support from your store leader
  • Regular working hours, in a 24/7 store
  • Genuine career progression opportunities across a large national network
  • Be a part of a leading, innovative and values driven brand
  • Employee Assistant Program (EAP) including mental, physical & personal support
  • A safe and inclusive work environment
  • A role where you are engaged, and every day is different!

Ideally the right candidate will have:

  • Passion, resilience, and a fun and friendly attitude
  • Experience in a fast-paced, customer focused role
  • Positive communication skills and ability to engage with your customers
  • Confidence working independently while being committed to supporting the team

To submit your interest, please click APPLY select APPLY MANUALLY to create a Workday profile. NO cover letter needed.

What's next?

Applications will be reviewed by our Talent Experience team and shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete our online video introduction to tell us what your resume can’t. This is the fun part of the process, so be yourself and answer the questions as creatively as you would like.

At 7-Eleven our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating a workplace that fosters inclusion and celebrates diversity. We strive to make every single 7-Eleven team member feel heard, valued, and respected no matter who they are or what diverse characteristics reflect their unique identity. We are proud to be a Diversity Council Australia Inclusive Employer 2024-2025 and Bronze Accredited with the Australian Workplace Equity Index.

At 7-Eleven, we are committed to ensuring that all prospective employees have the opportunity to perform at their best throughout our recruitment process. If you require any adjustments to support an inclusive and accessible experience, please contact us for a confidential discussion at peoplesupport@7eleven.com.au


** Please note, this email is strictly for adjustment requests related to the recruitment process. Other inquiries sent to this mailbox will not be actioned.**

To find out more about our current opportunities follow us on LinkedIn or view our careers page.

#LI-DNI

data.companyDescription: 7-Eleven, Inc. is the premier name in the convenience-retailing industry. Based in Irving, Texas, 7-Eleven operates, franchises and/or licenses more than 13,000 stores in the U.S. and Canada. In addition to 7-Eleven® stores, 7-Eleven, Inc. operates and franchises Speedway®, Stripes®, Laredo Taco Company® and Raise the Roost® Chicken and Biscuits locations. Known for its iconic brands such as Slurpee®, Big Bite® and Big Gulp®, 7-Eleven has expanded into high-quality sandwiches, salads, side dishes, cut fruit and protein boxes, as well as pizza, chicken wings and mini beef tacos. 7-Eleven offers customers industry-leading private brand products under the 7-Select™ brand including healthy options, decadent treats and everyday favorites at an outstanding value. Customers can earn and redeem points on various items in stores nationwide through its 7Rewards® loyalty program with more than 50 million members, place an order in the 7NOW® delivery app in over 2,000 cities, or rely on 7-Eleven for bill payment service, self-service lockers and other convenient services. Find out more online at www.7-Eleven.com.

data.title: In-Store Sales Representative (Mona Vale)
data.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an In-Store Sales Representative for our store in Mona Vale.


Who You'll Be Working For: Hardware & General is a large, family-owned building and plumbing supplier based in Sydney, Australia. Founded in 1960 by Walter MacGregor, we've grown from a single corner store to six locations across Sydney, yet we've remained proudly family-run, now in our third generation!


Why Work With Us: We're known for our high-quality products, expert staff, and outstanding customer service.

We provide fast, reliable delivery services and expert advice. Our extensive product range includes over 140,000 items, from building materials and plumbing supplies to hardware and renovation essentials.


We operate across six locations, including our flagship Brookvale site (home to multiple specialist sales centres) and stores in Peakhurst, Mona Vale, Terrey Hills, Hornsby, and Dural.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Assist customers with selection and purchase decisions.
  • Operate "Point of Sale" system to record transactions.
  • Process and follow up quotes to qualify, refine and close sales opportunities and enter details into the quote register and Frameworks.
  • Complete paperwork, ensuring procedures are followed as instructed.
  • Assist with preparation, packing and dispatch of orders & receipt to ensure safe storage of stock.
  • Manage stock levels and liaising with suppliers as directed by the local manager
  • Provide exceptional customer service and demonstrate product knowledge.
  • Ensure the store is well-maintained, organised, and visually appealing.
  • Contribute to achieving sales targets and supporting daily operations.
  • Undertake self-directed learning through Trade Net for relevant products.

What You'll Bring:

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in a customer service role, such as retail or trade
  • Basic computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Must have the legal right to work in Australia
  • Knowledge of building materials and plumbing supplies preferred but not essential as training will be provided
  • Ability to lift and move stock items safely, and stand for extended periods

What You'll Get in Return:

  • Attractive staff discounts across all our premium brands.
  • Friendly environment and many employee benefits!!


Join a business with a proud family history and take the next step in your leadership career. Apply now to grow with Hardware & General!

data.title: Yardperson - Portables
data.descriptionHtml:
Introduction:
Onsite Rental Group is a national specialist equipment hire business that focuses on transparent and efficient hire solutions. We have over 30 years’ experience in this industry across a range of industries including mining, oil & gas, construction, industrial, infrastructure, government and defence. With 500+ employees across 35+ branches and targeted locations, Onsite is driven by a core set of values which support our customer-centric vision – together we grow.

Description:
About the role

Reporting to the Team Leader, your role will be to:
Dedicated benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing
Clean portable buildings, including portable toilet blocks using equipment and supplies provided
Complete basis repair & maintenance tasks on portable buildings, including toilet blocks; repair & seal flooring, replace trim, paint and patch walls, basic plumbing, replace doors & locks etc.
Securely pack furniture & accessories in portables buildings for transport including tables, chairs, desks, fridges, microwaves etc.
Undertake general housekeeping and yard duties to ensure a safe, clean and well organised work environment.
Assisting qualified trades with portable building refurbishments and upgrades where necessary.

Skills and Experiences:
Skills and experience

We are looking for someone with relevant transferable skills, a positive attitude and capacity for hands on, physical work. Our ideal candidate will have:

Current driver's licence & reliable transport
Handyman experience, including use of power tools (desirable)
Relevant cleaning or labouring experience
Ability to work both autonomously and within a team
A positive attitude & high regard for workplace safety

Benefits and perk

Competitive base wage + Inclusion in Profit Share Plan
Free on site parking & open warehouse environment out of sun
Full time permanent position providing stable long term employment
Family friendly roster, Monday – Friday, with core hours worked between 7:00am – 3:06pm
Dedicated employee benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing, such as our Employee Assistance Program, Salary Continuance Insurance, Access to TAL - Health for Life Program, discounted private health insurance & a Reward & Recognition Program.

If this sounds like a role and a business you’d like to join, then please APPLY NOW!

Onsite is committed to achieving a diverse and socially inclusive workforce.

At our company Onsite Rental Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values equal recruitment opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. We recognise the rich cultural heritage and the significant contributions of Indigenous communities to Australia's identity. We also respect and Honor the Traditional Lands on which we operate, we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates to apply.

Candidates may be requested to undergo pre-employment checks to confirm the candidate's suitability for a role. These checks will vary by role but may include reference checks, right to work check, medical (including drug and alcohol test) and licence checks. Please note, as a part of our commitment to Destination Zero, Onsite also routinely conduct drug & alcohol testing in our workplaces.

Reporting to the Team Leader, your role will be to:

Dedicated benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing
Clean portable buildings, including portable toilet blocks using equipment and supplies provided
Complete basis repair & maintenance tasks on portable buildings, including toilet blocks; repair & seal flooring, replace trim, paint and patch walls, basic plumbing, replace doors & locks etc.
Securely pack furniture & accessories in portables buildings for transport including tables, chairs, desks, fridges, microwaves etc.

Skills and experience

Handyman experience, including use of power tools (desirable)
Relevant cleaning or labouring experience
Ability to work both autonomously and within a team
A positive attitude & high regard for workplace safety

Competitive base wage + Inclusion in Profit Share Plan
Free on site parking & open warehouse environment out of sun
Full time permanent position providing stable long term employment
Family friendly roster, Monday – Friday, with core hours worked between 7:00am – 3:06pm
Dedicated employee benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing, such as our Employee Assistance Program, Salary Continuance Insurance, Access to TAL - Health for Life Program, discounted private health insurance & a Reward & Recognition Program.

data.title: Civic Facilities Management Officer
data.descriptionHtml:
Introduction:
Become a Part of Moira Shire Council’s Exciting Journey!

At Moira Shire Council, we're reimagining local government with fresh ideas, a friendly approach, and a passion for making a real difference in our vibrant regional community. Nestled along the stunning Murray River, our region spans from the lush Barmah Forest to lively towns like Cobram, Numurkah, Nathalia, and Yarrawonga—one of Victoria’s top holiday spots.

We believe in working together with honesty, respect, integrity, teamwork, and accountability to create a future everyone can be proud of.

Our role as a Council? To serve, support, and inspire our communities to facilitate the success of the Moira2045 Community Vision.

Why Work With Us?

  • Above Award pay rates
  • A strong, values based, positive organisational culture
  • Supportive and family-friendly workplace.
  • Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle with opportunity to Work From Home
  • Access to extensive training and education opportunities, including in-house leadership program
  • Superannuation information sessions with Vision Super
  • Salary packaging and novated leases available
  • Access to wellness initiatives
  • Corporate discounts at five gyms across our shire
  • Generous parental leave
  • Up to two days paid volunteer leave for a community service within our shire.
  • Cultural and ceremonial leave.
  • Opportunities for purchased leave to better accommodate your lifestyle.
  • So much more.....
Please note all benefits are considered individually for roles on a pro-rata basis. Temporary and part-time roles may not be eligible for all inclusions.

Moira Shire Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Moira promotes a workplace that actively seeks to include, welcome and value the contributions of all people and encourages people with a disability, Aboriginal Australians, young people and people from culturally diverse backgrounds to apply.

Description:
Key Responsibilities and Functions

Civic Buildings

To undertake event setups and breakdowns according to scheduled bookings, on behalf of council.
Adapt to any last-minute changes or requirements to ensure seamless event delivery.
To provide an efficient service to the Community, Public, Councilor’s and Staff in relation to the internal & External events at the Cobram Civic Centre, Yarrawonga Town Hall, Numurkah Town Hall & All other Council Venues.
Provide access and lock-up of Cobram Civic Centre and perform Maintenance/Cleaning duties as directed.
Coordinate/attend to special cleaning requirements when necessary to various council assets.
Advise the Facilities team of maintenance requirements in relation to Council properties used for events and other infastrucure as arises.
Assist in the Preparation and setup of Venues for events including catering collection for various sources, stocking amenities and kitchen supplies, cleaning and set up of equipment including but not limited to Council Meetings, Staff Meetings and other events as requested in Cobram, Numurkah, Nathalia and Yarrawonga as required.
Pack up/breakdown of functions and events in venue space upon completion of meetings etc. including securing all furniture & equipment, ensuring all crockery and associated equipment is cleaned and secured.
Collection, return and distribution of catering, newspapers, dry cleaning and other materials when required.
Maintain appropriate kitchen stocks/cleaning consumables and accessories, meeting the requirements of Council, staff and visitors.
Ensure maintenance of equipment including, but not limited to, PA system, whiteboards, display boards, chairs and other equipment at Council’s facilities where events are held.
Essential Services - Conduct thorough safety inspections and testing of electrical equipment in various Council assets and infrastructure settings, shire wide, ensuring compliance with Australian Standards (AS/NZS 3760).
When required assist facilities maintenance with servicing & works on Council’s facilities and infrastructure, when directed.

Customer Service

All customer service duties as requested for benefit of Council.
Provide facility inspection access for users and potential users of Council facilities where events are held.
Provide efficient and courteous service to the general public.
To provide at all times a high level of Customer Service.

For more information about the role view the Position Description HERE (if Hyperlink is not working, click "Apply" to view it)

Skills and Experiences:
To Apply for this role, please include a cover letter addressing the following Key Selection Criteria:

Key Selection Criteria

Experience in venue management responsibilities.
Ability to work autonomously with minimum supervision
Competency to undertake the physical activities associated with the key responsibilities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Understanding of manual lifting requirements under OHS legislation.
Qualifications and/or extensive experience in the areas of event delivery.
Essential services experience. (ESM)
Building, Venue or Facilities Service experience.

Essential qualifications and experience

Experience in Customer Service
Understanding of manual lifting requirements under OHS legislation.
Driver’s license
Demonstrated experience with a range of equipment used in venue management.
Ability to perform various tasks involving heavy lifting, climbing ladders, and moving of equipment.
Experience in venue management and functions setup and clean-up.

data.title: Assistant Depot Officer
data.descriptionHtml:
Introduction:
Description:
Based in Corowa, but will work across the Federation Council area

  • Full-time – 76 hours per fortnight
  • Fortnightly RDO
  • Opportunity to learn diverse area of Local Council
The Opportunity

Federation Council is seeking a motivated Assistant Depot Officer to join our Engineering Department in Corowa. In this role, you will play a vital part in supporting the Depot Coordinator with day-to-day operations and procurement functions.

As the Assistant Depot Officer, you will be responsible for ensuring our depots and stores run smoothly and meet all legislative requirements. This is a hands-on position that involves everything from technical procurement to physical yard maintenance. We are looking for a collaborative team player who can communicate effectively with both internal staff and the general public.

Key Responsibilities

Safely operating forklifts to load/unload goods and coordinating deliveries to various worksites.
Handling purchase orders, managing staff PPE and uniform inventory, and providing purchasing support to other departments.
Maintaining the cleanliness of the yard and Wash Bay areas and monitoring stocks for items like gravel, aggregate, and fuel.
Conducting monthly stocktakes, maintaining first aid kits, and ensuring all operations align with Council policies and WHS standards.
Stepping up to perform higher duties when the Depot Coordinator is on leave.

Essential key criteria to be addressed in applications

A current Class “C” driver’s licence and a valid Forklift licence (or the ability to obtain one within three months).
Higher School Certificate (HSC) or equivalent.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with digital records management (e.g., Content Manager) and purchasing systems.
Proven ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently with minimal supervision.
A history of showing initiative to improve productivity and solve problems effectively.

Desirable Attributes

Previous experience in Local Government or a similar operational role.
Basic understanding of bookkeeping principles.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.

What we offer

An opportunity for you to grow and develop your skills.
Fortnightly rostered days off.
Being part of a team contributing to your local community.
A supportive and inclusive workplace with a real focus on work/life balance.
Long service leave entitlements after 5 years’ service

The appointment will be in accordance with the Local Government (State) Award and Council’s policies and conditions of employment. The salary is commencing at $34.35 per hour with progression up to $37.91 per hour dependent upon skills and experience.

How to find out more

To find out more about this opportunity you can contact Aaron Hoskin, Depot Coordinator, on (02) 6930 9164 Monday to Friday during business hours.

A copy of the Position Description can be viewed HERE

How to apply

Provide us with a cover letter telling us how you meet the criteria we have outlined above and also attach a resume detailing your work history, qualifications and skills.

Applications must be submitted by 5:00 PM on Thursday, 11 June 2026.

You may apply through any of the following methods:
Online: Select the 'Apply' button at the bottom of this page via our HR Management platform.
Email: Send your application to jobs@federationcouncil.nsw.gov.au.
By Mail: Send your application to Federation Council Human Resources, PO Box 77, Corowa NSW 2646.

Council is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity. We aim to recruit a diverse range of talented people to help us achieve our goals.

Council also recognises the skills and attributes of veterans and welcomes applications from ex-service personnel.

data.descriptionHtml:
Description:
Serve Up Sunshine and Wellness as the Heart of Sol Bowl

Position: Food & Beverage Attendant

Job Type: Permanent Part-Time

Location: SAN Hospital – Wahroonga

Step into the vibrant energy of Sol Bowl at the SAN Hospital where we nourish our community with every bowl and brew. Join our dedicated team and enjoy a role that offers variety, consistent hours, and a fast-paced, rewarding atmosphere. We are looking for an energetic individual who thrives on high standards and genuine customer connection. This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to grow your hospitality career with an industry leader.

What's In It For You

Enjoy exclusive Relish Discounts at over 450 retail outlets nationwide.
Competitive pay rate of $25.85 per hour plus applicable weekend and evening penalties.
Secure permanent part-time stability with a guaranteed 20-hour roster.
Work-life balance with flexible shifts ranging between 8 and 38 hours per week.
Access to professional development and internal career progression within the Cater Care network.
A supportive and inclusive team culture that values your contribution and well-being.

Skills and Experiences:
What You'll Do

Prepare and serve high-quality food and beverages in a fast-paced retail outlet.
Deliver exceptional customer service that brightens the day of hospital staff and visitors.
Maintain a clean and organized kitchen environment while performing essential dishwashing duties.
Work independently to manage daily tasks and ensure the outlet runs smoothly during shifts.
Operate point-of-sale systems and handle transactions with accuracy and efficiency.
Uphold strict food safety and hygiene standards across all preparation and service areas.

About You

Demonstrated barista experience or qualifications with a talent for crafting the perfect coffee.
Current Food Safety Supervisor certification or the willingness to obtain one promptly.
Valid Australian Driver’s Licence and reliable transport to the SAN Hospital location.
Proven ability to work autonomously and manage your time effectively in a busy setting.
Strong communication skills and a friendly, professional approach to customer service.
Previous experience in kitchen operations or food preparation within a retail or hospitality environment.

Why Cater Care

Cater Care is a leading, 100% Australian-owned contract catering service provider with 25 years of experience. We operate across multiple sectors including Aged Care, Education, Retail, and Remote Services. Through our values of Care, Pride, and Community, we pride ourselves on diversity, work/life balance, and providing excellent career opportunities. We strongly encourage First Nations people to consider a career with us.

How To Apply

Submit your updated resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your barista experience through our online portal today. Shortlisting will commence immediately, so don't miss your chance to join the Sol Bowl team!

data.title: Spray Dryer Operator
data.descriptionHtml:
If you are curious & creative, invested in not only your own success but also the growth of others, and believe in building the Great Australian Food Company, then you might be the one for us!

  • Full-time, permanent role with opportunities for upskilling and career progression

  • Be part of a leading Australian dairy manufacturer

  • Work with advanced drying technology & modern facility

  • Attractive hourly rate + shift loading

The Role

Our Tatura site is an icon in the region, well known around the world for its quality dairy products. As well as being the country’s largest producer of cream cheese, it also produces infant formula, nutritional lactoferrin, various milk powders, plus our famous single serve butter.

This role is accountable for complex process control, quality outcomes, across drying operations ensuring product quality, food safety, and production targets are consistently met.

The incumbent must be available on 12-hour shifts across days and nights a to support 24/7 factory operation (i.e. weekends, public holidays, etc).

  • Day shift: 6AM to 6PM

  • Night shift: 6PM to 6AM

Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor drying equipment to ensure safe and efficient production

  • Manage process parameters (temperature, pressure, flow rates, moisture levels) & respond to alarms, process deviations & equipment faults promptly.

  • Ensure effective shift handovers, accurate reporting and record‑keeping, timely escalation, and adherence to schedules

  • Perform start‑ups, shutdowns, changeovers, and cleaning (CIP) to required standards

  • Adherence to Bega’s Safety, Environmental and Quality systems and procedures

About you

  • Proven experience in operating industrial dryer processing equipment

  • Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills – fault finding and basic troubleshooting skills

  • Basic computer skills (Microsoft Words, Excel, Outlook, etc)

  • Attention to quality, safety, and details

  • Forklift license (good to have)

Bega Group is home to many trusted and iconic food and beverage brands. Whether it’s VEGEMITE on toast, a Dare on the go or a Zooper Dooper on a hot day - you've probably grown up enjoying the iconic products we proudly manufacture every day.

We have a strong regional focus and proudly support the communities where we work, live and play. At the Bega Group, we are proud of our heritage and will continue to build great opportunities to encourage our people to develop and thrive. No matter how you identify, we encourage talented people from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to apply to work at the Bega Group.

data.companyDescription:
Bega Cheese Limited has a long and uniquely Australian history that all started with humble beginnings in dairy.

Dairying started in the Bega Valley in the 1850’s with each farmer selling produce from their own dairy. In an effort to improve their individual production and marketing activities, local farmers banded together to establish the Bega Co-operative Creamery Company on July 15 1899.

In July 2017, Bega expanded its portfolio to include Vegemite, ZoOSh and Bega Peanut Butter. Bega now operates manufacturing sites across Victoria and NSW producing some of Australia’s most iconic and loved food brands and products.

data.title: Customer Relationship Specialist
data.descriptionHtml:
About the role

Do you have a passion for customer service and want to work with a driven, supportive and fun team?

At the BOQ Group, we believe in the power and potential of people. We are excited to grow our team and offer the right candidate an exciting career in banking.

If you’re ready to jump in with both feet, then we want to hear from you!

The purpose of this position is to provide outstanding customer service, by identifying and supporting customers to explore their current and future financial needs, provision relevant financial products and services and facilitate referrals to specialist teams where required.

The role works closely with the Branch Manager, by developing customer relationships through regular contact, proactive lead management, seeking opportunities for referrals, executing customer loan maintenance needs and coaching Customer Service Officers.

About you

As an experienced Customer Relationship Specialist, you will be a passionate, high-performing operator who consistently delivers an outstanding customer experience.

It would be advantageous if you have experience in the retail banking industry, with exposure to consumer lending.

Your drive to build long-lasting relationships and create positive customer experiences will set you apart.

You will be a key contributor to a collaborative team environment, always willing to go above and beyond for your customers and colleagues.

Your personalized approach to every customer interaction, combined with a "can do" attitude, will ensure success in all aspects of your role.

You will confidently learn and use a variety of technical financial systems, showcasing your excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong attention to detail.

About us

BOQ Group is a truly unique group of challenger brands with a purpose – to provide a genuine alternative to Australian financial services for customers and employees.

Our family of brands (Bank of Queensland (BOQ), ME Bank, Virgin Money Australia, BOQ Specialist), each come with their own defined customer audience and brand personality, but share one goal – to build social capital through banking. That’s creating trust with customers, exploring staff potential and believing that tiny gestures and big ideas can change the world for communities.

BOQ Group’s inclusive vision is to foster a workspace that values and leverages difference and creates new possibilities, a place where our people feel confident to bring their best selves to work every day. We embrace difference and believe that our workforce should reflect the customers and communities that we serve.

In 2023, we successfully implemented an innovative Reconciliation Plan, driving positive change and promoting inclusivity across BOQ Group.

Our perks

At BOQ Group, we are passionate about creating an exceptional work environment that nurtures both your professional and personal growth.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance your well-being, provide financial security, and foster a sense of community and inclusion. Here are just some of the fantastic perks you can enjoy as part of our team:

  • Flexible working arrangement - Balance your work and personal life with ease.

  • Discounted financial products - Enjoy exclusive rates on our financial services across the Group.

  • Salary sacrificing options - Maximise your take-home pay with our salary packaging options.

  • Paid parental leave with no minimum requirements - Spend quality time with your new family member without any worries.

  • Purchase additional annual leave - Need more time off? You can buy extra leave days.

  • Discounted private health insurance plan - Take care of your health with our special rates.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access confidential support for personal and professional challenges for you and your family

  • Access to employee network groups - Connect with peers through our First Nations Reconciliation, LGBTQIA+, Multicultural, Gender, Early Careers, and accessibility groups.

  • Pride in Diversity membership: We are proud members of Pride in Diversity and actively participate in the Australian Workplace Equality Index.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Join us and be part of a company that truly cares about its people and community!

How to apply

To apply for this role, follow the links.

BOQ Group is committed to diversity and an inclusive workforce. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People are encouraged to apply.

We celebrate, value and include people of all backgrounds, gender and expressions, sexualities, cultures, bodies and abilities. When you apply, you are welcome to tell us the pronouns you use and please let us know any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

If you are successful for a role with BOQ Group, it is a condition of employment that background screening is completed to ensure that the Bank complies with its obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing Act. These checks may include, but are not limited to identity, verification, reference checks, criminal background checks, immigration checks, verification of academic qualifications, bankruptcy checks.

Please no agency applications.

data.title: Commercial Settlements Officer
data.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Commercial Settlements Officer, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring lending transactions are settled accurately, efficiently and on time.
You’ll manage settlements end-to-end across a range of lending products, ensuring all documentation, conditions and funding requirements are met prior to release. This includes reviewing legal and settlement documents, validating supporting evidence (such as security, insurance and ownership documentation), and ensuring all records are complete and accurately captured in system.
You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to resolve outstanding items ahead of settlement, keeping communication clear, proactive and professional to ensure smooth execution.
A strong focus on risk and compliance is essential in this role. You’ll ensure all activities align with internal policies and regulatory requirements, including privacy, AML and responsible lending obligations, while consistently meeting service level timeframes.
This role sits within the broader lending operations environment and supports the final stage of the lending lifecycle, contributing to a seamless and positive experience for customers and stakeholders alike.

About You

You are highly organised and detail-oriented, and you thrive in a structured, process-driven environment where accuracy matters. You take pride in getting things right the first time and bring a calm, methodical approach to managing multiple settlements and competing deadlines.

You have experience in lending operations, settlements or broader financial services administration, and while exposure to commercial lending would be advantageous, it’s not essential. You’re confident working with systems, have strong numeracy and literacy skills, and understand the importance of maintaining clean, accurate data and documentation.

You communicate clearly and professionally, building effective relationships with a range of internal stakeholders and external partners. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance your well-being, provide financial security, and foster a sense of community and inclusion. Here are just some of the fantastic perks you can enjoy as part of our team:

Flexible working arrangement - Balance your work and personal life with ease.

Discounted financial products - Enjoy exclusive rates on our financial services across the Group.

Salary sacrificing options - Maximise your take-home pay with our salary packaging options.

Paid parental leave with no minimum requirements - Spend quality time with your new family member without any worries.

Purchase additional annual leave - Need more time off? You can buy extra leave days.

Discounted private health insurance plan - Take care of your health with our special rates.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access confidential support for personal and professional challenges for you and your family

Access to employee network groups - Connect with peers through our First Nations Reconciliation, LGBTQIA+, Multicultural, Gender, Early Careers, and accessibility groups.

Pride in Diversity membership: We are proud members of Pride in Diversity and actively participate in the Australian Workplace Equality Index.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Join us and be part of a company that truly cares about its people and community!

How to apply

To apply for this role, follow the links.

BOQ Group is committed to diversity and an inclusive workforce. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People are encouraged to apply.

We celebrate, value and include people of all backgrounds, gender and expressions, sexualities, cultures, bodies and abilities. When you apply, you are welcome to tell us the pronouns you use and please let us know any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

If you are successful for a role with BOQ Group, it is a condition of employment that background screening is completed to ensure that the Bank complies with its obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing Act. These checks may include, but are not limited to identity, verification, reference checks, criminal background checks, immigration checks, verification of academic qualifications, bankruptcy checks.

Please no agency applications.
data.companyDescription: Bank of Queensland (branded BOQ) is an Australian retail bank headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland. The bank is one of the oldest financial institutions in Queensland,  with a network of 252 branches, including 78 corporate branches and 166 Owner Managed branches. Following the Home Building Society and Pioneer mergers, it now has more than 650,000 customers.In 2007, customer satisfaction with the bank was placed at 88%.

data.title: Administration Assistant
data.descriptionHtml:
Role: Administration Assistant

Location: Coconut Grove, 0810, NT

Centre: Goodstart Nightcliff

Employment Type: Permanent. Part-time 20 Hours per week

Pay: $37.56 p/h + Super

Provide a warm welcome to children and families while supporting your centre team
Competitive pay above the national award rates
Get 15% discount off your childcare gap fees

Are you looking for a chance to use your customer service skills to make a difference? Whether you’re an experienced administrator or you think you’ve got the skills to excel in this role, we’d love to talk to you about which of our amazing opportunities would be the best fit for you.

In this role, you will:
Support the Centre Director to prioritise and build the centre’s attendance pipeline – Experience or confidence with social media platforms is advantageous
Deliver a high standard of customer service, including responding to enquiries in a friendly and professional manner
Perform key business administration tasks – Debt Management experience is essential
Build and maintain strong relationships with families

What Goodstart can offer you:
Competitive pay above the national award rates
15% discount off your childcare fees and up to 6 weeks paid parental leave
Fitness Passport - access to gyms and pools for you and your family at a heavily discounted price
Paid professional development
Two wellbeing days included in your personal leave per year
Free annual flu shot (optional)
Option to purchase extra leave for even greater work life balance
First Nations Support and Cultural Leave
Retail discounts on insurance, travel and technology
Uniform allowance and employee referral program

Current NT Working with Children Check

Click ‘Apply Now’ and submit your application.

We review applications as they are submitted. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible for your best chance to progress to the next stage of the process.

At Goodstart we are deeply committed to Reconciliation and encourage Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people to apply. For further information and support email deadlycareers@goodstart.org.au

We know that Goodstarters from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences strengthen our teams and help us grow. data.title: Uniform Shop Supervisor
data.descriptionHtml:
AI Job Summary

  • Minimum 2 years experience working in a supervisor role.
  • Diploma/Certificate or higher in Customer Service or Business Administration.
  • Hold a current Drivers Licence and Working with Children Check (or willing to obtain).

Sign up or log in to analyse my fit

Role Type

On-site • Permanent • Part-time • Entry Level

Description

About Alinta Apparel

Alinta Apparel is a quality bespoke school uniform and sportswear manufacturer and retailer with offices across Australia and New Zealand.

As one of the most trusted sources of uniform solutions in the industry, Alinta provides a quality and consistent range of apparel alongside an agile retail and wholesale partnership offering.

About The Role

We are currently looking for a permanent part-time supervisor to assist in running our uniform shops at our Flinders Christian College Carrum Downs & Tyabb campuses. This role is perfect for someone who loves engaging with customers, has a good eye for detail and is committed to providing exceptional service for our customers by assisting with their purchases and providing information and advice on uniform sizing and requirements to create a welcoming shop experience.

The successful applicant is required to hold a Current Drivers Licence and Working with Children Check (or willing to obtain).

Main duties will include:

  • Oversee the day to day operations of our uniform shops
  • Answer basic customer enquiries via email, phone and in-store.
  • Operating the POS system and processing sales transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Restocking shelves and maintaining store presentation.
  • Stocktaking and Ordering
  • Fitting student uniforms.
  • Reconciling the till
  • Liaising with Head Office and key stakeholders within our schools
  • Manage shop cleanliness and presentation within our stores
  • Train new staff
  • Implement and follow Alinta policies and procedures

About You

You will be a friendly and welcoming individual who enjoys working as a cohesive team member, with a strong work ethic and willingness to take on new tasks and responsibilities. You will have an enquiring mind, the desire to understand the business and an ability to stay informed in an environment where there is so much going on. You will also possess the following skills and experience:

  • Minimum 2 years experience working in a supervisor role
  • Diploma Certificate or higher in Customer Service or Business Administration
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Competent in using a POS System
  • Commitment and willingness to go ‘the extra mile’ for our staff and customers
  • An exceptionally friendly and engaging personality
  • A high level of written and oral communication skills
  • A professional mindset and flexibility
  • Exceptional organisational and time management skills to meet deadlines
  • The ability to work autonomously and within a team
  • The ability to develop and maintain long term relationships with stakeholders
  • The ability to problem solve and be a team player
  • A high level of store pride, with particular attention to detail on store cleanliness and presentation

If this sounds like you, apply now!

Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

data.title: Coffee Roaster/Green Bean Loader - Late Shift
data.descriptionHtml:
AI Job Summary

  • Prior experience in food manufacturing.
  • Understanding of SQF, HACCP and GMP with attention to detail, safety and reliability.
  • Current forklift licence.

Sign up or log in to analyse my fit

Role Type

On-site • Permanent • Full-time • Entry Level

Pay Rate

$70,000 AUD – $80,000 AUD (Annum)

Description

Who are Nomad Coffee Group?

Nomad Coffee Group is a collective of people and brands who believe great coffee can make a difference to the everyday. Driven by our shared aspirations, there is always something new to discover and learn.

Our brands include Veneziano Coffee Roasters, Coffee Hit, Black Bag Roasters, and Flight Coffee. From our best-in-class roasteries, we partner with leading cafes across Australia and New Zealand and millions more enjoy our cup everyday at home.

What’s the opportunity?

Operating as Black Bag Roasters we have a purpose-built facility with state-of-the-art equipment. This site is a monumental milestone for Nomad Coffee Group and positions the company for some exciting growth.

We are currently seeking a Coffee Roaster/Green Bean Loader. These coffee roasting positions are the ideal way to progress to the next step of your coffee career. You will have the opportunity to learn from industry leaders and develop into a complete coffee professional.

This is a full-time permanent position you must be available to work Monday to Friday, 6:00pm to 2:30am.

Key facets of the role:

  • Operating Brambati green loading and 600kg Roaster, maintaining a continuous flow of product. + achieving production targets.
  • Preparing and completing accurate records for QC and maintenance.
  • Receiving, moving, checking, and storing all green bean goods between the warehouse, green bean storage facility and holding bins;
  • Effectively communicate with production supervisors and roasters on roasting schedules to determine beans required/queuing arrangements
  • Safely operating the forklift and other industrial tools;
  • Committed to safety and quality assurance, and SQF procedures.
  • Utilising and analysing roasting software.
  • General cleaning and housekeeping.

What skills and knowledge do I need?

  • Prior experience in food manufacturing.
  • Previous roasting experience and coffee quality knowledge is prefered but not essential.
  • A mechanically-minded individual with a high aptitude in automated equipment operation.
  • An understanding of SQF, HACCP and GMP with strong attention to detail, safety and reliability.
  • Committed to quality in a high-volume environment.
  • Ability to follow policy, procedures and instructions.
  • Confidence using technology & systems.
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work autonomously and meet deadlines under pressure in fast-moving environment.
  • A high level of communication, organisational, time-management and problem-solving skills
  • Current forklift licence

What’s in it for you?

You’ll be working for a unique coffee business with large scale resources combined with a fast entrepreneurial decision-making pace. Our people and professional development power our growth.

  • Unique coffee business with large scale resources, with agile culture:
  • Competitive remuneration package:
  • Part of a global business with expansion plans:
  • Friendly and supportive management team:
  • The opportunity to be part of a business with a focus on sustainability and well-being:
  • RDO’s

If this sounds like the perfect role for you, what are you waiting for? Submit your resume now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Company Overview

At Minor DKL Food Group, we combine global operational excellence with a passion for innovation and community. Whether you’re interested in franchised restaurant operations or the creative, purpose-driven world of specialty coffee, we offer diverse roles that empower you to grow and make a positive impact. If you want to further your hospitality career at The Coffee Club—or explore the sustainable, artisanal realm of specialty coffee with Nomad Coffee Group, our proudly B Corp certified specialty coffee arm—there’s a place for you here. Discover a career where every cup, every service, and every experience contributes to our shared success. Join us and be part of a team that’s driving change in the world of coffee and hospitality.

data.title: Part Time Sales Team Member - Bathurst
data.descriptionHtml:
Let's get to know each other

WHO ARE WE?

At Fantastic Furniture, we're all about making life fantastic for our team and customers.

Our success is driven by our people; an incredibly talented team across multiple disciplines (both in-store and behind the scenes) with an unwavering passion for helping our customers create a home they love.

We are learners, collaborators and changemakers.
We prioritise personal growth to enhance our collective capability and see our business flourish. We value unique perspectives, and actively work together to achieve better results. Most importantly, we create and inspire continual transformation, because our future depends on it.

Making the decision to join us is making the decision to work with a team of fun, talented and super passionate team members keen to see you and our business succeed.

ABOUT YOUR NEW ROLE?

An exciting opportunity for a Part Time Retail Team Member is now available at our Bathurst store.

Our Retail Team Members are at the forefront of making life fantastic for our customers by providing an exceptional experience at every touch point. In this varied role, you will have an opportunity to learn all store operations, (including further exposure to our back of house operation), work collaboratively with passionate team members and explore plenty of opportunities to advance your career.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for team members who are passionate about delighting customers, want to grow their career, and can be relied on to support our teams - sometimes at short notice.

You may bring with you some experience from a sales/customer service, retail or hospitality background, but we are also interested in speaking to people who are keen to bring transferable skills into a retail setting (full training will be provided).

Join our team and embark on a journey of personal and professional growth! At our company, we prioritize investing in our people to help you thrive in your career.

Here's what you can expect:

  • ; Education and Development: We believe in continuous learning. That's why we offer you the opportunity to complete a Certificate III in Retail, fully sponsored by us. You'll gain valuable skills that will benefit you throughout your career.
  • ; Generous Staff Discounts: Enjoy exclusive discounts on our Fantastic Furniture products, making your home even more fabulous. We believe in sharing the perks with our team.
  • ; Work-Life Balance: We're dedicated to ensuring you have a healthy work/life balance. Flexibility is at the core of our culture, enabling you to achieve both personal and professional success.
  • ; Health and Wellbeing: Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of health and wellness programs to help you stay at your best, both physically and mentally.
  • ; Career Advancement: We're committed to your growth. Our programs are designed to support your development in your current role and help you reach your future career aspirations.

If you believe we could be your ideal match, we'd love to have a conversation with you! Your journey to a rewarding career starts here.

Fantastic Furniture is committed to responding to every applicant. We look forward to hearing from you!

data.title: Water and Sewer Assistant Operator
data.descriptionHtml:
Macksville, Australia

Reference: 6893741


  • Permanent full-time position
  • Work/life balance (8.5 day fortnight)
  • Weekly salary of $1240.53 to $1428.73 (including Level 2 Adverse Working Conditions allowance)
  • 12% superannuation with your choice of fund
  • Generous leave entitlements including long service leave after 5 years

About Us

Situated on the mid-north coast of NSW, just half an hour's drive south of Coffs Harbour, the Nambucca Valley boasts an idyllic natural environment with stunning beaches, pristine waterways and tranquil rainforests. The region's towns are vibrant, friendly country communities boasting modern and convenient services with plenty to see and do.

At Nambucca Valley Council, we strive for a culture where our team of around 150 employees feel valued and supported at work.

The Opportunity

As a member of the Water and Sewerage team, you will be providing an essential service to our community by performing maintenance and construction works on our water supply and sewerage reticulation systems.

Participation in an on-call roster to respond to after-hours emergencies is a requirement of the position.

Required skills and experience

Ideally you will have experience in the water and wastewater industry, particularly in relation to the installation and maintenance of water supply and wastewater infrastructure. A good level of physical fitness is required as well as a current drivers licence and proficiency in the use of portable electronic devices.

Why work with us?

  • Discounted fitness and pool membership
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program which provides confidential counselling for you and your immediate family
  • Salary packaging options including remote area benefits
  • Uniform and PPE supplied

How to apply

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://nambucca.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies & enter ref code: 6893741.

Applications close 31 May 2026

For further information, please contact: Brett Corven, Manager Water and Sewerage on 0417 271 218.

Nambucca Valley Council is committed to the principles of employment equity and diversity and encourages applications from people of all ages and backgrounds. If you have a disability and need to request any adjustments to assist with the application process, or to discuss workplace adjustments you may require, please contact the HR team on 02 6568 2555.

Council also recognises the skills and attributes of veterans and welcomes applications from ex-service personnel.



Applications Close: 31 May 2026

Salary packaging options including remote area benefits
Uniform and PPE supplied

How to apply

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://nambucca.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies & enter ref code: 6893741.

Applications close 31 May 2026

For further information, please contact: Brett Corven, Manager Water and Sewerage on 0417 271 218.

Nambucca Valley Council is committed to the principles of employment equity and diversity and encourages applications from people of all ages and backgrounds. If you have a disability and need to request any adjustments to assist with the application process, or to discuss workplace adjustments you may require, please contact the HR team on 02 6568 2555.

Council also recognises the skills and attributes of veterans and welcomes applications from ex-service personnel.

Applications Close: 31 May 2026
